`apps\web\src\app\api\auth\signup\route.ts`:

```ts
import { signUpSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, route } from '@/lib/api';
import { limitAuthAttempt } from '@/lib/auth-limits';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/**
 * Sign-up with e-mail, password and pseudo. When e-mail confirmation is enabled on the
 * Supabase project, no session is returned and the user must click the confirmation link.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const { email, password, username } = await parseBody(req, signUpSchema);
  await limitAuthAttempt(req, email);
  const admin = adminClient();

  const { data: taken } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id')
    .eq('username', username)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (taken) throw new ApiError('username_taken', 409);

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
    email,
    password,
    options: {
      emailRedirectTo: new URL('/auth/callback', clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL).toString(),
    },
  });
  if (error) {
    if (error.status === 429) throw new ApiError('rate_limited', 429);
    if (error.code === 'weak_password') throw new ApiError('password_too_weak', 422);
    // Same answer whether or not the address exists (no account enumeration).
    throw new ApiError('signup_failed', 400);
  }
  if (!data.user) throw new ApiError('signup_failed', 400);

  // Trusted server-side write: the user id comes from the Auth server response.
  const { error: nameError } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .update({ username })
    .eq('id', data.user.id)
    .is('username', null);
  if (nameError?.code === '23505') throw new ApiError('username_taken', 409);

  return json({ ok: true, needsConfirmation: data.session === null }, 201);
});
```

```ts
import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  createClient: vi.fn(),
  getUser: vi.fn(),
  deleteComment: vi.fn(),
  commentIdEq: vi.fn(),
  authorIdEq: vi.fn(),
  select: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/server', () => ({
  createClient: mocks.createClient,
  getUser: mocks.getUser,
}));

import { DELETE } from './route';

const commentId = 'e0a80123-4567-489a-8bcd-ef0123456789';
const userId = 'd0a80123-4567-489a-8bcd-ef0123456789';

function request(origin = 'http://localhost') {
  return new NextRequest(`http://localhost/api/comments/${commentId}`, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: {
      origin,
      host: 'localhost',
    },
  });
}

describe('comment deletion route', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mocks.getUser.mockResolvedValue({ id: userId });
    mocks.createClient.mockResolvedValue({
      from: () => ({ delete: mocks.deleteComment }),
    });
    mocks.deleteComment.mockReturnValue({ eq: mocks.commentIdEq });
    mocks.commentIdEq.mockReturnValue({ eq: mocks.authorIdEq });
    mocks.authorIdEq.mockReturnValue({ select: mocks.select });
    mocks.select.mockResolvedValue({ data: [{ id: commentId }], error: null });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('requires authentication before creating a database client', async () => {
    mocks.getUser.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const response = await DELETE(request(), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: commentId }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(401);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: 'unauthorized' });
    expect(mocks.createClient).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects a cross-origin deletion before authentication or storage', async () => {
    const response = await DELETE(request('https://other.example'), {
      params: Promise.resolve({ id: commentId }),
    });

    expect(response.status).toBe(403);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: 'bad_origin' });
    expect(mocks.getUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mocks.createClient).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('deletes only the comment owned by the authenticated user', async () => {
    const response = await DELETE(request(), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: commentId }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(mocks.commentIdEq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('id', commentId);
    expect(mocks.authorIdEq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('author_id', userId);
  });

  it('returns not found when no comment belonging to the user was deleted', async () => {
    mocks.select.mockResolvedValue({ data: [], error: null });

    const response = await DELETE(request(), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: commentId }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(404);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: 'not_found' });
  });

  it('rejects a malformed comment identifier', async () => {
    const response = await DELETE(request(), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: 'invalid' }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(422);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toMatchObject({ error: 'invalid_input' });
    expect(mocks.createClient).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** The author deletes their own comment (RLS: comments_delete_own). */
export const DELETE = route<{ params: Promise<{ id: string }> }>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const deleted = unwrap(
    await supabase.from('comments').delete().eq('id', id).eq('author_id', user.id).select('id'),
  );
  if (deleted.length === 0) throw new ApiError('not_found', 404);
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\api\feed\route.ts`:

```ts
import { decodeCursor, encodeCursor, FEED_SECTION_CATEGORIES, feedQuerySchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { hydrate, type PublicVideoRow } from '@/lib/feed';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { getUser } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const PAGE = 8;
const querySchema = feedQuerySchema
  .extend({
    limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(20).optional(),
  })
  .refine((query) => !(query.category && query.section), {
    message: 'category_and_section_conflict',
  });

/**
 * Hyperlocal feed, cursor-paginated. The query position is used for this request only: it is
 * neither stored nor logged. Results carry fuzzed positions and 100 m distance buckets.
 */
export const GET = route(async (req) => {
  const q = querySchema.parse(Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams));
  const cursor = q.cursor ? decodeCursor(q.cursor) : null;
  if (q.cursor && !cursor) throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  if (cursor && cursor.sort !== q.sort) throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  const ref = cursor?.ref ?? new Date().toISOString();
  const limit = q.limit ?? PAGE;
  const sectionCategories = q.section ? FEED_SECTION_CATEGORIES[q.section] : null;

  const rows = unwrap(
    await adminClient().rpc('nearby_videos', {
      p_lat: q.lat,
      p_lng: q.lng,
      p_radius_m: q.radius,
      p_category: q.category,
      p_cursor_score: cursor?.score,
      p_cursor_id: cursor?.id,
      p_ref_time: ref,
      p_limit: limit,
      p_sort_mode: q.sort,
      p_categories: sectionCategories ?? undefined,
      p_reduced_categories: q.reducedCategories,
    }),
  );
  const user = await getUser();
  const hiddenIds = new Set<string>();
  if (user?.id) {
    const { data } = await adminClient()
      .from('hidden_videos' as never)
      .select('video_id')
      .eq('user_id', user.id);
    for (const row of data ?? []) hiddenIds.add((row as { video_id: string }).video_id);
  }
  const items = (await hydrate(rows as PublicVideoRow[], user?.id ?? null)).filter(
    (item) => !hiddenIds.has(item.id),
  );
  const last = rows.at(-1);
  const nextCursor =
    rows.length === limit && last
      ? encodeCursor({ score: last.score, id: last.id, ref, sort: q.sort })
      : null;
  return json({ items, nextCursor });
});
```

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { signMedia } from '@/lib/media';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const payloadSchema = z.object({ videoId: z.string().uuid() });

export const GET = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const videoId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('videoId');
  const supabase = await createClient();

  if (videoId) {
    const id = z.string().uuid().parse(videoId);

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('hidden_videos')
      .select('video_id, created_at')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .eq('video_id', id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error) unwrap({ data: null, error });
    return json({ hidden: !!data });
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('hidden_videos')
    .select('video_id, created_at')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
  const rows = unwrap({ data, error }) ?? [];
  if (!rows.length) return json({ ids: [], videos: [] });

  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: videoRows, error: videoError } = await admin
    .from('videos')
    .select(
      'id, author_id, category, caption, offer_terms, poster_path, status, published_at, expires_at, is_merchant',
    )
    .in(
      'id',
      rows.map((row) => row.video_id),
    );
  const videos = unwrap({ data: videoRows, error: videoError }) ?? [];
  const authorIds = [...new Set(videos.map((video) => video.author_id))];
  const { data: profiles, error: profilesError } = authorIds.length
    ? await admin.from('profiles').select('id, username, role').in('id', authorIds)
    : { data: [], error: null };
  const authors = new Map(
    (unwrap({ data: profiles, error: profilesError }) ?? []).map((profile) => [
      profile.id,
      { username: profile.username, isMerchant: profile.role === 'merchant' },
    ]),
  );
  const posters = await signMedia(
    videos
      .filter((video) => video.status === 'active' && new Date(video.expires_at) > new Date())
      .map((video) => video.poster_path),
  );
  const videosById = new Map(videos.map((video) => [video.id, video]));

  return json({
    ids: rows.map((row) => row.video_id),
    videos: rows.map((row) => {
      const video = videosById.get(row.video_id);
      return {
        id: row.video_id,
        savedAt: new Date(row.created_at).getTime(),
        category: video?.category ?? null,
        caption: video?.caption ?? null,
        offerTerms: video?.offer_terms ?? '',
        authorName: video ? (authors.get(video.author_id)?.username ?? null) : null,
        posterUrl: video?.poster_path ? (posters.get(video.poster_path) ?? null) : null,
        status: video?.status ?? null,
        publishedAt: video?.published_at ?? null,
        expiresAt: video?.expires_at ?? null,
        isMerchant: video ? (authors.get(video.author_id)?.isMerchant ?? false) : false,
      };
    }),
  });
});

export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { videoId } = await parseBody(req, payloadSchema);
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const { error } = await supabase.from('hidden_videos').insert({
    user_id: user.id,
    video_id: videoId,
  });
  if (error && error.code !== '23505') unwrap({ data: null, error });

  const { data, error: idsError } = await supabase
    .from('hidden_videos')
    .select('video_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id);
  const ids = unwrap({ data, error: idsError }) ?? [];

  return json({ hidden: true, ids: ids.map((entry) => entry.video_id) });
});

export const DELETE = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { videoId } = await parseBody(req, payloadSchema);
  const supabase = await createClient();

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('hidden_videos')
    .delete()
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('video_id', videoId);
  if (error) unwrap({ data: null, error });

  const { data, error: idsError } = await supabase
    .from('hidden_videos')
    .select('video_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id);
  const ids = unwrap({ data, error: idsError }) ?? [];

  return json({ hidden: false, ids: ids.map((entry) => entry.video_id) });
});
```

```ts
import { profileUpdateSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const imagePath = z
  .string()
  .max(120)
  .regex(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}\/(avatar|cover)\/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(jpg|png|webp)$/i);
const schema = profileUpdateSchema.pick({ username: true, bio: true }).extend({
  avatarPath: imagePath.nullable().optional(),
  coverPath: imagePath.nullable().optional(),
});

/** Owner updates their public profile; RLS and column grants restrict editable fields. */
export const PATCH = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const patch = await parseBody(req, schema);
  for (const path of [patch.avatarPath, patch.coverPath]) {
    if (path && !path.startsWith(`${user.id}/`)) throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  }

  const admin = adminClient();
  const previous = unwrap<{ avatar_path: string | null; cover_path: string | null }>(
    await admin.from('profiles').select('avatar_path, cover_path').eq('id', user.id).single(),
  );
  const { avatarPath, coverPath, ...textPatch } = patch;
  const dbPatch = {
    ...textPatch,
    ...(avatarPath !== undefined ? { avatar_path: avatarPath } : {}),
    ...(coverPath !== undefined ? { cover_path: coverPath } : {}),
  };
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const updated = unwrap(
    await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update(dbPatch)
      .eq('id', user.id)
      .select('username, bio, avatar_path, cover_path')
      .single(),
  );
  const obsolete = [
    avatarPath !== undefined && previous.avatar_path !== avatarPath ? previous.avatar_path : null,
    coverPath !== undefined && previous.cover_path !== coverPath ? previous.cover_path : null,
  ].filter((path): path is string => path !== null);
  if (obsolete.length) {
    const { error } = await admin.storage.from('profile-images').remove(obsolete);
    if (error) console.error('profile image cleanup failed', error.message);
  }
  return json(updated);
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\api\me\route.ts`:

```ts
import { groupByBucket } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const schema = z.object({ confirm: z.string().min(1).max(40) });

/**
 * Account deletion: files are removed from storage right away (a purge job is also queued as a
 * safety net), then the auth user is deleted, which cascades to every row owned by the user.
 */
export const DELETE = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { confirm } = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: profile } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .select('username, avatar_path, cover_path')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .single();
  if (!profile || (profile.username ?? '') !== confirm.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    throw new ApiError('confirmation_mismatch', 422);
  }

  const paths = unwrap(await admin.rpc('prepare_account_deletion', { p_user: user.id })) ?? [];
  for (const [bucket, list] of groupByBucket(paths)) {
    const { error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).remove(list);
    if (error) console.error('storage removal deferred to purge job', bucket, error.message);
  }
  const profileImages = [profile.avatar_path, profile.cover_path].filter(
    (path): path is string => path !== null,
  );
  if (profileImages.length) {
    const { error } = await admin.storage.from('profile-images').remove(profileImages);
    if (error)
      console.error('profile image removal deferred after account deletion', error.message);
  }

  const { error } = await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(user.id);
  if (error) throw new ApiError('internal', 500);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  await supabase.auth.signOut();
  return json({ ok: true, deletedFiles: paths.length });
});
```

```ts
import { profileUpdateSchema } from '@nl/shared';

const schema = profileUpdateSchema
  .pick({ defaultRadius: true, locale: true, notifyAlerts: true })

export const PATCH = route(async (req) => {

  const supabase = await createClient();

    await supabase
      .from('user_settings')
      .update({
        ...(body.defaultRadius !== undefined && { default_radius: body.defaultRadius }),
        ...(body.locale !== undefined && { locale: body.locale }),
        ...(body.notifyAlerts !== undefined && { notify_alerts: body.notifyAlerts }),
        ...(body.onboarded && { onboarded_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      })
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .select('default_radius, locale, notify_alerts')
      .single(),

  const res = json(updated);

    res.cookies.set(LOCALE_COOKIE, body.locale, {
      path: '/',
      maxAge: 31_536_000,
      sameSite: 'lax',

});
```

`apps\web\src\app\api\merchant\route.ts`:

```ts
import { sanitizeText } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

function normalizeWebsite(value: string) {
  const trimmed = sanitizeText(value).trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';
  return /^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed) ? trimmed : `https://${trimmed}`;
}

function normalizePhone(value: string) {
  const digits = sanitizeText(value)
    .replace(/[^\d+()\-\s.]/g, '')
    .trim();
  return digits.length > 30 ? digits.slice(0, 30) : digits;
}

const schema = z.object({
  businessName: z.string().transform(sanitizeText).pipe(z.string().min(2).max(80)),
  description: z.string().transform(sanitizeText).pipe(z.string().max(280)).default(''),
  website: z.string().transform(sanitizeText).pipe(z.string().max(200)).default(''),
  phone: z.string().transform(sanitizeText).pipe(z.string().max(30)).default(''),
  address: z.string().transform(sanitizeText).pipe(z.string().max(200)).default(''),
  openingHours: z.string().transform(sanitizeText).pipe(z.string().max(200)).default(''),
});

/** Merchant application (pending until an admin approves it). */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { businessName, description, website, phone, address, openingHours } = await parseBody(
    req,
    schema,
  );
  const normalizedWebsite = normalizeWebsite(website);
  const normalizedPhone = normalizePhone(phone);
  const normalizedAddress = sanitizeText(address).trim();
  const normalizedOpeningHours = sanitizeText(openingHours).trim();
  if (normalizedWebsite && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(normalizedWebsite)) {
    throw new ApiError('invalid_website', 422);
  }
  if (normalizedWebsite) {
    try {
      new URL(normalizedWebsite);
    } catch {
      throw new ApiError('invalid_website', 422);
    }
  }
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const res = await supabase.from('merchant_profiles').insert({
    user_id: user.id,
    business_name: businessName,
    description,
    website: normalizedWebsite,
    phone: normalizedPhone,
    address: normalizedAddress,
    opening_hours: normalizedOpeningHours,
  });
  if (res.error?.code === '23505') throw new ApiError('conflict', 409);
  unwrap(res);
  return json({ status: 'pending' }, 201);
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\api\moderation\route.ts`:

```ts
import { MODERATION_ACTIONS, sanitizeText } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

const cell = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{15}$/);

const schema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  // Same fields as moderationDecisionSchema; "note required to remove" is enforced in SQL.
  z.object({
    type: z.literal('decision'),
    videoId: z.uuid(),
    action: z.enum(MODERATION_ACTIONS),
    note: z.string().max(1000).transform(sanitizeText).default(''),
  }),
  z.object({
    type: z.literal('appeal'),
    appealId: z.uuid(),
    uphold: z.boolean(),
    note: z.string().max(1000).transform(sanitizeText).default(''),
  }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal('apply'), cell }),
]);

/**
 * Moderator actions. Authorization is enforced in SQL (zone moderator or admin, no
 * self-moderation, appeals reviewed by someone else); the actor is the verified session user.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const body = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const admin = adminClient();
  if (body.type === 'decision') {
    const actionId = unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('moderate_video', {
        p_actor: user.id,
        p_video: body.videoId,
        p_kind: body.action,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
    return json({ actionId });
  }
  if (body.type === 'appeal') {
    unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('resolve_appeal', {
        p_reviewer: user.id,
        p_appeal: body.appealId,
        p_uphold: body.uphold,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
    return json({ ok: true });
  }
  unwrap(await admin.rpc('become_zone_moderator', { p_user: user.id, p_cell: body.cell }));
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { pushSubscribeSchema, zoneCell, zoneCenter } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/**
 * Subscribes this browser to alerts for a zone. The submitted position is only used to pick the
 * H3 cell; what is stored is the cell and its centre, never the device position.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { subscription, zone, radius } = await parseBody(req, pushSubscribeSchema);
  const cell = zoneCell(zone);
  const center = zoneCenter(cell);
  // One row per browser endpoint: a browser previously used by another account is re-assigned.
  await adminClient().from('push_subscriptions').delete().eq('endpoint', subscription.endpoint);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  unwrap(
    await supabase.from('push_subscriptions').insert({
      user_id: user.id,
      endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
      p256dh: subscription.keys.p256dh,
      auth: subscription.keys.auth,
      zone_cell: cell,
      zone_center: `SRID=4326;POINT(${center.lng} ${center.lat})`,
      radius_m: radius,
    }),
  );
  return json({ zoneCell: cell }, 201);
});

export const DELETE = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { endpoint } = await parseBody(req, z.object({ endpoint: z.url() }));
  const supabase = await createClient();
  unwrap(
    await supabase
      .from('push_subscriptions')
      .delete()
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .eq('endpoint', endpoint),
  );
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { commentSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { profileImageUrl } from '@/lib/profile-image';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };
const PAGE = 20;
const beforeSchema = z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }).optional();
interface CommentRow {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  created_at: string;
  author_id: string;
  author: { username: string | null; avatar_color: string; avatar_path: string | null } | null;
}

const columns =
  'id, body, created_at, author_id, author:profiles(username, avatar_color, avatar_path)';

function publicComment(row: CommentRow, mine: boolean) {
  return {
    ...row,
    author: row.author
      ? { ...row.author, avatar_url: profileImageUrl(row.author.avatar_path) }
      : null,
    mine,
  };
}

/** Comments, newest first, paginated with a `before` timestamp cursor. */
export const GET = route<Ctx>(async (req, { params }) => {
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const before = beforeSchema.parse(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('before') ?? undefined);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  let query = supabase
    .from('comments')
    .select(columns)
    .eq('video_id', id)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(PAGE);
  if (before) query = query.lt('created_at', before);
  const rows = unwrap(await query);
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  return json({
    comments: rows.map((c) => publicComment(c, c.author_id === data.user?.id)),
    nextBefore: rows.length === PAGE ? (rows.at(-1)?.created_at ?? null) : null,
  });
});

/** Text is sanitised by the schema; RLS checks authorship and ban, a trigger rate-limits. */
export const POST = route<Ctx>(async (req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const { body } = await parseBody(req, commentSchema);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const comment = unwrap<CommentRow>(
    await supabase
      .from('comments')
      .insert({ video_id: id, author_id: user.id, body })
      .select(columns)
      .single(),
  );
  return json(publicComment(comment, true), 201);
});
```

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { hydrate, type PublicVideoRow } from '@/lib/feed';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/** One public video (deep links, map preview, refresh of expired signed URLs). */
export const GET = route<{ params: Promise<{ id: string }> }>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const rows = unwrap(await adminClient().rpc('get_public_video', { p_id: id }));
  if (!rows?.length) throw new ApiError('not_found', 404);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: userData } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const user = userData.user;
  if (user) {
    const { data: hidden, error } = await supabase
      .from('hidden_videos')
      .select('video_id')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .eq('video_id', id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (error) unwrap({ data: null, error });
    if (hidden) throw new ApiError('not_found', 404);
  }
  const [item] = await hydrate(rows as PublicVideoRow[], user?.id ?? null);
  return json(item);
});
```

```ts
import { reportSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/**
 * Report with a reason. RLS forbids reporting one's own or invisible videos; a trigger
 * rate-limits and auto-hides the video at 3 distinct reporters (apply_report_threshold).
 */
export const POST = route<{ params: Promise<{ id: string }> }>(async (req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const { reason, details } = await parseBody(req, reportSchema);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const res = await supabase
    .from('reports')
    .insert({ video_id: id, reporter_id: user.id, reason, details: details ?? '' });
  if (res.error?.code === '23505') throw new ApiError('already_reported', 409);
  unwrap(res);
  return json({ ok: true }, 201);
});
```

```ts
import { groupByBucket } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

const idSchema = z.uuid();

/** Immediate withdrawal by the author: row deleted, files removed now (purge job as backup). */
export const DELETE = route<{ params: Promise<{ id: string }> }>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = idSchema.parse((await params).id);
  const admin = adminClient();
  const paths = unwrap(await admin.rpc('withdraw_video', { p_user: user.id, p_video: id })) ?? [];
  for (const [bucket, list] of groupByBucket(paths)) {
    const { error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).remove(list);
    if (error) console.error('withdraw: storage removal deferred to purge job', error.message);
  }
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\api\videos\[id]\uploaded\route.ts`:

```ts
import { MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, rawPathFor, RAW_BUCKET } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/** Step 3 of a publication: the raw file is verified in storage, then queued for the worker. */
export const POST = route<{ params: Promise<{ id: string }> }>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: video } = await admin
    .from('videos')
    .select('mime_type, status, raw_path')
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('author_id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!video) throw new ApiError('not_found', 404);
  if (video.status !== 'processing' || video.raw_path) return json({ status: video.status });

  const path = rawPathFor(user.id, id, video.mime_type);
  const name = path.split('/')[1] ?? '';
  const { data: files } = await admin.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).list(user.id, { search: name });
  const file = files?.find((f) => f.name === name);
  if (!file) throw new ApiError('upload_missing', 409);
  const size = Number((file.metadata as { size?: number } | null)?.size ?? 0);
  if (size <= 0 || size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) {
    await admin.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).remove([path]);
    throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  }
  unwrap(
    await admin.rpc('enqueue_processing', { p_author: user.id, p_video: id, p_raw_path: path }),
  );
  return json({ status: 'processing' });
});
```

```ts
function request(method: 'DELETE' | 'POST') {
  return new NextRequest(`http://localhost/api/videos/${videoId}/useful`, {
    method,
    headers: {
      origin: 'http://localhost',
      host: 'localhost',
      'content-type': 'application/json',
    },
    ...(method === 'POST' ? { body: '{}' } : {}),
  });
}

describe('useful reaction route', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mocks.getUser.mockResolvedValue({ id: userId });
    mocks.createClient.mockResolvedValue({
      from: (table: string) => {
        if (table === 'reactions') {
          return {
            insert: mocks.insert,
            delete: mocks.deleteReaction,
          };
        }
        return { select: mocks.select };
      },
    });
    mocks.insert.mockResolvedValue({ error: null });
    mocks.deleteReaction.mockReturnValue({ eq: mocks.reactionVideoEq });
    mocks.reactionVideoEq.mockReturnValue({ eq: mocks.reactionUserEq });
    mocks.reactionUserEq.mockResolvedValue({ data: null, error: null });
    mocks.select.mockReturnValue({ eq: mocks.videoEq });
    mocks.videoEq.mockReturnValue({ maybeSingle: mocks.maybeSingle });
    mocks.maybeSingle.mockResolvedValue({ data: { useful_count: 1 }, error: null });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('requires authentication before changing a reaction', async () => {
    mocks.getUser.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const response = await POST(request('POST'), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: videoId }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(401);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: 'unauthorized' });
    expect(mocks.createClient).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('adds a reaction and returns the current count', async () => {
    const response = await POST(request('POST'), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: videoId }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ reacted: true, usefulCount: 1 });
    expect(mocks.insert).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ video_id: videoId, user_id: userId });
  });

  it('treats a duplicate reaction as an idempotent success', async () => {
    mocks.insert.mockResolvedValue({ error: { code: '23505' } });

    const response = await POST(request('POST'), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: videoId }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ reacted: true, usefulCount: 1 });
  });

  it('removes only the current user reaction and returns the current count', async () => {
    mocks.maybeSingle.mockResolvedValue({ data: { useful_count: 0 }, error: null });

    const response = await DELETE(request('DELETE'), {
      params: Promise.resolve({ id: videoId }),
    });

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ reacted: false, usefulCount: 0 });
    expect(mocks.reactionVideoEq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('video_id', videoId);
    expect(mocks.reactionUserEq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user_id', userId);
  });

  it('surfaces counter read failures instead of returning a false zero', async () => {
    const errorSpy = vi.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    mocks.maybeSingle.mockResolvedValue({
      data: null,
      error: { code: 'XX000', message: 'database unavailable' },
    });

    const response = await POST(request('POST'), { params: Promise.resolve({ id: videoId }) });

    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
    await expect(response.json()).resolves.toEqual({ error: 'internal' });
    expect(errorSpy).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function usefulCount(supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>, id: string) {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('videos')
    .select('useful_count')
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (error) unwrap({ data, error });
  return data?.useful_count ?? 0;
}

/** "Utile": one per user and video, enforced by RLS + primary key. */
export const POST = route<Ctx>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const res = await supabase.from('reactions').insert({ video_id: id, user_id: user.id });
  if (res.error && res.error.code !== '23505') unwrap(res);
  return json({ reacted: true, usefulCount: await usefulCount(supabase, id) });
});

export const DELETE = route<Ctx>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  unwrap(await supabase.from('reactions').delete().eq('video_id', id).eq('user_id', user.id));
  return json({ reacted: false, usefulCount: await usefulCount(supabase, id) });
});
```

```ts
    expect(retry.status).toBe(201);

    await expect(retry.json()).resolves.toMatchObject({ videoId });
    expect(mocks.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mocks.rpc).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(

    );
    expect(mocks.rpc).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(
      2,
      'create_video',
      expect.objectContaining({ p_request_id: requestId }),
    );
  });
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\api\videos\route.ts`:

```ts
import {
  computeExpiresAt,
  createVideoSchema,
  rawPathFor,
  RAW_BUCKET,
  realtimeCell,
  zoneCell,
} from '@nl/shared';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/**
 * Step 1 of a publication: validates everything server-side (schema, accuracy ≤ 500 m,
 * plausible position, coherence with the previous publication, rate limit, merchant quota)
 * and reserves the video row. The client then uploads the raw file (TUS) to `uploadPath`.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const input = await parseBody(req, createVideoSchema);
  let expiresAt: Date;
  try {
    expiresAt = computeExpiresAt(input.category, new Date(), {
      eventEndsAt: input.eventEndsAt ? new Date(input.eventEndsAt) : undefined,
      merchantHours: input.merchantHours,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new ApiError((error as Error).message, 422);
  }
  const point = { lat: input.lat, lng: input.lng };
  const videoId = unwrap(
    await adminClient().rpc('create_video', {
      p_author: user.id,
      p_category: input.category,
      p_caption: input.caption,
      p_lat: input.lat,
      p_lng: input.lng,
      p_accuracy: input.accuracy,
      p_h3_cell: zoneCell(point),
      p_realtime_cell: realtimeCell(point),
      p_mime: input.mimeType,
      p_duration_ms: input.durationMs,
      p_expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
      p_request_id: input.requestId ?? crypto.randomUUID(),
      p_offer_terms: input.offerTerms ?? '',
    }),
  );
  if (!videoId) throw new ApiError('internal', 500);
  return json(
    { videoId, bucket: RAW_BUCKET, uploadPath: rawPathFor(user.id, videoId, input.mimeType) },
    201,
  );
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\auth\callback\route.ts`:

```ts
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';
import { safeNext } from '@/lib/redirect';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** Magic link landing: exchanges the PKCE code for a session, then routes the new user. */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const site = clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL;
  const code = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('code');
  const next = safeNext(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('next'));
  if (!code) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=callback', site));

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
  if (error || !data.user) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=callback', site));

  const [{ data: profile }, { data: settings }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('profiles').select('username').eq('id', data.user.id).single(),
    supabase.from('user_settings').select('onboarded_at').eq('user_id', data.user.id).single(),
  ]);
  const target = profile?.username ? next : `/bienvenue?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`;
  const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(target, site));
  // An account already onboarded elsewhere skips the onboarding on this new device.
  if (settings?.onboarded_at) {
    res.cookies.set(ONBOARDED_COOKIE, '1', { path: '/', maxAge: 31_536_000, sameSite: 'lax' });
  }
  return res;
}
```

```tsx
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { UsernameForm } from '@/components/auth/UsernameForm';
import { LogoMark } from '@/components/Logo';
import { safeNext } from '@/lib/redirect';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';

export default async function WelcomePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string }>;
}) {
  const next = safeNext((await searchParams).next);
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (!viewer) redirect(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`);
  if (viewer.username) redirect(next);
  const t = await getTranslations('auth.welcome');
  const after = viewer.settings.onboarded ? next : `/onboarding?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`;
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh max-w-md flex-col justify-center gap-8 p-6">
      <div className="flex justify-center">
        <LogoMark size={56} />
      </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
        </div>
        <UsernameForm next={after} />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { CaptureFlow } from '@/components/capture/CaptureFlow';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return { title: (await getTranslations('capture'))('title') };
}

export default async function RecordPage() {
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (!viewer) redirect('/login?next=/filmer');
  if (!viewer.username) redirect('/bienvenue?next=/filmer');
  const { data: merchant } = await adminClient()
    .from('merchant_profiles')
    .select('status')
    .eq('user_id', viewer.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  return (
    <main id="main">
      <CaptureFlow isMerchant={merchant?.status === 'approved'} />
    </main>
  );
```
```css
}

@media (max-width: 360px) {

:root[data-theme='light'] .border-white\/\[0\.06\],

}

:root[data-theme='light'] input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']),
:root[data-theme='light'] textarea,

@utility glow {

    0 10px 30px -10px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.7),

}

@utility text-brand {
  background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #38bdf8 0%, #2563eb 50%, #0ea5e9 100%);
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}

/* Admin workspace: same dark identity as the app, with a denser layout. */
.admin-theme {
  min-height: 100%;
}

.admin-sidebar-link[aria-current='page'] {
  background-image: var(--brand-gradient);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.8);
}

.app-shell {
  isolation: isolate;
}

.app-sidebar {
  border-right: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08);
  background:
    radial-gradient(30rem 24rem at -70% -12%, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.2), transparent 70%),
    rgb(9 13 32 / 0.94);
  box-shadow: 12px 0 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
  animation: sidebar-enter 420ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) both;
}

.app-sidebar nav > * {
  animation: sidebar-item-enter 360ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) both;
}

.app-sidebar nav > :nth-child(1) {
  animation-delay: 70ms;
}

.app-sidebar nav > :nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 120ms;
}

.app-sidebar nav > :nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 170ms;
}

.app-sidebar-link {
  color: var(--color-fog);
  transition:
    background-color 160ms ease,
    color 160ms ease,
    transform 160ms ease,
    box-shadow 160ms ease;
}

.app-sidebar-link svg {
  transition: transform 160ms ease;
}

.app-sidebar-link:hover {
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06);
  color: #fff;
  transform: translateX(2px);
}

.app-sidebar-link:hover svg {
  transform: scale(1.08);
}

.app-sidebar-link[aria-current='page'] {
  border: 1px solid rgb(56 189 248 / 0.22);
  background:
    linear-gradient(110deg, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.2), rgb(14 165 233 / 0.08)), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #38bdf8;
  transition:
    background-color 160ms ease,
    color 160ms ease,
    transform 160ms ease,
    box-shadow 200ms ease;
}

.app-record-link {
  background: var(--brand-gradient);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -12px rgb(14 165 233 / 0.75);
  transition:
    box-shadow 180ms ease,
    transform 180ms ease;
}

.app-record-link svg {
  transition: transform 200ms ease;
}

.app-record-link:hover svg {
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.app-record-link:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -10px rgb(14 165 233 / 0.8);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.app-sidebar-note {
  border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08);
  background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.035);
}

@keyframes sidebar-enter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-8px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes sidebar-item-enter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(5px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.feed-stage {
  height: calc(100svh - 3.5rem - env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  margin-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
}

.discover-hero {
  background:
    radial-gradient(30rem 24rem at 88% 40%, rgb(14 165 233 / 0.16), transparent 72%),
    radial-gradient(35rem 24rem at 10% 110%, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.16), transparent 72%),
    var(--color-panel);
}

.discover-orbit {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 3%;
  width: min(36vw, 22rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.discover-orbit > span:not(.discover-orbit-pin) {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 8%;
  border: 1px solid rgb(56 189 248 / 0.18);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.discover-orbit > span:nth-child(2) {
  inset: 20%;
  border-style: dashed;
  animation: orbit-turn 40s linear infinite;
}

.discover-orbit > span:nth-child(3) {
  inset: 32%;
  border-color: rgb(37 99 235 / 0.32);
}

.discover-orbit-pin {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #7dd3fc;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgb(56 189 248 / 0.45));
}

.discover-category {

    linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.035), transparent 60%), var(--color-panel);
}

.discover-category:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -24px rgb(14 165 233 / 0.75);
}

.discover-feature {
  background: linear-gradient(110deg, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.09), transparent 72%), var(--color-panel);
}

.discover-feature-map {
  background: linear-gradient(110deg, rgb(14 165 233 / 0.12), transparent 72%), var(--color-panel);
}

.discover-feature:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -24px rgb(14 165 233 / 0.7);
}

@keyframes orbit-turn {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .feed-stage {
    width: min(calc(100% - 1rem), 84rem);
    height: calc(100svh - 1rem);
    margin: 0.5rem auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08);
    border-radius: 1.5rem;
    background:
      radial-gradient(34rem 28rem at 50% 45%, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.12), transparent 72%),
      rgb(255 255 255 / 0.018);
  }

  /* Logo and filters in the stage's top-left corner, radius in the top-right. */
  .feed-header {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-areas: 'alerts categories radius';
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
    align-items: start;
    column-gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 0.5rem 2rem;
  }

  .feed-header-controls {
    display: contents;
  }

  .feed-header-controls > :first-child {
    grid-area: alerts;
  }

  .feed-category-filters {
    grid-area: categories;
  }

  .feed-category-options {
    right: 0;
    left: auto;
  }

  .feed-radius {
    grid-area: radius;
    justify-self: end;
    width: max-content;
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .feed-radius-options {
    right: 0;
    left: auto;
  }

  /* Desktop: maximize the video stage while preserving the 9:16 player and edge overlays. */
  .feed-list {
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }

  .feed-list .video-card > video {
    width: auto;
    max-width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 9 / 16;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }

  /* Just right of the video column (stage height = 100svh - 2rem). */
  .feed-nav {
    left: calc(50% + (100svh - 2rem) * 9 / 32 + 1.5rem);
  }
}

:root[data-theme='light'] .app-sidebar {
  border-right-color: rgb(23 32 51 / 0.1);
  background:
    radial-gradient(30rem 24rem at -70% -12%, rgb(37 99 235 / 0.12), transparent 70%),

:root[data-theme='light'] .app-sidebar-link:hover {

:root[data-theme='light'] .app-sidebar-link[aria-current='page'] {

:root[data-theme='light'] .app-sidebar-note {

}

:root[data-theme='light'] .bottom-nav {

  background-color: rgb(7 10 28 / 0.94);
}

:root[data-theme='light'] .discover-hero {
  border-color: rgb(23 32 51 / 0.1);
}

:root[data-theme='light'] .discover-category,
:root[data-theme='light'] .discover-feature,
:root[data-theme='light'] .discover-feature-map {
  border-color: rgb(23 32 51 / 0.1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .record-button {
    animation: none;
    transition: none;
  }

  .discover-orbit > span:nth-child(2) {
    animation: none;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata, Viewport } from 'next';
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from 'next-intl';
import { Inter } from 'next/font/google';
import { getLocale, getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { PwaShell } from '@/components/pwa/PwaShell';
import { ThemeProvider } from '@/components/theme/ThemeProvider';
import './globals.css';

const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'], variable: '--font-inter', display: 'swap' });

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  const t = await getTranslations('common');
  return {
    title: { default: t('appName'), template: `%s · ${t('appName')}` },
    description: t('tagline'),
    applicationName: t('appName'),
    appleWebApp: { capable: true, title: t('appName'), statusBarStyle: 'black-translucent' },
    formatDetection: { telephone: false },
    icons: { icon: '/icons/icon-192.png', apple: '/icons/apple-touch-icon.png' },
  };
}

export const viewport: Viewport = {
  themeColor: '#070a1c',
  width: 'device-width',
  initialScale: 1,
  viewportFit: 'cover',
};

export default async function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const locale = await getLocale();
  return (
    <html lang={locale} className={inter.variable}>
      <body className="font-sans antialiased">
        <NextIntlClientProvider>
          <ThemeProvider>
            <PwaShell
              disable={
                process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SW_IN_DEV !== '1'
              }
            >
              {children}
            </PwaShell>
          </ThemeProvider>
        </NextIntlClientProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';

const SLUGS = ['confidentialite', 'conditions', 'regles', 'contact'] as const;
type Slug = (typeof SLUGS)[number];
const isSlug = (s: string): s is Slug => (SLUGS as readonly string[]).includes(s);

type Params = { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> };

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Params): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  if (!isSlug(slug)) return {};
  return { title: (await getTranslations('legal'))(`pages.${slug}.title`) };
}

export default async function LegalPage({ params }: Params) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  if (!isSlug(slug)) notFound();
  const t = await getTranslations('legal');
  const tf = await getTranslations('common.footer');
  const sections = t.raw(`pages.${slug}.sections`) as Array<{ title: string; body: string }>;
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-6 p-6">
      <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-fog underline">
        ← Voisino
      </Link>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">{t(`pages.${slug}.title`)}</h1>
      {sections.map((s) => (
        <section key={s.title} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{s.title}</h2>
          <p className="leading-relaxed text-fog">{s.body}</p>
        </section>
      ))}
      <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('updated')}</p>
      <nav className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 border-t border-line pt-4 text-sm">
        <Link href="/legal/confidentialite">{tf('privacy')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/conditions">{tf('terms')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/regles">{tf('rules')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/contact">{tf('contact')}</Link>
      </nav>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { AuthForm } from '@/components/auth/AuthForms';
import { LogoMark } from '@/components/Logo';
import { safeNext } from '@/lib/redirect';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return { title: (await getTranslations('auth.login'))('title') };
}

export default async function LoginPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string; error?: string; mode?: string }>;
}) {
  const { next, error, mode } = await searchParams;
  const target = safeNext(next);
  if (await getViewer()) redirect(target);
  const t = await getTranslations('auth');
  const tc = await getTranslations('common');
  const signup = mode === 'signup';
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh max-w-md flex-col justify-center gap-8 p-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center">
        <span className="relative">
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-accent blur-2xl" />
          <span className="relative">
            <LogoMark size={64} />
          </span>
        </span>
        <p className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">{tc('appName')}</p>
        <p className="-mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-fog">{tc('slogan')}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 rounded-3xl border border-white/[0.07] bg-panel/80 p-6 shadow-2xl shadow-black/30 backdrop-blur">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{signup ? t('signup.title') : t('login.title')}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{signup ? t('signup.intro') : t('login.intro')}</p>
        </div>
        <AuthForm
          mode={signup ? 'signup' : 'login'}
          next={target}
          callbackError={error === 'callback'}
        />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
      )}

  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\app\sw.ts`:

```ts
/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import {
  CacheFirst,
  ExpirationPlugin,
  NetworkFirst,
  NetworkOnly,
  Serwist,
  StaleWhileRevalidate,
  type PrecacheEntry,
  type SerwistGlobalConfig,
} from 'serwist';

declare global {
  interface WorkerGlobalScope extends SerwistGlobalConfig {
    __SW_MANIFEST: (PrecacheEntry | string)[] | undefined;
  }
}
declare const self: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope;

const serwist = new Serwist({
  precacheEntries: self.__SW_MANIFEST,
  // Soft update: the new worker waits until the user accepts the "update" banner.
  skipWaiting: false,
  clientsClaim: true,
  navigationPreload: true,
  runtimeCaching: [
    // API responses carry positions and short-lived signed URLs: never cached.
    {
      matcher: ({ url }) => url.pathname.startsWith('/api/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/auth/'),
      handler: new NetworkOnly(),
    },
    // Private media (signed URLs) and video streams: network only.
    {
      matcher: ({ url, request }) =>
        url.pathname.includes('/storage/v1/') || request.destination === 'video',
      handler: new NetworkOnly(),
    },
    // Map style, glyphs and vector tiles: cache first, bounded.
    {
      matcher: ({ url }) => /openfreemap|tiles|maptiler|stadiamaps/.test(url.hostname),
      handler: new CacheFirst({
        cacheName: 'map-tiles',
        plugins: [new ExpirationPlugin({ maxEntries: 800, maxAgeSeconds: 14 * 24 * 3600 })],
      }),
    },
    // App code and styles: fast from cache, refreshed in background.
    {
      matcher: ({ request, url }) =>
        url.origin === self.location.origin &&
        ['script', 'style', 'worker', 'font'].includes(request.destination),
      handler: new StaleWhileRevalidate({ cacheName: 'static' }),
    },
    {
      matcher: ({ request, url }) =>
        url.origin === self.location.origin && request.destination === 'image',
      handler: new CacheFirst({
        cacheName: 'images',
        plugins: [new ExpirationPlugin({ maxEntries: 60, maxAgeSeconds: 30 * 24 * 3600 })],
      }),
    },
    // Only explicitly public pages may be retained for offline navigation. Authenticated
    // pages contain account data and must never fall back to a previous user's HTML.
    {
      matcher: ({ request, url }) =>
        request.mode === 'navigate' &&
        url.origin === self.location.origin &&
        [
          '/commerces',
          '/commerces/decouvrir',
          '/legal',
          '/legal/regles',
          '/legal/confidentialite',
        ].includes(url.pathname),
      handler: new NetworkFirst({ cacheName: 'public-pages', networkTimeoutSeconds: 4 }),
    },
    {
      matcher: ({ request }) => request.mode === 'navigate',
      handler: new NetworkOnly(),
    },
  ],
  fallbacks: {
    entries: [{ url: '/offline', matcher: ({ request }) => request.destination === 'document' }],
  },
});

// Remove pages cached by older service worker versions, which cached every navigation.
self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(caches.delete('pages'));
});

interface PushPayload {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  url: string;
  tag?: string;
}

self.addEventListener('push', (event) => {
  let data: PushPayload = { title: 'Voisino', body: '', url: '/' };
  try {
    data = { ...data, ...(event.data?.json() as Partial<PushPayload>) };
  } catch {
    /* non-JSON payload: keep defaults */
  }
  event.waitUntil(
    self.registration.showNotification(data.title, {
      body: data.body,
      tag: data.tag,
      icon: '/icons/icon-192.png',
      badge: '/icons/badge-96.png',
      data: { url: data.url },
    }),
  );
});

self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
  event.notification.close();
  const target = new URL(
    (event.notification.data as { url?: string })?.url ?? '/',
    self.location.origin,
  );
  if (target.origin !== self.location.origin) return;
  event.waitUntil(
    self.clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true }).then((clients) => {
      const open = clients.find((c) => new URL(c.url).origin === target.origin);
      if (open) {
        void open.navigate(target.href);
        return open.focus();
      }
      return self.clients.openWindow(target.href);
    }),
  );
});

serwist.addEventListeners();
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getFormatter, getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { hydrate, type PublicVideoRow } from '@/lib/feed';
import { getOfferStatus } from '@/lib/offer-status';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { VideoPageInteractions } from '@/components/video/VideoPageInteractions';

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function load(id: string) {
  if (!z.uuid().safeParse(id).success) return null;
  const { data } = await adminClient().rpc('get_public_video', { p_id: id });
  if (!data?.length) return null;
  const [item] = await hydrate(data as PublicVideoRow[], null);
  return item ?? null;
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Params): Promise<Metadata> {
  const item = await load((await params).id);
  const tc = await getTranslations('common');
  if (!item) return { title: tc('appName') };
  const category = tc(`categories.${item.category}`);
  return {
    title: `${category} — ${item.caption || tc('appName')}`,
    description: item.caption,
    openGraph: { title: category, description: item.caption, type: 'video.other' },
  };
}

/** Shareable deep link: public preview (fuzzed data only), then "open in the feed". */
export default async function VideoPage({ params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const item = await load(id);
  const t = await getTranslations('video');
```

```tsx
                          src={profileAvatar.imageUrl}

          <div className="app-sidebar-note mt-auto rounded-lg p-2.5">
            <Logo name={t('appName')} size={20} />
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('tagline')}</p>
          </div>
        </aside>
      )}
      <main
        id="main"
        className={`app-main min-h-dvh min-w-0 flex-1 ${showNavigation ? 'pb-[calc(4.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))] lg:pb-0' : ''}`}
      >
        {children}
      </main>
      <BottomNav isModerator={isModerator} profileAvatar={profileAvatar} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/** Relative luminance (WCAG) of a #rrggbb colour. */
function luminance(hex: string): number {
  const channel = (i: number) => {
    const c = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255;
    return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  };
  return 0.2126 * channel(1) + 0.7152 * channel(3) + 0.0722 * channel(5);
}

/** White or near-black initials, whichever reaches the better contrast on `bg`. */
export function initialsColor(bg: string): string {
  const l = luminance(bg);
  return 1.05 / (l + 0.05) >= (l + 0.05) / (luminance('#0b0d10') + 0.05) ? '#ffffff' : '#0b0d10';
}

/** Generated avatar: initials on the colour derived from the account id (no uploaded photo). */
export function Avatar({
  username,
  color,
  size = 40,
  src,
}: {
  username: string | null;
  color: string;
  size?: number;
  src?: string | null;
}) {
  if (src) {
    return (
      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- public profile images use Supabase URLs
      <img
        src={src}
        alt=""
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-full object-cover"
        style={{ width: size, height: size }}
      />
    );
  }
  const initials = (username ?? '?').replace(/_/g, '').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() || '?';
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-bold"
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        backgroundColor: color,
        color: initialsColor(color),
        fontSize: size * 0.4,
      }}
    >
      {initials}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';

interface ProfileAvatar {
  username: string | null;
  color: string;
  imageUrl: string | null;
}

const items = [
  { href: '/', key: 'feed', icon: 'M3 11l9-7 9 7v9a1 1 0 01-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 01-1-1z' },
  {
    href: '/decouvrir',
    key: 'more',
    icon: 'M12 3l2.2 6.8L21 12l-6.8 2.2L12 21l-2.2-6.8L3 12l6.8-2.2z',
  },
  {
    href: '/carte',
    key: 'map',
    icon: 'M12 21s-7-6.1-7-11.5A7 7 0 0112 2.5a7 7 0 017 7C19 14.9 12 21 12 21zm0-8.5a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6z',
  },
  { href: '/filmer', key: 'record', icon: '' },
  { href: '/me', key: 'profile', icon: 'M12 12a4 4 0 100-8 4 4 0 000 8zm-8 9a8 8 0 0116 0' },
] as const;

function isActive(href: string, pathname: string) {
  if (href === '/') return pathname === '/';
  if (href === '/me') return ['/me', '/u/', '/parametres'].some((p) => pathname.startsWith(p));
  return pathname.startsWith(href);
}

export function BottomNav({
  isModerator = false,
  profileAvatar = null,
}: {
  isModerator?: boolean;
  profileAvatar?: ProfileAvatar | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('common.nav');
  const pathname = usePathname();
  if (
    pathname === '/admin' ||
    pathname === '/filmer' ||
    (isModerator && pathname.startsWith('/moderation'))
  )
    return null;
  return (
    <nav
      aria-label={t('label')}
      className="bottom-nav fixed inset-x-3 z-40 mx-auto max-w-lg rounded-2xl px-1 pb-1 lg:hidden"
      style={{ bottom: 'max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px))' }}
    >
      <ul className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg items-center justify-around px-2">
        {items.map((item) => {
          if (item.key === 'record') {
            return (
              <li key={item.key}>
                <Link
                  href={item.href}
                  aria-label={t(item.key)}
                  className="record-button -mt-6 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-white ring-4 ring-black transition-transform active:scale-95"
                >
                  <svg
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    className="h-7 w-7"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="2.4"
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                  >
                    <path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" />
                  </svg>
                </Link>
              </li>
            );
          }
          const active = isActive(item.href, pathname);
          return (
            <li key={item.key}>
              <Link
                href={item.href}
                aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
                className={`relative flex min-h-12 min-w-14 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0 px-2 text-[10px] font-medium transition-colors ${active ? 'text-white' : 'text-fog hover:text-white'}`}
              >
                {item.key === 'profile' && profileAvatar?.imageUrl ? (
                  <Avatar
                    username={profileAvatar.username}
                    color={profileAvatar.color}
                    size={24}
                    src={profileAvatar.imageUrl}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <svg
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    className="h-6 w-6 text-white"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth="1.8"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                  >
                    <path d={item.icon} />
                  </svg>
                )}
                {t(item.key)}
                {active && (
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute bottom-1.5 h-1 w-5 rounded-full bg-accent"
                  />
                )}
              </Link>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useId } from 'react';

/** Brand mark: gradient map pin with a play button. */
export function LogoMark({ size = 36 }: { size?: number }) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 48 56" width={size} height={size * (56 / 48)}>
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={id} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#38bdf8" />
          <stop offset="0.5" stopColor="#2563eb" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#0ea5e9" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <path
        d="M24 2C12.4 2 3 11.2 3 22.6 3 37.4 24 54 24 54s21-16.6 21-31.4C45 11.2 35.6 2 24 2z"
        fill={`url(#${id})`}
      />
      <circle cx="24" cy="22" r="11" fill="#fff" fillOpacity="0.95" />
      <path d="M21 16.8v10.4l8.4-5.2z" fill="#2563eb" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** Mark + wordmark, with an optional supporting tagline. */
export function Logo({
  name,
  tagline,
  size = 32,
  className = '',
}: {
  name: string;
  tagline?: string;
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const words = tagline?.split(' ') ?? [];
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 ${className}`}>
      <LogoMark size={size} />
      <span className="flex flex-col leading-none">
        <span className="font-extrabold tracking-tight" style={{ fontSize: size * 0.72 }}>
          {name}
        </span>
        {tagline && (
          <span className="mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-fog">
            {words.slice(0, -1).join(' ')}{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-blue">{words.at(-1)}</span>
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';

/**
 * Explanation shown BEFORE any system permission prompt (camera, microphone, location,
 * notifications). Rendered as an accessible modal dialog.
 */
export function PermissionPrimer({
  open,
  title,
  children,
  confirmLabel,
  cancelLabel,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  confirmLabel: string;
  cancelLabel: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = ref.current;
    if (!dialog) return;
    if (open && !dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
    if (!open && dialog.open) dialog.close();
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onCancel();
      }}
      className="m-auto w-[min(92vw,28rem)] rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-5 text-white backdrop:bg-black/70"
    >
      <h2 id={titleId} className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">
        {title}
      </h2>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm text-fog">{children}</div>
      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Button onClick={onConfirm} autoFocus>
          {confirmLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>
          {cancelLabel}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
```
