`apps\web\src\components\admin\AdminClient.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

type Body =
  | { type: 'ban'; userId: string; banned: boolean; note: string }
  | { type: 'revert'; actionId: number; note: string }
  | { type: 'merchant'; userId: string; approve: boolean }
  | { type: 'mediaSettings'; settings: MediaSettings };

type AvailabilityReason =
  'ready' | 'disabled' | 'not_configured' | 'worker_offline' | 'model_unavailable';

export interface MediaSettings {
  faceBlurEnabled: boolean;
  plateBlurEnabled: boolean;
  detectEvery: number;
  faceMinScore: number;
  plateMinScore: number;
}

export interface MediaSettingsAuditEntry {
  id: number;
  actor_id: string | null;
  previous_settings: Record<string, unknown>;
  new_settings: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
}

function useAdminAction() {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const run = async (body: Body) => {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/admin', { body });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : {
            kind: 'error',
            text:
              res.error === 'review_conflict'
                ? t('review_conflict')
                : res.error === 'media_model_unavailable'
                  ? t('mediaProcessing.modelUnavailable')
                  : (errorText(res.error) ?? t('actionError')),
          },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
    setPending(false);
  };
  return { run, status, pending };
}

export function MerchantReview({
  userId,
  name,
  applicant,
  description,
  submittedAt,
}: {
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  applicant: string;
  description: string;
  submittedAt: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const { run, status, pending } = useAdminAction();
  const review = (approve: boolean) => {
    if (window.confirm(t(approve ? 'confirmApproveMerchant' : 'confirmRejectMerchant', { name }))) {
      void run({ type: 'merchant', userId, approve });
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-4">
      <div className="flex-1">
        <h3 className="font-semibold">{name}</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('merchantApplicant', { username: applicant })}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-fog">
          {description || t('noMerchantDescription')}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-fog">{t('submittedAt', { date: submittedAt })}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Button disabled={pending} onClick={() => review(true)}>
          {t('approve')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => review(false)}>
          {t('rejectMerchant')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function MediaProcessingSettings({
  initial,
  availability,
  audit,
}: {
  initial: MediaSettings;
  availability: {
    faces: { available: boolean; reason: AvailabilityReason };
    plates: { available: boolean; reason: AvailabilityReason };
  };
  audit: MediaSettingsAuditEntry[];
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('admin.mediaProcessing');
  const { run, status, pending } = useAdminAction();
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState({
    ...initial,
    detectEvery: String(initial.detectEvery),
    faceMinScore: String(initial.faceMinScore),
    plateMinScore: String(initial.plateMinScore),
  });
  const parsed = {
    detectEvery: Number(settings.detectEvery),
    faceMinScore: Number(settings.faceMinScore),
    plateMinScore: Number(settings.plateMinScore),
  };
  const valid =
    Number.isInteger(parsed.detectEvery) &&
    parsed.detectEvery >= 1 &&
    parsed.detectEvery <= 10 &&
    Number.isFinite(parsed.faceMinScore) &&
    parsed.faceMinScore >= 0.05 &&
    parsed.faceMinScore <= 0.95 &&
    Number.isFinite(parsed.plateMinScore) &&
    parsed.plateMinScore >= 0.05 &&
    parsed.plateMinScore <= 0.95;

  return (
    <section id="mediaSettings" aria-labelledby="media-settings-title" className="scroll-mt-20">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-3xl border border-line bg-panel/80 p-5">
        <div>
          <h2 id="media-settings-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {t('title')}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-fog">{t('hint')}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <label className="flex min-h-12 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line px-3">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={settings.faceBlurEnabled}
              disabled={!availability.faces.available && !settings.faceBlurEnabled}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, faceBlurEnabled: event.target.checked }))
              }
              className="h-5 w-5 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
            />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t('faces')}</span>
          </label>
          {!availability.faces.available && (
            <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t(`availability.${availability.faces.reason}`)}</p>
          )}
          <label className="flex min-h-12 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line px-3">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={settings.plateBlurEnabled}
              disabled={!availability.plates.available && !settings.plateBlurEnabled}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, plateBlurEnabled: event.target.checked }))
              }
              className="h-5 w-5 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
            />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">{t('plates')}</span>
          </label>
          {!availability.plates.available && (
            <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t(`availability.${availability.plates.reason}`)}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('detectEveryHelp')}</p>
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span>{t('detectEvery')}</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={10}
              step={1}
              value={settings.detectEvery}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, detectEvery: event.target.value }))
              }
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span>{t('faceMinScore')}</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={0.05}
              max={0.95}
              step={0.05}
              value={settings.faceMinScore}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, faceMinScore: event.target.value }))
              }
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span>{t('plateMinScore')}</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={0.05}
              max={0.95}
              step={0.05}
              value={settings.plateMinScore}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, plateMinScore: event.target.value }))
              }
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('thresholdHelp')}</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('modelNote')}</p>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          <Button
            disabled={pending || !valid}
            onClick={() =>
              void run({
                type: 'mediaSettings',
                settings: {
                  faceBlurEnabled: settings.faceBlurEnabled,
                  plateBlurEnabled: settings.plateBlurEnabled,
                  ...parsed,
                },
              })
            }
          >
            {pending ? t('saving') : t('save')}
          </Button>
          {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
        </div>
        {audit.length > 0 && (
          <details className="rounded-xl border border-line px-4 py-3">
            <summary className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-semibold">{t('auditTitle')}</summary>
            <ul className="mt-3 flex flex-col gap-2 text-xs text-fog">
              {audit.map((entry) => (
                <li key={entry.id}>
                  {new Date(entry.created_at).toLocaleString()} ·{' '}
                  {t('auditActor', { actor: entry.actor_id?.slice(0, 8) ?? '—' })}
                  {' · '}
                  {t('auditChange', {
                    detectEvery: String(entry.new_settings.detect_every ?? '—'),
                    faces: String(entry.new_settings.face_blur_enabled ?? '—'),
                    plates: String(entry.new_settings.plate_blur_enabled ?? '—'),
                    faceThreshold: String(entry.new_settings.face_min_score ?? '—'),
                    plateThreshold: String(entry.new_settings.plate_min_score ?? '—'),
                  })}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </details>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

type NotedBody =
  { type: 'ban'; userId: string; banned: boolean } | { type: 'revert'; actionId: number };

/** Ban / unban or revert, both requiring a written reason. */
export function NotedAction({
  label,
  body,
  variant = 'secondary',
}: {
  label: string;
  body: NotedBody;
  variant?: 'secondary' | 'danger';
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const { run, status, pending } = useAdminAction();
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const id = `note-${body.type}-${body.type === 'ban' ? body.userId : body.actionId}`;
  const submit = () => {
    if (body.type === 'ban' && body.banned && !window.confirm(t('confirmBan'))) return;
    if (body.type === 'revert' && !window.confirm(t('confirmRevert'))) return;
    void run({ ...body, note });
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="sr-only">
          {t('note')}
        </label>
        <input
          id={id}
          className={inputClass}
          placeholder={t('note')}
          value={note}
          onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
        />
        <Button variant={variant} disabled={pending || note.trim().length < 3} onClick={submit}>
          {pending ? t('saving') : label}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
              <span className="hidden font-semibold sm:inline">
                {username ? `@${username}` : t('profile')}
              </span>
            </Link>
          </header>
          <div className="border-b border-white/[0.06] px-4 py-3 lg:hidden">
            <nav aria-label={t('navigation')} className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
              {visible.map((item) => (
                <Link
                  key={item.key}
                  href={item.href}
                  className="glass flex min-h-10 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white/90"
                >
                  <Icon d={item.icon} />
                  {t(item.key)}
                </Link>
              ))}
              {isAdmin && (

                  {tools.map((item) => (
                    <Link
                      key={item.key}
                      href={`/admin#${item.key}`}
                      className="glass flex min-h-10 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white/90"
                    >
                      <Icon d={item.icon} />
                      {t(item.key)}
                    </Link>
                  ))}
                </>
              )}

          {children}
        </div>

}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

/** Refreshes the server-rendered queue while the admin is watching it. */
export function ProcessingRefresh() {
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') router.refresh();
    }, 4000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [router]);

  return null;
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { passwordSchema, usernameSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

/** Auth-specific error codes first, then the generic ones. */
function useAuthError() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.errors');
  const generic = useErrorText();
  return (code: string | null | undefined) => (code && t.has(code) ? t(code) : generic(code));
}

function PasswordInput({
  id,
  value,
  onChange,
  autoComplete,
}: {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  autoComplete: 'current-password' | 'new-password';
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <input
        id={id}
        type={visible ? 'text' : 'password'}
        autoComplete={autoComplete}
        required
        maxLength={72}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        className={`${inputClass} pr-24`}
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setVisible((v) => !v)}
        aria-pressed={visible}
        aria-controls={id}
        className="absolute inset-y-0 right-2 my-auto h-9 rounded-lg px-2 text-sm text-fog"
      >
        {visible ? t('hidePassword') : t('showPassword')}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function Consent() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.login');
  return (
    <p className="text-xs text-fog">
      {t.rich('consent', {
        terms: (c) => (
          <Link className="underline" href="/legal/conditions">
            {c}
          </Link>
        ),
        privacy: (c) => (
          <Link className="underline" href="/legal/confidentialite">
            {c}
          </Link>
        ),
      })}
    </p>
  );
}

/** Sign-in and sign-up on one screen (switchable), e-mail + password. */
export function AuthForm({
  mode: initialMode,
  next,
  callbackError,
}: {
  mode: 'login' | 'signup';
  next: string;
  callbackError: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(initialMode);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(
    callbackError ? t('login.callbackError') : null,
  );
  const [confirmSent, setConfirmSent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (mode === 'signup') {
      if (!usernameSchema.safeParse(username).success)
        return setError(t('errors.username_invalid'));
      const pwd = passwordSchema.safeParse(password);
      if (!pwd.success) return setError(authError(pwd.error.issues[0]?.message));
    }
    setPending(true);
    const res =
      mode === 'signup'
        ? await api<{ needsConfirmation?: boolean }>('/api/auth/signup', {
            body: { email, password, username },
          })
        : await api<{ needsUsername?: boolean }>('/api/auth/login', { body: { email, password } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return setError(
        res.error === 'invalid_input' ? t('login.invalidEmail') : authError(res.error),
      );
    }
    const data = res.data as { needsConfirmation?: boolean; needsUsername?: boolean };
    if (mode === 'signup' && data.needsConfirmation) return setConfirmSent(email);
    const target =
      mode === 'signup'
        ? `/onboarding?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`
        : data.needsUsername
          ? `/bienvenue?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`
          : next;
    router.replace(target);
    router.refresh();
  }

  if (confirmSent) {
    return <Notice kind="success">{t('signup.checkEmail', { email: confirmSent })}</Notice>;
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('login.email')} htmlFor="email">
        <input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          name="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          inputMode="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className={inputClass}
        />
      </Field>
      {mode === 'signup' && (
        <Field label={t('signup.username')} htmlFor="username" hint={t('signup.usernameHint')}>
          <input
            id="username"
            name="username"
            autoComplete="username"
            autoCapitalize="none"
            spellCheck={false}
            maxLength={20}
            value={username}
            onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value.toLowerCase())}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </Field>
      )}
      <Field
        label={mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.password') : t('login.password')}
        htmlFor="password"
        hint={mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.passwordHint') : undefined}
      >
        <PasswordInput
          id="password"
          value={password}
          onChange={setPassword}
          autoComplete={mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || !email || !password}>
        {mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.submit') : t('login.submit')}
      </Button>
      {mode === 'login' && (
        <Link href="/mot-de-passe-oublie" className="text-center text-sm underline">
          {t('login.forgot')}
        </Link>
      )}
      <p className="text-center text-sm text-fog">
        {mode === 'login' ? t('login.noAccount') : t('signup.hasAccount')}{' '}
        <button
          type="button"
          className="font-semibold text-white underline"
          onClick={() => {
            setError(null);
            setMode(mode === 'login' ? 'signup' : 'login');
          }}
        >
          {mode === 'login' ? t('login.toSignup') : t('signup.toLogin')}
        </button>
      </p>
      <Consent />
    </form>
  );
}

export function ForgotForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/auth/reset', { body: { email } });
    if (!res.ok) {
      return setError(
        res.error === 'invalid_input' ? t('login.invalidEmail') : authError(res.error),
      );
    }
    setSent(email);
  }

  if (sent) return <Notice kind="success">{t('forgot.sent', { email: sent })}</Notice>;
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('login.email')} htmlFor="email" error={error}>
        <input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          inputMode="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className={inputClass}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={!email}>
        {t('forgot.submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

export function NewPasswordForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pwd = passwordSchema.safeParse(password);
    if (!pwd.success) return setError(authError(pwd.error.issues[0]?.message));
    if (password !== confirm) return setError(t('reset.mismatch'));
    const res = await api('/api/auth/password', { body: { password } });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(res.status === 401 ? t('reset.expired') : authError(res.error));
    setDone(true);
  }

  if (done) return <Notice kind="success">{t('reset.done')}</Notice>;
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('reset.password')} htmlFor="new-password" hint={t('signup.passwordHint')}>
        <PasswordInput
          id="new-password"
          value={password}
          onChange={setPassword}
          autoComplete="new-password"
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('reset.confirm')} htmlFor="confirm-password">
        <PasswordInput
          id="confirm-password"
          value={confirm}
          onChange={setConfirm}
          autoComplete="new-password"
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={!password || !confirm}>
        {t('reset.submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { usernameSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export function UsernameForm({ next }: { next: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.welcome');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const parsed = usernameSchema.safeParse(username);
    if (!parsed.success) return setError(t('invalid'));
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: { username: parsed.data } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) return setError(res.error === 'conflict' ? t('taken') : errorText(res.error));
    router.replace(next);
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('username')} htmlFor="username" error={error}>
        <input
          id="username"
          name="username"
          autoComplete="username"
          autoCapitalize="none"
          spellCheck={false}
          maxLength={20}
          value={username}
          onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value.toLowerCase())}
          className={inputClass}
          aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || username.length < 3}>
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { MAX_RECORDING_MS } from '@nl/shared';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { PointerEvent } from 'react';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { pickMimeType } from '@/lib/recorder';

export interface Recording {
  blob: Blob;
  mime: string;
  durationMs: number;
}

type CamError = 'denied' | 'notFound' | 'unsupported' | 'generic';
type Facing = 'environment' | 'user';
/** A specific camera (deviceId) once devices are known, otherwise a facing preference. */
interface Target {
  deviceId: string | null;
  facing: Facing;
}

interface ZoomRange {
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step: number;
}

const supportedMime = () =>
  typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined'
    ? null
    : pickMimeType((m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m));

async function openCamera(target: Target): Promise<MediaStream | CamError> {
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia || !supportedMime()) return 'unsupported';
  const size = {
    width: { ideal: 1080 },
    height: { ideal: 1920 },
    aspectRatio: { ideal: 9 / 16 },
  };
  try {
    return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: target.deviceId
        ? { deviceId: { exact: target.deviceId }, ...size }
        : { facingMode: { ideal: target.facing }, ...size },
      audio: true,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const name = (e as DOMException).name;
    if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'SecurityError') return 'denied';
    return name === 'NotFoundError' ? 'notFound' : 'generic';
  }
}

/** Labels are only exposed after permission; "front"/"user"/"facetime" mark a selfie camera. */
const looksFront = (label: string) => /front|user|facetime|avant|selfie/i.test(label);
const lensLevel = (label: string): 0.5 | 1 | 2 | null => {
  if (/ultra.?wide|ultra.?grand.?angle|0[.,]5\s*x|0[.,]5x/i.test(label)) return 0.5;
  if (/tele(photo)?|2\s*x|2x|3\s*x|3x/i.test(label)) return 2;
  if (/back|rear|environment|arrière|principale|main/i.test(label)) return 1;
  return null;
};

/**
 * Full-screen camera: back camera by default, switch between every available camera (button or
 * double tap), flashlight when supported, 30 s max with a gauge.
 * Only `getUserMedia` + `MediaRecorder` are used: there is no file picker (no gallery import).
 */
export function Camera({ onRecorded }: { onRecorded: (r: Recording) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('capture');
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const recorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const activeDurationRef = useRef(0);
  const takeStartedAtRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const updateRecordingTimeRef = useRef<FrameRequestCallback>(() => {});
  const audioContextRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const pointersRef = useRef(new Map<number, { x: number; y: number }>());
  const pinchRef = useRef<{ distance: number; zoom: number } | null>(null);
  const zoomRef = useRef(1);
  const lastGood = useRef<Target | null>(null);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<Target>({ deviceId: null, facing: 'environment' });
  const [cameras, setCameras] = useState<MediaDeviceInfo[]>([]);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState<{ deviceId: string; front: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [torch, setTorch] = useState<{ supported: boolean; on: boolean }>({
    supported: false,
    on: false,
  });
  const [badge, setBadge] = useState<'front' | 'back' | null>(null);
  const [switchFailed, setSwitchFailed] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<CamError | null>(null);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [timerDelay, setTimerDelay] = useState<0 | 3 | 10>(0);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [takeDurations, setTakeDurations] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [zoomRange, setZoomRange] = useState<ZoomRange | null>(null);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);

  const stopTracks = useCallback(() => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((tr) => tr.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    // Many Android devices cannot open a second camera while one is live: release it first.
    stopTracks();
    void openCamera(target).then(async (result) => {
      if (typeof result === 'string') {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const previous = lastGood.current;
        if (previous && previous !== target) {
          setSwitchFailed(true);
          setTarget(previous);
        } else setError(result);
        return;
      }
      if (cancelled) {
        result.getTracks().forEach((tr) => tr.stop());
        return;
      }
      streamRef.current = result;
      lastGood.current = target;
      if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = result;

      const track = result.getVideoTracks()[0];
      const settings = track?.getSettings();
      const front = settings?.facingMode
        ? settings.facingMode === 'user'
        : looksFront(track?.label ?? '') || target.facing === 'user';
      setCurrent(settings?.deviceId ? { deviceId: settings.deviceId, front } : null);
      const caps = track?.getCapabilities?.() as { torch?: boolean; zoom?: ZoomRange } | undefined;
      setTorch({ supported: Boolean(caps?.torch), on: false });
      const range = caps?.zoom;
      setZoomRange(
        range && Number.isFinite(range.min) && Number.isFinite(range.max)
          ? { min: range.min, max: range.max, step: range.step || 0.1 }
          : null,
      );
      setBadge(front ? 'front' : 'back');
      setError(null);
      setReady(true);

      const devices = await navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices().catch(() => []);
      if (!cancelled) setCameras(devices.filter((d) => d.kind === 'videoinput' && d.deviceId));
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [stopTracks, target]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      stopTracks();
      if (frameRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      void audioContextRef.current?.close();
    },
    [stopTracks],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!badge) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setBadge(null), 1500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [badge]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!switchFailed) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setSwitchFailed(false), 3000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [switchFailed]);

  const canSwitch = cameras.length > 1 || cameras.length === 0;
  const physicalLenses = cameras.flatMap((camera) => {
    if (looksFront(camera.label)) return [];
    const level = lensLevel(camera.label);
    return level === null ? [] : [{ camera, level }];
  });
  const zoomLevels = [0.5, 1, 2].filter((level) => {
    const hasPhysicalLens = physicalLenses.some((lens) => lens.level === level);
    const hasDigitalRange = zoomRange
      ? level >= zoomRange.min && level <= zoomRange.max
      : level >= 1;
    return hasPhysicalLens || hasDigitalRange;
  });

  const setZoomLevel = useCallback(
    (value: number) => {
      const min = zoomRange?.min ?? 1;
      const max = zoomRange?.max ?? 3;
      const next = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
      zoomRef.current = next;
      setZoom(next);
    },
    [zoomRange],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const track = streamRef.current?.getVideoTracks()[0];
    if (!track || !zoomRange || !('zoom' in zoomRange)) return;
    void track.applyConstraints({ advanced: [{ zoom } as MediaTrackConstraintSet] }).catch(() => {
      // Keep the CSS zoom as a graceful fallback on browsers that expose but reject zoom.
      setZoomRange(null);
    });
  }, [zoom, zoomRange]);

  function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent<HTMLVideoElement>) {
    pointersRef.current.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });
    if (pointersRef.current.size === 2) {
      const [a, b] = [...pointersRef.current.values()];
      pinchRef.current = {
        distance: Math.hypot(a!.x - b!.x, a!.y - b!.y),
        zoom: zoomRef.current,
      };
    }
  }

  function onPointerMove(event: PointerEvent<HTMLVideoElement>) {
    if (!pointersRef.current.has(event.pointerId)) return;
    pointersRef.current.set(event.pointerId, { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY });
    if (pointersRef.current.size !== 2 || !pinchRef.current) return;
    const [a, b] = [...pointersRef.current.values()];
    const distance = Math.hypot(a!.x - b!.x, a!.y - b!.y);
    if (pinchRef.current.distance > 0) {
      setZoomLevel(pinchRef.current.zoom * (distance / pinchRef.current.distance));
    }
  }

  function onPointerUp(event: PointerEvent<HTMLVideoElement>) {
    pointersRef.current.delete(event.pointerId);
    pinchRef.current = null;
  }

  function selectLens(level: number) {
    const lens = physicalLenses.find((candidate) => candidate.level === level);
    if (lens && lens.camera.deviceId !== current?.deviceId) {
      setSwitchFailed(false);
      setReady(false);
      setZoom(1);
      zoomRef.current = 1;
      setTarget({ deviceId: lens.camera.deviceId, facing: 'environment' });
      return;
    }
    setZoomLevel(level);
  }

  const switchCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (recording || !ready) return;
    setSwitchFailed(false);
    setReady(false);
    // With known devices, cycle through all of them (front, back, wide, external webcam…);
    // otherwise fall back to flipping the facing preference.
    if (cameras.length > 1) {
      const index = cameras.findIndex((c) => c.deviceId === current?.deviceId);
      const next = cameras[(index + 1) % cameras.length]!;
      setTarget({
        deviceId: next.deviceId,
        facing: looksFront(next.label) ? 'user' : 'environment',
      });
    } else {
      setTarget((prev) => ({
        deviceId: null,
        facing: prev.facing === 'environment' ? 'user' : 'environment',
      }));
    }
  }, [cameras, current, ready, recording]);

  async function toggleTorch() {
    const track = streamRef.current?.getVideoTracks()[0];
    if (!track) return;
    const on = !torch.on;
    try {
      await track.applyConstraints({ advanced: [{ torch: on } as MediaTrackConstraintSet] });
      setTorch({ supported: true, on });
    } catch {
      setTorch({ supported: false, on: false });
    }
  }

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    if (recorderRef.current?.state === 'recording' || recorderRef.current?.state === 'paused') {
      recorderRef.current.stop();
    }
  }, []);

  const updateRecordingTime = useCallback(() => {
    const start = takeStartedAtRef.current;
    const currentTake = start === null ? 0 : performance.now() - start;
    const ms = activeDurationRef.current + currentTake;
    setElapsed(ms);
    if (ms >= MAX_RECORDING_MS) {
      recorderRef.current?.stop();
      return;
    }
    frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(updateRecordingTimeRef.current);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    updateRecordingTimeRef.current = updateRecordingTime;
  }, [updateRecordingTime]);

  const pauseTake = useCallback(() => {
    const recorder = recorderRef.current;
    const start = takeStartedAtRef.current;
    if (recorder?.state !== 'recording' || start === null) return;
    const duration = performance.now() - start;
    activeDurationRef.current += duration;
    takeStartedAtRef.current = null;
    if (frameRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
    setTakeDurations((takes) => [...takes, duration]);
    setElapsed(activeDurationRef.current);
    recorder.pause();
    setPaused(true);
  }, []);

  function resumeTake() {
    const recorder = recorderRef.current;
    if (recorder?.state !== 'paused') return;
    takeStartedAtRef.current = performance.now();
    recorder.resume();
    setPaused(false);
    frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(updateRecordingTimeRef.current);
  }

  const countdownBeep = useCallback(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.AudioContext) return;
    try {
      const context = audioContextRef.current ?? new AudioContext();
      audioContextRef.current = context;
      void context.resume();
      const oscillator = context.createOscillator();
      const gain = context.createGain();
      oscillator.frequency.value = 880;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, context.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, context.currentTime + 0.09);
      oscillator.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(context.destination);
      oscillator.start();
      oscillator.stop(context.currentTime + 0.09);
    } catch {
      // Audio feedback is optional; countdown remains available without Web Audio.
    }
  }, []);

  const startRecording = useCallback(() => {
    const stream = streamRef.current;
    const mime = supportedMime();
    if (!stream || !mime) return;
    const chunks: Blob[] = [];
    const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mime, videoBitsPerSecond: 2_500_000 });
    activeDurationRef.current = 0;
    takeStartedAtRef.current = performance.now();
    setTakeDurations([]);
    recorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
      if (e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data);
    };
    recorder.onstop = () => {
      const start = takeStartedAtRef.current;
      const duration = activeDurationRef.current + (start === null ? 0 : performance.now() - start);
      takeStartedAtRef.current = null;
      activeDurationRef.current = 0;
      if (frameRef.current !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      setRecording(false);
      setPaused(false);
      const durationMs = Math.min(MAX_RECORDING_MS, Math.round(duration));
      stopTracks();
      onRecorded({ blob: new Blob(chunks, { type: mime }), mime, durationMs });
    };
    recorderRef.current = recorder;
    recorder.start(1000);
    setRecording(true);
    setPaused(false);
    setElapsed(0);
    frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(updateRecordingTimeRef.current);
  }, [onRecorded, stopTracks]);

  const record = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerDelay > 0) {
      setCountdown(timerDelay);
      countdownBeep();
      return;
    }
    startRecording();
  }, [countdownBeep, startRecording, timerDelay]);

  const advanceCountdown = useCallback(() => {
    if (countdown === null) return;
    if (countdown <= 1) {
      setCountdown(null);
      startRecording();
      return;
    }
    countdownBeep();
    setCountdown(countdown - 1);
  }, [countdown, countdownBeep, startRecording]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (countdown === null) return;
    const timeout = setTimeout(advanceCountdown, 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [advanceCountdown, countdown]);

  const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / MAX_RECORDING_MS);
  const completedDuration = takeDurations.reduce((sum, duration) => sum + duration, 0);
  const activeTakeDuration = recording && !paused ? Math.max(0, elapsed - completedDuration) : 0;
  const visibleTakes = [...takeDurations, ...(activeTakeDuration > 0 ? [activeTakeDuration] : [])];
  const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((MAX_RECORDING_MS - elapsed) / 1000));
  const mirrored = current?.front ?? target.facing === 'user';

  const retryCamera = useCallback(() => {
    setError(null);
    setReady(false);
    setCurrent(null);
    setTarget((prev) => ({ deviceId: prev.deviceId, facing: prev.facing }));
  }, []);

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-full max-w-md flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
        <Notice kind="error">{t(`errors.${error}`)}</Notice>
        <Button type="button" onClick={retryCamera} className="w-full">
          {t('errors.retry')}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative h-full w-full overflow-hidden bg-black">
      <video
        ref={videoRef}
        autoPlay
        muted
        playsInline
        aria-label={t('title')}
        onDoubleClick={canSwitch ? switchCamera : undefined}
        onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
        onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
        onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
        onPointerCancel={onPointerUp}
        style={{ transform: `${mirrored ? 'scaleX(-1) ' : ''}scale(${zoomRange ? 1 : zoom})` }}
        className={`h-full w-full touch-none object-contain transition-opacity duration-300 ${ready ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'}`}
      />
      {!ready && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="glass absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 flex -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm"
        >
          <span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white motion-safe:animate-spin"
          />
          {t('starting')}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1.5 bg-white/15" aria-hidden="true">
        {visibleTakes.map((duration, index) => {
          const left = visibleTakes.slice(0, index).reduce((sum, take) => sum + take, 0);
          return (
            <span
              key={index}
              className="absolute inset-y-0 bg-accent"
              style={{
                left: `${(left / MAX_RECORDING_MS) * 100}%`,
                width: `${(duration / MAX_RECORDING_MS) * 100}%`,
              }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-[calc(1rem+env(safe-area-inset-top))] flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
        {ready && !recording && countdown === null && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div
              role="group"
              className="glass flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full p-1"
              aria-label={t('zoom.label')}
            >
              {zoomLevels.map((level) => {
                const lens = physicalLenses.find((candidate) => candidate.level === level);
                const selected = lens
                  ? lens.camera.deviceId === current?.deviceId
                  : Math.abs(zoom - level) < 0.08;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={level}
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={t(
                      `zoom.${level === 0.5 ? 'wide' : level === 2 ? 'tele' : 'level'}`,
                      {
                        level,
                      },
                    )}
                    aria-pressed={selected}
                    onClick={() => selectLens(level)}
                    className="min-h-11 min-w-11 rounded-full px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition active:scale-95 aria-pressed:bg-white aria-pressed:text-ink"
                  >
                    {level.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}×
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={
                timerDelay === 0 ? t('timer.off') : t('timer.set', { seconds: timerDelay })
              }
              aria-pressed={timerDelay > 0}
              onClick={() => setTimerDelay((value) => (value === 0 ? 3 : value === 3 ? 10 : 0))}
              className="glass min-h-11 min-w-11 rounded-full px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-white"
            >
              {timerDelay === 0 ? '⏱' : `${timerDelay}s`}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        <p
          className={`glass flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold ${recording ? 'border-alert/60!' : ''}`}
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          {recording && (
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-alert motion-safe:animate-pulse"
            />
          )}
          {recording
            ? paused
              ? t('paused')
              : t('remaining', { seconds: remaining })
            : t('maxDuration')}
        </p>
        {badge && !recording && (
          <p className="glass rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs text-white/90" aria-hidden="true">
            {t(badge)}
          </p>
        )}
        {switchFailed && (
          <p role="alert" className="rounded-full bg-alert/90 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold">
            {t('switchFailed')}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 to-transparent pt-16 pb-[max(2rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
        {canSwitch && !recording && ready && (
          <p className="text-xs text-white/70">{t('switchHint')}</p>
        )}
        <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm grid-cols-3 place-items-center">
          {torch.supported ? (
            <ControlButton
              label={torch.on ? t('torchOff') : t('torchOn')}
              pressed={torch.on}
              onClick={toggleTorch}
              icon="M9 2h6l-1 7h4l-8 13 2-9H8z"
            />
          ) : (
            <span />
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={recording ? stop : record}
            disabled={!ready}
            aria-label={recording ? t('stop') : t('record')}
            className="relative flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-white/90 transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <svg className="absolute -inset-1 -rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 88 88" aria-hidden="true">
              <circle
                cx="44"
                cy="44"
                r="40"
                fill="none"
                stroke="var(--color-alert)"
                strokeWidth="5"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeDasharray={251}
                strokeDashoffset={251 * (1 - progress)}
              />
            </svg>
            <span
              className={`bg-alert shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(255,77,109,0.7)] transition-all ${recording ? 'h-7 w-7 rounded-md' : 'h-14 w-14 rounded-full'}`}
            />
          </button>
          {recording ? (
            <ControlButton
              label={paused ? t('resume') : t('pause')}
              disabled={!ready}
              onClick={paused ? resumeTake : pauseTake}
              icon={paused ? 'M8 5v14l11-7z' : 'M8 5v14M16 5v14'}
            />
          ) : canSwitch ? (
            <ControlButton
              label={t('switch')}
              disabled={!ready}
              onClick={switchCamera}
              icon="M20 7h-3.2L15 5H9L7.2 7H4v12h16zM9 13.5a3 3 0 015-2.2l1-1M15 12.5a3 3 0 01-5 2.2l-1 1"
            />
          ) : (
            <span />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {countdown !== null && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="absolute inset-0 z-20 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/45 text-white"
          onClick={() => setCountdown(null)}
          aria-label={t('timer.cancel')}
        >
          <span aria-live="assertive" className="text-8xl font-bold tabular-nums">
            {countdown}
          </span>
          <span className="mt-4 rounded-full bg-black/50 px-4 py-2 text-sm">
            {t('timer.cancel')}
          </span>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ControlButton({
  label,
  icon,
  onClick,
  pressed,
  disabled,
}: {
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      aria-pressed={pressed}
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition active:scale-90 disabled:opacity-40 ${pressed ? 'bg-amber-300 text-ink' : 'glass text-white'}`}
    >
      <svg
        aria-hidden="true"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        className="h-6 w-6"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth="2"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        strokeLinecap="round"
      >
        <path d={icon} />
      </svg>
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

  CAPTION_MAX,

  MAX_ACCURACY_M,
  MERCHANT_DURATIONS_H,

} from '@nl/shared';

import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { enqueue } from '@/lib/offline-queue';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';
import { publish, PublishError, type Fix, type PublishMeta } from '@/lib/publish';
import { containerOf } from '@/lib/recorder';
import { Camera, type Recording } from './Camera';

type Step = 'primer' | 'camera' | 'preview' | 'form' | 'sending' | 'done' | 'queued';

/** datetime-local bounds for an event end: from now + 15 min to now + 7 days (local time). */
function eventBounds() {
  const local = (ms: number) => {
    const d = new Date(ms);
    return new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  };
  const now = Date.now();
  return { minEvent: local(now + 15 * 60_000), maxEvent: local(now + 7 * 24 * 3_600_000 - 60_000) };
}

export function CaptureFlow({ isMerchant }: { isMerchant: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('capture');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>('primer');
  const [rec, setRec] = useState<Recording | null>(null);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category>('alert');
  const [caption, setCaption] = useState('');
  const [offerTerms, setOfferTerms] = useState('');
  const [eventEnd, setEventEnd] = useState('');
  const [merchantHours, setMerchantHours] = useState<number>(24);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);

  const previewUrl = useMemo(() => (rec ? URL.createObjectURL(rec.blob) : null), [rec]);
  useEffect(() => () => void (previewUrl && URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl)), [previewUrl]);

  const categories = CATEGORIES.filter((c) => c !== 'shop' || isMerchant);

  async function locate(): Promise<Fix | null> {
    setLocating(true);
    try {
      const pos = await currentPosition();
      const fix = {
        lat: pos.coords.latitude,
        lng: pos.coords.longitude,
        accuracy: Math.ceil(pos.coords.accuracy),
      };
      if (fix.accuracy > MAX_ACCURACY_M) {
        setError(t('location.imprecise', { accuracy: fix.accuracy }));
        return null;
      }
      return fix;
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        (e as GeolocationPositionError).code === 1
          ? t('location.denied')
          : t('location.unavailable'),
      );
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLocating(false);
    }
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!rec) return;
    setError(null);
    const fix = await locate();
    if (!fix) return;
    const meta: PublishMeta = {
      category,
      caption,
      mimeType: containerOf(rec.mime),
      durationMs: rec.durationMs,
      ...(category === 'event' && eventEnd && { eventEndsAt: new Date(eventEnd).toISOString() }),
      ...(category === 'shop' && { merchantHours, offerTerms }),
    };
    const requestId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const keepForLater = async (error?: unknown) => {
      const reserved = error instanceof PublishError ? error.reserved : undefined;
      await enqueue({
        id: requestId,
        blob: rec.blob,
        meta,
        fix,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        reserved,
      });
      setStep('queued');
    };
    if (!navigator.onLine) return keepForLater();
    setStep('sending');
    try {
      await publish(rec.blob, meta, fix, setProgress, undefined, requestId);
      setStep('done');
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof PublishError && err.retryable) return keepForLater(err);
      setStep('form');
      const code = err instanceof PublishError ? err.code : 'generic';
      setError(t.has(`errorsPublish.${code}`) ? t(`errorsPublish.${code}`) : errorText(code));
    }
  }

  const [{ minEvent, maxEvent }] = useState(eventBounds);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col bg-ink">
      <header className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-10 flex justify-end px-3 pb-3 pt-[calc(0.75rem+env(safe-area-inset-top))]">
        <Link
          href="/"

          className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-black/60 text-2xl"

        open={step === 'primer'}

        confirmLabel={t('primer.continue')}
        cancelLabel={t('primer.later')}
        onConfirm={() => setStep('camera')}
        onCancel={() => router.push('/')}
      >
        <p>{t('primer.body')}</p>
        <ul className="list-disc pl-5">
          <li>{t('primer.camera')}</li>
          <li>{t('primer.location')}</li>

        <p>{t('primer.privacy')}</p>

      {step === 'camera' && (

          <div className="flex gap-3 p-4 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">

        >

          <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">{t('form.category')}</legend>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">

            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('form.preview.title')}</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-accent">{tc(category)}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm">
              {caption.trim() || t('form.preview.emptyCaption')}

            {category === 'shop' && (

          )}
          <div className="sticky bottom-0 -mx-4 mt-auto bg-gradient-to-t from-ink via-ink/95 to-ink/80 px-4 pt-3 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] backdrop-blur sm:-mx-6 sm:px-6">
            <Button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full"
              disabled={
                step === 'sending' ||
                locating ||
                (category === 'event' && !eventEnd) ||
                (category === 'shop' && offerTerms.trim().length < 3)
              }
            >
              {locating
                ? t('form.locating')
                : error && /±/.test(error)
                  ? t('location.retry')
                  : t('form.publish')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {(step === 'done' || step === 'queued') && (
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-4 p-6 pb-[max(1.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] text-center">
          <Notice kind="success">
            {step === 'done' ? t('form.processing') : t('offline.queued')}
          </Notice>
          <Link
            href="/me?tab=status"
            className="rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-ink"
          >
            {t('form.seeStatus')}
          </Link>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => {
              setRec(null);
              setCaption('');
              setOfferTerms('');
              setProgress(0);
              setStep('camera');
            }}
          >
            {t('form.another')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';

/**
 * Republishes recordings kept offline once the network is back, but only if the device is
 * still within 100 m of where they were filmed (and with a precise fix).
 */
export function OfflineQueueRunner() {
  const t = useTranslations('capture.offline');
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(0);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [canRetry, setCanRetry] = useState(false);
  const running = useRef(false);

  const drain = useCallback(async () => {
    if (running.current || !navigator.onLine) return;
    running.current = true;
    setMessage(null);
    setCanRetry(false);
    try {
      // Loaded lazily: this runner is mounted on every page but rarely has work.
      const { judge, listQueued, removeQueued } = await import('@/lib/offline-queue');
      const items = await listQueued();
      setPending(items.length);
      if (items.length === 0) return;
      const { publish, PublishError } = await import('@/lib/publish');
      let fix;
      try {
        const pos = await currentPosition();
        fix = {
          lat: pos.coords.latitude,
          lng: pos.coords.longitude,
          accuracy: Math.ceil(pos.coords.accuracy),
        };
      } catch {
        setMessage(t('locationUnavailable'));
        setCanRetry(true);
        return;
      }
      for (const item of items) {
        const verdict = judge(item, Date.now(), fix);
        if (verdict === 'wait-precision') {
          setMessage(t('waitPrecision'));
          setCanRetry(true);
          continue;
        }
        if (verdict !== 'publish') {
          await removeQueued(item.id);
          setMessage(t(verdict === 'drop-stale' ? 'droppedStale' : 'droppedMoved'));
          continue;
        }
        try {
          await publish(item.blob, item.meta, item.fix, () => undefined, item.reserved, item.id);
          await removeQueued(item.id);
          setMessage(t('sent'));
        } catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof PublishError && error.reserved) {
            item.reserved = error.reserved;
            const { enqueue } = await import('@/lib/offline-queue');
            await enqueue(item);
          }
          if (error instanceof PublishError && error.retryable) {
            setMessage(t('retryable'));
            setCanRetry(true);
          } else {
            await removeQueued(item.id);
            setMessage(t('failed'));
          }
        }
      }
      setPending((await listQueued()).length);
    } finally {
      running.current = false;
    }
  }, [t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onOnline = () => void drain();
    window.addEventListener('online', onOnline);
    const timer = setTimeout(onOnline, 3000);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', onOnline);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [drain]);

  if (!pending && !message) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 top-3 z-40 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel/95 px-3 py-2 text-sm shadow-lg"
    >
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-3xl items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span>{message ?? t('pending', { count: pending })}</span>
        {canRetry && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void drain()}
            className="min-h-11 shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 font-semibold text-accent underline underline-offset-4"
          >
            {t('retry')}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';

interface LiveAlert {
  id: string;
  caption: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
}

/**
 * "Alertes proches" banner: initial list from the feed API, then live updates over Supabase
 * Realtime broadcast topics (one per H3 res-7 cell covering the radius). Payloads only carry
 * fuzzed positions.
 */
export function AlertsBanner({
  lat,
  lng,
  radius,
  onShow,
}: {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  radius: number;
  onShow: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('feed.alerts');
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<Map<string, string>>(new Map());
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({
      lat: String(lat),
      lng: String(lng),
      radius: String(radius),
      category: 'alert',
      limit: '20',
    });
    const refreshAlerts = () =>
      api<{ items: FeedItem[] }>(`/api/feed?${qs}`).then((res) => {
        if (alive && res.ok) setAlerts(new Map(res.data.items.map((i) => [i.id, i.caption])));
      });
    void refreshAlerts();
    const refreshTimer = window.setInterval(() => void refreshAlerts(), 60_000);

    // Realtime client and H3 are loaded after first paint, only where the banner is used.
    let cleanup = () => {};
    void Promise.all([import('@nl/shared'), import('@/lib/supabase/browser')]).then(
      ([{ haversineMeters, realtimeCells }, { browserClient }]) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const supabase = browserClient();
        const liveRadius = Math.min(radius, 5000);
        // shortcut: live updates cover at most 5 km (61 channels; 10 km would need 127, over
        // Realtime's per-client channel limit). Upgrade with coarser topic cells if needed.
        const channels = realtimeCells({ lat, lng }, liveRadius).map((cell) =>
          supabase
            .channel(`alerts:${cell}`, { config: { private: false } })
            .on('broadcast', { event: 'alert' }, ({ payload }) => {
              const a = payload as LiveAlert;
              if (haversineMeters({ lat, lng }, a) > liveRadius + 50) return;
              setAlerts((prev) => new Map(prev).set(a.id, a.caption));
              setFlash(a.caption || '');
              setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 6000);
            })
            .subscribe(),
        );
        cleanup = () => {
          for (const c of channels) void supabase.removeChannel(c);
        };
      },
    );
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      window.clearInterval(refreshTimer);
      cleanup();
    };
  }, [lat, lng, radius]);

  const showRangeNotice = radius > 5000;
  if (alerts.size === 0 && !showRangeNotice) return null;
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
      {alerts.size > 0 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onShow}
          className="flex min-h-9 w-full items-center gap-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-rose-600 px-2.5 text-left text-[11px] font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-rose-950/20 transition hover:bg-rose-700 focus-visible:outline-white sm:text-xs"
          aria-label={`${t('banner', { count: alerts.size })} — ${t('show')}`}
        >
          <svg
            aria-hidden="true"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          >
            <path d="M12 3 2.8 20h18.4L12 3Z" />
            <path d="M12 9v4m0 3h.01" />
          </svg>
          <span className="truncate">{t('banner', { count: alerts.size })}</span>
        </button>
      )}
      {showRangeNotice && (
        <p className="px-2 pt-1 text-[10px] leading-tight text-white/70" role="note">
          {t('liveLimit')}
        </p>
      )}
      {flash !== null && (
        <p
          role="alert"
          className="absolute left-4 right-4 top-full mt-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/90 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white shadow-lg backdrop-blur"
        >
          {t('new', { caption: flash })}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { COMMENT_MAX } from '@nl/shared';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { Button, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { Sheet } from './Sheet';

interface Comment {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  created_at: string;
  mine: boolean;
  author: { username: string | null; avatar_color: string; avatar_url: string | null } | null;
}

interface Page {
  comments: Comment[];
  nextBefore: string | null;
}

export function Comments({
  videoId,
  signedIn,
  onClose,
}: {
  videoId: string | null;
  signedIn: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('video.commentsPanel');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<Comment[]>([]);
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [body, setBody] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!videoId) return;
    let alive = true;
    void api<Page>(`/api/videos/${videoId}/comments`).then((res) => {
      if (!alive) return;
      if (res.ok) {
        setComments(res.data.comments);
        setNext(res.data.nextBefore);
      } else {
        setError(errorText(res.error));
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [errorText, reloadKey, videoId]);

  async function more() {
    if (!videoId || !next || loadingMore) return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    const res = await api<Page>(
      `/api/videos/${videoId}/comments?before=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`,
    );
    if (res.ok) {
      setComments((c) => [...c, ...res.data.comments]);
      setNext(res.data.nextBefore);
    } else setError(errorText(res.error));
    setLoadingMore(false);
  }

  async function send(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!videoId || !body.trim() || sending) return;
    setError(null);
    setSending(true);
    const res = await api<Comment>(`/api/videos/${videoId}/comments`, { body: { body } });
    if (!res.ok) setError(errorText(res.error));
    else {
      setComments((c) => [res.data, ...c]);
      setBody('');
    }
    setSending(false);
  }

  async function remove(id: string) {
    if (removing) return;
    setError(null);
    setRemoving(id);
    const res = await api(`/api/comments/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE', body: {} });
    if (res.ok) setComments((c) => c.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
    else setError(errorText(res.error));
    setRemoving(null);
  }

  return (
    <Sheet
      open={videoId !== null}
      title={t('title')}
      onClose={onClose}
      closeLabel={tc('close')}
      position="bottom"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {signedIn ? (
          <form onSubmit={send} className="flex gap-2">
            <label htmlFor="comment-body" className="sr-only">
              {t('placeholder')}
            </label>
            <input
              id="comment-body"
              className={inputClass}
              maxLength={COMMENT_MAX}
              placeholder={t('placeholder')}
              value={body}
              onChange={(e) => setBody(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={!body.trim() || sending}>
              {sending ? tc('loading') : t('send')}
            </Button>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <Notice>{t('login')}</Notice>
        )}
        {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
        {error && comments.length === 0 && !loading && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => {
              setLoading(true);
              setError(null);
              setComments([]);
              setNext(null);
              setReloadKey((key) => key + 1);
            }}
          >
            {tc('retry')}
          </Button>
        )}
        {loading ? (
          <p role="status" className="text-fog">
            {tc('loading')}
          </p>
        ) : comments.length === 0 && !error ? (
          <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>
        ) : comments.length > 0 ? (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {comments.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id} className="flex gap-3">
                <Avatar
                  username={c.author?.username ?? null}
                  color={c.author?.avatar_color ?? '#64748b'}
                  size={32}
                  src={c.author?.avatar_url}
                />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-xs text-fog">
                    @{c.author?.username} · {format.relativeTime(new Date(c.created_at), now)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-line break-words">{c.body}</p>
                </div>
                {c.mine && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="min-h-11 self-start rounded-lg px-2 text-xs text-fog underline"
                    disabled={removing === c.id}
                    onClick={() => void remove(c.id)}
                  >
                    {removing === c.id ? tc('loading') : t('delete')}
                  </button>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        ) : null}
        {next && (
          <Button variant="ghost" disabled={loadingMore} onClick={() => void more()}>
            {loadingMore ? tc('loading') : t('more')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```
