```tsx
'use client';

import { CATEGORIES, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { CategoryIcon } from '@/components/CategoryIcon';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';
import { formatDistance } from './format';

type SpotlightItem = Pick<
  FeedItem,
  'id' | 'category' | 'caption' | 'posterUrl' | 'videoUrl' | 'author' | 'distanceM' | 'usefulCount'
>;
type Status = 'idle' | 'locating' | 'loading' | 'ready';
type ErrorKind = 'denied' | 'locationError' | 'fetchError';

const SPOTLIGHT_LIMIT = 12;

export function ExploreSpotlightGrid() {
  const t = useTranslations('discover.spotlight');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const locale = useLocale();
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category | null>(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [sortMode, setSortMode] = useState<'relevance' | 'popular' | 'nearest'>('relevance');
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<SpotlightItem[]>([]);
  const [previewId, setPreviewId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false);
  const cardRefs = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLAnchorElement>());
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>('idle');
  const [error, setError] = useState<ErrorKind | null>(null);
  const initialLoadStarted = useRef(false);

  const loadSpotlight = useCallback(
    async (selectedCategory: Category | null, coords: { lat: number; lng: number } | null) => {
      setError(null);
      let searchPosition = coords;

      if (!searchPosition) {
        setStatus('locating');
        try {
          const fix = await currentPosition();
          searchPosition = { lat: fix.coords.latitude, lng: fix.coords.longitude };
          setPosition(searchPosition);
        } catch (reason) {
          const denied =
            typeof reason === 'object' && reason !== null && 'code' in reason && reason.code === 1;
          setError(denied ? 'denied' : 'locationError');
          setStatus('idle');
          return;
        }
      }

      setStatus('loading');
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        lat: String(searchPosition.lat),
        lng: String(searchPosition.lng),
        radius: '3000',
        limit: String(SPOTLIGHT_LIMIT),
        sort: 'relevance',
      });
      if (selectedCategory) query.set('category', selectedCategory);

      const result = await api<{ items: SpotlightItem[] }>(`/api/feed?${query}`);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setError('fetchError');
        setStatus('idle');
        return;
      }

      setItems(result.data.items.slice(0, SPOTLIGHT_LIMIT));
      setStatus('ready');
    },
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const media = window.matchMedia('(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)');
    const updateInputMode = () => setIsMobile(media.matches);
    updateInputMode();
    media.addEventListener('change', updateInputMode);
    return () => media.removeEventListener('change', updateInputMode);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMobile || status !== 'ready') return;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const visible = entries
          .filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio >= 0.65)
          .sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio)[0];
        if (visible) {
          setPreviewId(visible.target.getAttribute('data-spotlight-id'));
        } else {
          setPreviewId((current) => {
            const stillVisible = [...cardRefs.current.values()].some(
              (card) =>
                card.getAttribute('data-spotlight-id') === current &&
                card.getBoundingClientRect().top < window.innerHeight &&
                card.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 0,
            );
            return stillVisible ? current : null;
          });
        }
      },
      { threshold: [0, 0.65, 0.85] },
    );
    cardRefs.current.forEach((card) => observer.observe(card));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [isMobile, items, status]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialLoadStarted.current) return;
    initialLoadStarted.current = true;
    void loadSpotlight(null, null);
  }, [loadSpotlight]);

  function selectCategory(nextCategory: Category | null) {
    setCategory(nextCategory);
    setItems([]);
    if (status === 'ready') void loadSpotlight(nextCategory, position);
  }

  const busy = status === 'locating' || status === 'loading';
  const visibleItems = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedQuery = searchQuery.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(locale);
    const filtered = items.filter((item) => {
      if (!normalizedQuery) return true;
      const searchable = [
        item.caption,
        item.author.username ?? '',
        tc(`categories.${item.category}`),
      ]
        .join(' ')
        .toLocaleLowerCase(locale);
      return searchable.includes(normalizedQuery);
    });

    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortMode === 'popular') return b.usefulCount - a.usefulCount;
      if (sortMode === 'nearest') {
        if (a.distanceM === null) return b.distanceM === null ? 0 : 1;
        if (b.distanceM === null) return -1;
        return a.distanceM - b.distanceM;
      }
      return items.indexOf(a) - items.indexOf(b);
    });
  }, [items, locale, searchQuery, sortMode, tc]);

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="spotlight-title" className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:gap-5">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 id="spotlight-title" className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">
            {t('title')}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('subtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        {error && (
          <Button
            onClick={() => void loadSpotlight(category, position)}
            disabled={busy}
            className="shrink-0"
          >
            {t('retry')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </header>

      <nav aria-label={t('filtersLabel')} className="-mx-1 overflow-x-auto px-1 pb-1">
        <div className="flex w-max min-w-full gap-1">
          {[null, ...CATEGORIES].map((filter) => {
            const active = category === filter;
            return (
              <button
                key={filter ?? 'all'}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={active}
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => selectCategory(filter)}
                className={`group relative inline-flex min-h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:rounded-md focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 ${
                  active ? 'text-white' : 'text-fog hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {filter && <CategoryIcon category={filter} className="h-4 w-4" />}
                {filter ? tc(`categories.${filter}`) : t('all')}
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className={`absolute inset-x-2 bottom-0 h-0.5 origin-center rounded-full bg-blue transition-transform duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none ${
                    active ? 'scale-x-100' : 'scale-x-0'
                  }`}
                />
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </nav>

      <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('locationHint')}</p>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel/70 p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:p-4">
        <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1">
          <label htmlFor="spotlight-search" className="sr-only">
            {t('searchLabel')}
          </label>
          <input
            id="spotlight-search"
            type="search"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(event) => setSearchQuery(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={t('searchPlaceholder')}
            disabled={busy || items.length === 0}
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-ink/60 px-3 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-fog focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="spotlight-sort" className="text-xs font-semibold text-fog">
            {t('sortLabel')}
          </label>
          <select
            id="spotlight-sort"
            value={sortMode}
            onChange={(event) => setSortMode(event.target.value as typeof sortMode)}
            disabled={busy || items.length === 0}
            className="min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-line bg-ink px-3 text-sm text-white focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 sm:flex-none"
          >
            <option value="relevance">{t('sortRelevance')}</option>
            <option value="popular">{t('sortPopular')}</option>
            <option value="nearest">{t('sortNearest')}</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      {status === 'ready' && items.length > 0 && (
        <div
          className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-fog"
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          <span>{t('resultsCount', { count: visibleItems.length })}</span>
          {(searchQuery || sortMode !== 'relevance') && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSearchQuery('');
                setSortMode('relevance');
              }}
              className="min-h-9 shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2 font-semibold text-white underline underline-offset-4 transition-colors hover:text-blue focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent"
            >
              {t('resetSearchSort')}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <Notice kind="error">
          {error === 'denied'
            ? t('denied')
            : error === 'locationError'
              ? t('locationError')
              : t('fetchError')}
        </Notice>
      )}
      {busy && (
        <p role="status" className="text-sm text-fog">
          {t(status)}
        </p>
      )}
      {status === 'ready' &&
        (items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-5 text-sm text-fog">
            <p>{t('empty')}</p>
            {category && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => selectCategory(null)}
                className="mt-3 min-h-10 rounded-lg px-2 font-semibold text-white underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-blue focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent"
              >
                {t('clearCategory')}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : visibleItems.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-line bg-panel/60 p-6 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{t('noResults')}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-fog">{t('noResultsHint')}</p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="mt-3 min-h-10 rounded-lg px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-blue focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent"
            >
              {t('clearSearch')}
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
            {visibleItems.map((item, index) => {
              const distance =
                item.distanceM === null ? null : formatDistance(item.distanceM, locale);
              return (
                <Link
                  key={item.id}
                  href={`/v/${item.id}`}
                  ref={(node) => {
                    if (node) cardRefs.current.set(item.id, node);
                    else cardRefs.current.delete(item.id);
                  }}
                  data-spotlight-id={item.id}
                  onMouseEnter={() => {
                    if (!isMobile) setPreviewId(item.id);
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={() => {
                    if (!isMobile)
                      setPreviewId((current) => (current === item.id ? null : current));
                  }}
                  className={`group relative flex min-h-64 flex-col justify-end overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-line bg-panel transition duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-accent/60 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent ${
                    index === 0 ? 'col-span-2 row-span-2 min-h-[22rem] sm:min-h-[26rem]' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.posterUrl ? (
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- short-lived signed poster URL
                    <img
                      src={item.posterUrl}
                      alt=""
                      loading="lazy"
                      className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-panel to-ink"
                    />
                  )}
                  {item.videoUrl && (
                    <video
                      src={previewId === item.id ? item.videoUrl : undefined}
                      poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
                      muted
                      loop
                      playsInline
                      autoPlay
                      preload={previewId === item.id ? 'metadata' : 'none'}
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className={`absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-200 ${previewId === item.id ? 'opacity-100' : 'pointer-events-none opacity-0'}`}
                    />
                  )}
                  <div
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-3/4 bg-gradient-to-t from-ink via-ink/70 to-transparent"
                  />
                  <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col gap-2 p-4 sm:p-5">
                    <span className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-panel/80 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white backdrop-blur">
                      <CategoryIcon category={item.category} className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-blue" />
                      {tc(`categories.${item.category}`)}
                    </span>
                    <p className="video-overlay-copy line-clamp-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white sm:text-base">
                      {item.caption || tc('appName')}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 text-xs text-fog">
                      <span className="truncate">
                        {item.author.username ? `@${item.author.username}` : ''}
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5">
                        {distance && (
                          <span>
                            {distance.value} {distance.unit}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span aria-label={t('usefulCount', { count: item.usefulCount })}>
                          ♥{' '}
                          {new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact' }).format(
                            item.usefulCount,
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
} from '@/lib/feed-preferences';
import { useLocation } from '@/lib/useLocation';
import { useNeighborhoodFilters } from '@/lib/useNeighborhoodFilters';
import { getVideoMuted, setVideoMuted, subscribeToVideoMuted } from '@/lib/video-preferences';
import { AlertsBanner } from './AlertsBanner';
import { VideoCard } from './VideoCard';
import { WelcomeHero } from './WelcomeHero';

// Sheets are only needed once opened.
const Comments = dynamic(() => import('./Comments').then((m) => m.Comments), { ssr: false });
const ReportDialog = dynamic(() => import('./ReportDialog').then((m) => m.ReportDialog), {
  ssr: false,
});

interface Props {
  initialRadius: number;
  signedIn: boolean;
  focusId: string | null;
  returnToMap: boolean;
  initialCategory: Category | null;
  notice: string | null;
}

type Status = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
type VideoFit = 'cover' | 'contain';

const VIDEO_FIT_KEY = 'nl-video-fit';
const VIDEO_FIT_EVENT = 'nl-video-fit-change';
const REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY = '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)';
const EMPTY_HIDDEN_IDS = new Set<string>();

function getVideoFitSnapshot(): VideoFit {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'cover';
  try {
    const savedFit = window.localStorage.getItem(VIDEO_FIT_KEY);
    return savedFit === 'contain' ? 'contain' : 'cover';
  } catch {
    return 'cover';
  }
}

function subscribeToVideoFit(onChange: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener(VIDEO_FIT_EVENT, onChange);
  window.addEventListener('storage', onChange);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(VIDEO_FIT_EVENT, onChange);
    window.removeEventListener('storage', onChange);
  };
}

function saveVideoFit(fit: VideoFit) {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(VIDEO_FIT_KEY, fit);
  } catch {
    // Keep the in-memory preference usable when browser storage is unavailable.
  }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(VIDEO_FIT_EVENT));
}

function getReducedMotionSnapshot() {
  return window.matchMedia(REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY).matches;
}

function subscribeToReducedMotion(onChange: () => void) {
  const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia(REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY);
  mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', onChange);
  return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
}

export function Feed({
  initialRadius,
  signedIn,
  focusId,
  returnToMap,
  initialCategory,
  notice,
}: Props) {
  const t = useTranslations('feed');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const router = useRouter();
  const { state: location, locate, dismiss } = useLocation();
  const {
    radius,

    category,

    reset: resetFilters,

  } = useNeighborhoodFilters(initialRadius, initialCategory);
  const clearCategoryQuery = () => {
    if (!initialCategory) return;
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (!params.has('category')) return;
    params.delete('category');
    const query = params.toString();
    router.replace(query ? `/?${query}` : '/', { scroll: false });

                            setReducedCategories(next);

                    >

        </div>
      )}

      {coords && status === 'ready' && items.length === 0 && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 pt-36 text-center">
          <Illustration />

              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => changeCategory(null)}>

            )}

                {t('empty.wider', { radius: tc(`radius.${wider}`) })}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div
          ref={listRef}

          aria-busy={status === 'loading'}

                item={item}

                muted={muted}

                autoplay={autoplay}
                onToggleMute={() => setVideoMuted(!muted)}
                sortMode={sortMode}
                reducedCategory={reducedCategories.includes(item.category)}

                onReport={(i) => setReportFor(i.id)}
                onAuthRequired={goLogin}
                signedIn={signedIn}

          ))}
          <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-fog" role="status">

      )}

      {items.length > 1 && (
        <div className="feed-nav absolute top-1/2 z-30 hidden -translate-y-1/2 flex-col gap-4 lg:flex">
          {[
            { index: active - 1, label: t('previousVideo'), d: 'm6 15 6-6 6 6' },
            { index: active + 1, label: t('nextVideo'), d: 'm6 9 6 6 6-6' },
          ].map(({ index, label, d }) => (
            <button
              key={label}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => goTo(index)}
              disabled={index < 0 || index >= items.length}
              aria-label={label}
              className="glass flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-white transition-[transform,opacity] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              <svg
                aria-hidden="true"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                className="h-6 w-6"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.5"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <path d={d} />
              </svg>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {commentsFor && (
        <Comments
          key={commentsFor}
          videoId={commentsFor}
          signedIn={signedIn}
          onClose={() => setCommentsFor(null)}
        />
      )}
      {reportFor && <ReportDialog videoId={reportFor} onClose={() => setReportFor(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function SectionChip({
  active,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`min-h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full px-3 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-white ${
        active ? 'bg-accent text-white' : 'glass text-white/85 hover:text-white'
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function FilterChip({
  active,
  onClick,
  className = '',
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={`inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-4 text-sm font-medium transition ${active ? 'glow bg-accent font-semibold text-white' : 'glass text-white/90 hover:text-white'} ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function Illustration({ dim = false }: { dim?: boolean }) {
  return (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- static decorative SVG
    <img
      src="/illustrations/radar.svg"
      alt=""
      width={176}
      height={176}
      className={`mb-2 h-44 w-44 ${dim ? 'opacity-50 grayscale' : ''}`}

}

function FeedSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div
      className="relative flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-b from-panel to-ink"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <Illustration />
      <div className="absolute inset-x-4 bottom-8 flex flex-col gap-3 motion-safe:animate-pulse">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-full bg-white/10" />
          <div className="h-4 w-28 rounded-full bg-white/10" />
        </div>
        <div className="h-4 w-3/4 rounded-full bg-white/10" />
        <div className="h-4 w-1/2 rounded-full bg-white/10" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { REPORT_REASONS, type ReportReason } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { Sheet } from './Sheet';

export function ReportDialog({
  videoId,
  onClose,
}: {
  videoId: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('video.reportPanel');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<ReportReason>('recognizable_person');
  const [details, setDetails] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const close = () => {
    setStatus(null);
    setDetails('');
    onClose();
  };

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!videoId) return;
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api(`/api/videos/${videoId}/report`, { body: { reason, details } });
    setPending(false);
    if (res.ok) setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('done') });
    else
      setStatus({
        kind: 'error',
        text: res.error === 'already_reported' ? t('already') : (errorText(res.error) ?? ''),
      });
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={videoId !== null} title={t('title')} onClose={close} closeLabel={tc('close')}>
      {status?.kind === 'success' ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Notice kind="success">{status.text}</Notice>
          <Link
            href="/me/decisions"
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-line bg-white/[0.04] px-4 text-sm font-semibold"
          >
            {t('viewDecisions')}
          </Link>
          <Button onClick={close}>{tc('close')}</Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('threshold')}</p>
          <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">{t('reason')}</legend>
            {REPORT_REASONS.map((r) => (
              <label
                key={r}
                className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line px-3"
              >
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="reason"
                  value={r}
                  checked={reason === r}
                  onChange={() => setReason(r)}
                  className="h-5 w-5 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
                />
                {t(`reasons.${r}`)}
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
          <Field label={t('details')} htmlFor="report-details">
            <textarea
              id="report-details"
              className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
              maxLength={500}
              value={details}
              onChange={(e) => setDetails(e.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
          {status && <Notice kind="error">{status.text}</Notice>}
          <Button type="submit" variant="danger" disabled={pending}>
            {t('submit')}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Accessible bottom sheet built on <dialog> (focus trap, Escape to close). */
export function Sheet({
  open,
  title,
  onClose,
  closeLabel,
  children,
  position = 'center',
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  closeLabel: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  position?: 'center' | 'bottom';
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const d = ref.current;
    if (!d) return;
    if (open && !d.open) d.showModal();
    if (!open && d.open) d.close();
  }, [open]);
  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      onClose={onClose}
      onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}
      className={`mb-0 mt-auto max-h-[80dvh] w-full ${
        position === 'bottom' ? 'max-w-none' : 'max-w-lg'
      } rounded-t-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-0 text-white backdrop:bg-black/60 ${
        position === 'bottom'
          ? 'sm:mb-0 sm:mt-auto sm:rounded-t-2xl sm:rounded-b-none'
          : 'sm:m-auto sm:rounded-2xl'
      }`}
    >
      <div className="flex max-h-[80dvh] flex-col">
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
          <h2 id={titleId} className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label={closeLabel}
            className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center text-2xl"
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </header>
        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\feed\VideoCard.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { CATEGORY_COLORS, type FeedSort } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useLocale, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';
import { fetchIsVideoHidden, toggleHiddenVideoServer, isVideoHidden } from '@/lib/hidden-videos';
import { fetchIsVideoSaved, toggleSavedVideoServer, isVideoSaved } from '@/lib/saved-videos';
import { getOfferStatus } from '@/lib/offer-status';
import { formatDistance } from './format';
import { Sheet } from './Sheet';

interface Props {
  item: FeedItem;
  active: boolean;
  /** Only the visible video and the next one get a source (preload next only). */
  load: boolean;
  muted: boolean;
  fit: 'cover' | 'contain';
  onToggleFit: () => void;
  autoplay: boolean;
  onToggleMute: () => void;
  sortMode: FeedSort;
  reducedCategory: boolean;
  onComments: (item: FeedItem) => void;
  onReport: (item: FeedItem) => void;
  onAuthRequired: () => void;
  signedIn: boolean;
}

export function VideoCard({
  item,
  active,
  load,
  muted,
  fit,
  onToggleFit,
  autoplay,
  onToggleMute,
  sortMode,
  reducedCategory,
  onComments,
  onReport,
  onAuthRequired,
  signedIn,
}: Props) {
  const t = useTranslations('video');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const locale = useLocale();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const [src, setSrc] = useState(item.videoUrl);
  const [mediaReloadKey, setMediaReloadKey] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(true);
  const [mediaState, setMediaState] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('loading');
  const [usefulPending, setUsefulPending] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(() => isVideoSaved(item.id));
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(() => isVideoHidden(item.id));
  const [collectionPending, setCollectionPending] = useState<'saved' | 'hidden' | null>(null);
  const [time, setTime] = useState({ current: 0, duration: 0 });
  const progress = time.duration > 0 ? (time.current / time.duration) * 100 : 0;
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!signedIn) return;

    let active = true;
    void Promise.all([fetchIsVideoSaved(item.id), fetchIsVideoHidden(item.id)])
      .then(([isSaved, isHidden]) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setSaved(isSaved);
        setHidden(isHidden);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active) {
          setToast(t('collectionReadError'));
          setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [item.id, signedIn, t]);
  const mediaRetries = useRef(0);
  const mediaRequest = useRef<{
    generation: number;
    controller: AbortController | null;
  }>({ generation: 0, controller: null });
  const [useful, setUseful] = useState({ reacted: item.reacted, count: item.usefulCount });
  const [captionExpanded, setCaptionExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [shareOpen, setShareOpen] = useState(false);
  const [whyOpen, setWhyOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (active && autoplay && !shareOpen && !whyOpen)
      void video.play().catch(() => setPaused(true));
    if (!active || !autoplay || shareOpen || whyOpen) video.pause();
  }, [active, autoplay, mediaReloadKey, shareOpen, src, whyOpen]);

  const requestMediaUrl = useCallback(async () => {
    const generation = ++mediaRequest.current.generation;
    mediaRequest.current.controller?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    mediaRequest.current.controller = controller;

    try {
      const result = await api<FeedItem>(`/api/videos/${item.id}/media`, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || generation !== mediaRequest.current.generation) return null;
      return result;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, [item.id]);

  const refreshUrl = useCallback(
    async (force = false) => {
      if (mediaRetries.current >= 1) {
        setMediaState('error');
        return;
      }
      mediaRetries.current += 1;
      const res = await requestMediaUrl();
      if (!res) {
        setMediaState('error');
        return;
      }
      if (res.ok && res.data.videoUrl) {
        const sameUrl = res.data.videoUrl === src;
        setSrc(res.data.videoUrl);
        if (force || sameUrl) setMediaReloadKey((key) => key + 1);
        setMediaState('loading');
        return;
      }
      setMediaState('error');
    },
    [requestMediaUrl, src],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!load || src || mediaRetries.current >= 1) return;

    let current = true;
    let settled = false;
    mediaRetries.current += 1;
    void requestMediaUrl().then((res) => {
      settled = true;
      if (!current || !res) return;
      if (res.ok && res.data.videoUrl) {
        mediaRetries.current = 0;
        setSrc(res.data.videoUrl);
        setMediaState('loading');
      } else {
        setMediaState('error');
      }
    });

    return () => {
      current = false;
      // A request cancelled before answering (remount, StrictMode) must not consume the attempt.
      if (!settled) mediaRetries.current -= 1;
    };
  }, [item.id, load, requestMediaUrl, src]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      mediaRequest.current.generation += 1;
      mediaRequest.current.controller?.abort();
      mediaRequest.current.controller = null;
    },
    [item.id],
  );

  function retryMedia() {
    mediaRetries.current = 0;
    setMediaState('loading');
    void refreshUrl(true);
  }

  async function toggleUseful() {
    if (!signedIn) return onAuthRequired();
    if (usefulPending) return;
    setUsefulPending(true);
    const res = await api<{ reacted: boolean; usefulCount: number }>(
      `/api/videos/${item.id}/useful`,
      {
        method: useful.reacted ? 'DELETE' : 'POST',
        body: {},
      },
    );
    if (res.ok) {
      setUseful({ reacted: res.data.reacted, count: res.data.usefulCount });
      setToast(t(res.data.reacted ? 'usefulToast' : 'removeUsefulToast'));
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
    } else {
      setToast(t('usefulError'));
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
    }
    setUsefulPending(false);
  }

  async function toggleSave() {
    if (!signedIn) return onAuthRequired();

    if (collectionPending) return;
    setCollectionPending('saved');
    try {
      const next = await toggleSavedVideoServer(item.id);
      setSaved(next.saved);
      setToast(next.saved ? t('saveToast') : t('unsaveToast'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('nl-saved-videos-change'));
    } catch {
      setToast(t('saveError'));
    } finally {
      setCollectionPending(null);
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
    }
  }

  async function toggleHide() {
    if (!signedIn) return onAuthRequired();

    if (collectionPending) return;
    if (!hidden && !window.confirm(t('hideConfirm'))) return;
    setCollectionPending('hidden');
    try {
      const next = await toggleHiddenVideoServer(item.id);
      setHidden(next.hidden);
      setToast(next.hidden ? t('hideToast') : t('unhideToast'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('nl-hidden-videos-change'));
    } catch {
      setToast(t('hideError'));
    } finally {
      setCollectionPending(null);
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
    }
  }

  async function copyShareLink() {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/v/${item.id}`;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      setShareOpen(false);
      setToast(t('shared'));
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
    } catch {
      setToast(t('shareError'));
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
    }
  }

  async function shareWithDevice() {
    if (!navigator.share) {
      await copyShareLink();
      return;
    }

    try {
      await navigator.share({
        title: tc(item.category),
        text: item.caption,
        url: `${window.location.origin}/v/${item.id}`,
      });
      setShareOpen(false);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error && error.name === 'AbortError') return;
      setToast(t('shareError'));
      setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
    }
  }

  function togglePlay() {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (video.paused)
      void video.play().catch(() => {
        setPaused(true);
        setToast(t('playbackError'));
        setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
      });
    else video.pause();
  }

  const distance = item.distanceM === null ? null : formatDistance(item.distanceM, locale);
  const distanceLabel = distance ? t(distance.unit, { value: distance.value }) : null;
  const publishedWhen = item.publishedAt
    ? format.relativeTime(new Date(item.publishedAt), now)
    : format.relativeTime(new Date(item.expiresAt), now);
  const offerStatus = getOfferStatus(
    item.category,
    item.author.isMerchant,
    item.expiresAt,
    'active',
    now,
  );
  const merchantWebsite = item.author.isMerchant ? item.author.merchantWebsite : null;
  const merchantPhone = item.author.isMerchant ? item.author.merchantPhone : null;
  const merchantAddress = item.author.isMerchant ? item.author.merchantAddress : null;

  return (
    <article
      className="video-card isolate relative h-full w-full snap-start snap-always overflow-hidden bg-black"
      aria-label={`${tc(item.category)} — ${item.caption}`}
      data-testid="feed-item"
      data-video-id={item.id}
    >
      {/* Desktop always shows the blurred backdrop around the centred 9:16 column. */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className={`absolute inset-[-2rem] z-0 bg-black bg-cover bg-center transition-opacity duration-300 ${fit === 'contain' ? '' : 'hidden lg:block'}`}
        style={{
          backgroundImage: item.posterUrl ? `url("${item.posterUrl}")` : undefined,
          filter: 'blur(28px) brightness(0.42)',
        }}
      />
      <video
        key={`${item.id}:${mediaReloadKey}`}
        ref={ref}
        src={load && src ? src : undefined}
        poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
        preload={load ? 'auto' : 'none'}
        playsInline
        muted={muted}
        loop
        onPlay={() => setPaused(false)}
        onPause={() => setPaused(true)}
        onLoadedData={() => {
          mediaRetries.current = 0;
          setMediaState('ready');
        }}
        onTimeUpdate={(event) => {
          const video = event.currentTarget;
          if (Number.isFinite(video.duration) && video.duration > 0) {
            setTime({ current: video.currentTime, duration: video.duration });
          }
        }}
        onError={() => {
          if (load && src) void refreshUrl();
        }}
        onClick={togglePlay}
        className={`relative z-10 h-full w-full ${fit === 'cover' ? 'object-cover' : 'object-contain'}`}
      />
      <div
        role="progressbar"
        aria-label={t('playbackProgress')}
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={100}
        aria-valuenow={Math.round(progress)}
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-30 h-0.5 bg-white/30 lg:inset-x-6 lg:bottom-16 lg:h-1 lg:rounded-full"
      >
        <div
          className="h-full rounded-full bg-white/90 transition-[width] duration-200 lg:bg-accent"
          style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="absolute inset-x-6 bottom-3 z-30 hidden items-center gap-3 text-white lg:flex">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={togglePlay}
          aria-label={paused ? t('play') : t('pause')}
          disabled={mediaState !== 'ready'}
          className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-colors hover:bg-white/15 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-white disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="h-6 w-6" fill="currentColor">
            {paused ? <path d="M7 4.5v15l12-7.5z" /> : <path d="M6 5h4v14H6zm8 0h4v14h-4z" />}
          </svg>
        </button>
        <span className="text-sm tabular-nums text-white/80">
          {formatClock(time.current)} / {formatClock(time.duration)}
        </span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggleMute}
          aria-label={muted ? t('unmute') : t('mute')}
          aria-pressed={!muted}
          className="ml-auto flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-colors hover:bg-white/15 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
        >
          <svg

            viewBox="0 0 24 24"

            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          >
            <path
              d={
                muted
                  ? 'M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4zM17 9l4 6m0-6l-4 6'
                  : 'M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4zM16 8a5 5 0 010 8m2.5-10.5a8.5 8.5 0 010 13'
              }
            />

        </button>
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onToggleFit}
        aria-label={fit === 'cover' ? t('showEntireVideo') : t('fillScreen')}
        className="glass absolute right-4 top-[10.5rem] z-30 lg:top-auto lg:right-20 lg:bottom-3 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-white transition-[transform,background-color] duration-200 ease-out hover:scale-105 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
      >
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"

          strokeWidth="2"

          strokeLinejoin="round"
        >
          {fit === 'cover' ? (
            <path d="M8 3H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v3m13-5h3a2 2 0 012 2v3M3 16v3a2 2 0 002 2h3m13-5v3a2 2 0 01-2 2h-3" />
          ) : (
            <path d="M8 3v5H3m13-5v5h5M3 16h5v5m13-5h-5v5" />

      </button>
      {load && mediaState === 'loading' && (

          role="status"

          <button

      <button

'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 focus:opacity-100'}`}

          />

              : 'M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4zM16 8a5 5 0 010 8m2.5-10.5a8.5 8.5 0 010 13'

      {toast && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="absolute left-1/2 top-20 z-40 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-black/70 px-3 py-1 text-sm text-white"

      <Sheet
        open={shareOpen}

      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-white/75">{t('sharePanel.description')}</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void shareWithDevice()}
            className="flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 font-semibold text-ink focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
          >
            {t('sharePanel.system')}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void copyShareLink()}
            className="glass flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 font-semibold text-white focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
          >
            {t('sharePanel.copyLink')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </Sheet>
      <Sheet
        open={whyOpen}
        title={t('whyPanel.title')}
        onClose={() => setWhyOpen(false)}
        closeLabel={t('whyPanel.close')}
      >
        <div className="space-y-3 text-sm text-white/85">
          <p>{t(`whyPanel.sort.${sortMode}`)}</p>
          {distanceLabel && <p>{t('whyPanel.distance', { distance: distanceLabel })}</p>}
          <p>{t('whyPanel.category', { category: tc(item.category) })}</p>
          <p>{t('whyPanel.freshness', { when: publishedWhen })}</p>
          <p>{t('whyPanel.useful', { count: useful.count })}</p>
          {reducedCategory && sortMode === 'relevance' && <p>{t('whyPanel.reducedCategory')}</p>}
        </div>
      </Sheet>
    </article>
  );
}

function formatClock(seconds: number) {
  const s = Math.floor(seconds);
  return `${String(Math.floor(s / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function ActionButton({
  label,
  ariaLabel,
  icon,
  onClick,
  pressed,
  disabled = false,
  className = '',
}: {
  label: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  icon: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      aria-pressed={pressed}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`${className} feed-action-button group flex min-h-11 w-14 flex-col items-center gap-1 text-center transition-[transform,opacity] duration-200 ease-out hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 focus-visible:rounded-xl focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-60`}
    >
      <span
        className={`feed-action-icon flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-[transform,background-color,color,box-shadow] duration-200 ease-out group-active:scale-95 ${pressed ? 'glow bg-accent text-white' : 'text-white'}`}
      >
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          className="h-5 w-5 transition-transform duration-200 ease-out group-hover:scale-110"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeLinecap="round"
        >
          <path d={icon} />
        </svg>
      </span>
      <span className="feed-action-label max-w-full leading-tight drop-shadow">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  { tile: 'from-violet-500 to-indigo-600', icon: 'M3 7h12v10H3zM15 10l6-3v10l-6-3' },
  {
    tile: 'from-sky-400 to-blue-600',
    icon: 'M12 21s-7-6.1-7-11.5A7 7 0 0112 2.5a7 7 0 017 7C19 14.9 12 21 12 21zm0-8.5a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6z',

  { tile: 'from-fuchsia-500 to-pink-600', icon: 'M4 9l1.5-5h13L20 9M4 9v11h16V9M10 20v-5h4v5' },
  { tile: 'from-amber-400 to-orange-500', icon: 'M4 6h16v15H4zM4 10h16M8 3v4M16 3v4' },
] as const;

/**
 * Home screen shown until the viewer's position is known. It also serves as the explanation
 * shown before the system location prompt.
 */
export function WelcomeHero({
  status,
  signedIn,
  notice,
  onLocate,
  onLater,
}: {
  status: LocationState['status'];
  signedIn: boolean;
  notice: string | null;
  onLocate: () => void;
  onLater: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('feed');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const features = t.raw('hero.features') as { title: string; body: string }[];
  const locating = status === 'locating' || status === 'unknown';

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="welcome-title" className="h-full overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain">
      <div className="relative h-[38%] max-h-[24rem] min-h-60 overflow-hidden">
        {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- static decorative SVG */}
        <img
          src="/illustrations/city-night.svg"
          alt=""
          className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover"
        />
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 pb-3 text-center">
          <span className="drop-shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(139,92,255,0.6)]">
            <LogoMark size={52} />
          </span>
          <p className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">{tc('appName')}</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-fog">
            {tc('slogan').split(' ').slice(0, -1).join(' ')}{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-blue">{tc('slogan').split(' ').at(-1)}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-xl flex-col gap-5 px-5 pt-3 pb-8">
        {notice && <Notice kind="success">{notice}</Notice>}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-center">
          <h1 id="welcome-title" className="text-2xl leading-tight font-bold text-balance">
            {t('hero.title')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('hero.body')}</p>
        </div>

        <ul className="order-last grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {features.map((f, i) => (
            <li
              key={f.title}
              className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-3xl border border-white/[0.07] bg-panel/80 p-3.5"
            >
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br text-white shadow-lg ${FEATURES[i]?.tile ?? FEATURES[0].tile}`}
              >
                <svg
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  className="h-5 w-5"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                >
                  <path d={FEATURES[i]?.icon ?? FEATURES[0].icon} />
                </svg>
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm leading-tight font-semibold">{f.title}</span>
              <span className="text-xs leading-snug text-fog">{f.body}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {status === 'denied' && <Notice kind="error">{t('location.denied')}</Notice>}
          {status === 'error' && <Notice>{t('location.needed')}</Notice>}
          <Button onClick={onLocate} disabled={locating} className="min-h-13 text-base">
            <svg
              aria-hidden="true"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              className={`h-5 w-5 ${locating ? 'motion-safe:animate-spin' : ''}`}
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
            >
              {locating ? (
                <path d="M12 3a9 9 0 109 9" />
              ) : (
                <path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3M12 17a5 5 0 100-10 5 5 0 000 10z" />
              )}
            </svg>
            <span role={locating ? 'status' : undefined}>
              {locating ? t('location.locating') : t('location.allow')}
            </span>
          </Button>
          <div className="flex gap-3 *:flex-1">
            <Link
              href="/commerces/decouvrir"
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-3 text-sm font-semibold hover:border-accent/60"
            >
              {t('hero.shops')}
            </Link>
            {signedIn ? (
              status === 'primer' && (
                <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onLater}>
                  {t('location.later')}
                </Button>
              )
            ) : (
              <Link
                href="/login?next=/"
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-3 text-sm font-semibold hover:border-accent/60"
              >
                {t('hero.login')}
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="flex items-start gap-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-fog">
            <svg
              aria-hidden="true"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-accent"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            >
              <path d="M6 11V8a6 6 0 0112 0v3M5 11h14v10H5z" />
            </svg>
            {t('location.primerBody')}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```ts
/** "300 m" / "1,2 km" from a 100 m bucketed distance. */
export function formatDistance(
  meters: number,
  locale: string,
): { unit: 'm' | 'km'; value: string } {
  if (meters < 1000) return { unit: 'm', value: String(meters) };
  return {
    unit: 'km',
    value: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(meters / 1000),
  };
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { CATEGORIES, CATEGORY_COLORS, RADII_M, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { CategoryIcon } from '@/components/CategoryIcon';
import { Sheet } from '@/components/feed/Sheet';

export function MapFiltersDialog({
  open,
  category,
  radius,
  canReset,
  onCategoryChange,
  onRadiusChange,
  onReset,
  onClose,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  category: Category | null;
  radius: number;
  canReset: boolean;
  onCategoryChange: (category: Category | null) => void;
  onRadiusChange: (radius: number) => void;
  onReset: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('map.filters');
  const tf = useTranslations('feed.filters');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} title={t('title')} onClose={onClose} closeLabel={tc('actions.close')}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
        <fieldset>
          <legend className="mb-3 text-sm font-semibold">{tf('label')}</legend>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <CategoryButton active={category === null} onClick={() => onCategoryChange(null)}>
              {tf('all')}
            </CategoryButton>
            {CATEGORIES.map((item) => (
              <CategoryButton
                key={item}
                active={category === item}
                onClick={() => onCategoryChange(item)}
              >
                <span style={{ color: category === item ? undefined : CATEGORY_COLORS[item] }}>
                  <CategoryIcon category={item} />
                </span>
                {tc(`categories.${item}`)}
              </CategoryButton>
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="map-radius" className="text-sm font-semibold">
            {tf('radius')}
          </label>
          <select
            id="map-radius"
            value={radius}
            onChange={(event) => onRadiusChange(Number(event.target.value))}
            className="glass min-h-12 w-full rounded-xl px-4 text-sm font-semibold"
          >
            {RADII_M.map((value) => (
              <option key={value} value={value}>
                {tc(`radius.${value}`)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        {canReset && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onReset}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-white/15 px-4 text-sm font-semibold text-white/90 transition-colors hover:border-accent/70 hover:text-white focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
          >
            {t('reset')}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

function CategoryButton({
  active,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 text-sm font-medium transition ${active ? 'glow bg-accent font-semibold text-white' : 'glass text-white/90 hover:text-white'}`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\map\MapView.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css';
import { CATEGORIES, CATEGORY_COLORS, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import type { ExpressionSpecification, GeoJSONSource, Map as MlMap, Marker } from 'maplibre-gl';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';
import { useNeighborhoodFilters } from '@/lib/useNeighborhoodFilters';
import { useLocation } from '@/lib/useLocation';
import { circlePolygon, zoomForRadius } from './geometry';
import { MapFiltersDialog } from './MapFiltersDialog';
import { getMapViewport, setMapViewport } from './viewport';

interface Selected {
  id: string;
  category: Category;
  caption: string;
  posterUrl: string | null;
  username: string | null;
  usefulCount: number | null;
  previewLoading: boolean;
  previewUnavailable: boolean;
}

type VideosGeoJSON = { type: 'FeatureCollection'; features: unknown[] };

const VIDEO_LAYERS = ['points', 'clusters'] as const;

const colorExpression = [
  'match',
  ['get', 'category'],
  ...CATEGORIES.flatMap((c) => [c, CATEGORY_COLORS[c]]),
  '#9ca3af',
] as unknown as ExpressionSpecification;

export function MapView({ initialRadius }: { initialRadius: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations('map');
  const tf = useTranslations('feed');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const { state: location, locate, dismiss } = useLocation();

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mapRef = useRef<MlMap | null>(null);
  const markerRef = useRef<Marker | null>(null);
  const lastLocationRef = useRef<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const previewRequestRef = useRef(0);

  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [filtersOpen, setFiltersOpen] = useState(false);
  const [count, setCount] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Selected | null>(null);
  const [resultsState, setResultsState] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('loading');
  const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0);

  const {
    radius,
    setRadius,
    category,
    setCategory,
    reset: resetFilters,
    customized: filtersCustomized,
    ready: filtersReady,
  } = useNeighborhoodFilters(initialRadius, null);

  const lat = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lat : null;
  const lng = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lng : null;
  const isFilterActive = Boolean(category) || radius !== initialRadius;

  // ── Création de la carte (une seule fois, une fois la position + filtres prêts) ──
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!filtersReady || lat === null || lng === null || mapRef.current) return;
    const node = containerRef.current;
    if (!node) return;

    let cancelled = false;
    void import('maplibre-gl').then((maplibregl) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      maplibregl.setWorkerUrl('/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs');

      const savedViewport = getMapViewport();
      const map = new maplibregl.Map({
        container: node,
        style: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL,
        center: savedViewport ? [savedViewport.longitude, savedViewport.latitude] : [lng, lat],
        zoom: savedViewport?.zoom ?? zoomForRadius(radius),
        attributionControl: { compact: true },
      });
      mapRef.current = map;

      map.on('moveend', () => {
        const center = map.getCenter();
        setMapViewport({
          latitude: center.lat,
          longitude: center.lng,
          zoom: map.getZoom(),
        });
      });

      map.on('load', () => {
        map.addSource('radius', {
          type: 'geojson',
          data: circlePolygon(lat, lng, radius),
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'radius-fill',
          type: 'fill',
          source: 'radius',
          paint: { 'fill-color': '#2563eb', 'fill-opacity': 0.08 },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'radius-line',
          type: 'line',
          source: 'radius',
          paint: { 'line-color': '#2563eb', 'line-width': 2 },
        });
        map.addSource('videos', {
          type: 'geojson',
          data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] },
          cluster: true,
          clusterRadius: 42,
          clusterMaxZoom: 17,
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'clusters',
          type: 'circle',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['has', 'point_count'],
          paint: {
            'circle-color': '#141a2c',
            'circle-stroke-color': '#2563eb',
            'circle-stroke-width': 2,
            'circle-radius': ['step', ['get', 'point_count'], 16, 10, 22, 30, 28],
          },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'cluster-count',
          type: 'symbol',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['has', 'point_count'],
          layout: { 'text-field': ['get', 'point_count_abbreviated'], 'text-size': 13 },
          paint: { 'text-color': '#ffffff' },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'points',
          type: 'circle',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['!', ['has', 'point_count']],
          paint: {
            'circle-color': colorExpression,
            'circle-radius': 9,
            'circle-stroke-color': '#ffffff',
            'circle-stroke-width': 2,
          },
        });

        map.on('click', 'points', (e) => {
          const p = e.features?.[0]?.properties as Selected | undefined;
          if (!p?.id) return;
          const request = ++previewRequestRef.current;
          setSelected({
            id: p.id,
            category: p.category,
            caption: p.caption,
            posterUrl: null,
            username: null,
            usefulCount: null,
            previewLoading: true,
            previewUnavailable: false,
          });
          void api<FeedItem>(`/api/videos/${encodeURIComponent(p.id)}/media`).then((res) => {
            if (request !== previewRequestRef.current) return;
            if (res.ok) {
              setSelected((current) =>
                current?.id === p.id
                  ? {
                      ...current,
                      category: res.data.category,
                      caption: res.data.caption,
                      posterUrl: res.data.posterUrl,
                      username: res.data.author.username,
                      usefulCount: res.data.usefulCount,
                      previewLoading: false,
                    }
                  : current,
              );
            } else {
              setSelected((current) =>
                current?.id === p.id
                  ? { ...current, previewLoading: false, previewUnavailable: true }
                  : current,
              );
            }
          });
        });

        map.on('click', 'clusters', (e) => {
          const feature = e.features?.[0];
          if (!feature) return;
          const clusterId = feature.properties?.cluster_id as number | undefined;
          if (clusterId == null) return;
          const source = map.getSource('videos') as GeoJSONSource;
          void source
            .getClusterExpansionZoom(clusterId)
            .then((zoom) => {
              const coords = (feature.geometry as { coordinates: [number, number] }).coordinates;
              map.easeTo({ center: coords, zoom });
            })
            .catch(() => {});
        });

        // Ferme la fiche si on clique sur une zone vide de la carte.
        map.on('click', (e) => {
          const hit = map.queryRenderedFeatures(e.point, { layers: [...VIDEO_LAYERS] });
          if (hit.length === 0) {
            previewRequestRef.current += 1;
            setSelected(null);
          }
        });

        for (const layer of VIDEO_LAYERS) {
          map.on('mouseenter', layer, () => {
            map.getCanvas().style.cursor = 'pointer';
          });
          map.on('mouseleave', layer, () => {
            map.getCanvas().style.cursor = '';
          });
        }

        markerRef.current = new maplibregl.Marker({ color: '#2563eb' })
          .setLngLat([lng, lat])
          .addTo(map);
        setLoaded(true);
      });
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [filtersReady, lat, lng, radius]);

  // ── Démontage : on retire proprement la carte ──
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      markerRef.current = null;
      mapRef.current?.remove();
      mapRef.current = null;
    };
  }, []);

  // ── Données + overlay rayon + marker, en fonction de la position et des filtres ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapRef.current;
    if (!loaded || !filtersReady || !map || lat === null || lng === null) return;

    setResultsState('loading');
    (map.getSource('radius') as GeoJSONSource | undefined)?.setData(
      circlePolygon(lat, lng, radius),
    );
    markerRef.current?.setLngLat([lng, lat]);

    const qs = new URLSearchParams({
      lat: String(lat),
      lng: String(lng),
      radius: String(radius),
    });
    if (category) qs.set('category', category);

    let alive = true;
    void api<VideosGeoJSON>(`/api/map?${qs}`)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        if (!res.ok) {
          setResultsState('error');
          return;
        }
        (map.getSource('videos') as GeoJSONSource).setData(
          res.data as Parameters<GeoJSONSource['setData']>[0],
        );
        setCount(res.data.features.length);
        setResultsState('ready');
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (alive) setResultsState('error');
      });

    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [loaded, filtersReady, lat, lng, radius, category, retry]);

  // ── Recadrage : on saute le premier run (la carte est déjà créée au bon endroit) ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapRef.current;
    if (!loaded || !map || lat === null || lng === null) return;

    const previous = lastLocationRef.current;
    lastLocationRef.current = { lat, lng };

    if (previous === null) return; // premier run : rien à recadrer

    const locationChanged = previous.lat !== lat || previous.lng !== lng;
    map.flyTo({
      center: locationChanged ? [lng, lat] : map.getCenter(),
      zoom: zoomForRadius(radius),
    });
  }, [loaded, lat, lng, radius]);

  // ── Fermeture de la fiche via Échap ──
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selected) return;
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') setSelected(null);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [selected]);

  const relocate = useCallback(() => void locate(), [locate]);
  const closeSelected = useCallback(() => {
    previewRequestRef.current += 1;
    setSelected(null);
  }, []);
  const retryLoad = useCallback(() => {
    setResultsState('loading');
    setRetry((value) => value + 1);
  }, []);

  const statusMessage =
    resultsState === 'ready' && count !== null
      ? t('count', { count, radius: tc(`radius.${radius}`) })
      : resultsState === 'loading'
        ? t('loading', { radius: tc(`radius.${radius}`) })
        : '';

  return (
    <div className="relative h-[calc(100dvh-4.5rem)] w-full">
      <h1 className="sr-only">{t('title')}</h1>

      <PermissionPrimer
        open={location.status === 'primer'}
        title={tf('location.primerTitle')}
        confirmLabel={tf('location.allow')}
        cancelLabel={tf('location.later')}
        onConfirm={() => void locate()}
        onCancel={dismiss}
      >
        <p>{tf('location.primerBody')}</p>
      </PermissionPrimer>

      <div ref={containerRef} className="h-full w-full" role="region" aria-label={t('title')} />

      {(location.status === 'denied' || location.status === 'error') && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <Notice kind="error">
            {location.status === 'denied' ? tf('location.denied') : tf('location.needed')}
          </Notice>
          <Button onClick={relocate}>{tf('location.allow')}</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 p-3">
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          className="rounded-full shadow-lg"
          onClick={() => setFiltersOpen(true)}
          aria-haspopup="dialog"
          aria-expanded={filtersOpen}
          aria-label={
            isFilterActive ? `${t('filters.button')}, ${t('filters.active')}` : t('filters.button')
          }
        >
          <svg
            aria-hidden="true"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            className="h-5 w-5"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2"
            strokeLinecap="round"
          >
            <path d="M4 6h16M7 12h10m-7 6h4" />
            <circle cx="8" cy="6" r="1.5" fill="currentColor" />
            <circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="currentColor" />
            <circle cx="11" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="currentColor" />
          </svg>
          {t('filters.button')}
          {isFilterActive && (
            <span className="ml-1 h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-accent" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
        </Button>

        <p
          className="glass max-w-[55%] rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-right text-xs empty:hidden"
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          {statusMessage}
        </p>
      </div>

      <MapFiltersDialog
        open={filtersOpen}
        category={category}
        radius={radius}
        canReset={filtersCustomized}
        onCategoryChange={setCategory}
        onRadiusChange={setRadius}
        onReset={resetFilters}
        onClose={() => setFiltersOpen(false)}
      />

      {resultsState === 'error' && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="absolute inset-x-3 top-16 z-10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-alert/50 bg-ink/95 p-3 shadow-xl"
        >
          <p className="text-sm">{t('loadError')}</p>
          <Button variant="secondary" className="shrink-0" onClick={retryLoad}>
            {tc('actions.retry')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <Button
        variant="secondary"
        className="absolute bottom-6 right-3 rounded-full"
        onClick={relocate}
        aria-label={t('locate')}
      >
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          className="h-5 w-5"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
        >
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
          <path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3" />
        </svg>
        {t('locate')}
      </Button>

      <p className="absolute bottom-1 left-3 text-[10px] text-fog">{t('attribution')}</p>

      {selected && (
        <div
          className="glass absolute inset-x-3 bottom-20 flex max-h-[45dvh] items-start gap-3 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl p-3 shadow-2xl shadow-black/40 sm:inset-x-auto sm:bottom-6 sm:left-4 sm:w-[min(26rem,calc(100%-2rem))]"
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={tc(`categories.${selected.category}`)}
        >
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
            {selected.posterUrl ? (
              // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- short-lived signed poster URL
              <img
                src={selected.posterUrl}
                alt=""
                className="mb-3 aspect-video w-full rounded-2xl bg-black object-cover"
              />
            ) : (
              <div
                aria-hidden="true"
                className="mb-3 flex aspect-video items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-black/30"
              >
                {selected.previewLoading ? (

                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {selected.username && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-fog">@{selected.username}</p>}

            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">

                href={`/v/${encodeURIComponent(selected.id)}`}

              >
                {t('preview.details')}

              <Link
                href={`/?video=${encodeURIComponent(selected.id)}&category=${selected.category}&radius=${radius}&fromMap=1`}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-xl bg-accent px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-ink"
              >
                {t('open')}
              </Link>

          <button
            type="button"

            aria-label={tc('actions.close')}

          >
            ×
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
/** GeoJSON polygon approximating a circle of `radiusM` around a point (for the radius overlay). */
export function circlePolygon(lat: number, lng: number, radiusM: number, steps = 64) {
  const coords: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i += 1) {
    const a = (i / steps) * 2 * Math.PI;
    coords.push([
      lng + (radiusM * Math.cos(a)) / (111_320 * Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180)),
      lat + (radiusM * Math.sin(a)) / 110_540,
    ]);
  }
  return {
    type: 'Feature' as const,
    properties: {},
    geometry: { type: 'Polygon' as const, coordinates: [coords] },
  };
}

/** Zoom level showing the whole radius on a phone screen. */
export const zoomForRadius = (radiusM: number): number =>
  radiusM <= 300
    ? 15.5
    : radiusM <= 1000
      ? 14
      : radiusM <= 3000
        ? 12.4
        : radiusM <= 5000
          ? 11.6
          : 10.6;
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { getMapViewport, setMapViewport } from './viewport';

describe('in-memory map viewport', () => {
  beforeEach(() => setMapViewport(null));

  it('keeps the most recent view available during client navigation', () => {
    const viewport = { latitude: 48.8566, longitude: 2.3522, zoom: 13 };

    setMapViewport(viewport);

    expect(getMapViewport()).toEqual(viewport);
  });

  it('does not persist a viewport when the map has not been visited', () => {
    expect(getMapViewport()).toBeNull();
  });

  it('can clear the view after the user resets the map session', () => {
    setMapViewport({ latitude: 48, longitude: 2, zoom: 11 });

    setMapViewport(null);

    expect(getMapViewport()).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export function MerchantForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('merchant');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState('');
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('');
  const [address, setAddress] = useState('');
  const [openingHours, setOpeningHours] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/merchant', {
      body: { businessName, description, website, phone, address, openingHours },
    });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <Field label={t('businessName')} htmlFor="m-name">
        <input
          id="m-name"
          className={inputClass}
          maxLength={80}
          required
          value={businessName}
          onChange={(e) => setBusinessName(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('description')} htmlFor="m-desc">
        <textarea
          id="m-desc"
          className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
          maxLength={280}
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <Field label={t('website')} htmlFor="m-website">
          <input
            id="m-website"
            type="url"
            className={inputClass}
            value={website}
            placeholder="https://"
            onChange={(e) => setWebsite(e.target.value)}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t('phone')} htmlFor="m-phone">
          <input
            id="m-phone"
            className={inputClass}
            value={phone}
            maxLength={30}
            onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
          />
        </Field>
      </div>
      <Field label={t('address')} htmlFor="m-address">
        <input
          id="m-address"
          className={inputClass}
          value={address}
          maxLength={200}
          onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('openingHours')} htmlFor="m-hours">
        <input
          id="m-hours"
          className={inputClass}
          value={openingHours}
          maxLength={200}
          placeholder={t('openingHoursPlaceholder')}
          onChange={(e) => setOpeningHours(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={businessName.trim().length < 2}>
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```
