```tsx
'use client';

import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

/** Same window as the appeals RLS policy (30 days). */
const APPEAL_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 24 * 3_600_000;

export interface Decision {
  id: number;
  kind: string;
  note: string;
  createdAt: string;
  appealStatus: string | null;
  appealable: boolean;
}

export function Decisions({ items }: { items: Decision[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation.decisions');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [appealed, setAppealed] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  async function appeal(actionId: number) {
    const res = await api('/api/appeals', { body: { actionId, reason } });
    if (!res.ok) return setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' });
    setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('appealSent') });
    setAppealed(new Set(appealed).add(actionId));
    setOpen(null);
    setReason('');
  }

  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {items.map((d) => (
          <li key={d.id}>
            <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p className="font-semibold">{t(`kinds.${d.kind}`)}</p>
              {d.note && <p className="text-sm text-fog">{d.note}</p>}
              <p className="text-xs text-fog">{format.relativeTime(new Date(d.createdAt), now)}</p>
              {d.appealStatus && (
                <p className="text-sm">
                  {t('appealed', { status: t(`status.${d.appealStatus}`) })}
                </p>
              )}
              {d.appealable &&
                now.getTime() - new Date(d.createdAt).getTime() < APPEAL_WINDOW_MS &&
                !d.appealStatus &&
                !appealed.has(d.id) &&
                (open === d.id ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <Field label={t('appealLabel')} htmlFor={`appeal-${d.id}`}>
                      <textarea
                        id={`appeal-${d.id}`}
                        className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
                        maxLength={1000}
                        value={reason}
                        onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    <Button disabled={reason.trim().length < 10} onClick={() => appeal(d.id)}>
                      {t('appeal')}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(d.id)}>
                    {t('appeal')}
                  </Button>
                ))}
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export interface QueueItem {
  videoId: string;
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  status: string;
  hiddenReason: string | null;
  reportCount: number;
  reasons: string[];
  author: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
}

export interface AppealItem {
  appealId: string;
  reason: string;
  actionKind: string;
  actionNote: string;
  caption: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
}

type Status = { kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null;

export function ModerationQueue({ items }: { items: QueueItem[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const tr = useTranslations('video.reportPanel.reasons');
  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.videoId} data-testid="queue-item" data-video-id={item.videoId}>
          <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <strong>{tc(item.category)}</strong>
              <span className="text-fog">@{item.author}</span>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-line px-2 py-0.5 text-xs">
                {t('reports', { count: item.reportCount })}
              </span>
              {item.status === 'hidden' && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-500 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-ink">
                  {t('hiddenAuto')}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {item.videoUrl && (
              <video
                src={item.videoUrl}
                poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
                controls
                playsInline
                preload="metadata"
                className="max-h-96 w-full rounded-xl bg-black object-contain"
              />
            )}
            {item.caption && <p>{item.caption}</p>}
            {item.reasons.length > 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-fog">
                {t('reasons')} : {item.reasons.map((r) => tr(r)).join(', ')}
              </p>
            )}
            <DecisionForm videoId={item.videoId} />
          </Card>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function DecisionForm({ videoId }: { videoId: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function decide(action: 'validate' | 'hide' | 'remove' | 'warn') {
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', {
      body: { type: 'decision', videoId, action, note },
    });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const noteMissing = res.error === 'invalid_input' || res.error === 'note_required';
      return setStatus({
        kind: 'error',
        text: noteMissing ? t('note') : (errorText(res.error) ?? ''),
      });
    }
    setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('done') });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Field label={t('note')} htmlFor={`note-${videoId}`}>
        <textarea
          id={`note-${videoId}`}
          className={`${inputClass} min-h-16`}
          maxLength={1000}
          value={note}
          onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <Button disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('validate')}>
          {t('actions.validate')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('hide')}>
          {t('actions.hide')}
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="danger"
          disabled={pending || note.trim().length < 3}
          onClick={() => decide('remove')}
        >
          {t('actions.remove')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('warn')}>
          {t('actions.warn')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AppealsQueue({ items }: { items: AppealItem[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const tk = useTranslations('moderation.decisions.kinds');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function resolve(appealId: string, uphold: boolean) {
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', {
      body: { type: 'appeal', appealId, uphold, note: notes[appealId] ?? '' },
    });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('appealsEmpty')}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {items.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.appealId}>
            <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">
                {tk(a.actionKind)}
                {a.actionNote && <span className="font-normal text-fog"> — {a.actionNote}</span>}
              </p>
              {a.videoUrl && (
                <video
                  src={a.videoUrl}
                  poster={a.posterUrl ?? undefined}
                  controls
                  playsInline
                  preload="metadata"
                  className="max-h-80 w-full rounded-xl bg-black object-contain"
                />
              )}
              {a.caption && <p className="text-sm">{a.caption}</p>}
              <p className="text-sm">
                <span className="text-fog">{t('appealReason')} : </span>
                {a.reason}
              </p>
              <label className="sr-only" htmlFor={`an-${a.appealId}`}>
                {t('note')}
              </label>
              <textarea
                id={`an-${a.appealId}`}
                className={`${inputClass} min-h-14`}
                value={notes[a.appealId] ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes({ ...notes, [a.appealId]: e.target.value })}
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <Button onClick={() => resolve(a.appealId, true)}>{t('uphold')}</Button>
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => resolve(a.appealId, false)}>
                  {t('reject')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ApplyForm({ eligible, cells }: { eligible: boolean; cells: string[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation.apply');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [cell, setCell] = useState(cells[0] ?? '');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function apply() {
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', { body: { type: 'apply', cell } });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('rules')}</p>
      <Notice kind={eligible ? 'success' : 'info'}>
        {eligible ? t('eligible') : t('notEligible')}
      </Notice>
      {eligible &&
        (cells.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('noZone')}</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Field label={t('zone')} htmlFor="apply-cell">
              <select
                id="apply-cell"
                className={inputClass}
                value={cell}
                onChange={(e) => setCell(e.target.value)}
              >
                {cells.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c} value={c}>
                    {c.slice(3, 9)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Button onClick={apply}>{t('submit')}</Button>
          </>
        ))}
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { isIos, isStandalone } from '@/lib/platform';

import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';

const ONBOARDING_STEP_KEY = 'neighbors-onboarding-step';

interface InstallPrompt extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
}

const STEPS = ['value', 'permissions', 'rules'] as const;
const INSTALL_STEP = STEPS.length;

export function Onboarding({
  next,
  signedIn,
  initialStep,
}: {
  next: string;
  signedIn: boolean;
  initialStep: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('onboarding');
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(initialStep);
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState<InstallPrompt | null>(null);
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState<'ios' | 'android' | 'other' | 'installed'>('other');

  useEffect(() => {
    const onPrompt = (e: Event) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setPrompt(e as InstallPrompt);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setPlatform(
        isStandalone()
          ? 'installed'
          : isIos()
            ? 'ios'
            : /Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent)
              ? 'android'
              : 'other',
      );
      const saved = Number(window.localStorage.getItem(ONBOARDING_STEP_KEY));
      const requestedInstallGuide =
        new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('step') === 'install';
      if (
        !requestedInstallGuide &&
        Number.isInteger(saved) &&
        saved >= 0 &&
        saved <= INSTALL_STEP
      ) {
        setStep(saved);
      }
    }, 0);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  async function finish() {
    window.localStorage.removeItem(ONBOARDING_STEP_KEY);
    // Non-sensitive preference cookie read by src/proxy.ts (no tracking, no personal data).
    document.cookie = `${ONBOARDED_COOKIE}=1; path=/; max-age=31536000; samesite=lax`;
    if (signedIn) await api('/api/me/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body: { onboarded: true } });
    router.replace(next);
  }

  const key = step === INSTALL_STEP ? 'install' : (STEPS[step] ?? 'value');
  const list = (k: string) => t.raw(k) as string[];
  const changeStep = (nextStep: number) => {
    const bounded = Math.max(0, Math.min(INSTALL_STEP, nextStep));
    window.localStorage.setItem(ONBOARDING_STEP_KEY, String(bounded));
    setStep(bounded);
  };

  return (
    <main
      id="main"
      className="mx-auto flex h-dvh w-full max-w-xl flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden px-5 py-4 sm:gap-6 sm:p-6"
    >
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between pt-1 text-sm text-fog">
        {step !== INSTALL_STEP ? (
          <p aria-live="polite">
            {t('step', {
              current: step + 1,
              total: STEPS.length,
            })}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <span aria-hidden="true" />
        )}
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={finish}>
          {t('skip')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {step !== INSTALL_STEP && (
        <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1.5" aria-hidden="true">
          {STEPS.map((s, i) => (
            <span
              key={s}
              className={`h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full ${i <= step ? 'bg-accent' : 'bg-line'}`}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <section
        className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain"
        aria-labelledby="onboarding-title"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 pb-4">
          {key === 'value' && (
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-accent">
              {t('value.eyebrow')}
            </p>
          )}
          <h1 id="onboarding-title" className="text-2xl font-bold leading-tight sm:text-3xl">
            {t(`${key}.title`)}
          </h1>
          {key === 'value' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('value.body')}</p>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {list('value.points').map((p) => (
                  <li
                    key={p}
                    className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel px-3 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed"
                  >
                    <span
                      className="mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-accent"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <span>{p}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'permissions' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-fog">{t('permissions.body')}</p>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                {(['camera', 'location', 'notifications'] as const).map((p) => (
                  <li key={p} className="rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3">
                    {t(`permissions.${p}`)}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'install' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-fog">{t('install.body')}</p>
              {platform === 'installed' && <Notice kind="success">{t('install.installed')}</Notice>}
              {platform === 'ios' && <Notice>{t('install.ios')}</Notice>}
              {platform === 'android' && <Notice>{t('install.android')}</Notice>}
              {platform === 'other' && <Notice>{t('install.manual')}</Notice>}
              {platform !== 'installed' && prompt && (
                <Button
                  onClick={async () => {
                    await prompt.prompt();
                    setPrompt(null);
                  }}
                >
                  {t('install.button')}
                </Button>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'rules' && (
            <>
              <ul className="flex list-disc flex-col gap-2 pl-5">
                {list('rules.points').map((p) => (
                  <li key={p}>{p}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <Link href="/legal/regles" className="underline">
                {t('rules.link')}
              </Link>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-3 border-t border-line bg-ink pt-3 pb-[max(0.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
        {step > 0 && step < INSTALL_STEP && (
          <Button variant="secondary" className="flex-1" onClick={() => changeStep(step - 1)}>
            {t('back')}
          </Button>
        )}
        {step < STEPS.length - 1 ? (
          <Button className="flex-1" onClick={() => changeStep(step + 1)}>
            {t('next')}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button className="flex-1" onClick={finish}>
            {t('finish')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

interface OwnVideo {
  id: string;
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  status: 'processing' | 'active' | 'hidden' | 'removed' | 'expired' | 'rejected';
  created_at: string;
}

const statusColor: Record<OwnVideo['status'], string> = {
  processing: 'bg-sky-500',
  active: 'bg-green-500',
  hidden: 'bg-amber-500',
  removed: 'bg-alert',
  expired: 'bg-line',
  rejected: 'bg-alert',
};

async function fetchOwnVideos(): Promise<{ videos: OwnVideo[] } | { error: string }> {
  const res = await api<{ videos: OwnVideo[] }>('/api/me/videos');
  return res.ok ? { videos: res.data.videos } : { error: res.error };
}

/** Owner view: status of every publication (processing → active / rejected) and withdrawal. */
export function MyVideos() {
  const t = useTranslations('profile');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<OwnVideo[] | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const result = await fetchOwnVideos();
    if ('error' in result) setLoadError(errorText(result.error));
    else {
      setVideos(result.videos);
      setLoadError(null);
    }
  }, [errorText]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void fetchOwnVideos().then((result) => {
      if (!alive) return;
      if ('error' in result) setLoadError(errorText(result.error));
      else setVideos(result.videos);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [errorText]);

  // Poll while something is processing so the status flips to active/rejected without reload.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!videos?.some((v) => v.status === 'processing')) return;
    const timer = setInterval(load, 4000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [videos, load]);

  async function withdraw(id: string) {
    if (!window.confirm(t('withdrawConfirm'))) return;
    const res = await api(`/api/videos/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE', body: {} });
    setMessage(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('withdrawn') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) void load();
  }

  if (loadError) return <Notice kind="error">{loadError}</Notice>;
  if (!videos)
    return (
      <p role="status" className="text-sm text-fog">
        {t('collectionLoading')}
      </p>
    );
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="my-videos" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div>
        <h2 id="my-videos" className="text-lg font-semibold">
          {t('myVideos')}
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-fog">{t('myVideosDescription')}</p>
      </div>
      {message && <Notice kind={message.kind}>{message.text}</Notice>}
      {videos.length === 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-4 text-sm text-fog">
          <p>{t('emptyMyVideos')}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2" aria-live="polite">
        {videos.map((v) => (
          <li
            key={v.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3"
            data-testid="own-video"
            data-status={v.status}
          >
            <span
              className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${statusColor[v.status]}`}
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="truncate text-sm">
                <strong>{tc(v.category)}</strong> · {v.caption || '—'}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-fog">
                {t(`status.${v.status}`)} · {format.relativeTime(new Date(v.created_at), now)}
              </p>
              {v.status === 'hidden' || v.status === 'removed' || v.status === 'rejected' ? (
                <Link
                  href="/me/decisions"
                  className="mt-1 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-xs font-semibold underline underline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
                >
                  {t('viewModerationDecision')}
                </Link>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            {v.status !== 'removed' && (
              <Button variant="ghost" className="text-sm" onClick={() => withdraw(v.id)}>
                {t('withdraw')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { getOfferStatus } from '@/lib/offer-status';

type CollectionKind = 'saved' | 'hidden';
type CollectionVideo = {
  id: string;
  savedAt: number;
  category: string | null;
  caption: string | null;
  offerTerms: string;
  authorName: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  publishedAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string | null;
  isMerchant: boolean;
};

const ENDPOINTS: Record<CollectionKind, string> = {
  saved: '/api/me/saved-videos',
  hidden: '/api/me/hidden-videos',
};

export function VideoCollection({ kind }: { kind: CollectionKind }) {
  const t = useTranslations('profile');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<CollectionVideo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState(false);
  const [pendingId, setPendingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(false);
    setActionError(false);
    const result = await api<{ videos: CollectionVideo[] }>(ENDPOINTS[kind]);
    if (result.ok) setVideos(result.data.videos);
    else setError(true);
    setLoading(false);
  }, [kind]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    void api<{ videos: CollectionVideo[] }>(ENDPOINTS[kind]).then((result) => {
      if (!active) return;
      if (result.ok) setVideos(result.data.videos);
      else setError(true);
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [kind]);

  async function removeVideo(videoId: string) {
    if (kind === 'hidden' && !window.confirm(t('restoreHiddenConfirm'))) return;
    setPendingId(videoId);
    setActionError(false);
    setFeedback(null);
    const result = await api<{ ids: string[] }>(ENDPOINTS[kind], {
      method: 'DELETE',
      body: { videoId },
    });
    if (result.ok) {
      setVideos((current) => current.filter((video) => video.id !== videoId));
      setFeedback(kind === 'saved' ? t('savedRemovedFeedback') : t('hiddenRestoredFeedback'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('nl-saved-videos-change'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('nl-hidden-videos-change'));
    } else {
      setActionError(true);
    }
    setPendingId(null);
  }

  const title = kind === 'saved' ? t('savedVideos') : t('hiddenVideos');
  const emptyText = kind === 'saved' ? t('emptySavedVideos') : t('emptyHiddenVideos');
  const actionText = kind === 'saved' ? t('removeSaved') : t('restoreHidden');
  const dateKey = kind === 'saved' ? 'savedOn' : 'hiddenOn';
  const description = kind === 'saved' ? t('savedVideosDescription') : t('hiddenVideosDescription');

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${kind}-videos-heading`} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <h2 id={`${kind}-videos-heading`} className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{description}</p>
        </div>
        {!loading && !error && (
          <span className="rounded-full border border-white/10 bg-white/5 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-fog">
            {t('collectionCount', { count: videos.length })}
          </span>
        )}
      </header>

      {feedback && (
        <p
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite"
          className="rounded-xl border border-green-400/20 bg-green-950/20 p-3 text-sm text-white"
        >
          {feedback}
        </p>
      )}
      {loading ? (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-panel p-4 text-sm text-fog"
        >
          {t('collectionLoading')}
        </p>
      ) : error ? (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-400/30 bg-red-950/20 p-4">
          <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-white">
            {t('collectionError')}
          </p>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => void refresh()}>
            {t('retryCollection')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {actionError && (
            <p
              role="alert"
              className="rounded-xl border border-red-400/30 bg-red-950/20 p-3 text-sm text-white"
            >
              {t('collectionActionError')}
            </p>
          )}
          {videos.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-panel p-4 text-sm text-fog sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
              <p>{emptyText}</p>
              <Link
                href="/"
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 font-semibold text-ink transition-colors hover:bg-accent/90 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
              >
                {t('browseFeed')}
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <ul className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {videos.map((video) => {
                const offerStatus = getOfferStatus(
                  video.category,
                  video.isMerchant,
                  video.expiresAt,
                  video.status,
                  now,
                );
                const available =
                  video.status === 'active' &&
                  video.expiresAt !== null &&
                  Number.isFinite(Date.parse(video.expiresAt)) &&
                  Date.parse(video.expiresAt) > now.getTime();
                const categoryLabel = video.category
                  ? tc(`categories.${video.category}`)
                  : t('unknownCategory');
                const date = format.relativeTime(new Date(video.savedAt), now);
                const unavailableLabel =
                  offerStatus === 'expired'
                    ? t('offerExpired')
                    : offerStatus === 'invalid'
                      ? t('offerInvalid')
                      : video.status === 'hidden'
                        ? t('videoModerated')
                        : video.status === 'expired' ||
                            (video.expiresAt !== null &&
                              new Date(video.expiresAt).getTime() <= now.getTime())
                          ? t('videoExpired')
                          : t('videoUnavailable');

                return (
                  <li
                    key={video.id}
                    className="flex min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-panel"
                  >
                    {available ? (
                      <Link
                        href={`/v/${video.id}`}
                        aria-label={t('openCollectionVideo', { category: categoryLabel })}
                        className="relative block w-28 shrink-0 self-stretch bg-black sm:w-32"
                      >
                        {video.posterUrl ? (
                          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- short-lived signed poster URL
                          <img
                            src={video.posterUrl}
                            alt=""
                            className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover"
                            loading="lazy"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="flex h-full min-h-40 items-center justify-center p-2 text-center text-xs text-fog">
                            {categoryLabel}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </Link>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="relative flex min-h-40 w-28 shrink-0 items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-white/10 to-panel p-2 text-center text-xs text-fog sm:w-32">
                        {video.posterUrl ? (
                          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- short-lived signed poster URL
                          <img
                            src={video.posterUrl}
                            alt=""
                            className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover opacity-40"
                            loading="lazy"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          categoryLabel
                        )}
                        <span className="relative rounded-full bg-black/75 px-2 py-1">
                          {unavailableLabel}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-start gap-2 p-3">
                      <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-accent/15 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-accent">
                          {categoryLabel}
                        </span>
                        {offerStatus === 'valid' && video.expiresAt && (
                          <span className="rounded-full bg-green-700 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                            {t('offerValidUntil', {
                              when: format.relativeTime(new Date(video.expiresAt), now),
                            })}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {(!available || offerStatus === 'invalid') && (
                          <span className="rounded-full bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-fog">
                            {unavailableLabel}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <p className="line-clamp-3 text-sm font-medium text-white">
                        {video.caption || t('noCaption')}
                      </p>
                      {video.category === 'shop' && (
                        <div className="w-full rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/5 p-2 text-xs">
                          <p className="font-semibold text-fog">{t('offerTerms')}</p>
                          <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-white">
                            {video.offerTerms || t('offerTermsMissing')}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="mt-auto flex w-full flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-fog">
                        {video.authorName && (
                          <Link
                            href={`/u/${video.authorName}`}
                            className="min-h-11 truncate text-left underline-offset-2 hover:underline focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-white"
                          >
                            {t('collectionAuthor', { name: video.authorName })}
                          </Link>
                        )}
                        <time dateTime={new Date(video.savedAt).toISOString()}>
                          {t(dateKey, { when: date })}
                        </time>
                        {video.publishedAt && (
                          <time dateTime={video.publishedAt}>
                            {t('publishedOn', {
                              when: format.relativeTime(new Date(video.publishedAt), now),
                            })}
                          </time>
                        )}
                        {video.expiresAt && available && !offerStatus && (
                          <span>
                            {t('videoExpires', {
                              when: format.relativeTime(new Date(video.expiresAt), now),
                            })}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        className="min-h-11 w-full justify-center px-2 text-xs"
                        disabled={pendingId === video.id}
                        onClick={() => void removeVideo(video.id)}
                      >
                        {pendingId === video.id
                          ? t('collectionUpdating')
                          : kind === 'hidden' && video.status === 'hidden'
                            ? t('removePersonalHide')
                            : actionText}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { RADII_M } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import {
  currentPosition,
  isIos,
  isStandalone,
  pushSupported,
  swRegistration,
  urlBase64ToUint8Array,
} from '@/lib/platform';

type State = 'loading' | 'unsupported' | 'ios-install' | 'off' | 'on';

async function detectState(): Promise<State> {
  if (isIos() && !isStandalone()) return 'ios-install';
  if (!pushSupported()) return 'unsupported';
  const reg = await swRegistration();
  const sub = await reg?.pushManager.getSubscription();
  return sub ? 'on' : 'off';
}

export function PushSettings({
  notifyAlerts,
  defaultRadius,
}: {
  notifyAlerts: boolean;
  defaultRadius: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('push');
  const ts = useTranslations('settings.notifications');
  const tr = useTranslations('common.radius');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>('loading');
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(defaultRadius);
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState(notifyAlerts);
  const [primer, setPrimer] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void detectState()
      .then((s) => alive && setState(s))
      .catch(() => alive && setState('unsupported'));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function enable() {
    setPrimer(false);
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      if ((await Notification.requestPermission()) !== 'granted') return setError(t('denied'));
      let pos: GeolocationPosition;
      try {
        pos = await currentPosition();
      } catch {
        return setError(t('noPosition'));
      }
      const reg = await swRegistration();
      if (!reg) return setError(errorText('generic'));
      const subscription =
        (await reg.pushManager.getSubscription()) ??
        (await reg.pushManager.subscribe({
          userVisibleOnly: true,
          applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array(clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY),
        }));
      const json = subscription.toJSON();
      const res = await api('/api/push/subscribe', {
        body: {
          subscription: { endpoint: json.endpoint, keys: json.keys },
          zone: { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude },
          radius,
        },
      });
      if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
      setState('on');
    } catch {
      setError(errorText('generic'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function disable() {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const reg = await swRegistration();
      const sub = await reg?.pushManager.getSubscription();
      if (sub) {
        const res = await api('/api/push/subscribe', {
          method: 'DELETE',
          body: { endpoint: sub.endpoint },
        });
        if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
        await sub.unsubscribe();
      }
      setState('off');
    } catch {
      setError(errorText('generic'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function toggleAlerts(value: boolean) {
    setError(null);
    setAlerts(value);
    try {
      const res = await api('/api/me/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body: { notifyAlerts: value } });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setAlerts(!value);
        setError(errorText(res.error));
      }
    } catch {
      setAlerts(!value);
      setError(errorText('generic'));
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{ts('title')}</h2>
      <label className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span>
          {ts('alerts')}
          <span className="block text-xs text-fog">{ts('alertsHint')}</span>
        </span>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          className="h-6 w-6 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
          checked={alerts}
          onChange={(e) => toggleAlerts(e.target.checked)}
        />
      </label>

      <h3 className="font-medium">{t('title')}</h3>
      {state === 'unsupported' && <Notice>{t('unsupported')}</Notice>}
      {state === 'ios-install' && (
        <Notice>
          {t('iosInstall')}{' '}
          <Link href="/onboarding?step=install" className="underline">
            {t('iosInstallLink')}
          </Link>
        </Notice>
      )}
      {(state === 'off' || state === 'on') && (
        <>
          <Field label={t('radius')} htmlFor="push-radius">
            <select
              id="push-radius"
              className={inputClass}
              value={radius}
              onChange={(e) => setRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
              disabled={state === 'on'}
            >
              {RADII_M.map((r) => (
                <option key={r} value={r}>
                  {tr(String(r))}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog" aria-live="polite">
            {state === 'on' ? t('enabled', { radius: tr(String(radius)) }) : t('disabled')}
          </p>
          {state === 'off' ? (
            <Button onClick={() => setPrimer(true)} disabled={busy}>
              {t('enable')}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={disable} disabled={busy}>
              {t('disable')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}

      <PermissionPrimer
        open={primer}
        title={t('primer.title')}
        confirmLabel={t('primer.continue')}
        cancelLabel={t('primer.later')}
        onConfirm={enable}
        onCancel={() => setPrimer(false)}
      >
        <p>{t('primer.body')}</p>
        <ul className="list-disc pl-5">
          <li>{t('primer.notifications')}</li>
          <li>{t('primer.location')}</li>
        </ul>
      </PermissionPrimer>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { SerwistProvider, useSerwist } from '@serwist/turbopack/react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Registers the service worker (scope "/") and renders update / offline banners. */
export function PwaShell({ children, disable }: { children: ReactNode; disable: boolean }) {
  return (
    <SerwistProvider
      swUrl="/serwist/sw.js"
      disable={disable}
      options={{ scope: '/' }}
      reloadOnOnline={false}
    >
      {children}
      <UpdateBanner />
      <OfflineBanner />
    </SerwistProvider>
  );
}

function UpdateBanner() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.update');
  const { serwist } = useSerwist();
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(false);
  const accepted = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!serwist) return;
    const onWaiting = () => setWaiting(true);
    // Reload only after the user accepted an update, not on the very first install.
    const onControlling = () => {
      if (accepted.current) window.location.reload();
    };
    serwist.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
    serwist.addEventListener('controlling', onControlling);
    return () => {
      serwist.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
      serwist.removeEventListener('controlling', onControlling);
    };
  }, [serwist]);
  if (!waiting) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 bottom-24 z-50 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3 shadow-xl"
    >
      <p className="flex-1 text-sm">{t('available')}</p>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          accepted.current = true;
          serwist?.messageSkipWaiting();
        }}
        className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-accent px-3 font-semibold text-ink"
      >
        {t('reload')}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function OfflineBanner() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.offline');
  const [offline, setOffline] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOffline(!navigator.onLine);
    const timer = setTimeout(update, 0);
    window.addEventListener('online', update);
    window.addEventListener('offline', update);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('online', update);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', update);
    };
  }, []);
  if (!offline) return null;
  return (
    <p
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 bg-amber-500 px-3 py-1.5 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-ink"
    >
      {t('banner')}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { Button, Card, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { profileImageUrl } from '@/lib/profile-image';
import { browserClient } from '@/lib/supabase/browser';

const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const EXTENSION_BY_TYPE: Record<string, string> = {
  'image/jpeg': 'jpg',
  'image/png': 'png',
  'image/webp': 'webp',
};

export function ProfileImagesForm({
  userId,
  username,
  avatarColor,
  avatarPath: initialAvatarPath,
  coverPath: initialCoverPath,
}: {
  userId: string;
  username: string;
  avatarColor: string;
  avatarPath: string | null;
  coverPath: string | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.profileImages');
  const ta = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const avatarInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const avatarCameraInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const coverInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [avatarPath, setAvatarPath] = useState(initialAvatarPath);
  const [coverPath, setCoverPath] = useState(initialCoverPath);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState<'avatar' | 'cover' | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  async function upload(kind: 'avatar' | 'cover', file?: File) {
    if (!file) return;
    const extension = EXTENSION_BY_TYPE[file.type];
    if (!extension) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: t('unsupported') });
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: t('tooLarge') });
      return;
    }

    setStatus(null);
    setUploading(kind);
    const path = `${userId}/${kind}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${extension}`;
    const supabase = browserClient();
    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from('profile-images')
      .upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type, cacheControl: '31536000', upsert: false });

    if (uploadError) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: errorText(uploadError.message) ?? t('uploadError') });
      setUploading(null);
      return;
    }

    const field = kind === 'avatar' ? 'avatarPath' : 'coverPath';
    const result = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: { [field]: path } });
    if (!result.ok) {
      await supabase.storage.from('profile-images').remove([path]);
      setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: errorText(result.error) ?? t('uploadError') });
      setUploading(null);
      return;
    }

    if (kind === 'avatar') setAvatarPath(path);
    else setCoverPath(path);
    setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t(kind === 'avatar' ? 'avatarSaved' : 'coverSaved') });
    setUploading(null);
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function remove(kind: 'avatar' | 'cover') {
    setStatus(null);
    setUploading(kind);
    const field = kind === 'avatar' ? 'avatarPath' : 'coverPath';
    const result = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: { [field]: null } });
    if (!result.ok) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: errorText(result.error) ?? t('uploadError') });
    } else {
      if (kind === 'avatar') setAvatarPath(null);
      else setCoverPath(null);
      setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t(kind === 'avatar' ? 'avatarRemoved' : 'coverRemoved') });
      router.refresh();
    }
    setUploading(null);
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
      <section className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <span className="rounded-full bg-accent p-1">
          <Avatar
            username={username}
            color={avatarColor}
            size={72}
            src={profileImageUrl(avatarPath)}
          />
        </span>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col items-start gap-1">
          <p className="font-medium">{t('avatar')}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('avatarHint')}</p>
          <input
            ref={avatarInput}
            type="file"
            accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
            className="sr-only"
            aria-label={t('avatar')}
            onChange={(event) => {
              void upload('avatar', event.target.files?.[0]);
              event.target.value = '';
            }}
          />
          <input
            ref={avatarCameraInput}
            type="file"
            accept="image/*"
            capture="user"
            className="sr-only"
            aria-label={t('takeAvatar')}
            onChange={(event) => {
              void upload('avatar', event.target.files?.[0]);
              event.target.value = '';
            }}
          />
          <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              disabled={uploading !== null}
              onClick={() => avatarInput.current?.click()}
            >
              {uploading === 'avatar' ? ta('loading') : t('chooseAvatar')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              disabled={uploading !== null}
              onClick={() => avatarCameraInput.current?.click()}
            >
              {t('takeAvatar')}
            </Button>
          </div>
          {avatarPath && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="min-h-11 text-sm text-fog underline"
              disabled={uploading !== null}
              onClick={() => void remove('avatar')}
            >
              {t('removeAvatar')}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="font-medium">{t('cover')}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('coverHint')}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="relative aspect-[3/1] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-line bg-ink">
          {coverPath ? (
            // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- public profile image URL
            <img
              src={profileImageUrl(coverPath) ?? undefined}
              alt=""
              className="h-full w-full object-cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="h-full w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue/20 via-accent/30 to-blue/10" />
          )}
        </div>
        <input
          ref={coverInput}
          type="file"
          accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
          className="sr-only"
          aria-label={t('cover')}
          onChange={(event) => {
            void upload('cover', event.target.files?.[0]);
            event.target.value = '';
          }}
        />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            disabled={uploading !== null}
            onClick={() => coverInput.current?.click()}
          >
            {uploading === 'cover' ? ta('loading') : t('chooseCover')}
          </Button>
          {coverPath && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              disabled={uploading !== null}
              onClick={() => void remove('cover')}
            >
              {t('removeCover')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\settings\SettingsForms.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { RADII_M } from '@nl/shared';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

type Status = { kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null;

export function ProfileForm({ username, bio }: { username: string; bio: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.profile');
  const tw = useTranslations('auth.welcome');
  const ta = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [values, setValues] = useState({ username, bio });
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: values });
    if (res.ok) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('saved') });
      router.refresh();
      return;
    }
    const text =
      res.error === 'conflict'
        ? tw('taken')
        : res.error === 'invalid_input'
          ? tw('invalid')
          : (errorText(res.error) ?? '');
    setStatus({ kind: 'error', text });
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
        <Field label={t('username')} htmlFor="s-username">
          <input
            id="s-username"
            className={inputClass}
            value={values.username}
            maxLength={20}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            onChange={(e) => setValues({ ...values, username: e.target.value.toLowerCase() })}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t('bio')} htmlFor="s-bio" hint={t('bioHint', { count: values.bio.length })}>
          <textarea
            id="s-bio"
            className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
            value={values.bio}
            maxLength={160}
            onChange={(e) => setValues({ ...values, bio: e.target.value })}
          />
        </Field>
        {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
        <Button type="submit">{ta('save')}</Button>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function PreferencesForm({
  defaultRadius,
  locale,
}: {
  defaultRadius: number;
  locale: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.preferences');
  const tr = useTranslations('common.radius');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function save(body: object) {
    const res = await api('/api/me/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('saved') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
      <Field label={t('radius')} htmlFor="s-radius">
        <select
          id="s-radius"
          className={inputClass}
          defaultValue={defaultRadius}
          onChange={(e) => save({ defaultRadius: Number(e.target.value) })}
        >
          {RADII_M.map((r) => (
            <option key={r} value={r}>
              {tr(String(r))}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('language')} htmlFor="s-locale">
        <select
          id="s-locale"
          className={inputClass}
          defaultValue={locale}
          onChange={(e) => save({ locale: e.target.value })}
        >
          <option value="fr">{t('languages.fr')}</option>
          <option value="en">{t('languages.en')}</option>
        </select>
      </Field>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </Card>
  );
}

export function DataSection() {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.data');
  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('exportHint')}</p>
      <a
        href="/api/me/export"
        download
        className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-line px-4 font-semibold"
      >
        {t('export')}
      </a>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function DangerZone({ username }: { username: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.danger');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function remove() {
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/me', { method: 'DELETE', body: { confirm } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    router.replace('/?deleted=1');
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-alert/60">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-alert">{t('title')}</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('body')}</p>
      <Field label={t('confirmLabel', { username })} htmlFor="s-confirm" error={error}>
        <input
          id="s-confirm"
          className={inputClass}
          value={confirm}
          autoCapitalize="none"
          onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button
        variant="danger"
        disabled={pending || confirm.trim().toLowerCase() !== username}
        onClick={remove}
      >
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react';

interface Tab {
  id: 'profile' | 'preferences' | 'account';
  label: string;
  content: ReactNode;
}

export function SettingsTabs({ tabs, ariaLabel }: { tabs: Tab[]; ariaLabel: string }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<Tab['id']>('profile');
  const refs = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);

  function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) {
    let nextIndex: number | null = null;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') nextIndex = (index + 1) % tabs.length;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') nextIndex = (index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
    if (event.key === 'Home') nextIndex = 0;
    if (event.key === 'End') nextIndex = tabs.length - 1;
    if (nextIndex === null) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const next = tabs[nextIndex];
    if (!next) return;
    setActive(next.id);
    refs.current[nextIndex]?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div
        role="tablist"
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.07] bg-panel/60 p-1.5"
      >
        {tabs.map((tab, index) => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            ref={(element) => {
              refs.current[index] = element;
            }}
            id={`settings-tab-${tab.id}`}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={active === tab.id}
            aria-controls={`settings-panel-${tab.id}`}
            tabIndex={active === tab.id ? 0 : -1}
            onClick={() => setActive(tab.id)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => handleKeyDown(event, index)}
            className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl px-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${active === tab.id ? 'glow bg-accent text-white' : 'text-fog hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'}`}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {tabs.map((tab) => (
        <div
          key={tab.id}
          id={`settings-panel-${tab.id}`}
          role="tabpanel"
          aria-labelledby={`settings-tab-${tab.id}`}
          tabIndex={0}
          hidden={active !== tab.id}
          className="flex flex-col gap-4 focus-visible:rounded-2xl focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent"
        >
          {tab.content}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useSyncExternalStore,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';

type Theme = 'dark' | 'light';
const ThemeContext = createContext<{ theme: Theme; setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void } | null>(null);

function subscribe(onChange: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener('storage', onChange);
  window.addEventListener('neighbors-theme-change', onChange);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('storage', onChange);
    window.removeEventListener('neighbors-theme-change', onChange);
  };
}

function getSnapshot(): Theme {
  return window.localStorage.getItem('neighbors-theme') === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';
}

function getServerSnapshot(): Theme {
  return 'dark';
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const theme = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = theme;
  }, [theme]);

  const setTheme = useCallback((next: Theme) => {
    window.localStorage.setItem('neighbors-theme', next);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('neighbors-theme-change'));
  }, []);

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider');
  return context;
}
```

```tsx
type Variant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'ghost';

export function Notice({
  kind = 'info',
  children,
}: {
  kind?: 'info' | 'error' | 'success';

}) {

    kind === 'error'

      : kind === 'success'
        ? 'border-emerald-400/40 bg-emerald-400/10 text-emerald-200'
        : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-fog';

      className={`rounded-2xl border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm ${kind === 'error' ? 'bg-alert/10' : ''} ${color}`}
    >
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';

/** Maps an API error code to a translated sentence (falls back to the generic message). */
export function useErrorText() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.errors');
  return useCallback(
    (code: string | null | undefined) => {
      if (!code) return null;
      return t.has(code) ? t(code) : t('generic');
    },
    [t],
  );
}
```

```tsx
export function VideoPageInteractions({
  item,

  creatorHref,

  item: FeedItem;
  signedIn: boolean;
  creatorHref: string;

  const t = useTranslations('video');
  const [commentsOpen, setCommentsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
  const [collectionPending, setCollectionPending] = useState<'saved' | 'hidden' | null>(null);
  const [useful, setUseful] = useState({ reacted: item.reacted, count: item.usefulCount });
  const [usefulPending, setUsefulPending] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!signedIn) return;

    let active = true;
    void Promise.all([fetchIsVideoSaved(item.id), fetchIsVideoHidden(item.id)])
      .then(([isSaved, isHidden]) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setSaved(isSaved);
        setHidden(isHidden);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active) {
          setToast(t('collectionReadError'));
          window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [item.id, signedIn, t]);

  async function toggleUseful() {
    if (!signedIn || usefulPending) return;
    setUsefulPending(true);
    const res = await api<{ reacted: boolean; usefulCount: number }>(
      `/api/videos/${item.id}/useful`,
      { method: useful.reacted ? 'DELETE' : 'POST', body: {} },
    );
    if (res.ok) {
      setUseful({ reacted: res.data.reacted, count: res.data.usefulCount });
    } else {
      setToast(t('usefulError'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
    }
    setUsefulPending(false);
  }

  async function toggleSave() {
    if (!signedIn) return;
    if (collectionPending) return;
    setCollectionPending('saved');
    try {
      const next = await toggleSavedVideoServer(item.id);
      setSaved(next.saved);
      setToast(next.saved ? t('saveToast') : t('unsaveToast'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
    } catch {
      setToast(t('saveError'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
    } finally {
      setCollectionPending(null);
    }
  }

  async function toggleHide() {
    if (!signedIn) return;
    if (collectionPending) return;
    if (!hidden && !window.confirm(t('hideConfirm'))) return;
    setCollectionPending('hidden');
    try {
      const next = await toggleHiddenVideoServer(item.id);
      setHidden(next.hidden);
      setToast(next.hidden ? t('hideToast') : t('unhideToast'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
    } catch {
      setToast(t('hideError'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
    } finally {
      setCollectionPending(null);
    }
  }

  async function copyLink() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
      setToast(t('shared'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
    } catch {
      setToast(t('shareError'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
    }
  }

  function shareTo(platform: 'facebook' | 'whatsapp' | 'x') {
    const url = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
    const text = encodeURIComponent(item.caption);
    const destinations = {
      facebook: `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${url}`,
      whatsapp: `https://wa.me/?text=${text}%20${url}`,
      x: `https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=${text}&url=${url}`,
    };
    window.open(destinations[platform], '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  }

  async function share() {
    if (!navigator.share) {
      await copyLink();
      return;
    }
    try {
      await navigator.share({ title: item.caption, url: window.location.href });
    } catch (error) {

      setToast(t('shareError'));
      window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
```

`apps\web\src\i18n\messages.ts`:

```ts
import type { Locale } from './locales';

/** One JSON file per namespace in messages/<locale>/. */
export const NAMESPACES = [
  'common',
  'auth',
  'profile',
  'settings',
  'capture',
  'feed',
  'discover',
  'map',
  'video',
  'moderation',
  'admin',
  'merchant',
  'push',
  'onboarding',
  'legal',
] as const;

type Messages = { [key: string]: string | Messages };

function deepMerge(base: Messages, override: Messages): Messages {
  const out: Messages = { ...base };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(override)) {
    const b = out[k];
    out[k] = typeof v === 'object' && typeof b === 'object' ? deepMerge(b, v) : v;
  }
  return out;
}

async function load(locale: Locale, ns: string): Promise<Messages> {
  try {
    return (await import(`../../messages/${locale}/${ns}.json`)).default as Messages;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/** French is the reference; other locales override it key by key (missing keys fall back to French). */
export async function loadMessages(locale: Locale): Promise<Messages> {
  const entries = await Promise.all(
    NAMESPACES.map(async (ns) => {
      const fr = await load('fr', ns);
      return [ns, locale === 'fr' ? fr : deepMerge(fr, await load(locale, ns))] as const;
    }),
  );
  return Object.fromEntries(entries);
}
```

```ts
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getRequestConfig } from 'next-intl/server';
import { isLocale, LOCALE_COOKIE, type Locale } from './locales';
import { loadMessages } from './messages';

// No locale prefix in URLs: the locale comes from a cookie set in the settings page.
export default getRequestConfig(async () => {
  const fromCookie = (await cookies()).get(LOCALE_COOKIE)?.value;
  const locale: Locale = isLocale(fromCookie) ? fromCookie : 'fr';
  return { locale, messages: await loadMessages(locale), timeZone: 'Europe/Paris' };
});
```

```ts
  position_incoherent: 422,
  accuracy_too_low: 422,
  profile_incomplete: 409,
  merchant_quota_exceeded: 429,
  video_not_awaiting_upload: 409,
  video_not_active: 409,
  not_revertible: 409,
  review_conflict: 409,
};

export function fromDbError(error: { message: string; code?: string }): ApiError {
  if (error.message in DB_ERRORS)
    return new ApiError(error.message, DB_ERRORS[error.message] ?? 400);
  if (error.code === '23505') return new ApiError('conflict', 409);
  if (error.code === '42501') return new ApiError('forbidden', 403);
  if (error.code === '23514' || error.code === '22P02') return new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  console.error('Unexpected database error', error);
  return new ApiError('internal', 500);
}

/** Unwraps a Supabase `{ data, error }` result, converting errors to ApiError. */
export function unwrap<T>(result: {
  data: T | null;
  error: { message: string; code?: string } | null;
}): T {
  if (result.error) throw fromDbError(result.error);
  // Without an error, PostgREST returns data (void RPCs legitimately return null).
  return result.data as T;
}

export const json = (body: unknown, status = 200, headers?: HeadersInit) =>
  NextResponse.json(body, { status, headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', ...headers } });

/**
 * CSRF protection for cookie-authenticated mutations: the browser always sends `Origin` on
 * cross-site and same-site POST/PATCH/DELETE; it must match the host we are served from.
 */
export function assertSameOrigin(req: Request): void {
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const host = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host') ?? req.headers.get('host');
  if (!origin || !host) throw new ApiError('bad_origin', 403);
  let originHost: string;
  try {
    originHost = new URL(origin).host;
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('bad_origin', 403);
  }
  if (originHost !== host) throw new ApiError('bad_origin', 403);
}

type Handler<C> = (req: NextRequest, ctx: C) => Promise<Response>;

/** Wraps a route handler: CSRF check on mutations, uniform JSON errors. */
export function route<C = unknown>(handler: Handler<C>): Handler<C> {
  return async (req, ctx) => {
    try {
      if (!['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(req.method)) assertSameOrigin(req);
      return await handler(req, ctx);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError) return json({ error: error.message }, error.status);
      if (error instanceof ZodError) {
        return json(
          {
            error: 'invalid_input',
            issues: error.issues.map((i) => ({ path: i.path.join('.'), message: i.message })),
          },
          422,
        );
      }
      console.error(error);
      return json({ error: 'internal' }, 500);
    }
  };
}

export async function requireUser() {
  const user = await getUser();
  if (!user) throw new ApiError('unauthorized', 401);
  return user;
}

export async function parseBody<T>(req: Request, schema: ZodType<T>): Promise<T> {
  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('invalid_json', 400);
  }
  return schema.parse(body);
}

/** Salted hash of the client IP: used as a rate-limit key, never stored raw. */
export const hashKey = (value: string): string =>
  createHash('sha256').update(serverEnv().IP_HASH_SALT).update(value).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);

export function ipKey(req: Request): string {
  const ip =
    req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ||
    req.headers.get('x-real-ip') ||
    'unknown';
  return hashKey(`ip:${ip}`);
}
```

```ts
import { hashKey, ipKey, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/**
 * Brute-force protection for every auth endpoint: counted per IP and per e-mail address
 * (both as salted hashes, never stored raw). Raises `rate_limited` (429).
 */
export async function limitAuthAttempt(req: Request, email: string): Promise<void> {
  const admin = adminClient();
  unwrap(await admin.rpc('check_rate_limit', { p_key: ipKey(req), p_rule: 'login' }));
  unwrap(
    await admin.rpc('check_rate_limit', {
      p_key: hashKey(`email:${email.toLowerCase()}`),
      p_rule: 'login',
    }),
  );
}
```

```ts
  });

  it('republishes when still at the same place with a precise fix', () => {

  it('waits for a position exceeding the 500 m accuracy limit', () => {
    expect(judge(item, t0 + 60_000, { ...filmed, accuracy: 501 })).toBe('wait-precision');
  });
  it('drops stale recordings', () => {
    expect(judge(item, t0 + MAX_AGE_MS + 1, filmed)).toBe('drop-stale');
  });
```

```ts
'use client';

export type ApiResult<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: string; status: number };

/** JSON fetch for our own /api routes. Errors come back as stable codes (see lib/api.ts). */
export async function api<T = unknown>(
  path: string,
  init: { method?: string; body?: unknown; signal?: AbortSignal } = {},
): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(path, {
      method: init.method ?? (init.body === undefined ? 'GET' : 'POST'),
      headers: init.body === undefined ? undefined : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: init.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(init.body),
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      signal: init.signal,
    });
    const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as T & { error?: string };
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: data.error ?? 'generic', status: res.status };
    return { ok: true, data };
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as Error).name === 'AbortError') throw error;
    return { ok: false, error: 'network', status: 0 };
  }
}
```

```ts
interface CspOptions {
  nonce: string;
  isDev: boolean;
  supabaseUrl: string;
  mapStyleUrl: string;
  siteUrl: string;
}

/** Strict, nonce-based Content-Security-Policy (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md § Web). */
export function buildCsp({ nonce, isDev, supabaseUrl, mapStyleUrl, siteUrl }: CspOptions): string {
  const supabase = new URL(supabaseUrl);
  const realtime = `${supabase.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws'}://${supabase.host}`;
  const tiles = new URL(mapStyleUrl).origin;
  const directives: Record<string, string[]> = {
    'default-src': ["'self'"],
    'script-src': [
      "'self'",
      `'nonce-${nonce}'`,
      "'strict-dynamic'",
      ...(isDev ? ["'unsafe-eval'"] : []),
    ],
    // Inline <style> tags carry the nonce; dev tooling injects un-nonced styles.
    'style-src': ["'self'", isDev ? "'unsafe-inline'" : `'nonce-${nonce}'`],
    // style="" attributes (sizes, colours) cannot run script; <style> elements still need the nonce.
    'style-src-attr': ["'unsafe-inline'"],
    'img-src': ["'self'", 'blob:', 'data:', supabase.origin, tiles],
    'media-src': ["'self'", 'blob:', supabase.origin],
    'connect-src': ["'self'", supabase.origin, realtime, tiles],
    'font-src': ["'self'", 'data:'],
    'worker-src': ["'self'", 'blob:'],
    'child-src': ["'self'", 'blob:'],
    'manifest-src': ["'self'"],
    'object-src': ["'none'"],
    'base-uri': ["'self'"],
    'form-action': ["'self'"],
    'frame-ancestors': ["'none'"],
  };
  const parts = Object.entries(directives).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.join(' ')}`);
  if (!isDev && siteUrl.startsWith('https://')) parts.push('upgrade-insecure-requests');
  return parts.join('; ');
}
```

```ts
import {

function makeStorage(initial?: string, failWrites = false): Storage {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  if (initial !== undefined) values.set('nl-feed-reduced-categories', initial);

  return {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
      if (failWrites) throw new Error('Storage unavailable');
      values.set(key, value);
    },
    removeItem: (key: string) => values.delete(key),
    clear: () => values.clear(),
    key: (index: number) => Array.from(values.keys())[index] ?? null,
    get length() {
      return values.size;
    },
  } as Storage;
}
```
