`apps\web\src\lib\feed-preferences.ts`:

```ts
import { CATEGORIES, type Category } from '@nl/shared';

type StorageLike = Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'>;

const STORAGE_KEY = 'nl-feed-reduced-categories';
const CHANGE_EVENT = 'nl-feed-reduced-categories-change';
let memorySnapshot = '';

function resolveStorage(storage?: StorageLike | null): StorageLike | null {
  if (storage !== undefined) return storage;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    return window.localStorage;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function normalizeCategories(value: unknown): Category[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return [...new Set(value.filter((item): item is Category => CATEGORIES.includes(item)))];
}

export function getReducedCategoriesSnapshot(storage?: StorageLike | null): string {
  const target = resolveStorage(storage);
  if (!target) return memorySnapshot;

  try {
    const saved = target.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved === null) return memorySnapshot;
    memorySnapshot = normalizeCategories(JSON.parse(saved)).join(',');
  } catch {
    return memorySnapshot;
  }
  return memorySnapshot;
}

export function parseReducedCategories(snapshot: string): Category[] {
  return normalizeCategories(snapshot ? snapshot.split(',') : []);
}

export function setReducedCategories(categories: Category[], storage?: StorageLike | null): void {
  memorySnapshot = normalizeCategories(categories).join(',');
  const target = resolveStorage(storage);
  if (!target) return;

  try {
    target.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(parseReducedCategories(memorySnapshot)));
  } catch {
    // Keep the preference available for this page session when browser storage is unavailable.
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
  }
}

export function subscribeToReducedCategories(onChange: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

  const handleStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
    if (event.key === STORAGE_KEY || event.key === null) onChange();
  };
  window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);

  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { Category } from '@nl/shared';
import { signMedia } from '@/lib/media';
import { profileImageUrl } from '@/lib/profile-image';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** Public shape of a video in the feed. Never contains the exact position. */
export interface FeedItem {
  id: string;
  category: Category;
  caption: string;
  offerTerms: string;
  author: {
    id: string;
    username: string | null;
    color: string;
    avatarUrl: string | null;
    isMerchant: boolean;
    merchantWebsite: string | null;
    merchantPhone: string | null;
    merchantAddress: string | null;
  };
  publishedAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  usefulCount: number;
  commentCount: number;
  isMerchant: boolean;
  /** Fuzzed (~50 m) public position. */
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  /** Bucketed to 100 m; null when the viewer position is unknown (deep link). */
  distanceM: number | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
  reacted: boolean;
}

export interface PublicVideoRow {
  id: string;
  author_id: string;
  author_username: string | null;
  author_color: string;
  author_is_merchant?: boolean;
  author_website?: string | null;
  author_phone?: string | null;
  author_address?: string | null;
  category: Category;
  caption: string;
  published_at: string | null;
  expires_at: string;
  useful_count: number;
  comment_count: number;
  is_merchant: boolean;
  public_lat: number;
  public_lng: number;
  distance_m?: number;
}

/** Adds short-lived media URLs and the viewer's "useful" state to public rows. */
export async function hydrate(
  rows: PublicVideoRow[],
  viewerId: string | null,
): Promise<FeedItem[]> {
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];
  const ids = rows.map((r) => r.id);
  const { data: paths } = await adminClient()
    .from('videos')
    .select('id, video_path, poster_path, offer_terms')
    .in('id', ids);
  const byId = new Map((paths ?? []).map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  const urls = await signMedia((paths ?? []).flatMap((p) => [p.video_path, p.poster_path]));
  const authorIds = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.author_id))];
  const { data: profiles } = await adminClient()
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id, avatar_path')
    .in('id', authorIds);
  const avatarUrls = new Map(
    (profiles ?? []).map((profile) => [profile.id, profileImageUrl(profile.avatar_path)]),
  );
  let reacted = new Set<string>();
  if (viewerId) {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const { data } = await supabase.from('reactions').select('video_id').in('video_id', ids);
    reacted = new Set((data ?? []).map((r) => r.video_id));
  }
  return rows.map((r) => {
    const p = byId.get(r.id);
    return {
      id: r.id,
      category: r.category,
      caption: r.caption,
      offerTerms: p?.offer_terms ?? '',
      author: {
        id: r.author_id,
        username: r.author_username,
        color: r.author_color,
        avatarUrl: avatarUrls.get(r.author_id) ?? null,
        isMerchant: Boolean(r.author_is_merchant ?? r.is_merchant),
        merchantWebsite: r.author_website ?? null,
        merchantPhone: r.author_phone ?? null,
        merchantAddress: r.author_address ?? null,
      },
      publishedAt: r.published_at,
      expiresAt: r.expires_at,
      usefulCount: r.useful_count,
      commentCount: r.comment_count,
      isMerchant: r.is_merchant,
      lat: r.public_lat,
      lng: r.public_lng,
      distanceM: r.distance_m ?? null,
      videoUrl: p?.video_path ? (urls.get(p.video_path) ?? null) : null,
      posterUrl: p?.poster_path ? (urls.get(p.poster_path) ?? null) : null,
      reacted: reacted.has(r.id),
    };
  });
}
```

```ts
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

type StorageLike = Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'>;

const STORAGE_KEY = 'nl-hidden-videos';

function resolveStorage(storage?: StorageLike | null): StorageLike | null {
  if (storage) return storage;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    return window.localStorage;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function readHiddenVideoIds(storage?: StorageLike | null): string[] {
  const target = resolveStorage(storage);
  if (!target) return [];

  try {
    const raw = target.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
    return parsed.filter((entry): entry is string => typeof entry === 'string');
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function isVideoHidden(videoId: string, storage?: StorageLike | null): boolean {
  return readHiddenVideoIds(storage).includes(videoId);
}

export function toggleHiddenVideo(videoId: string, storage?: StorageLike | null) {
  const target = resolveStorage(storage);
  const current = readHiddenVideoIds(target);
  const exists = current.includes(videoId);
  const next = exists ? current.filter((item) => item !== videoId) : [videoId, ...current];

  if (target) {
    try {
      target.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('nl-hidden-videos-change'));
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore quota or unavailable storage so the UI still stays usable.
    }
  }

  return { hidden: !exists, ids: next };
}

export async function fetchHiddenVideoIds(): Promise<string[]> {
  const res = await api<{ ids: string[] }>('/api/me/hidden-videos');
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not load hidden videos: ${res.error}`);
  return res.data.ids;
}

export async function fetchIsVideoHidden(videoId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const res = await api<{ hidden: boolean }>(
    `/api/me/hidden-videos?videoId=${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}`,
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not read hidden video state: ${res.error}`);
  return res.data.hidden;
}

export async function toggleHiddenVideoServer(videoId: string) {
  const currentHidden = await fetchIsVideoHidden(videoId);
  const res = await api<{ hidden: boolean; ids: string[] }>('/api/me/hidden-videos', {
    method: currentHidden ? 'DELETE' : 'POST',
    body: { videoId },
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not update hidden video state: ${res.error}`);
  return res.data;
}
```

```ts
type WorkerStatus = { detectors: unknown; last_seen: string };
export type ModelAvailability = {
  available: boolean;
  reason: 'ready' | 'disabled' | 'not_configured' | 'worker_offline' | 'model_unavailable';
};

export function mediaModelAvailability(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv,
  workers: WorkerStatus[],
  now = Date.now(),
) {
  const active = workers.filter((worker) => now - Date.parse(worker.last_seen) < 90_000);
  const model = (
    key: 'faces' | 'plates',
    envEnabled: boolean,
    pathConfigured: boolean,
  ): ModelAvailability => {
    if (!envEnabled) return { available: false, reason: 'disabled' };
    if (!pathConfigured) return { available: false, reason: 'not_configured' };
    if (active.length === 0) return { available: false, reason: 'worker_offline' };
    const detectorName = key === 'faces' ? 'face-yunet' : 'plate-yolo';
    if (
      !active.some(
        (worker) =>
          typeof worker.detectors === 'object' &&
          worker.detectors !== null &&
          detectorName in worker.detectors &&
          (worker.detectors as Record<string, unknown>)[detectorName] === true,
      )
    ) {
      return { available: false, reason: 'model_unavailable' };
    }
    return { available: true, reason: 'ready' };
  };
  return {
    faces: model('faces', env.FACE_BLUR_ENABLED !== 'false', true),
    plates: model(
      'plates',
      env.PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED === 'true',
      Boolean(env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH?.trim()),
    ),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { VIDEO_BUCKET } from '@nl/shared';
import { adminClient, SIGNED_URL_TTL_S } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/** Short-lived signed URLs for private processed media (videos bucket only). */
export async function signMedia(
  paths: Array<string | null | undefined>,
): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const unique = [...new Set(paths.filter((p): p is string => Boolean(p)))];
  const out = new Map<string, string>();
  if (unique.length === 0) return out;
  const { data, error } = await adminClient()
    .storage.from(VIDEO_BUCKET)
    .createSignedUrls(unique, SIGNED_URL_TTL_S);
  if (error) throw error;
  for (const row of data) if (row.path && row.signedUrl) out.set(row.path, row.signedUrl);
  return out;
}
```

```ts
export type OfferStatus = 'valid' | 'expired' | 'invalid' | 'unavailable' | null;

export function getOfferStatus(
  category: string | null,
  isMerchant: boolean,
  expiresAt: string | null,
  videoStatus: string | null,
  now: Date,
): OfferStatus {
  if (category !== 'shop') return null;
  if (videoStatus === 'expired') return 'expired';
  if (videoStatus !== 'active') return 'unavailable';

  const expiry = expiresAt ? Date.parse(expiresAt) : Number.NaN;
  if (!Number.isFinite(expiry)) return 'invalid';
  if (expiry <= now.getTime()) return 'expired';
  if (!isMerchant) return 'invalid';
  return 'valid';
}
```

`apps\web\src\lib\offline-queue.ts`:

```ts
'use client';

import { haversineMeters, MAX_ACCURACY_M } from '@nl/shared';
import { openDB, type IDBPDatabase } from 'idb';
import type { Fix, PublishMeta } from '@/lib/publish';

/** A recording kept on the device while offline. Stored only in this browser (IndexedDB). */
export interface QueuedPublication {
  id: string;
  blob: Blob;
  meta: PublishMeta;
  fix: Fix;
  createdAt: number;
  reserved?: { videoId: string; uploadPath: string };
}

/** A queued video is republished only if the device is still within this distance of where it was filmed. */
export const MAX_DRIFT_M = 100;
/** Older recordings are dropped: hyperlocal news goes stale (alerts live 6 h). */
export const MAX_AGE_MS = 6 * 3_600_000;

let db: Promise<IDBPDatabase> | undefined;
const store = () =>
  (db ??= openDB('neighbors-live', 1, {
    upgrade(d) {
      d.createObjectStore('outbox', { keyPath: 'id' });
    },
  }));

export async function enqueue(item: QueuedPublication): Promise<void> {
  await (await store()).put('outbox', item);
}

export async function listQueued(): Promise<QueuedPublication[]> {
  return (await store()).getAll('outbox');
}

export async function removeQueued(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await (await store()).delete('outbox', id);
}

export type Verdict = 'publish' | 'drop-stale' | 'drop-moved' | 'wait-precision';

/** Decides what to do with a queued recording given the device's current position. */
export function judge(
  item: Pick<QueuedPublication, 'fix' | 'createdAt'>,
  now: number,
  current: Fix,
): Verdict {
  if (now - item.createdAt > MAX_AGE_MS) return 'drop-stale';
  if (current.accuracy > MAX_ACCURACY_M) return 'wait-precision';
  if (haversineMeters(item.fix, current) > MAX_DRIFT_M) return 'drop-moved';
  return 'publish';
}
```

```ts
'use client';

export const isIos = (): boolean =>
  typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
  (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
    (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1));

/** True when running as an installed PWA (home screen), required for Web Push on iOS. */
export const isStandalone = (): boolean =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
  (window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
    (navigator as Navigator & { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true);

export const pushSupported = (): boolean =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
  'serviceWorker' in navigator &&
  'PushManager' in window &&
  'Notification' in window;

/** One-shot high-accuracy position (never watched, never stored client-side). */
export function currentPosition(timeoutMs = 15_000): Promise<GeolocationPosition> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!('geolocation' in navigator)) return reject(new Error('unsupported'));
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, {
      enableHighAccuracy: true,
      timeout: timeoutMs,
      maximumAge: 0,
    });
  });
}

/** Service worker registration, or null if none becomes ready in time. */
export async function swRegistration(timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<ServiceWorkerRegistration | null> {
  if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return null;
  return Promise.race([
    navigator.serviceWorker.ready,
    new Promise<null>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), timeoutMs)),
  ]);
}

export function urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64: string): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {
  const padded = (base64 + '='.repeat((4 - (base64.length % 4)) % 4))
    .replace(/-/g, '+')
    .replace(/_/g, '/');
  const raw = atob(padded);
  const out = new Uint8Array(new ArrayBuffer(raw.length));
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i += 1) out[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { RAW_BUCKET } from '@nl/shared';
import { Upload } from 'tus-js-client';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { browserClient } from '@/lib/supabase/browser';

export interface PublishMeta {
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  mimeType: 'video/mp4' | 'video/webm';
  durationMs: number;
  eventEndsAt?: string;
  merchantHours?: number;
  offerTerms?: string;
}

export interface Fix {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  accuracy: number;
}

export class PublishError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly retryable: boolean;
  readonly reserved?: { videoId: string; uploadPath: string };
  constructor(
    code: string,
    retryable: boolean,
    reserved?: { videoId: string; uploadPath: string },
  ) {
    super(code);
    this.code = code;
    this.retryable = retryable;
    this.reserved = reserved;
  }
}

/** Resumable upload (TUS, 6 MB chunks as required by Supabase) with automatic retries. */
function tusUpload(
  file: Blob,
  path: string,
  contentType: string,
  token: string,
  onProgress: (p: number) => void,
) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const upload = new Upload(file, {
      endpoint: `${clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/upload/resumable`,
      retryDelays: [0, 1000, 3000, 5000, 10000, 20000],
      headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'x-upsert': 'false' },
      uploadDataDuringCreation: true,
      removeFingerprintOnSuccess: true,
      metadata: { bucketName: RAW_BUCKET, objectName: path, contentType, cacheControl: '3600' },
      chunkSize: 6 * 1024 * 1024,
      onError: reject,
      onProgress: (sent, total) => onProgress(total ? Math.round((sent / total) * 100) : 0),
      onSuccess: () => resolve(),
    });
    void upload.findPreviousUploads().then((previous) => {
      if (previous[0]) upload.resumeFromPreviousUpload(previous[0]);
      upload.start();
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Full publication: reserve (server validation) → resumable upload → confirm.
 * `existingVideoId` lets the offline queue resume a publication already reserved.
 */
export async function publish(
  file: Blob,
  meta: PublishMeta,
  fix: Fix,
  onProgress: (percent: number) => void,
  existing?: { videoId: string; uploadPath: string },
  requestId = crypto.randomUUID(),
): Promise<{ videoId: string }> {
  let target = existing;
  if (!target) {
    const res = await api<{ videoId: string; uploadPath: string }>('/api/videos', {
      body: { ...meta, ...fix, sizeBytes: file.size, requestId },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new PublishError(res.error, res.status === 0);
    target = res.data;
  }
  const { data } = await browserClient().auth.getSession();
  const token = data.session?.access_token;
  if (!token) throw new PublishError('unauthorized', true, target);
  try {
    await tusUpload(file, target.uploadPath, meta.mimeType, token, onProgress);
  } catch {
    throw new PublishError('network', true, target);
  }
  const done = await api(`/api/videos/${target.videoId}/uploaded`, { body: {} });
  if (!done.ok) throw new PublishError(done.error, done.status === 0);
  return { videoId: target.videoId };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * MediaRecorder formats in order of preference. Safari (iOS/macOS) records MP4/H.264,
 * Chrome/Firefox/Android record WebM. The worker transcodes everything to MP4 anyway.
 */
export const MIME_CANDIDATES = [
  'video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E,mp4a.40.2',
  'video/mp4',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus',
  'video/webm',
] as const;

export function pickMimeType(isSupported: (type: string) => boolean): string | null {
  return MIME_CANDIDATES.find((t) => isSupported(t)) ?? null;
}

/** Container type sent to the server ("video/mp4" | "video/webm"), without codecs. */
export const containerOf = (mime: string): 'video/mp4' | 'video/webm' =>
  mime.startsWith('video/mp4') ? 'video/mp4' : 'video/webm';
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { isVideoSaved, readSavedVideoIds, toggleSavedVideo } from './saved-videos';

function makeStorage(initial: string[] = []): Storage {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  if (initial.length > 0) {
    values.set('nl-saved-videos', JSON.stringify(initial));
  }

  return {
    getItem(key: string) {
      return values.has(key) ? (values.get(key) ?? null) : null;
    },
    setItem(key: string, value: string) {
      values.set(key, value);
    },
    removeItem(key: string) {
      values.delete(key);
    },
    clear() {
      values.clear();
    },
    key(index: number) {
      return Array.from(values.keys())[index] ?? null;
    },
    get length() {
      return values.size;
    },
  } as Storage;
}

describe('saved video list', () => {
  it('reads persisted ids from storage', () => {
    const storage = makeStorage(['v1', 'v2']);
    expect(readSavedVideoIds(storage)).toEqual(['v1', 'v2']);
  });

  it('returns true only for saved video ids', () => {
    const storage = makeStorage(['v2']);
    expect(isVideoSaved('v1', storage)).toBe(false);
    expect(isVideoSaved('v2', storage)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('adds ids without duplication and removes them on the second toggle', () => {
    const storage = makeStorage();
    const first = toggleSavedVideo('v42', storage);
    expect(first).toMatchObject({ saved: true, ids: ['v42'] });
    expect(readSavedVideoIds(storage)).toEqual(['v42']);

    const second = toggleSavedVideo('v42', storage);
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ saved: false, ids: [] });
    expect(readSavedVideoIds(storage)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

`apps\web\src\lib\saved-videos.ts`:

```ts
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

type StorageLike = Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'>;

export type SavedVideoRecord = {
  id: string;
  category?: string | null;
  caption?: string | null;
  posterUrl?: string | null;
  authorName?: string | null;
  savedAt: number;
  status?: string | null;
  publishedAt?: string | null;
  expiresAt?: string | null;
};

const STORAGE_KEY = 'nl-saved-videos';

function resolveStorage(storage?: StorageLike | null): StorageLike | null {
  if (storage) return storage;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    return window.localStorage;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function normalizeSavedVideos(raw: unknown): SavedVideoRecord[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];

  return raw
    .map((entry): SavedVideoRecord | null => {
      if (typeof entry === 'string') {
        return { id: entry, savedAt: Date.now() };
      }
      if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return null;
      const candidate = entry as Partial<SavedVideoRecord> & { id?: unknown };
      if (typeof candidate.id !== 'string' || !candidate.id.trim()) return null;
      return {
        id: candidate.id,
        category: typeof candidate.category === 'string' ? candidate.category : undefined,
        caption: typeof candidate.caption === 'string' ? candidate.caption : undefined,
        posterUrl: typeof candidate.posterUrl === 'string' ? candidate.posterUrl : undefined,
        authorName: typeof candidate.authorName === 'string' ? candidate.authorName : undefined,
        savedAt: typeof candidate.savedAt === 'number' ? candidate.savedAt : Date.now(),
        status: typeof candidate.status === 'string' ? candidate.status : null,
        publishedAt: typeof candidate.publishedAt === 'string' ? candidate.publishedAt : null,
        expiresAt: typeof candidate.expiresAt === 'string' ? candidate.expiresAt : null,
      };
    })
    .filter((entry): entry is SavedVideoRecord => entry !== null);
}

export function readSavedVideos(storage?: StorageLike | null): SavedVideoRecord[] {
  const target = resolveStorage(storage);
  if (!target) return [];

  try {
    const raw = target.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return normalizeSavedVideos(JSON.parse(raw));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export function readSavedVideoIds(storage?: StorageLike | null): string[] {
  return readSavedVideos(storage).map((video) => video.id);
}

export function isVideoSaved(videoId: string, storage?: StorageLike | null): boolean {
  return readSavedVideoIds(storage).includes(videoId);
}

export function toggleSavedVideo(
  videoId: string,
  detailsOrStorage?: Partial<Omit<SavedVideoRecord, 'id' | 'savedAt'>> | StorageLike | null,
  storage?: StorageLike | null,
) {
  const target = resolveStorage(
    storage ?? (detailsOrStorage && 'getItem' in detailsOrStorage ? detailsOrStorage : null),
  );
  const details = detailsOrStorage && !('getItem' in detailsOrStorage) ? detailsOrStorage : {};
  const current = readSavedVideos(target);
  const existsIndex = current.findIndex((item) => item.id === videoId);
  const exists = existsIndex >= 0;
  const next = exists
    ? current.filter((item) => item.id !== videoId)
    : [{ id: videoId, savedAt: Date.now(), ...details }, ...current];

  if (target) {
    try {
      target.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('nl-saved-videos-change'));
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore quota or unavailable storage so the UI still stays usable.
    }
  }

  return {
    saved: !exists,
    ids: next.map((item) => item.id),
    item: next.find((item) => item.id === videoId) ?? null,
    items: next,
  };
}

export async function fetchSavedVideos(): Promise<SavedVideoRecord[]> {
  const res = await api<{ videos: SavedVideoRecord[] }>('/api/me/saved-videos');
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not load saved videos: ${res.error}`);
  return res.data.videos;
}

export async function fetchIsVideoSaved(videoId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const res = await api<{ saved: boolean }>(
    `/api/me/saved-videos?videoId=${encodeURIComponent(videoId)}`,
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not read saved video state: ${res.error}`);
  return res.data.saved;
}

export async function toggleSavedVideoServer(videoId: string) {
  const currentSaved = await fetchIsVideoSaved(videoId);
  const res = await api<{ saved: boolean; ids: string[]; item: SavedVideoRecord | null }>(
    '/api/me/saved-videos',
    {
      method: currentSaved ? 'DELETE' : 'POST',
      body: { videoId },
    },
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not update saved video state: ${res.error}`);
  return res.data;
}
```

```ts
import { cache } from 'react';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export interface Viewer {
  id: string;
  email: string | undefined;
  username: string | null;
  bio: string;
  avatarColor: string;
  avatarPath: string | null;
  coverPath: string | null;
  role: 'user' | 'merchant' | 'admin';
  reputation: number;
  banned: boolean;
  isModerator: boolean;
  moderatedCells: string[];
  settings: { defaultRadius: number; locale: string; notifyAlerts: boolean; onboarded: boolean };
}

/** The verified signed-in user with profile, settings and roles (deduplicated per request). */
export const getViewer = cache(async (): Promise<Viewer | null> => {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const user = data.user;
  if (!user) return null;
  const admin = adminClient();
  const [profile, settings, zones] = await Promise.all([
    admin
      .from('profiles')
      .select('username, bio, avatar_color, avatar_path, cover_path, role, reputation, banned_at')
      .eq('id', user.id)
      .single(),
    supabase
      .from('user_settings')
      .select('default_radius, locale, notify_alerts, onboarded_at')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .single(),
    admin.from('zone_moderators').select('h3_cell').eq('user_id', user.id),
  ]);
  if (!profile.data) return null;
  const cells = (zones.data ?? []).map((z) => z.h3_cell);
  return {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    username: profile.data.username,
    bio: profile.data.bio,
    avatarColor: profile.data.avatar_color,
    avatarPath: profile.data.avatar_path,
    coverPath: profile.data.cover_path,
    role: profile.data.role,
    reputation: profile.data.reputation,
    banned: profile.data.banned_at !== null,
    isModerator: cells.length > 0 || profile.data.role === 'admin',
    moderatedCells: cells,
    settings: {
      defaultRadius: settings.data?.default_radius ?? 1000,
      locale: settings.data?.locale ?? 'fr',
      notifyAlerts: settings.data?.notify_alerts ?? true,
      onboarded: Boolean(settings.data?.onboarded_at),
    },
  };
});
```

```ts
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import type { Database } from '@nl/shared';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';

/** Supabase client acting as the signed-in user (RLS applies). Server components & routes. */
export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  return createServerClient<Database>(
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(),
        setAll: (toSet) => {
          try {
            for (const { name, value, options } of toSet) cookieStore.set(name, value, options);
          } catch {
            // Called from a Server Component: cookies are refreshed by src/proxy.ts instead.
          }
        },
      },
    },
  );
}

/** Verified current user (validated against the Auth server), or null. */
export async function getUser() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  return data.user;
}
```

```ts
import { initialsColor } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { buildCsp } from './csp';
import { safeNext } from './redirect';

const lum = (hex: string) => {
  const ch = (i: number) => {
    const c = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255;
    return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  };
  return 0.2126 * ch(1) + 0.7152 * ch(3) + 0.0722 * ch(5);
};
const contrast = (a: string, b: string) => {
  const [x, y] = [lum(a), lum(b)].sort((p, q) => q - p) as [number, number];
  return (x + 0.05) / (y + 0.05);
};

describe('accessibility of generated colours', () => {
  it('category chips keep white text at WCAG AA (4.5:1)', () => {
    for (const color of Object.values(CATEGORY_COLORS)) {
      expect(contrast('#ffffff', color)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
    }
  });
  it('avatar initials pick the readable text colour', () => {
    for (const bg of [
      '#ef4444',
      '#f97316',
      '#d97706',
      '#16a34a',
      '#0d9488',
      '#0284c7',
      '#4f46e5',
    ]) {
      expect(contrast(initialsColor(bg), bg)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
    }
  });
});

describe('csp', () => {
  const base = {
    nonce: 'abc',
    supabaseUrl: 'https://p.supabase.co',
    mapStyleUrl: 'https://tiles.example.org/styles/x',
    siteUrl: 'https://app.example.org',
  };
  it('is strict in production', () => {
    const csp = buildCsp({ ...base, isDev: false });
    expect(csp).toContain("script-src 'self' 'nonce-abc' 'strict-dynamic'");
    expect(csp).not.toContain('unsafe-eval');
    expect(csp).toContain("style-src 'self' 'nonce-abc'");
    expect(csp).toContain("frame-ancestors 'none'");
    expect(csp).toContain('connect-src');
    expect(csp).toContain('wss://p.supabase.co');
    expect(csp).toContain('upgrade-insecure-requests');
  });
  it('relaxes eval only in development', () => {
    expect(buildCsp({ ...base, isDev: true })).toContain("'unsafe-eval'");
  });
});

describe('safeNext (open redirect protection)', () => {
  it('keeps same-site paths and rejects others', () => {
    expect(safeNext('/carte?x=1')).toBe('/carte?x=1');
    expect(safeNext('//evil.example')).toBe('/');
    expect(safeNext('https://evil.example')).toBe('/');
    expect(safeNext('/\\evil.example')).toBe('/');
    expect(safeNext(null)).toBe('/');
  });
});
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';

export type LocationState =
  | { status: 'unknown' }
  | { status: 'primer' }
  | { status: 'locating' }
  | { status: 'ok'; lat: number; lng: number }
  | { status: 'denied' }
  | { status: 'error' };

const PRIMED_KEY = 'nl-location-primed';

function readPrimed(): boolean {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(PRIMED_KEY) === '1';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Viewer position for feed/map queries. The explanation screen is shown before the first
 * system prompt; afterwards the position is re-read on each visit. Nothing is persisted.
 * `?lat=&lng=` overrides it (manual exploration, demos and tests).
 */
export function useLocation() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<LocationState>({ status: 'unknown' });

  const locate = useCallback(async () => {
    setState({ status: 'locating' });
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(PRIMED_KEY, '1');
    } catch {
      /* private mode: the primer will simply show again next time */
    }
    try {
      const pos = await currentPosition();
      setState({ status: 'ok', lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude });
    } catch (e) {
      setState({ status: (e as GeolocationPositionError).code === 1 ? 'denied' : 'error' });
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const lat = Number(params.get('lat'));
    const lng = Number(params.get('lng'));
    let cancelled = false;
    void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (params.has('lat') && Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng)) {
        setState({ status: 'ok', lat, lng });
      } else if (readPrimed()) {
        void locate();
      } else {
        setState({ status: 'primer' });
      }
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [locate]);

  return { state, locate, dismiss: () => setState({ status: 'error' }) };
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { CATEGORIES, RADII_M, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'nl-neighborhood-filters';
const CHANGE_EVENT = 'nl-neighborhood-filters-change';
let memorySnapshot = '{}';

interface Filters {
  radius: number;
  category: Category | null;
}

function parseFilters(snapshot: string): Partial<Filters> {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(snapshot) as { radius?: unknown; category?: unknown } | null;
    return {
      radius:
        typeof saved?.radius === 'number' &&
        RADII_M.includes(saved.radius as (typeof RADII_M)[number])
          ? saved.radius
          : undefined,
      category:
        saved?.category === null ||
        (typeof saved?.category === 'string' && CATEGORIES.includes(saved.category as Category))
          ? (saved.category as Category | null)
          : undefined,
    };
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function getSnapshot() {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? memorySnapshot;
  } catch {
    return memorySnapshot;
  }
}

function subscribe(onChange: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener('storage', onChange);
  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('storage', onChange);
    window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
  };
}

function saveFilters(filters: Filters) {
  memorySnapshot = JSON.stringify(filters);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, memorySnapshot);
  } catch {
    // Keep filters usable for this page session when browser storage is unavailable.
  }
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
}

/** Keep only category and radius locally so feed and map use the same neighborhood filters. */
export function useNeighborhoodFilters(initialRadius: number, initialCategory: Category | null) {
  const snapshot = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, () => '');
  const saved = parseFilters(snapshot);
  const ready = snapshot !== '';
  const radius = saved.radius ?? initialRadius;
  const category = initialCategory ?? saved.category ?? null;

  return {
    radius,
    category,
    ready,
    setRadius: (nextRadius: number) => saveFilters({ radius: nextRadius, category }),
    setCategory: (nextCategory: Category | null) => saveFilters({ radius, category: nextCategory }),
    reset: () => saveFilters({ radius: initialRadius, category: null }),
    customized: radius !== initialRadius || category !== null,
  };
}
```

```ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { getVideoMuted, setVideoMuted } from './video-preferences';

function makeStorage(initial?: string, failWrites = false): Storage {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  if (initial !== undefined) values.set('nl-video-muted', initial);

  return {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
      if (failWrites) throw new Error('Storage unavailable');
      values.set(key, value);
    },
    removeItem: (key: string) => values.delete(key),
    clear: () => values.clear(),
    key: (index: number) => Array.from(values.keys())[index] ?? null,
    get length() {
      return values.size;
    },
  } as Storage;
}

describe('video sound preference', () => {
  beforeEach(() => setVideoMuted(true, null));

  it('defaults to muted when no preference has been saved', () => {
    expect(getVideoMuted(null)).toBe(true);
    expect(getVideoMuted(makeStorage())).toBe(true);
  });

  it('reads and persists the preference in browser storage', () => {
    const storage = makeStorage();

    setVideoMuted(false, storage);

    expect(storage.getItem('nl-video-muted')).toBe('false');
    expect(getVideoMuted(storage)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('uses the safe muted default for unrecognized stored values', () => {
    expect(getVideoMuted(makeStorage('invalid'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('keeps the in-memory preference when storage writes fail', () => {
    const storage = makeStorage(undefined, true);

    setVideoMuted(false, storage);

    expect(getVideoMuted(storage)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
type StorageLike = Pick<Storage, 'getItem' | 'setItem'>;

const STORAGE_KEY = 'nl-video-muted';
const CHANGE_EVENT = 'nl-video-muted-change';
let memoryMuted = true;

function resolveStorage(storage?: StorageLike | null): StorageLike | null {
  if (storage !== undefined) return storage;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    return window.localStorage;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getVideoMuted(storage?: StorageLike | null): boolean {
  const target = resolveStorage(storage);
  if (!target) return memoryMuted;

  try {
    const saved = target.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved === null) return memoryMuted;
    return saved === 'false' ? false : true;
  } catch {
    return memoryMuted;
  }
}

export function setVideoMuted(muted: boolean, storage?: StorageLike | null): void {
  memoryMuted = muted;
  const target = resolveStorage(storage);
  if (!target) return;

  try {
    target.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(muted));
  } catch {
    // Keep the preference available for this page session when browser storage is unavailable.
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CHANGE_EVENT));
  }
}

export function subscribeToVideoMuted(onChange: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

  const handleStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
    if (event.key === STORAGE_KEY || event.key === null) onChange();
  };
  window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  window.addEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);

  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    window.removeEventListener(CHANGE_EVENT, onChange);
  };
}
```

```ts
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { buildCsp } from '@/lib/csp';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';
/** App screens that first-time visitors only reach after the core onboarding. */
const GATED = /^\/(carte|me|u\/[^/]+|parametres|moderation|commerce|admin)?$/;

/** Refreshes the Supabase session cookies and sets a per-request CSP nonce. */
export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname, search } = request.nextUrl;
  if (GATED.test(pathname) && !request.cookies.has(ONBOARDED_COOKIE)) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = '/onboarding';
    url.search = `?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname + search)}`;
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  const nonce = Buffer.from(crypto.randomUUID()).toString('base64');
  const csp = buildCsp({
    nonce,
    isDev: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development',
    supabaseUrl: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
    mapStyleUrl: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL,
    siteUrl: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL,
  });

  const forward = () => {
    const headers = new Headers(request.headers);
    headers.set('x-nonce', nonce);
    headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', csp);
    headers.set('cookie', request.cookies.toString());
    return NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } });
  };

  let response = forward();
  const supabase = createServerClient(
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
        setAll: (toSet) => {
          for (const { name, value } of toSet) request.cookies.set(name, value);
          response = forward();
          for (const { name, value, options } of toSet) response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
        },
      },
    },
  );
  // Revalidates and, if needed, refreshes the session; must run before any render.
  await supabase.auth.getUser();

  response.headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', csp);
  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|serwist/|icons/|manifest.webmanifest|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|svg|webp|ico)$).*)',
  ],
};
```

`apps\worker\scripts\check-blur.ts`:

```ts
// Manual verification of the face pipeline on real media (run inside the worker container):
//   node scripts/check-blur.ts image <file.jpg>                    → prints detected faces
//   node scripts/check-blur.ts video <in> <out.mp4> <poster.jpg>   → full blur + transcode
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { YunetFaceDetector } from '../src/blur/yunet.ts';
import { blurAndTranscode } from '../src/media/pipeline.ts';

const [mode, input, output, poster] = process.argv.slice(2);
const model = process.env.FACE_MODEL_PATH ?? 'models/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx';
const detector = await YunetFaceDetector.load(model);

if (mode === 'image' && input) {
  const size = spawnSync(
    'ffprobe',
    [
      '-v',
      'error',
      '-select_streams',
      'v:0',
      '-show_entries',
      'stream=width,height',
      '-of',
      'csv=p=0',
      input,
    ],
    { encoding: 'utf8' },
  );
  const [width = 0, height = 0] = size.stdout.trim().split(',').map(Number);
  const raw = spawnSync(
    'ffmpeg',
    ['-v', 'error', '-i', input, '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgb24', 'pipe:1'],
    {
      maxBuffer: 1 << 28,
    },
  );
  const started = Date.now();
  const faces = await detector.detect({ data: new Uint8Array(raw.stdout), width, height });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ width, height, ms: Date.now() - started, faces }, null, 2));
} else if (mode === 'video' && input && output && poster) {
  const started = Date.now();
  const stats = await blurAndTranscode(input, output, poster, {
    detectors: [detector],
    detectEvery: 2,
  });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ ...stats, ms: Date.now() - started }));
} else {
  console.error('usage: check-blur.ts image <file> | video <in> <out.mp4> <poster.jpg>');
  process.exit(2);
}
```

`apps\worker\scripts\download-yunet.mjs`:

```mjs
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';

const url =
  process.env.YUNET_URL ??
  'https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/opencv/opencv_zoo/main/models/face_detection_yunet/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx';
const expectedSha256 =
  process.env.YUNET_SHA256 ?? '8f2383e4dd3cfbb4553ea8718107fc0423210dc964f9f4280604804ed2552fa4';
const modelPath = resolve(
  process.cwd(),
  process.env.FACE_MODEL_PATH || 'models/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx',
);

let alreadyInstalled = false;
try {
  const existing = await readFile(modelPath);
  const existingSha256 = createHash('sha256').update(existing).digest('hex');
  if (existingSha256 !== expectedSha256) {
    throw new Error(
      `Existing YuNet model checksum mismatch at ${modelPath}: expected ${expectedSha256}, got ${existingSha256}`,
    );
  }
  console.log(`YuNet model already verified at ${modelPath}`);
  alreadyInstalled = true;
} catch (error) {
  if (!(error instanceof Error) || !('code' in error) || error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
}

if (!alreadyInstalled) {
  const response = await fetch(url);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`YuNet download failed (${response.status}): ${url}`);

  const model = Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer());
  const actualSha256 = createHash('sha256').update(model).digest('hex');
  if (actualSha256 !== expectedSha256) {
    throw new Error(`YuNet checksum mismatch: expected ${expectedSha256}, got ${actualSha256}`);
  }

  await mkdir(dirname(modelPath), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(modelPath, model, { flag: 'wx' });
  console.log(`Installed YuNet model at ${modelPath} (SHA-256 ${actualSha256})`);
}
```

```ts
import type { Box, Frame } from './types.ts';

export function iou(a: Box, b: Box): number {
  const x1 = Math.max(a.x, b.x);
  const y1 = Math.max(a.y, b.y);
  const x2 = Math.min(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w);
  const y2 = Math.min(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h);
  const inter = Math.max(0, x2 - x1) * Math.max(0, y2 - y1);
  const union = a.w * a.h + b.w * b.h - inter;
  return union <= 0 ? 0 : inter / union;
}

/** Greedy non-maximum suppression, highest score first. */
export function nms(boxes: Box[], threshold: number): Box[] {
  const sorted = [...boxes].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  const kept: Box[] = [];
  for (const box of sorted) if (kept.every((k) => iou(k, box) < threshold)) kept.push(box);
  return kept;
}

/** Grows a box by `ratio` on each side (privacy margin for hair, ears, motion). */
export function expand(box: Box, ratio: number): Box {
  const dx = box.w * ratio;
  const dy = box.h * ratio;
  return { ...box, x: box.x - dx, y: box.y - dy, w: box.w + 2 * dx, h: box.h + 2 * dy };
}

export interface Letterbox {
  /** CHW float32 tensor data, BGR order, values 0..255 (YuNet convention). */
  tensor: Float32Array;
  scale: number;
}

/**
 * Resizes (bilinear) an RGB frame into a size×size square, top-left aligned and zero padded,
 * and converts it to a BGR CHW float tensor.
 */
export function letterboxBgr(frame: Frame, size: number): Letterbox {
  const scale = size / Math.max(frame.width, frame.height);
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(frame.width * scale));
  const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(frame.height * scale));
  const plane = size * size;
  const tensor = new Float32Array(3 * plane);
  const src = frame.data;
  const sw = frame.width;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 1) {
    const fy = Math.min(frame.height - 1, (y + 0.5) / scale - 0.5);
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(fy));
    const y1 = Math.min(frame.height - 1, y0 + 1);
    const wy = fy - y0;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 1) {
      const fx = Math.min(sw - 1, (x + 0.5) / scale - 0.5);
      const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(fx));
      const x1 = Math.min(sw - 1, x0 + 1);
      const wx = fx - x0;
      const i00 = (y0 * sw + x0) * 3;
      const i01 = (y0 * sw + x1) * 3;
      const i10 = (y1 * sw + x0) * 3;
      const i11 = (y1 * sw + x1) * 3;
      const o = y * size + x;
      for (let c = 0; c < 3; c += 1) {
        const top = (src[i00 + c] ?? 0) * (1 - wx) + (src[i01 + c] ?? 0) * wx;
        const bottom = (src[i10 + c] ?? 0) * (1 - wx) + (src[i11 + c] ?? 0) * wx;
        // RGB -> BGR planes.
        tensor[(2 - c) * plane + o] = top * (1 - wy) + bottom * wy;
      }
    }
  }
  return { tensor, scale };
}
```

`apps\worker\src\blur\pixelate.ts`:

```ts
import type { Box, Frame } from './types.ts';

/**
 * Irreversibly pixelates the boxes in place: each box is split into ~`blocks` cells across,
 * every cell is replaced by its mean colour.
 */
export function pixelate(frame: Frame, boxes: Box[], blocks = 6): void {
  const { data, width, height } = frame;
  for (const box of boxes) {
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(box.x));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(box.y));
    const x1 = Math.min(width, Math.ceil(box.x + box.w));
    const y1 = Math.min(height, Math.ceil(box.y + box.h));
    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) continue;
    const cell = Math.max(4, Math.ceil((x1 - x0) / blocks));
    for (let cy = y0; cy < y1; cy += cell) {
      for (let cx = x0; cx < x1; cx += cell) {
        const ex = Math.min(x1, cx + cell);
        const ey = Math.min(y1, cy + cell);
        let r = 0;
        let g = 0;
        let b = 0;
        const n = (ex - cx) * (ey - cy);
        for (let y = cy; y < ey; y += 1) {
          for (let x = cx; x < ex; x += 1) {
            const i = (y * width + x) * 3;
            r += data[i] ?? 0;
            g += data[i + 1] ?? 0;
            b += data[i + 2] ?? 0;
          }
        }
        r = Math.round(r / n);
        g = Math.round(g / n);
        b = Math.round(b / n);
        for (let y = cy; y < ey; y += 1) {
          for (let x = cx; x < ex; x += 1) {
            const i = (y * width + x) * 3;
            data[i] = r;
            data[i + 1] = g;
            data[i + 2] = b;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
import * as ort from 'onnxruntime-node';
import { letterboxBgr, nms } from './geometry.ts';
import { DisabledDetector, type Box, type Detector, type Frame } from './types.ts';

const INPUT = 640;

/**
 * Decodes a single-class YOLOv8-style detection head, output shape [1, 5, N]
 * (cx, cy, w, h, score per anchor), in the 640×640 input space.
 */
export function decodeYoloSingleClass(
  data: Float32Array,
  anchors: number,
  minScore: number,
): Box[] {
  const boxes: Box[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < anchors; i += 1) {
    const score = data[4 * anchors + i] ?? 0;
    if (score < minScore) continue;
    const cx = data[i] ?? 0;
    const cy = data[anchors + i] ?? 0;
    const w = data[2 * anchors + i] ?? 0;
    const h = data[3 * anchors + i] ?? 0;
    boxes.push({ x: cx - w / 2, y: cy - h / 2, w, h, score });
  }
  return boxes;
}

/**
 * Licence plate detector. No reliable, openly licensed plate model is bundled with the project:
 * it only runs when an operator provides one (PLATE_MODEL_PATH, YOLOv8 single-class ONNX export,
 * 640×640 input). See docs/PRIVACY.md for the real coverage.
 */
export class OnnxPlateDetector implements Detector {
  readonly name = 'plate-yolo';
  readonly enabled = true;
  private readonly session: ort.InferenceSession;
  private readonly minScore: number;

  private constructor(session: ort.InferenceSession, minScore: number) {
    this.session = session;
    this.minScore = minScore;
  }

  static async load(modelPath: string, minScore = 0.35): Promise<OnnxPlateDetector> {
    return new OnnxPlateDetector(await ort.InferenceSession.create(modelPath), minScore);
  }

  async detect(frame: Frame, settings?: { minScore: number }): Promise<Box[]> {
    const { tensor, scale } = letterboxBgr(frame, INPUT);
    // YOLO models expect RGB normalised to 0..1: swap the BGR planes back and rescale.
    const plane = INPUT * INPUT;
    const rgb = new Float32Array(tensor.length);
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c += 1) {
      const src = tensor.subarray((2 - c) * plane, (3 - c) * plane);
      for (let i = 0; i < plane; i += 1) rgb[c * plane + i] = (src[i] ?? 0) / 255;
    }
    const inputName = this.session.inputNames[0] ?? 'images';
    const outputName = this.session.outputNames[0] ?? 'output0';
    const result = await this.session.run({
      [inputName]: new ort.Tensor('float32', rgb, [1, 3, INPUT, INPUT]),
    });
    const out = result[outputName];
    if (!out) return [];
    const anchors = out.dims[2] ?? 0;
    const boxes = decodeYoloSingleClass(
      out.data as Float32Array,
      anchors,
      settings?.minScore ?? this.minScore,
    );
    return nms(boxes, 0.4).map((b) => ({
      x: b.x / scale,
      y: b.y / scale,
      w: b.w / scale,
      h: b.h / scale,
      score: b.score,
    }));
  }
}

export async function createPlateDetector(
  enabled: boolean,
  modelPath: string | undefined,
): Promise<Detector> {
  if (!enabled || !modelPath) return new DisabledDetector('plate');
  return OnnxPlateDetector.load(modelPath);
}
```

```ts
import { expand, iou } from './geometry.ts';
import type { Box } from './types.ts';

interface Track {
  box: Box;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  /** Frames since the last matching detection. */
  missed: number;
}

export interface TrackerOptions {
  /** Frames a track survives without detection (covers detector misses and skipped frames). */
  ttl: number;
  /** IoU needed to associate a detection with an existing track. */
  matchIou: number;
  /** Safety margin added around every blurred box (fraction of its size per side). */
  margin: number;
}

/**
 * Simple IoU tracker: associates detections with tracks, extrapolates motion with a constant
 * velocity while a face is not detected, and keeps blurring for `ttl` frames after it was lost.
 */
export class BoxTracker {
  private tracks: Track[] = [];
  private readonly opts: TrackerOptions;

  constructor(opts: Partial<TrackerOptions> = {}) {
    this.opts = { ttl: 8, matchIou: 0.2, margin: 0.25, ...opts };
  }

  /** Advances one frame. Pass `detections` when the detector ran on this frame, else null. */
  step(detections: Box[] | null): Box[] {
    for (const t of this.tracks) {
      t.box = { ...t.box, x: t.box.x + t.vx, y: t.box.y + t.vy };
      t.missed += 1;
    }
    if (detections) {
      const free = new Set(this.tracks);
      for (const d of [...detections].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)) {
        let best: Track | undefined;
        let bestIou = this.opts.matchIou;
        for (const t of free) {
          const v = iou(t.box, d);
          if (v >= bestIou) {
            best = t;
            bestIou = v;
          }
        }
        if (best) {
          free.delete(best);
          // Per-frame displacement since the last detection, smoothed.
          const lastX = best.box.x - best.missed * best.vx;
          const lastY = best.box.y - best.missed * best.vy;
          best.vx = 0.5 * best.vx + (0.5 * (d.x - lastX)) / best.missed;
          best.vy = 0.5 * best.vy + (0.5 * (d.y - lastY)) / best.missed;
          best.box = d;
          best.missed = 0;
        } else {
          this.tracks.push({ box: d, vx: 0, vy: 0, missed: 0 });
        }
      }
    }
    this.tracks = this.tracks.filter((t) => t.missed <= this.opts.ttl);
    return this.tracks.map((t) => expand(t.box, this.opts.margin));
  }
}
```

```ts
/** Axis-aligned box in pixel coordinates of the frame it was detected on. */
export interface Box {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  score: number;
}

/** Packed RGB24 frame (row-major, 3 bytes per pixel). */
export interface Frame {
  data: Uint8Array;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/**
 * A detector of things to blur (faces, licence plates…). Implementations must favour recall:
 * a missed face is a privacy incident, an extra blurred patch is not.
 */
export interface Detector {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly enabled: boolean;
  detect(frame: Frame, settings?: { minScore: number }): Promise<Box[]>;
}

/** Detector used when a capability is switched off or no reliable model is available. */
export class DisabledDetector implements Detector {
  readonly enabled = false;
  readonly name: string;
  constructor(name: string) {
    this.name = name;
  }
  async detect(): Promise<Box[]> {
    return [];
  }
}
```

`apps\worker\src\blur\yunet.ts`:

```ts
import * as ort from 'onnxruntime-node';
import { letterboxBgr, nms } from './geometry.ts';
import type { Box, Detector, Frame } from './types.ts';

const INPUT = 640;
const STRIDES = [8, 16, 32] as const;

export interface YunetOutputs {
  cls: Float32Array[];
  obj: Float32Array[];
  bbox: Float32Array[];
}

/**
 * Decodes YuNet (opencv_zoo face_detection_yunet_2023mar) raw outputs into boxes in the
 * 640×640 input space. Same maths as OpenCV's FaceDetectorYN.
 */
export function decodeYunet(out: YunetOutputs, minScore: number): Box[] {
  const boxes: Box[] = [];
  STRIDES.forEach((stride, s) => {
    const cols = INPUT / stride;
    const cls = out.cls[s];
    const obj = out.obj[s];
    const bbox = out.bbox[s];
    if (!cls || !obj || !bbox) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < cls.length; i += 1) {
      const c = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, cls[i] ?? 0));
      const o = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, obj[i] ?? 0));
      const score = Math.sqrt(c * o);
      if (score < minScore) continue;
      const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
      const col = i % cols;
      const cx = (col + (bbox[i * 4] ?? 0)) * stride;
      const cy = (row + (bbox[i * 4 + 1] ?? 0)) * stride;
      const w = Math.exp(bbox[i * 4 + 2] ?? 0) * stride;
      const h = Math.exp(bbox[i * 4 + 3] ?? 0) * stride;
      boxes.push({ x: cx - w / 2, y: cy - h / 2, w, h, score });
    }
  });
  return boxes;
}

/** Splits a frame into `n` overlapping tiles along its long side. */
export function tiles(
  frame: Frame,
  n: number,
  overlap: number,
): Array<{ x: number; y: number; frame: Frame }> {
  const horizontal = frame.width >= frame.height;
  const long = horizontal ? frame.width : frame.height;
  const size = Math.ceil(long / n) + overlap;
  const out: Array<{ x: number; y: number; frame: Frame }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
    const start = Math.max(0, Math.min(long - size, i * Math.ceil(long / n) - overlap / 2));
    const x = horizontal ? start : 0;
    const y = horizontal ? 0 : start;
    const w = horizontal ? size : frame.width;
    const h = horizontal ? frame.height : size;
    const data = new Uint8Array(w * h * 3);
    for (let row = 0; row < h; row += 1) {
      const from = ((y + row) * frame.width + x) * 3;
      data.set(frame.data.subarray(from, from + w * 3), row * w * 3);
    }
    out.push({ x, y, frame: { data, width: w, height: h } });
  }
  return out;
}

export class YunetFaceDetector implements Detector {
  readonly name = 'face-yunet';
  readonly enabled = true;
  private readonly session: ort.InferenceSession;
  private readonly minScore: number;

  private constructor(session: ort.InferenceSession, minScore: number) {
    this.session = session;
    this.minScore = minScore;
  }

  static async load(modelPath: string, minScore = 0.5): Promise<YunetFaceDetector> {
    const session = await ort.InferenceSession.create(modelPath, { intraOpNumThreads: 2 });
    return new YunetFaceDetector(session, minScore);
  }

  /**
   * Whole frame plus overlapping tiles along the long side: downscaling a 1280 px frame to
   * 640 px halves small faces below YuNet's ~10 px floor, tiles keep them near full size.
   */
  async detect(frame: Frame, settings?: { minScore: number }): Promise<Box[]> {
    const minScore = settings?.minScore ?? this.minScore;
    const boxes = await this.detectOnce(frame, minScore);
    const long = Math.max(frame.width, frame.height);
    if (long > INPUT * 1.25) {
      for (const tile of tiles(frame, 2, 64)) {
        for (const b of await this.detectOnce(tile.frame, minScore))
          boxes.push({ ...b, x: b.x + tile.x, y: b.y + tile.y });
      }
    }
    return nms(boxes, 0.3);
  }

  private async detectOnce(frame: Frame, minScore: number): Promise<Box[]> {
    const { tensor, scale } = letterboxBgr(frame, INPUT);
    const result = await this.session.run({
      input: new ort.Tensor('float32', tensor, [1, 3, INPUT, INPUT]),
    });
    const pick = (name: string) => result[name]?.data as Float32Array;
    const boxes = decodeYunet(
      {
        cls: STRIDES.map((s) => pick(`cls_${s}`)),
        obj: STRIDES.map((s) => pick(`obj_${s}`)),
        bbox: STRIDES.map((s) => pick(`bbox_${s}`)),
      },
      minScore,
    );
    return nms(boxes, 0.3).map((b) => ({
      x: b.x / scale,
      y: b.y / scale,
      w: b.w / scale,
      h: b.h / scale,
      score: b.score,
    }));
  }
}
```

```ts
import { hostname } from 'node:os';
import { z } from 'zod';

const bool = z.enum(['true', 'false']).transform((v) => v === 'true');

const schema = z
  .object({
    DATABASE_URL: z.string().regex(/^postgres(ql)?:\/\//),
    SUPABASE_URL: z.url(),
    SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: z.string().min(20),
    NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY: z.string().min(20),
    VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY: z.string().min(20),
    VAPID_SUBJECT: z.string().regex(/^(mailto:|https:\/\/)/),
    NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: z.url().default('http://localhost:3000'),
    WORKER_ID: z.string().min(1).default(hostname()),
    WORKER_CONCURRENCY: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(8).default(1),
    DETECT_EVERY: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10).default(2),
    FACE_BLUR_ENABLED: bool.default(true),
    FACE_MODEL_PATH: z
      .string()
      .optional()
      .transform((v) => v?.trim() || undefined)
      .default('models/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx'),
    PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED: bool.default(false),
    PLATE_MODEL_PATH: z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .optional()
      .transform((v) => v || undefined),
    POLL_INTERVAL_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(500).default(10_000),
    OUTBOX_INTERVAL_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(500).default(15_000),
  })
  .superRefine((env, ctx) => {
    if (env.FACE_BLUR_ENABLED && !env.FACE_MODEL_PATH) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: 'custom',
        path: ['FACE_MODEL_PATH'],
        message: 'FACE_MODEL_PATH is required when FACE_BLUR_ENABLED=true',
      });
    }
    if (env.PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED && !env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: 'custom',
        path: ['PLATE_MODEL_PATH'],
        message: 'PLATE_MODEL_PATH is required when PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED=true',
      });
    }
  });

export type WorkerEnv = z.infer<typeof schema>;

/** Validated at startup: the worker refuses to run with an incomplete configuration. */
export const loadEnv = (source: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): WorkerEnv => schema.parse(source);
```

`apps\worker\src\index.ts`:

```ts
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import pg from 'pg';
import { OnnxPlateDetector } from './blur/plates.ts';
import { DisabledDetector, type Detector } from './blur/types.ts';
import { YunetFaceDetector } from './blur/yunet.ts';
import { loadEnv } from './env.ts';
import { claimJob, runJob, type JobDeps } from './jobs.ts';
import { Notifier } from './notify.ts';
import { storageClient } from './storage.ts';

const env = loadEnv();
const log = (msg: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify({ t: new Date().toISOString(), worker: env.WORKER_ID, msg, ...extra }),
  );

async function loadDetectors(): Promise<Detector[]> {
  const detectors: Detector[] = [];
  if (env.FACE_BLUR_ENABLED && (!env.FACE_MODEL_PATH || !existsSync(env.FACE_MODEL_PATH))) {
    throw new Error(`face model missing: ${env.FACE_MODEL_PATH ?? '(FACE_MODEL_PATH is not set)'}`);
  }
  if (env.FACE_MODEL_PATH && existsSync(env.FACE_MODEL_PATH)) {
    detectors.push(await YunetFaceDetector.load(env.FACE_MODEL_PATH));
  } else {
    detectors.push(new DisabledDetector('face'));
  }
  if (env.PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED && (!env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH || !existsSync(env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH))) {
    throw new Error(
      `plate model missing: ${env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH ?? '(PLATE_MODEL_PATH is not set)'}`,
    );
  }
  if (env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH && existsSync(env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH)) {
    detectors.push(await OnnxPlateDetector.load(env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH));
  } else {
    detectors.push(new DisabledDetector('plate'));
  }
  return detectors;
}

async function main() {
  const db = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: env.DATABASE_URL, max: env.WORKER_CONCURRENCY + 2 });
  const deps: JobDeps = {
    db,
    storage: storageClient(env),
    detectors: await loadDetectors(),
    detectEvery: env.DETECT_EVERY,
    faceBlurAvailable: env.FACE_BLUR_ENABLED,
    plateBlurAvailable: env.PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED,
    log,
  };
  log('worker started', {
    detectors: deps.detectors.map((d) => `${d.name}:${d.enabled ? 'on' : 'off'}`),
  });
  const writeWorkerStatus = () =>
    db.query(
      `insert into public.media_worker_status (worker_id, detectors, last_seen)
       values ($1, $2::jsonb, now())
       on conflict (worker_id) do update
       set detectors = excluded.detectors, last_seen = excluded.last_seen`,
      [
        env.WORKER_ID,
        JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(deps.detectors.map((d) => [d.name, d.enabled]))),
      ],
    );
  await writeWorkerStatus();

  let wake: (() => void) | undefined;
  const nap = (ms: number) =>
    new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(resolve, ms);
      wake = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve();
      };
    });

  // LISTEN gives near-instant pickup; polling covers missed notifications and scheduled retries.
  const listener = new pg.Client({ connectionString: env.DATABASE_URL });
  await listener.connect();
  await listener.query('listen media_jobs');
  listener.on('notification', () => wake?.());

  let stopping = false;
  const stop = () => {
    stopping = true;
    wake?.();
  };
  process.on('SIGTERM', stop);
  process.on('SIGINT', stop);

  const jobLoop = async (slot: number) => {
    while (!stopping) {
      try {
        const job = await claimJob(db, `${env.WORKER_ID}#${slot}`);
        if (job) await runJob(job, deps);
        else await nap(env.POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
      } catch (error) {
        log('job loop error', { error: String(error) });
        await nap(env.POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
      }
    }
  };

  const notifier = new Notifier(db, env, log);
  const heartbeat = async () => {
    while (!stopping) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 30_000));
      if (!stopping) {
        try {
          await writeWorkerStatus();
        } catch (error) {
          log('worker status heartbeat failed', { error: String(error) });
        }
      }
    }
  };
  const outboxLoop = async () => {
    while (!stopping) {
      try {
        while ((await notifier.drain()) > 0) {
          /* drain until empty */
        }
      } catch (error) {
        log('outbox error', { error: String(error) });
      }
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, env.OUTBOX_INTERVAL_MS));
    }
  };

  await Promise.all([
    ...Array.from({ length: env.WORKER_CONCURRENCY }, (_, i) => jobLoop(i)),
    outboxLoop(),
    heartbeat(),
  ]);
  await listener.end();
  await db.end();
  log('worker stopped');
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```ts
import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { Detector } from './blur/types.ts';
import { NonRetryableError } from './media/ffmpeg.ts';
import { blurAndTranscode } from './media/pipeline.ts';
import { RAW_BUCKET, VIDEO_BUCKET, removePaths } from './storage.ts';

export interface MediaJob {
  id: number;
  video_id: string | null;
  kind: 'process' | 'purge';
  payload: { raw_path?: string; paths?: string[] };
  attempts: number;
  max_attempts: number;
  settings_snapshot?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

export interface JobDeps {
  db: Pool;
  storage: SupabaseClient;
  detectors: Detector[];
  detectEvery: number;
  faceBlurAvailable: boolean;
  plateBlurAvailable: boolean;
  log: (msg: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
}

interface RuntimeMediaSettings {
  faceBlurEnabled: boolean;
  plateBlurEnabled: boolean;
  detectEvery: number;
  faceMinScore: number;
  plateMinScore: number;
}

async function readMediaSettings(
  deps: JobDeps,
  snapshot?: Record<string, unknown> | null,
): Promise<RuntimeMediaSettings> {
  const { rows } = await deps.db.query<{ key: string; value: unknown }>(
    `select key, value from public.app_config where key = any($1::text[])`,
    [
      [
        'media_face_blur_enabled',
        'media_plate_blur_enabled',
        'media_detect_every',
        'media_face_min_score',
        'media_plate_min_score',
      ],
    ],
  );
  const values = new Map(rows.map(({ key, value }) => [key, value]));
  const snapshotKeys: Record<string, string> = {
    media_face_blur_enabled: 'face_blur_enabled',
    media_plate_blur_enabled: 'plate_blur_enabled',
    media_detect_every: 'detect_every',
    media_face_min_score: 'face_min_score',
    media_plate_min_score: 'plate_min_score',
  };
  for (const [key, snapshotKey] of Object.entries(snapshotKeys)) {
    if (snapshot && snapshot[snapshotKey] !== undefined) values.set(key, snapshot[snapshotKey]);
  }
  const bool = (key: string, fallback: boolean) => {
    const value = values.get(key);
    return typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : fallback;
  };
  const number = (key: string, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) => {
    const value = values.get(key);
    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= min && value <= max
      ? value
      : fallback;
  };
  return {
    faceBlurEnabled: bool('media_face_blur_enabled', true),
    plateBlurEnabled: bool('media_plate_blur_enabled', false),
    detectEvery: number('media_detect_every', deps.detectEvery, 1, 10),
    faceMinScore: number('media_face_min_score', 0.5, 0.05, 0.95),
    plateMinScore: number('media_plate_min_score', 0.35, 0.05, 0.95),
  };
}

export async function claimJob(db: Pool, workerId: string): Promise<MediaJob | null> {
  const { rows } = await db.query<MediaJob>('select * from public.claim_media_job($1)', [workerId]);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

function updateJobProgress(
  deps: JobDeps,
  jobId: number,
  progress: number,
  phase: string,
): Promise<void> {
  return deps.db
    .query(
      'update public.media_jobs set progress = $2, phase = $3, updated_at = now() where id = $1',
      [jobId, Math.max(0, Math.min(99, Math.round(progress))), phase],
    )
    .then(() => undefined);
}

async function processVideo(job: MediaJob, deps: JobDeps): Promise<void> {
  const { rows } = await deps.db.query<{
    status: string;
    raw_path: string | null;
    duration_ms: number;
  }>('select status, raw_path, duration_ms from public.videos where id = $1', [job.video_id]);
  const video = rows[0];
  if (!video || video.status !== 'processing' || !video.raw_path) {
    // Withdrawn or already handled meanwhile: nothing to do.
    await deps.db.query('select public.complete_job($1)', [job.id]);
    return;
  }
  const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'nl-'));
  try {
    await updateJobProgress(deps, job.id, 2, 'downloading');
    const { data, error } = await deps.storage.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).download(video.raw_path);
    if (error || !data) throw new Error(`download failed: ${error?.message ?? 'empty'}`);
    const input = join(dir, 'input');
    const output = join(dir, 'output.mp4');
    const poster = join(dir, 'poster.jpg');
    await writeFile(input, Buffer.from(await data.arrayBuffer()));
    await updateJobProgress(deps, job.id, 5, 'preparing');

    const mediaSettings = await readMediaSettings(deps, job.settings_snapshot);
    const detectors = deps.detectors.map((detector) => {
      if (detector.name === 'face-yunet') {
        return {
          name: detector.name,
          enabled: mediaSettings.faceBlurEnabled && deps.faceBlurAvailable,
          detect: (frame: Parameters<Detector['detect']>[0]) =>
            detector.detect(frame, { minScore: mediaSettings.faceMinScore }),
        };
      }
      if (detector.name === 'plate-yolo') {
        return {
          name: detector.name,
          enabled: mediaSettings.plateBlurEnabled && deps.plateBlurAvailable,
          detect: (frame: Parameters<Detector['detect']>[0]) =>
            detector.detect(frame, { minScore: mediaSettings.plateMinScore }),
        };
      }
      return detector;
    });

    const started = Date.now();
    let progressWrite = Promise.resolve();
    const stats = await blurAndTranscode(input, output, poster, {
      detectors,
      detectEvery: mediaSettings.detectEvery,
      expectedDurationS: video.duration_ms / 1000,
      onProgress: (percent) => {
        progressWrite = progressWrite.then(() =>
          updateJobProgress(deps, job.id, 5 + percent * 0.8, 'blurring'),
        );
      },
    });
    await progressWrite;

    const videoPath = `${job.video_id}.mp4`;
    const posterPath = `${job.video_id}.jpg`;
    const outputs = [
      [videoPath, output, 'video/mp4'],
      [posterPath, poster, 'image/jpeg'],
    ] as const;
    await updateJobProgress(deps, job.id, 88, 'uploading');
    for (const [index, [path, file, type]] of outputs.entries()) {
      const { error: upErr } = await deps.storage.storage
        .from(VIDEO_BUCKET)
        .upload(path, await readFile(file), { contentType: type, upsert: true });
      if (upErr) throw new Error(`upload ${path}: ${upErr.message}`);
      await updateJobProgress(deps, job.id, index === 0 ? 94 : 98, 'publishing');
    }
    await deps.db.query('select public.complete_process_job($1, $2, $3)', [
      job.id,
      videoPath,
      posterPath,
    ]);

    // The unblurred original is deleted as soon as the processed version is live.
    try {
      await removePaths(deps.storage, [video.raw_path]);
    } catch (e) {
      await deps.db.query(
        "insert into public.media_jobs (video_id, kind, payload) values ($1, 'purge', jsonb_build_object('paths', array[$2::text]))",
        [job.video_id, video.raw_path],
      );
      deps.log('raw removal deferred to a purge job', { job: job.id, error: String(e) });
    }
    deps.log('video processed', {
      job: job.id,
      video: job.video_id,
      ms: Date.now() - started,
      ...stats,
    });
  } finally {
    await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

async function purge(job: MediaJob, deps: JobDeps): Promise<void> {
  await removePaths(deps.storage, job.payload.paths ?? []);
  await deps.db.query('select public.complete_job($1)', [job.id]);
  deps.log('files purged', { job: job.id, count: job.payload.paths?.length ?? 0 });
}

export async function runJob(job: MediaJob, deps: JobDeps): Promise<void> {
  try {
    if (job.kind === 'process') await processVideo(job, deps);
    else await purge(job, deps);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    if (error instanceof NonRetryableError) {
      await deps.db.query('update public.media_jobs set attempts = max_attempts where id = $1', [
        job.id,
      ]);
    }
    const { rows } = await deps.db.query<{ fail_media_job: string }>(
      'select public.fail_media_job($1, $2)',
      [job.id, message],
    );
    await deps.db.query(
      `update public.media_jobs
       set progress = case when $2 = 'queued' then 0 else progress end,
           phase = case when $2 = 'queued' then 'retrying' else 'failed' end,
           updated_at = now()
       where id = $1`,
      [job.id, rows[0]?.fail_media_job],
    );
    deps.log('job failed', {
      job: job.id,
      kind: job.kind,
      outcome: rows[0]?.fail_media_job,
      error: message,
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import type { Readable } from 'node:stream';

export interface Probe {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  durationS: number;
  hasAudio: boolean;
  rotation: number;
}

/** Errors that retrying cannot fix (corrupt or out-of-spec media): the job fails at once. */
export class NonRetryableError extends Error {}

async function collect(stream: Readable): Promise<string> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  for await (const c of stream) chunks.push(c as Buffer);
  return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
}

export async function run(cmd: string, args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  const child = spawn(cmd, args, { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe'] });
  const stderr = collect(child.stderr);
  const [code] = (await once(child, 'close')) as [number];
  if (code !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd} exited ${code}: ${(await stderr).slice(-1500)}`);
}

export async function probe(path: string): Promise<Probe> {
  const child = spawn('ffprobe', [
    '-v',
    'error',
    '-print_format',
    'json',
    '-show_streams',
    '-show_format',
    path,
  ]);
  const [out, err] = await Promise.all([collect(child.stdout), collect(child.stderr)]);
  const [code] = (await once(child, 'close')) as [number];
  if (code !== 0) throw new NonRetryableError(`unreadable media: ${err.slice(-500)}`);
  const info = JSON.parse(out) as {
    streams: Array<{
      codec_type: string;
      width?: number;
      height?: number;
      tags?: { rotate?: string };
      side_data_list?: Array<{ rotation?: number }>;
    }>;
    format: { duration?: string };
  };
  const video = info.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === 'video');
  if (!video?.width || !video.height) throw new NonRetryableError('no video stream');
  const sideRotation = video.side_data_list?.find((d) => d.rotation !== undefined)?.rotation;
  return {
    width: video.width,
    height: video.height,
    // MediaRecorder WebM files often lack a duration header; 0 means "unknown".
    durationS: Number(info.format.duration ?? 0) || 0,
    hasAudio: info.streams.some((s) => s.codec_type === 'audio'),
    rotation: Number(video.tags?.rotate ?? sideRotation ?? 0),
  };
}

/** Published video canvas: portrait 9:16 at 1080 × 1920 (even H.264 dimensions). */
export function targetSize(
  _width: number,
  _height: number,
  _rotation: number,
): { width: number; height: number } {
  return { width: 1080, height: 1920 };
}

export const FPS = 30;
export const MAX_DURATION_S = 31;
```
