```ts
import { decodeCursor, encodeCursor, feedQuerySchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { hydrate, type PublicVideoRow } from '@/lib/feed';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { getUser } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const PAGE = 8;
const querySchema = feedQuerySchema.extend({
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(20).optional(),
});

/**
 * Hyperlocal feed, cursor-paginated. The query position is used for this request only: it is
 * neither stored nor logged. Results carry fuzzed positions and 100 m distance buckets.
 */
export const GET = route(async (req) => {
  const q = querySchema.parse(Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams));
  const cursor = q.cursor ? decodeCursor(q.cursor) : null;
  if (q.cursor && !cursor) throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  const ref = cursor?.ref ?? new Date().toISOString();
  const limit = q.limit ?? PAGE;

  const rows = unwrap(
    await adminClient().rpc('nearby_videos', {
      p_lat: q.lat,
      p_lng: q.lng,
      p_radius_m: q.radius,
      p_category: q.category,
      p_cursor_score: cursor?.score,
      p_cursor_id: cursor?.id,
      p_ref_time: ref,
      p_limit: limit,
    }),
  );
  const user = await getUser();
  const items = await hydrate(rows as PublicVideoRow[], user?.id ?? null);
  const last = rows.at(-1);
  const nextCursor =
    rows.length === limit && last ? encodeCursor({ score: last.score, id: last.id, ref }) : null;
  return json({ items, nextCursor });
});
```

```ts
import { feedQuerySchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { json, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

const querySchema = feedQuerySchema.pick({ lat: true, lng: true, radius: true, category: true });

/** GeoJSON of active videos around a point (fuzzed positions), clustered client-side. */
export const GET = route(async (req) => {
  const q = querySchema.parse(Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams));
  const rows = unwrap(
    await adminClient().rpc('map_videos', {
      p_lat: q.lat,
      p_lng: q.lng,
      p_radius_m: q.radius,
      p_category: q.category,
    }),
  );
  return json({
    type: 'FeatureCollection',
    features: (rows ?? []).map((r) => ({
      type: 'Feature',
      id: r.id,
      geometry: { type: 'Point', coordinates: [r.public_lng, r.public_lat] },
      properties: { id: r.id, category: r.category, caption: r.caption },
    })),
  });
```

```ts
import { groupByBucket } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const schema = z.object({ confirm: z.string().min(1).max(40) });

/**
 * Account deletion: files are removed from storage right away (a purge job is also queued as a
 * safety net), then the auth user is deleted, which cascades to every row owned by the user.
 */
export const DELETE = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { confirm } = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: profile } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .select('username')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .single();
  if (!profile || (profile.username ?? '') !== confirm.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    throw new ApiError('confirmation_mismatch', 422);
  }

  const paths = unwrap(await admin.rpc('prepare_account_deletion', { p_user: user.id })) ?? [];
  for (const [bucket, list] of groupByBucket(paths)) {
    const { error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).remove(list);
    if (error) console.error('storage removal deferred to purge job', bucket, error.message);
  }

  const { error } = await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(user.id);
  if (error) throw new ApiError('internal', 500);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  await supabase.auth.signOut();
  return json({ ok: true, deletedFiles: paths.length });
});
```

```ts
  .pick({ defaultRadius: true, locale: true, notifyAlerts: true })

        ...(body.onboarded && { onboarded_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
```

```ts
import { MODERATION_ACTIONS, sanitizeText } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

const cell = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{15}$/);

const schema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  // Same fields as moderationDecisionSchema; "note required to remove" is enforced in SQL.
  z.object({
    type: z.literal('decision'),
    videoId: z.uuid(),
    action: z.enum(MODERATION_ACTIONS),
    note: z.string().max(1000).transform(sanitizeText).default(''),
  }),
  z.object({
    type: z.literal('appeal'),
    appealId: z.uuid(),
    uphold: z.boolean(),
    note: z.string().max(1000).transform(sanitizeText).default(''),
  }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal('apply'), cell }),
]);

/**
 * Moderator actions. Authorization is enforced in SQL (zone moderator or admin, no
 * self-moderation, appeals reviewed by someone else); the actor is the verified session user.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const body = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const admin = adminClient();
  if (body.type === 'decision') {
    const actionId = unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('moderate_video', {
        p_actor: user.id,
        p_video: body.videoId,
        p_kind: body.action,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
    return json({ actionId });
  }
  if (body.type === 'appeal') {
    unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('resolve_appeal', {
        p_reviewer: user.id,
        p_appeal: body.appealId,
        p_uphold: body.uphold,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
    return json({ ok: true });
  }
  unwrap(await admin.rpc('become_zone_moderator', { p_user: user.id, p_cell: body.cell }));
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { pushSubscribeSchema, zoneCell, zoneCenter } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/**
 * Subscribes this browser to alerts for a zone. The submitted position is only used to pick the
 * H3 cell; what is stored is the cell and its centre, never the device position.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { subscription, zone, radius } = await parseBody(req, pushSubscribeSchema);
  const cell = zoneCell(zone);
  const center = zoneCenter(cell);
  // One row per browser endpoint: a browser previously used by another account is re-assigned.
  await adminClient().from('push_subscriptions').delete().eq('endpoint', subscription.endpoint);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  unwrap(
    await supabase.from('push_subscriptions').insert({
      user_id: user.id,
      endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
      p256dh: subscription.keys.p256dh,
      auth: subscription.keys.auth,
      zone_cell: cell,
      zone_center: `SRID=4326;POINT(${center.lng} ${center.lat})`,
      radius_m: radius,
    }),
  );
  return json({ zoneCell: cell }, 201);
});

export const DELETE = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { endpoint } = await parseBody(req, z.object({ endpoint: z.url() }));
  const supabase = await createClient();
  unwrap(
    await supabase
      .from('push_subscriptions')
      .delete()
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .eq('endpoint', endpoint),
  );
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { commentSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };
const PAGE = 20;
const beforeSchema = z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }).optional();
interface CommentRow {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  created_at: string;
  author_id: string;
  author: { username: string | null; avatar_color: string } | null;
}

const columns = 'id, body, created_at, author_id, author:profiles(username, avatar_color)';

/** Comments, newest first, paginated with a `before` timestamp cursor. */
export const GET = route<Ctx>(async (req, { params }) => {
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const before = beforeSchema.parse(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('before') ?? undefined);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  let query = supabase
    .from('comments')
    .select(columns)
    .eq('video_id', id)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(PAGE);
  if (before) query = query.lt('created_at', before);
  const rows = unwrap(await query);
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  return json({
    comments: rows.map((c) => ({ ...c, mine: c.author_id === data.user?.id })),
    nextBefore: rows.length === PAGE ? (rows.at(-1)?.created_at ?? null) : null,
  });
});

/** Text is sanitised by the schema; RLS checks authorship and ban, a trigger rate-limits. */
export const POST = route<Ctx>(async (req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const { body } = await parseBody(req, commentSchema);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const comment = unwrap<CommentRow>(
    await supabase
      .from('comments')
      .insert({ video_id: id, author_id: user.id, body })
      .select(columns)
      .single(),
  );
  return json({ ...comment, mine: true }, 201);
});
```

```ts
import { MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, rawPathFor, RAW_BUCKET } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/** Step 3 of a publication: the raw file is verified in storage, then queued for the worker. */
export const POST = route<{ params: Promise<{ id: string }> }>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: video } = await admin
    .from('videos')
    .select('mime_type, status, raw_path')
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('author_id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!video) throw new ApiError('not_found', 404);
  if (video.status !== 'processing' || video.raw_path) return json({ status: video.status });

  const path = rawPathFor(user.id, id, video.mime_type);
  const name = path.split('/')[1] ?? '';
  const { data: files } = await admin.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).list(user.id, { search: name });
  const file = files?.find((f) => f.name === name);
  if (!file) throw new ApiError('upload_missing', 409);
  const size = Number((file.metadata as { size?: number } | null)?.size ?? 0);
  if (size <= 0 || size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) {
    await admin.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).remove([path]);
    throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  }
  unwrap(
    await admin.rpc('enqueue_processing', { p_author: user.id, p_video: id, p_raw_path: path }),
  );
  return json({ status: 'processing' });
});
```

```ts
import {
  computeExpiresAt,
  createVideoSchema,
  rawPathFor,
  RAW_BUCKET,
  realtimeCell,
  zoneCell,
} from '@nl/shared';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/**
 * Step 1 of a publication: validates everything server-side (schema, accuracy ≤ 100 m,
 * plausible position, coherence with the previous publication, rate limit, merchant quota)
 * and reserves the video row. The client then uploads the raw file (TUS) to `uploadPath`.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const input = await parseBody(req, createVideoSchema);
  let expiresAt: Date;
  try {
    expiresAt = computeExpiresAt(input.category, new Date(), {
      eventEndsAt: input.eventEndsAt ? new Date(input.eventEndsAt) : undefined,
      merchantHours: input.merchantHours,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new ApiError((error as Error).message, 422);
  }
  const point = { lat: input.lat, lng: input.lng };
  const videoId = unwrap(
    await adminClient().rpc('create_video', {
      p_author: user.id,
      p_category: input.category,
      p_caption: input.caption,
      p_lat: input.lat,
      p_lng: input.lng,
      p_accuracy: input.accuracy,
      p_h3_cell: zoneCell(point),
      p_realtime_cell: realtimeCell(point),
      p_mime: input.mimeType,
      p_duration_ms: input.durationMs,
      p_expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
    }),
  );
  if (!videoId) throw new ApiError('internal', 500);
  return json(
    { videoId, bucket: RAW_BUCKET, uploadPath: rawPathFor(user.id, videoId, input.mimeType) },
    201,
  );
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\auth\callback\route.ts`:

```ts
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';
import { safeNext } from '@/lib/redirect';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** Magic link landing: exchanges the PKCE code for a session, then routes the new user. */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const site = clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL;
  const code = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('code');
  const next = safeNext(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('next'));
  if (!code) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=callback', site));

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
  if (error || !data.user) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=callback', site));

  const [{ data: profile }, { data: settings }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('profiles').select('username').eq('id', data.user.id).single(),
    supabase.from('user_settings').select('onboarded_at').eq('user_id', data.user.id).single(),
  ]);
  const target = profile?.username ? next : `/bienvenue?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`;
  const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(target, site));
  // An account already onboarded elsewhere skips the onboarding on this new device.
  if (settings?.onboarded_at) {
    res.cookies.set(ONBOARDED_COOKIE, '1', { path: '/', maxAge: 31_536_000, sameSite: 'lax' });
  }
  return res;
}
```

```tsx
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

import { UsernameForm } from '@/components/auth/UsernameForm';
import { safeNext } from '@/lib/redirect';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';

export default async function WelcomePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string }>;
}) {
  const next = safeNext((await searchParams).next);
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (!viewer) redirect(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`);
  if (viewer.username) redirect(next);
  const t = await getTranslations('auth.welcome');
  const after = viewer.settings.onboarded ? next : `/onboarding?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`;
  return (

        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
        <p className="text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
      </div>
      <UsernameForm next={after} />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { CaptureFlow } from '@/components/capture/CaptureFlow';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return { title: (await getTranslations('capture'))('title') };
}

export default async function RecordPage() {
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (!viewer) redirect('/login?next=/filmer');
  if (!viewer.username) redirect('/bienvenue?next=/filmer');
  const { data: merchant } = await adminClient()
    .from('merchant_profiles')
    .select('status')
    .eq('user_id', viewer.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  return (
    <main id="main">
      <CaptureFlow isMerchant={merchant?.status === 'approved'} />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';

const SLUGS = ['confidentialite', 'conditions', 'regles', 'contact'] as const;
type Slug = (typeof SLUGS)[number];
const isSlug = (s: string): s is Slug => (SLUGS as readonly string[]).includes(s);

type Params = { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> };

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Params): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  if (!isSlug(slug)) return {};
  return { title: (await getTranslations('legal'))(`pages.${slug}.title`) };
}

export default async function LegalPage({ params }: Params) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  if (!isSlug(slug)) notFound();
  const t = await getTranslations('legal');
  const tf = await getTranslations('common.footer');
  const sections = t.raw(`pages.${slug}.sections`) as Array<{ title: string; body: string }>;
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-6 p-6">
      <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-fog underline">
        ← Neighbors Live
      </Link>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">{t(`pages.${slug}.title`)}</h1>
      <p
        role="note"
        className="rounded-xl border border-amber-500 bg-amber-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
      >
        {t('draft')}
      </p>
      {sections.map((s) => (
        <section key={s.title} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{s.title}</h2>
          <p className="leading-relaxed text-fog">{s.body}</p>
        </section>
      ))}
      <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('updated')}</p>
      <nav className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 border-t border-line pt-4 text-sm">
        <Link href="/legal/confidentialite">{tf('privacy')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/conditions">{tf('terms')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/regles">{tf('rules')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/contact">{tf('contact')}</Link>
      </nav>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string; error?: string; mode?: string }>;
}) {

  if (await getViewer()) redirect(target);
  const t = await getTranslations('auth');
  const signup = mode === 'signup';
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh max-w-md flex-col justify-center gap-6 p-6">

      </div>
      <AuthForm
        mode={signup ? 'signup' : 'login'}
        next={target}
        callbackError={error === 'callback'}
      />
    </main>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\app\sw.ts`:

```ts
/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import {
  CacheFirst,
  ExpirationPlugin,
  NetworkFirst,
  NetworkOnly,
  Serwist,
  StaleWhileRevalidate,
  type PrecacheEntry,
  type SerwistGlobalConfig,
} from 'serwist';

declare global {
  interface WorkerGlobalScope extends SerwistGlobalConfig {
    __SW_MANIFEST: (PrecacheEntry | string)[] | undefined;
  }
}
declare const self: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope;

const serwist = new Serwist({
  precacheEntries: self.__SW_MANIFEST,
  // Soft update: the new worker waits until the user accepts the "update" banner.
  skipWaiting: false,
  clientsClaim: true,
  navigationPreload: true,
  runtimeCaching: [
    // API responses carry positions and short-lived signed URLs: never cached.
    {
      matcher: ({ url }) => url.pathname.startsWith('/api/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/auth/'),
      handler: new NetworkOnly(),
    },
    // Private media (signed URLs) and video streams: network only.
    {
      matcher: ({ url, request }) =>
        url.pathname.includes('/storage/v1/') || request.destination === 'video',
      handler: new NetworkOnly(),
    },
    // Map style, glyphs and vector tiles: cache first, bounded.
    {
      matcher: ({ url }) => /openfreemap|tiles|maptiler|stadiamaps/.test(url.hostname),
      handler: new CacheFirst({
        cacheName: 'map-tiles',
        plugins: [new ExpirationPlugin({ maxEntries: 800, maxAgeSeconds: 14 * 24 * 3600 })],
      }),
    },
    // App code and styles: fast from cache, refreshed in background.
    {
      matcher: ({ request, url }) =>
        url.origin === self.location.origin &&
        ['script', 'style', 'worker', 'font'].includes(request.destination),
      handler: new StaleWhileRevalidate({ cacheName: 'static' }),
    },
    {
      matcher: ({ request, url }) =>
        url.origin === self.location.origin && request.destination === 'image',
      handler: new CacheFirst({
        cacheName: 'images',
        plugins: [new ExpirationPlugin({ maxEntries: 60, maxAgeSeconds: 30 * 24 * 3600 })],
      }),
    },
    // Pages: network first with a short timeout, offline page as fallback.
    {
      matcher: ({ request }) => request.mode === 'navigate',
      handler: new NetworkFirst({ cacheName: 'pages', networkTimeoutSeconds: 4 }),
    },
  ],
  fallbacks: {
    entries: [{ url: '/offline', matcher: ({ request }) => request.destination === 'document' }],
  },
});

interface PushPayload {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  url: string;
  tag?: string;
}

self.addEventListener('push', (event) => {
  let data: PushPayload = { title: 'Neighbors Live', body: '', url: '/' };
  try {
    data = { ...data, ...(event.data?.json() as Partial<PushPayload>) };
  } catch {
    /* non-JSON payload: keep defaults */
  }
  event.waitUntil(
    self.registration.showNotification(data.title, {
      body: data.body,
      tag: data.tag,
      icon: '/icons/icon-192.png',
      badge: '/icons/badge-96.png',
      data: { url: data.url },
    }),
  );
});

self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
  event.notification.close();
  const target = new URL(
    (event.notification.data as { url?: string })?.url ?? '/',
    self.location.origin,
  );
  if (target.origin !== self.location.origin) return;
  event.waitUntil(
    self.clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true }).then((clients) => {
      const open = clients.find((c) => new URL(c.url).origin === target.origin);
      if (open) {
        void open.navigate(target.href);
        return open.focus();
      }
      return self.clients.openWindow(target.href);
    }),
  );
});

serwist.addEventListeners();
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { hydrate, type PublicVideoRow } from '@/lib/feed';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function load(id: string) {
  if (!z.uuid().safeParse(id).success) return null;
  const { data } = await adminClient().rpc('get_public_video', { p_id: id });
  if (!data?.length) return null;
  const [item] = await hydrate(data as PublicVideoRow[], null);
  return item ?? null;
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Params): Promise<Metadata> {
  const item = await load((await params).id);
  const tc = await getTranslations('common');
  if (!item) return { title: tc('appName') };
  const category = tc(`categories.${item.category}`);
  return {
    title: `${category} — ${item.caption || tc('appName')}`,
    description: item.caption,
    openGraph: { title: category, description: item.caption, type: 'video.other' },
  };
}

/** Shareable deep link: public preview (fuzzed data only), then "open in the feed". */
export default async function VideoPage({ params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const item = await load(id);
  const t = await getTranslations('video');
  const tc = await getTranslations('common');
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh max-w-md flex-col gap-4 p-4">
      {!item ? (
        <p className="pt-10 text-center text-fog">{t('unavailable')}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <video
            src={item.videoUrl ?? undefined}
            poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
            controls
            playsInline
            muted
            autoPlay
            loop
            aria-label={item.caption}
            className="aspect-[9/16] w-full rounded-2xl bg-black object-cover"
          />
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{tc(`categories.${item.category}`)}</p>
          {item.caption && <p className="text-lg">{item.caption}</p>}
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('by', { username: item.author.username ?? '' })}</p>
        </>
      )}
      <Link
        href={item ? `/?video=${item.id}` : '/'}
        className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 font-semibold text-ink"
      >
        {t('openFeed')}
      </Link>
    </main>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\Avatar.tsx`:

```tsx
/** Relative luminance (WCAG) of a #rrggbb colour. */
function luminance(hex: string): number {
  const channel = (i: number) => {
    const c = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255;
    return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  };
  return 0.2126 * channel(1) + 0.7152 * channel(3) + 0.0722 * channel(5);
}

/** White or near-black initials, whichever reaches the better contrast on `bg`. */
export function initialsColor(bg: string): string {
  const l = luminance(bg);
  return 1.05 / (l + 0.05) >= (l + 0.05) / (luminance('#0b0d10') + 0.05) ? '#ffffff' : '#0b0d10';
}

/** Generated avatar: initials on the colour derived from the account id (no uploaded photo). */
export function Avatar({
  username,
  color,
  size = 40,
}: {
  username: string | null;
  color: string;
  size?: number;
}) {
  const initials = (username ?? '?').replace(/_/g, '').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() || '?';
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-bold"
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        backgroundColor: color,
        color: initialsColor(color),
        fontSize: size * 0.4,
      }}
    >
      {initials}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
                >
                  <span className="block h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-alert" aria-hidden="true" />
                </Link>
              </li>
            );
          }
          return (
            <li key={item.key}>
              <Link
                href={item.href}
                aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
                className={`flex min-h-14 min-w-14 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 px-2 text-[11px] ${active ? 'text-accent' : 'text-fog'}`}
              >
                <svg
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  className="h-6 w-6"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="1.8"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                >
                  <path d={item.icon} />
                </svg>
                {t(item.key)}
              </Link>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';

/**
 * Explanation shown BEFORE any system permission prompt (camera, microphone, location,
 * notifications). Rendered as an accessible modal dialog.
 */
export function PermissionPrimer({
  open,
  title,
  children,
  confirmLabel,
  cancelLabel,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  confirmLabel: string;
  cancelLabel: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = ref.current;
    if (!dialog) return;
    if (open && !dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
    if (!open && dialog.open) dialog.close();
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onCancel();
      }}
      className="m-auto w-[min(92vw,28rem)] rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-5 text-white backdrop:bg-black/70"
    >
      <h2 id={titleId} className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">
        {title}
      </h2>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm text-fog">{children}</div>
      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Button onClick={onConfirm} autoFocus>
          {confirmLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>
          {cancelLabel}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

type Body =
  | { type: 'ban'; userId: string; banned: boolean; note: string }
  | { type: 'revert'; actionId: number; note: string }
  | { type: 'merchant'; userId: string; approve: boolean };

function useAdminAction() {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const run = async (body: Body) => {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/admin', { body });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : {
            kind: 'error',
            text:
              res.error === 'review_conflict'
                ? t('review_conflict')
                : (errorText(res.error) ?? t('actionError')),
          },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
    setPending(false);
  };
  return { run, status, pending };
}

export function MerchantReview({
  userId,
  name,
  applicant,
  description,
  submittedAt,
}: {
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  applicant: string;
  description: string;
  submittedAt: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const { run, status, pending } = useAdminAction();
  const review = (approve: boolean) => {
    if (window.confirm(t(approve ? 'confirmApproveMerchant' : 'confirmRejectMerchant', { name }))) {
      void run({ type: 'merchant', userId, approve });
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-4">
      <div className="flex-1">
        <h3 className="font-semibold">{name}</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('merchantApplicant', { username: applicant })}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-fog">
          {description || t('noMerchantDescription')}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-fog">{t('submittedAt', { date: submittedAt })}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Button disabled={pending} onClick={() => review(true)}>
          {t('approve')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => review(false)}>
          {t('rejectMerchant')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}

type NotedBody =
  { type: 'ban'; userId: string; banned: boolean } | { type: 'revert'; actionId: number };

/** Ban / unban or revert, both requiring a written reason. */
export function NotedAction({
  label,
  body,
  variant = 'secondary',
}: {
  label: string;
  body: NotedBody;
  variant?: 'secondary' | 'danger';
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const { run, status, pending } = useAdminAction();
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const id = `note-${body.type}-${body.type === 'ban' ? body.userId : body.actionId}`;
  const submit = () => {
    if (body.type === 'ban' && body.banned && !window.confirm(t('confirmBan'))) return;
    if (body.type === 'revert' && !window.confirm(t('confirmRevert'))) return;
    void run({ ...body, note });
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="sr-only">
          {t('note')}
        </label>
        <input
          id={id}
          className={inputClass}
          placeholder={t('note')}
          value={note}
          onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
        />
        <Button variant={variant} disabled={pending || note.trim().length < 3} onClick={submit}>
          {pending ? t('saving') : label}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { passwordSchema, usernameSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

/** Auth-specific error codes first, then the generic ones. */
function useAuthError() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.errors');
  const generic = useErrorText();
  return (code: string | null | undefined) => (code && t.has(code) ? t(code) : generic(code));
}

function PasswordInput({
  id,
  value,
  onChange,
  autoComplete,
}: {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  autoComplete: 'current-password' | 'new-password';
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <input
        id={id}
        type={visible ? 'text' : 'password'}
        autoComplete={autoComplete}
        required
        maxLength={72}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        className={`${inputClass} pr-24`}
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setVisible((v) => !v)}
        aria-pressed={visible}
        aria-controls={id}
        className="absolute inset-y-0 right-2 my-auto h-9 rounded-lg px-2 text-sm text-fog"
      >
        {visible ? t('hidePassword') : t('showPassword')}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function Consent() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.login');
  return (
    <p className="text-xs text-fog">
      {t.rich('consent', {
        terms: (c) => (
          <Link className="underline" href="/legal/conditions">
            {c}
          </Link>
        ),
        privacy: (c) => (
          <Link className="underline" href="/legal/confidentialite">
            {c}
          </Link>
        ),
      })}
    </p>
  );
}

/** Sign-in and sign-up on one screen (switchable), e-mail + password. */
export function AuthForm({
  mode: initialMode,
  next,
  callbackError,
}: {
  mode: 'login' | 'signup';
  next: string;
  callbackError: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(initialMode);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(
    callbackError ? t('login.callbackError') : null,
  );
  const [confirmSent, setConfirmSent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (mode === 'signup') {
      if (!usernameSchema.safeParse(username).success)
        return setError(t('errors.username_invalid'));
      const pwd = passwordSchema.safeParse(password);
      if (!pwd.success) return setError(authError(pwd.error.issues[0]?.message));
    }
    setPending(true);
    const res =
      mode === 'signup'
        ? await api<{ needsConfirmation?: boolean }>('/api/auth/signup', {
            body: { email, password, username },
          })
        : await api<{ needsUsername?: boolean }>('/api/auth/login', { body: { email, password } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return setError(
        res.error === 'invalid_input' ? t('login.invalidEmail') : authError(res.error),
      );
    }
    const data = res.data as { needsConfirmation?: boolean; needsUsername?: boolean };
    if (mode === 'signup' && data.needsConfirmation) return setConfirmSent(email);
    const target =
      mode === 'signup'
        ? `/onboarding?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`
        : data.needsUsername
          ? `/bienvenue?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`
          : next;
    router.replace(target);
    router.refresh();
  }

  if (confirmSent) {
    return <Notice kind="success">{t('signup.checkEmail', { email: confirmSent })}</Notice>;
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('login.email')} htmlFor="email">
        <input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          name="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          inputMode="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className={inputClass}
        />
      </Field>
      {mode === 'signup' && (
        <Field label={t('signup.username')} htmlFor="username" hint={t('signup.usernameHint')}>
          <input
            id="username"
            name="username"
            autoComplete="username"
            autoCapitalize="none"
            spellCheck={false}
            maxLength={20}
            value={username}
            onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value.toLowerCase())}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </Field>
      )}
      <Field
        label={mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.password') : t('login.password')}
        htmlFor="password"
        hint={mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.passwordHint') : undefined}
      >
        <PasswordInput
          id="password"
          value={password}
          onChange={setPassword}
          autoComplete={mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || !email || !password}>
        {mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.submit') : t('login.submit')}
      </Button>
      {mode === 'login' && (
        <Link href="/mot-de-passe-oublie" className="text-center text-sm underline">
          {t('login.forgot')}
        </Link>
      )}
      <p className="text-center text-sm text-fog">
        {mode === 'login' ? t('login.noAccount') : t('signup.hasAccount')}{' '}
        <button
          type="button"
          className="font-semibold text-white underline"
          onClick={() => {
            setError(null);
            setMode(mode === 'login' ? 'signup' : 'login');
          }}
        >
          {mode === 'login' ? t('login.toSignup') : t('signup.toLogin')}
        </button>
      </p>
      <Consent />
    </form>
  );
}

export function ForgotForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/auth/reset', { body: { email } });
    if (!res.ok) {
      return setError(
        res.error === 'invalid_input' ? t('login.invalidEmail') : authError(res.error),
      );
    }
    setSent(email);
  }

  if (sent) return <Notice kind="success">{t('forgot.sent', { email: sent })}</Notice>;
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('login.email')} htmlFor="email" error={error}>
        <input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          inputMode="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className={inputClass}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={!email}>
        {t('forgot.submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

export function NewPasswordForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pwd = passwordSchema.safeParse(password);
    if (!pwd.success) return setError(authError(pwd.error.issues[0]?.message));
    if (password !== confirm) return setError(t('reset.mismatch'));
    const res = await api('/api/auth/password', { body: { password } });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(res.status === 401 ? t('reset.expired') : authError(res.error));
    setDone(true);
    router.replace('/');
  }

  if (done) return <Notice kind="success">{t('reset.done')}</Notice>;
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('reset.password')} htmlFor="new-password" hint={t('signup.passwordHint')}>
        <PasswordInput
          id="new-password"
          value={password}
          onChange={setPassword}
          autoComplete="new-password"
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('reset.confirm')} htmlFor="confirm-password">
        <PasswordInput
          id="confirm-password"
          value={confirm}
          onChange={setConfirm}
          autoComplete="new-password"
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={!password || !confirm}>
        {t('reset.submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { usernameSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export function UsernameForm({ next }: { next: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.welcome');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const parsed = usernameSchema.safeParse(username);
    if (!parsed.success) return setError(t('invalid'));
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: { username: parsed.data } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) return setError(res.error === 'conflict' ? t('taken') : errorText(res.error));
    router.replace(next);
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('username')} htmlFor="username" error={error}>
        <input
          id="username"
          name="username"
          autoComplete="username"
          autoCapitalize="none"
          spellCheck={false}
          maxLength={20}
          value={username}
          onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value.toLowerCase())}
          className={inputClass}
          aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || username.length < 3}>
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\capture\Camera.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { MAX_RECORDING_MS } from '@nl/shared';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { pickMimeType } from '@/lib/recorder';

export interface Recording {
  blob: Blob;
  mime: string;
  durationMs: number;
}

type CamError = 'denied' | 'notFound' | 'unsupported' | 'generic';

const supportedMime = () =>
  typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined'
    ? null
    : pickMimeType((m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m));

async function openCamera(facing: 'environment' | 'user'): Promise<MediaStream | CamError> {
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia || !supportedMime()) return 'unsupported';
  try {
    return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: { facingMode: { ideal: facing }, width: { ideal: 720 }, height: { ideal: 1280 } },
      audio: true,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const name = (e as DOMException).name;
    if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'SecurityError') return 'denied';
    return name === 'NotFoundError' ? 'notFound' : 'generic';
  }
}

/**
 * Full-screen camera: back camera by default, front/back switch, 30 s max with a gauge.
 * Only `getUserMedia` + `MediaRecorder` are used: there is no file picker (no gallery import).
 */
export function Camera({ onRecorded }: { onRecorded: (r: Recording) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('capture');
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const recorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'environment' | 'user'>('environment');
  const [error, setError] = useState<CamError | null>(null);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  const stopTracks = () => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((tr) => tr.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    void openCamera(facing).then((result) => {
      if (typeof result === 'string') {
        if (!cancelled) setError(result);
        return;
      }
      if (cancelled) {
        result.getTracks().forEach((tr) => tr.stop());
        return;
      }
      stopTracks();
      streamRef.current = result;
      if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = result;
      setError(null);
      setReady(true);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [facing]);

  useEffect(() => () => stopTracks(), []);

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    if (recorderRef.current?.state === 'recording') recorderRef.current.stop();
  }, []);

  function record() {
    const stream = streamRef.current;
    const mime = supportedMime();
    if (!stream || !mime) return;
    const chunks: Blob[] = [];
    const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mime, videoBitsPerSecond: 2_500_000 });
    const startedAt = performance.now();
    recorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
      if (e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data);
    };
    recorder.onstop = () => {
      setRecording(false);
      const durationMs = Math.min(MAX_RECORDING_MS, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));
      stopTracks();
      onRecorded({ blob: new Blob(chunks, { type: mime }), mime, durationMs });
    };
    recorderRef.current = recorder;
    recorder.start(1000);
    setRecording(true);
    setElapsed(0);
    const tick = () => {
      if (recorder.state !== 'recording') return;
      const ms = performance.now() - startedAt;
      setElapsed(ms);
      if (ms >= MAX_RECORDING_MS) recorder.stop();
      else requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / MAX_RECORDING_MS);
  const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((MAX_RECORDING_MS - elapsed) / 1000));

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-full max-w-md flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
        <Notice kind="error">{t(`errors.${error}`)}</Notice>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative h-full w-full bg-black">
      <video
        ref={videoRef}
        autoPlay
        muted
        playsInline
        aria-label={t('title')}
        className={`h-full w-full object-cover ${facing === 'user' ? '-scale-x-100' : ''}`}
      />
      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1.5 bg-white/20" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="h-full bg-alert" style={{ width: `${progress * 100}%` }} />
      </div>
      <p
```

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  CAPTION_MAX,
  CATEGORIES,
  MAX_ACCURACY_M,
  MERCHANT_DURATIONS_H,
  type Category,
} from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { enqueue } from '@/lib/offline-queue';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';
import { publish, PublishError, type Fix, type PublishMeta } from '@/lib/publish';
import { containerOf } from '@/lib/recorder';
import { Camera, type Recording } from './Camera';

type Step = 'primer' | 'camera' | 'preview' | 'form' | 'sending' | 'done' | 'queued';

/** datetime-local bounds for an event end: from now + 15 min to now + 7 days (local time). */
function eventBounds() {
  const local = (ms: number) => {
    const d = new Date(ms);
    return new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  };
  const now = Date.now();
  return { minEvent: local(now + 15 * 60_000), maxEvent: local(now + 7 * 24 * 3_600_000 - 60_000) };
}

export function CaptureFlow({ isMerchant }: { isMerchant: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('capture');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>('primer');
  const [rec, setRec] = useState<Recording | null>(null);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category>('alert');
  const [caption, setCaption] = useState('');
  const [eventEnd, setEventEnd] = useState('');
  const [merchantHours, setMerchantHours] = useState<number>(24);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);

  const previewUrl = useMemo(() => (rec ? URL.createObjectURL(rec.blob) : null), [rec]);
  useEffect(() => () => void (previewUrl && URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl)), [previewUrl]);

  const categories = CATEGORIES.filter((c) => c !== 'shop' || isMerchant);

  async function locate(): Promise<Fix | null> {
    setLocating(true);
    try {
      const pos = await currentPosition();
      const fix = {
        lat: pos.coords.latitude,
        lng: pos.coords.longitude,
        accuracy: Math.round(pos.coords.accuracy),
      };
      if (fix.accuracy > MAX_ACCURACY_M) {
        setError(t('location.imprecise', { accuracy: fix.accuracy }));
        return null;
      }
      return fix;
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        (e as GeolocationPositionError).code === 1
          ? t('location.denied')
          : t('location.unavailable'),
      );
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLocating(false);
    }
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!rec) return;
    setError(null);
    const fix = await locate();
    if (!fix) return;
    const meta: PublishMeta = {
      category,
      caption,
      mimeType: containerOf(rec.mime),
      durationMs: rec.durationMs,
      ...(category === 'event' && eventEnd && { eventEndsAt: new Date(eventEnd).toISOString() }),
      ...(category === 'shop' && { merchantHours }),
    };
    const keepForLater = async () => {
      await enqueue({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), blob: rec.blob, meta, fix, createdAt: Date.now() });
      setStep('queued');
    };
    if (!navigator.onLine) return keepForLater();
    setStep('sending');
    try {
      await publish(rec.blob, meta, fix, setProgress);
      setStep('done');
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof PublishError && err.retryable) return keepForLater();
      setStep('form');
      const code = err instanceof PublishError ? err.code : 'generic';
      setError(t.has(`errorsPublish.${code}`) ? t(`errorsPublish.${code}`) : errorText(code));
    }
  }

  const [{ minEvent, maxEvent }] = useState(eventBounds);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col bg-ink">
      <header className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-10 flex justify-end p-3">
        <Link
          href="/"
          aria-label={t('close')}
          className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-black/60 text-2xl"
        >
          ×
        </Link>
      </header>

      <PermissionPrimer
        open={step === 'primer'}
        title={t('primer.title')}
        confirmLabel={t('primer.continue')}
        cancelLabel={t('primer.later')}
        onConfirm={() => setStep('camera')}
        onCancel={() => router.push('/')}
      >
        <p>{t('primer.body')}</p>
        <ul className="list-disc pl-5">
          <li>{t('primer.camera')}</li>
          <li>{t('primer.location')}</li>
        </ul>
        <p>{t('primer.privacy')}</p>
      </PermissionPrimer>

      {step === 'camera' && (
        <Camera
          onRecorded={(r) => {
            setRec(r);
            setStep('preview');
          }}
        />
      )}

      {step === 'preview' && previewUrl && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
          <h1 className="sr-only">{t('preview.title')}</h1>
          <video
            src={previewUrl}
            controls
            autoPlay
            loop
            playsInline
            className="min-h-0 flex-1 bg-black object-contain"
          />
          <div className="flex gap-3 p-4 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              className="flex-1"
              onClick={() => {
                setRec(null);
                setStep('camera');
              }}
            >
              {t('preview.retake')}
            </Button>
            <Button className="flex-1" onClick={() => setStep('form')}>
              {t('preview.next')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {(step === 'form' || step === 'sending') && (
        <form
          onSubmit={submit}
          className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-lg flex-1 flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto p-4 pt-16"
        >
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{t('form.title')}</h1>
          <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">{t('form.category')}</legend>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {categories.map((c) => (
                <label
                  key={c}
                  className={`flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-xl border px-2 text-sm ${category === c ? 'border-accent bg-accent text-ink' : 'border-line'}`}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="category"
                    value={c}
                    checked={category === c}
                    onChange={() => setCategory(c)}
                    className="sr-only"
                  />
                  {tc(c)}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t(`form.lifetime.${category}`)}</p>
          </fieldset>
          <Field
            label={t('form.caption')}
            htmlFor="caption"
            hint={t('form.captionHint', { count: caption.length })}
          >
            <textarea
              id="caption"
              className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
              maxLength={CAPTION_MAX}
              value={caption}
              onChange={(e) => setCaption(e.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
          {category === 'event' && (
            <Field label={t('form.eventEnd')} htmlFor="event-end" hint={t('form.eventEndHint')}>
              <input
                id="event-end"
                type="datetime-local"
                required
                min={minEvent}
                max={maxEvent}
                className={inputClass}
                value={eventEnd}
                onChange={(e) => setEventEnd(e.target.value)}
              />
            </Field>
          )}
          {category === 'shop' && (
            <Field label={t('form.merchantDuration')} htmlFor="merchant-hours">
              <select
                id="merchant-hours"
                className={inputClass}
                value={merchantHours}
                onChange={(e) => setMerchantHours(Number(e.target.value))}
              >
                {MERCHANT_DURATIONS_H.map((h) => (
                  <option key={h} value={h}>
                    {t('form.hours', { count: h })}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
          )}
          {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
          {step === 'sending' && (
            <div role="status" className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p>{t('form.uploading', { percent: progress })}</p>
              <progress
                value={progress}
                max={100}
                className="w-full accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
              />
            </div>
          )}
          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={step === 'sending' || locating || (category === 'event' && !eventEnd)}
          >
            {locating
              ? t('form.locating')
              : error && /±/.test(error)
                ? t('location.retry')
                : t('form.publish')}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}

      {(step === 'done' || step === 'queued') && (
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <Notice kind="success">
            {step === 'done' ? t('form.processing') : t('offline.queued')}
          </Notice>
          <Link href="/me" className="rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-ink">
            {t('form.seeStatus')}
          </Link>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => {
              setRec(null);
              setCaption('');
              setProgress(0);
              setStep('camera');
            }}
          >
            {t('form.another')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';

/**
 * Republishes recordings kept offline once the network is back, but only if the device is
 * still within 100 m of where they were filmed (and with a precise fix).
 */
export function OfflineQueueRunner() {
  const t = useTranslations('capture.offline');
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(0);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [canRetry, setCanRetry] = useState(false);
  const running = useRef(false);

  const drain = useCallback(async () => {
    if (running.current || !navigator.onLine) return;
    running.current = true;
    setMessage(null);
    setCanRetry(false);
    try {
      // Loaded lazily: this runner is mounted on every page but rarely has work.
      const { judge, listQueued, removeQueued } = await import('@/lib/offline-queue');
      const items = await listQueued();
      setPending(items.length);
      if (items.length === 0) return;
      const { publish, PublishError } = await import('@/lib/publish');
      let fix;
      try {
        const pos = await currentPosition();
        fix = {
          lat: pos.coords.latitude,
          lng: pos.coords.longitude,
          accuracy: Math.round(pos.coords.accuracy),
        };
      } catch {
        setMessage(t('locationUnavailable'));
        setCanRetry(true);
        return;
      }
      for (const item of items) {
        const verdict = judge(item, Date.now(), fix);
        if (verdict === 'wait-precision') {
          setMessage(t('waitPrecision'));
          setCanRetry(true);
          continue;
        }
        if (verdict !== 'publish') {
          await removeQueued(item.id);
          setMessage(t(verdict === 'drop-stale' ? 'droppedStale' : 'droppedMoved'));
          continue;
        }
        try {
          await publish(item.blob, item.meta, item.fix, () => undefined);
          await removeQueued(item.id);
          setMessage(t('sent'));
        } catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof PublishError && error.retryable) {
            setMessage(t('retryable'));
            setCanRetry(true);
          } else {
            await removeQueued(item.id);
            setMessage(t('failed'));
          }
        }
      }
      setPending((await listQueued()).length);
    } finally {
      running.current = false;
    }
  }, [t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onOnline = () => void drain();
    window.addEventListener('online', onOnline);
    const timer = setTimeout(onOnline, 3000);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', onOnline);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [drain]);

  if (!pending && !message) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 top-3 z-40 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel/95 px-3 py-2 text-sm shadow-lg"
    >
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-3xl items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span>{message ?? t('pending', { count: pending })}</span>
        {canRetry && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void drain()}
            className="min-h-11 shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 font-semibold text-accent underline underline-offset-4"
          >
            {t('retry')}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';

interface LiveAlert {
  id: string;
  caption: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
}

/**
 * "Alertes proches" banner: initial list from the feed API, then live updates over Supabase
 * Realtime broadcast topics (one per H3 res-7 cell covering the radius). Payloads only carry
 * fuzzed positions.
 */
export function AlertsBanner({
  lat,
  lng,
  radius,
  onShow,
}: {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  radius: number;
  onShow: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('feed.alerts');
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<Map<string, string>>(new Map());
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({
      lat: String(lat),
      lng: String(lng),
      radius: String(radius),
      category: 'alert',
      limit: '20',
    });
    void api<{ items: FeedItem[] }>(`/api/feed?${qs}`).then((res) => {
      if (alive && res.ok) setAlerts(new Map(res.data.items.map((i) => [i.id, i.caption])));
    });

    // Realtime client and H3 are loaded after first paint, only where the banner is used.
    let cleanup = () => {};
    void Promise.all([import('@nl/shared'), import('@/lib/supabase/browser')]).then(
      ([{ haversineMeters, realtimeCells }, { browserClient }]) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const supabase = browserClient();
        const channels = realtimeCells({ lat, lng }, radius).map((cell) =>
          supabase
            .channel(`alerts:${cell}`, { config: { private: false } })
            .on('broadcast', { event: 'alert' }, ({ payload }) => {
              const a = payload as LiveAlert;
              if (haversineMeters({ lat, lng }, a) > radius + 50) return;
              setAlerts((prev) => new Map(prev).set(a.id, a.caption));
              setFlash(a.caption || '');
              setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 6000);
            })
            .subscribe(),
        );
        cleanup = () => {
          for (const c of channels) void supabase.removeChannel(c);
        };
      },
    );
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      cleanup();
    };
  }, [lat, lng, radius]);

  if (alerts.size === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onShow}
        className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-alert px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-ink"
        aria-label={`${t('banner', { count: alerts.size })} — ${t('show')}`}
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">⚠</span>
        {t('banner', { count: alerts.size })}
      </button>
      {flash !== null && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-black/80 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
          {t('new', { caption: flash })}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { COMMENT_MAX } from '@nl/shared';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { Button, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { Sheet } from './Sheet';

interface Comment {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  created_at: string;
  mine: boolean;
  author: { username: string | null; avatar_color: string } | null;
}

interface Page {
  comments: Comment[];
  nextBefore: string | null;
}

export function Comments({
  videoId,
  signedIn,
  onClose,
}: {
  videoId: string | null;
  signedIn: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('video.commentsPanel');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<Comment[]>([]);
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [body, setBody] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!videoId) return;
    let alive = true;
    void api<Page>(`/api/videos/${videoId}/comments`).then((res) => {
      if (!alive || !res.ok) return;
      setComments(res.data.comments);
      setNext(res.data.nextBefore);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [videoId]);

  async function more() {
    if (!videoId || !next) return;
    const res = await api<Page>(
      `/api/videos/${videoId}/comments?before=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`,
    );
    if (res.ok) {
      setComments((c) => [...c, ...res.data.comments]);
      setNext(res.data.nextBefore);
    }
  }

  async function send(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!videoId || !body.trim()) return;
    setError(null);
    const res = await api<Comment>(`/api/videos/${videoId}/comments`, { body: { body } });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    setComments((c) => [res.data, ...c]);
    setBody('');
  }

  async function remove(id: string) {
    const res = await api(`/api/comments/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE', body: {} });
    if (res.ok) setComments((c) => c.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={videoId !== null} title={t('title')} onClose={onClose} closeLabel={tc('close')}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {signedIn ? (
          <form onSubmit={send} className="flex gap-2">
            <label htmlFor="comment-body" className="sr-only">
              {t('placeholder')}
            </label>
            <input
              id="comment-body"
              className={inputClass}
              maxLength={COMMENT_MAX}
              placeholder={t('placeholder')}
              value={body}
              onChange={(e) => setBody(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={!body.trim()}>
              {t('send')}
            </Button>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <Notice>{t('login')}</Notice>
        )}
        {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
        {comments.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {comments.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id} className="flex gap-3">
                <Avatar
                  username={c.author?.username ?? null}
                  color={c.author?.avatar_color ?? '#64748b'}
                  size={32}
                />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-xs text-fog">
                    @{c.author?.username} · {format.relativeTime(new Date(c.created_at), now)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-line break-words">{c.body}</p>
                </div>
                {c.mine && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="self-start text-xs text-fog underline"
                    onClick={() => remove(c.id)}
                  >
                    {t('delete')}
                  </button>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {next && (
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={more}>
            {t('more')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```
