```tsx
'use client';

import { CATEGORIES, RADII_M, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';
import { useLocation } from '@/lib/useLocation';
import { AlertsBanner } from './AlertsBanner';
import { VideoCard } from './VideoCard';

// Sheets are only needed once opened.
const Comments = dynamic(() => import('./Comments').then((m) => m.Comments), { ssr: false });
const ReportDialog = dynamic(() => import('./ReportDialog').then((m) => m.ReportDialog), {
  ssr: false,
});

interface Props {
  initialRadius: number;
  signedIn: boolean;
  focusId: string | null;
  initialCategory: Category | null;
  notice: string | null;
}

type Status = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';

export function Feed({ initialRadius, signedIn, focusId, initialCategory, notice }: Props) {
  const t = useTranslations('feed');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const router = useRouter();
  const { state: location, locate, dismiss } = useLocation();
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(initialRadius);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category | null>(initialCategory);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FeedItem[]>([]);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>('idle');
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(true);
  const [commentsFor, setCommentsFor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reportFor, setReportFor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [autoplay, setAutoplay] = useState(true);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const loadingMore = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const apply = () => setAutoplay(!mq.matches);
    const timer = setTimeout(apply, 0);
    mq.addEventListener('change', apply);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      mq.removeEventListener('change', apply);
    };
  }, []);

  const lat = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lat : null;
  const lng = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lng : null;
  const coords = lat !== null && lng !== null ? { lat, lng } : null;
  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);

  const fetchPage = useCallback(
    async (after: string | null) => {
      if (lat === null || lng === null) return null;
      const qs = new URLSearchParams({
        lat: String(lat),
        lng: String(lng),
        radius: String(radius),
      });
      if (category) qs.set('category', category);
      if (after) qs.set('cursor', after);
      return api<{ items: FeedItem[]; nextCursor: string | null }>(`/api/feed?${qs}`);
    },
    [lat, lng, radius, category],
  );

  // First page (and focused deep-linked video) whenever position or filters change.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lat === null) return;
    let alive = true;
    const run = async () => {
      setStatus('loading');
      const [page, focused] = await Promise.all([
        fetchPage(null),
        focusId ? api<FeedItem>(`/api/videos/${focusId}/media`) : Promise.resolve(null),
      ]);
      if (!alive) return;
      if (!page?.ok) return setStatus('error');
      const first = focused?.ok ? [focused.data] : [];
      setItems([...first, ...page.data.items.filter((i) => i.id !== focusId)]);
      setCursor(page.data.nextCursor);
      setActive(0);
      listRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
      setStatus('ready');
    };
    void run();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [fetchPage, focusId, lat, reloadKey]);

  const loadMore = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!cursor || loadingMore.current) return;
    loadingMore.current = true;
    const page = await fetchPage(cursor);
    loadingMore.current = false;
    if (page?.ok) {
      setItems((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        ...page.data.items.filter((i) => !prev.some((p) => p.id === i.id)),
      ]);
      setCursor(page.data.nextCursor);
    }
  }, [cursor, fetchPage]);

  const loadMoreRef = useRef(loadMore);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadMoreRef.current = loadMore;
  }, [loadMore]);

  // The card that is ≥60 % visible becomes active (autoplay), the next one is preloaded;
  // nearing the end of the list fetches the next page.
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = listRef.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const count = items.length;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const e of entries) {
          if (!e.isIntersecting || e.intersectionRatio < 0.6) continue;
          const index = Number((e.target as HTMLElement).dataset.index);
          setActive(index);
          if (index >= count - 2) void loadMoreRef.current();
        }
      },
      { root, threshold: [0.6] },
    );
    root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-index]').forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [items]);

  const goLogin = () => router.push('/login?next=/');

  return (
    <div className="relative h-[calc(100dvh-4.5rem)] w-full">
      <PermissionPrimer
        open={location.status === 'primer'}
        title={t('location.primerTitle')}
        confirmLabel={t('location.allow')}
        cancelLabel={t('location.later')}
        onConfirm={() => void locate()}
        onCancel={dismiss}
      >
        <p>{t('location.primerBody')}</p>
      </PermissionPrimer>

      <header className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-20 flex flex-col gap-2 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/80 to-transparent p-3 pb-6">
        <h1 className="sr-only">{t('title')}</h1>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <nav aria-label={t('filters.label')} className="flex flex-1 gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
            <FilterChip active={category === null} onClick={() => setCategory(null)}>
              {t('filters.all')}
            </FilterChip>
            {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
              <FilterChip key={c} active={category === c} onClick={() => setCategory(c)}>
                {tc(`categories.${c}`)}
              </FilterChip>
            ))}
          </nav>
          <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="feed-radius">
            {t('filters.radius')}
          </label>
          <select
            id="feed-radius"
            value={radius}
            onChange={(e) => setRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="min-h-11 rounded-full border border-line bg-black/70 px-3 text-sm"
          >
            {RADII_M.map((r) => (
              <option key={r} value={r}>
                {tc(`radius.${r}`)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        {category === 'alert' && (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-alert/50 bg-black/80 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white">
            {t('alerts.notice')}
          </p>
        )}
        {coords && (
          <AlertsBanner
            lat={coords.lat}
            lng={coords.lng}
            radius={radius}
            onShow={() => setCategory('alert')}
          />
        )}
        {notice && <Notice kind="success">{notice}</Notice>}
      </header>

      {location.status !== 'ok' && location.status !== 'primer' && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          {location.status === 'locating' || location.status === 'unknown' ? (
            <p role="status" className="text-fog">
              {t('location.locating')}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Notice kind={location.status === 'denied' ? 'error' : 'info'}>
                {location.status === 'denied' ? t('location.denied') : t('location.needed')}
              </Notice>
              <Button onClick={() => void locate()}>{t('location.allow')}</Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {coords && status === 'loading' && items.length === 0 && <FeedSkeleton />}

      {coords && status === 'error' && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <Notice kind="error">{t('error')}</Notice>
          <Button onClick={() => setReloadKey((k) => k + 1)}>{tc('actions.retry')}</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {coords && status === 'ready' && items.length === 0 && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">{t('empty.title')}</h2>
          <p className="text-fog">{t('empty.body')}</p>
          <Link href="/filmer" className="rounded-xl bg-accent px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-ink">
            {t('empty.cta')}
          </Link>
          {radius < 3000 && (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setRadius(radius === 300 ? 1000 : 3000)}>
              {t('empty.wider', { radius: tc(`radius.${radius === 300 ? 1000 : 3000}`) })}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div
          ref={listRef}
          className="h-full snap-y snap-mandatory overflow-y-scroll overscroll-contain"
          aria-busy={status === 'loading'}
        >
          {items.map((item, index) => (
            <div key={item.id} data-index={index} className="h-full w-full">
              <VideoCard
                item={item}
                active={index === active}
                load={index === active || index === active + 1}
                muted={muted}
                autoplay={autoplay}
                onToggleMute={() => setMuted((m) => !m)}
                onComments={(i) => setCommentsFor(i.id)}
                onReport={(i) => setReportFor(i.id)}
                onAuthRequired={goLogin}
                signedIn={signedIn}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
          <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-fog" role="status">
            {cursor ? t('loadingMore') : t('end')}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {commentsFor && (
        <Comments videoId={commentsFor} signedIn={signedIn} onClose={() => setCommentsFor(null)} />
      )}
      {reportFor && <ReportDialog videoId={reportFor} onClose={() => setReportFor(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function FilterChip({
  active,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={`min-h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3 text-sm ${active ? 'border-accent bg-accent font-semibold text-ink' : 'border-line bg-black/60 text-white'}`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function FeedSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div
      className="flex h-full flex-col justify-end gap-3 bg-panel p-4 pb-8 motion-safe:animate-pulse"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div className="h-5 w-24 rounded-full bg-line" />
      <div className="h-5 w-3/4 rounded bg-line" />
      <div className="h-4 w-1/2 rounded bg-line" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { REPORT_REASONS, type ReportReason } from '@nl/shared';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { Sheet } from './Sheet';

export function ReportDialog({
  videoId,
  onClose,
}: {
  videoId: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('video.reportPanel');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<ReportReason>('recognizable_person');
  const [details, setDetails] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const close = () => {
    setStatus(null);
    setDetails('');
    onClose();
  };

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!videoId) return;
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api(`/api/videos/${videoId}/report`, { body: { reason, details } });
    setPending(false);
    if (res.ok) setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('done') });
    else
      setStatus({
        kind: 'error',
        text: res.error === 'already_reported' ? t('already') : (errorText(res.error) ?? ''),
      });
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={videoId !== null} title={t('title')} onClose={close} closeLabel={tc('close')}>
      {status?.kind === 'success' ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Notice kind="success">{status.text}</Notice>
          <Button onClick={close}>{tc('close')}</Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
          <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">{t('reason')}</legend>
            {REPORT_REASONS.map((r) => (
              <label
                key={r}
                className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line px-3"
              >
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="reason"
                  value={r}
                  checked={reason === r}
                  onChange={() => setReason(r)}
                  className="h-5 w-5 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
                />
                {t(`reasons.${r}`)}
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
          <Field label={t('details')} htmlFor="report-details">
            <textarea
              id="report-details"
              className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
              maxLength={500}
              value={details}
              onChange={(e) => setDetails(e.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
          {status && <Notice kind="error">{status.text}</Notice>}
          <Button type="submit" variant="danger" disabled={pending}>
            {t('submit')}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Accessible bottom sheet built on <dialog> (focus trap, Escape to close). */
export function Sheet({
  open,
  title,
  onClose,
  closeLabel,
  children,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  closeLabel: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const d = ref.current;
    if (!d) return;
    if (open && !d.open) d.showModal();
    if (!open && d.open) d.close();
  }, [open]);
  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      onClose={onClose}
      onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}
      className="mb-0 mt-auto max-h-[80dvh] w-full max-w-lg rounded-t-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-0 text-white backdrop:bg-black/60 sm:m-auto sm:rounded-2xl"
    >
      <div className="flex max-h-[80dvh] flex-col">
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
          <h2 id={titleId} className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label={closeLabel}
            className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center text-2xl"
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </header>
        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\feed\VideoCard.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { CATEGORY_COLORS } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useLocale, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';
import { formatDistance } from './format';

interface Props {
  item: FeedItem;
  active: boolean;
  /** Only the visible video and the next one get a source (preload next only). */
  load: boolean;
  muted: boolean;
  autoplay: boolean;
  onToggleMute: () => void;
  onComments: (item: FeedItem) => void;
  onReport: (item: FeedItem) => void;
  onAuthRequired: () => void;
  signedIn: boolean;
}

export function VideoCard({
  item,
  active,
  load,
  muted,
  autoplay,
  onToggleMute,
  onComments,
  onReport,
  onAuthRequired,
  signedIn,
}: Props) {
  const t = useTranslations('video');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const locale = useLocale();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const [src, setSrc] = useState(item.videoUrl);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(true);
  const [mediaState, setMediaState] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('loading');
  const mediaRetries = useRef(0);
  const mediaRequest = useRef<{
    generation: number;
    controller: AbortController | null;
  }>({ generation: 0, controller: null });
  const [useful, setUseful] = useState({ reacted: item.reacted, count: item.usefulCount });
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [captionExpanded, setCaptionExpanded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (active && autoplay) void video.play().catch(() => setPaused(true));
    if (!active || !autoplay) video.pause();
  }, [active, autoplay, src]);

  const requestMediaUrl = useCallback(async () => {
    const generation = ++mediaRequest.current.generation;
    mediaRequest.current.controller?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    mediaRequest.current.controller = controller;

    try {
      const result = await api<FeedItem>(`/api/videos/${item.id}/media`, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || generation !== mediaRequest.current.generation) return null;
      return result;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, [item.id]);

  const refreshUrl = useCallback(
    async (force = false) => {
      if (mediaRetries.current >= 1) {
        setMediaState('error');
        return;
      }
      mediaRetries.current += 1;
      const res = await requestMediaUrl();
      if (!res) return;
      if (res.ok && res.data.videoUrl && (force || res.data.videoUrl !== src)) {
        setSrc(res.data.videoUrl);
        setMediaState('loading');
        return;
      }
      if (force && res.ok && res.data.videoUrl) ref.current?.load();
      setMediaState('error');
    },
    [requestMediaUrl, src],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!load || src || mediaRetries.current >= 1) return;

    let current = true;
    mediaRetries.current += 1;
    void requestMediaUrl().then((res) => {
      if (!current || !res) return;
      if (res.ok && res.data.videoUrl) {
        mediaRetries.current = 0;
        setSrc(res.data.videoUrl);
        setMediaState('loading');
      } else {
        setMediaState('error');
      }
    });

    return () => {
      current = false;
    };
  }, [item.id, load, requestMediaUrl, src]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      mediaRequest.current.generation += 1;
      mediaRequest.current.controller?.abort();
      mediaRequest.current.controller = null;
    },
    [item.id],
  );

  function retryMedia() {
    mediaRetries.current = 0;
    setMediaState('loading');
    void refreshUrl(true);
  }

  async function toggleUseful() {
    if (!signedIn) return onAuthRequired();
    const res = await api<{ reacted: boolean; usefulCount: number }>(
      `/api/videos/${item.id}/useful`,
      {
        method: useful.reacted ? 'DELETE' : 'POST',
        body: {},
      },
    );
    if (res.ok) setUseful({ reacted: res.data.reacted, count: res.data.usefulCount });
  }

  async function share() {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/v/${item.id}`;
    try {
      if (navigator.share)
        await navigator.share({ title: tc(item.category), text: item.caption, url });
      else {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
        setToast(t('shared'));
        setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
      }
    } catch {
      /* share sheet dismissed */
    }
  }

  function togglePlay() {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (video.paused)
      void video.play().catch(() => {
        setPaused(true);
        setToast(t('playbackError'));
        setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
      });
    else video.pause();
  }

  const distance = item.distanceM === null ? null : formatDistance(item.distanceM, locale);

  return (
    <article
      className="relative h-full w-full snap-start snap-always overflow-hidden bg-black"
      aria-label={`${tc(item.category)} — ${item.caption}`}
      data-testid="feed-item"
      data-video-id={item.id}
    >
      <video
        ref={ref}
        src={load && src ? src : undefined}
        poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
        preload={load ? 'auto' : 'none'}
        playsInline
        muted={muted}
        loop
        onPlay={() => setPaused(false)}
        onPause={() => setPaused(true)}
        onLoadedData={() => {
          mediaRetries.current = 0;
          setMediaState('ready');
        }}
        onError={() => {
          if (load && src) void refreshUrl();
        }}
        onClick={togglePlay}
        className="h-full w-full object-cover"
      />
      {load && mediaState === 'loading' && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-black/70 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white"
        >
          {t('mediaLoading')}
        </p>
      )}
      {load && mediaState === 'error' && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-black/70 p-6 text-center">
          <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-white">
            {t('mediaUnavailable')}
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={retryMedia}
            className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-ink"
          >
            {t('retryMedia')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={togglePlay}
        aria-label={paused ? t('play') : t('pause')}
        disabled={mediaState !== 'ready'}
        className={`absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 flex h-16 w-16 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-black/50 text-3xl transition-opacity disabled:hidden ${paused ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 focus:opacity-100'}`}
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">{paused ? '▶' : '❚❚'}</span>
      </button>

      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent px-4 pb-6 pt-24">
        <div className="pointer-events-auto flex max-w-[calc(100%-5rem)] flex-col gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
            <span
              className="rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-white"
              style={{ backgroundColor: CATEGORY_COLORS[item.category] }}
            >
              {tc(item.category)}
            </span>
            {item.isMerchant && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-500 px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-ink">
                {t('merchant')}
              </span>
            )}
            {distance && (
              <span className="text-fog">
                {t('distance', { distance: t(distance.unit, { value: distance.value }) })}
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="text-fog">
              · {t('expires', { when: format.relativeTime(new Date(item.expiresAt), now) })}
            </span>
          </div>
          {item.caption && (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
              <p
                className={`text-base font-medium leading-snug ${captionExpanded ? '' : 'line-clamp-3'}`}
              >
                {item.caption}
              </p>
              {item.caption.length > 100 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-expanded={captionExpanded}
                  onClick={() => setCaptionExpanded((expanded) => !expanded)}
                  className="min-h-11 rounded-lg px-1 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-white underline underline-offset-4"
                >
                  {captionExpanded ? t('captionLess') : t('captionMore')}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <Link
            href={`/u/${item.author.username}`}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-fog"
          >
            <Avatar username={item.author.username} color={item.author.color} size={28} />
            {t('by', { username: item.author.username ?? '' })}
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute bottom-6 right-3 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-xs">
        <ActionButton
          label={t('usefulCount', { count: useful.count })}
          pressed={useful.reacted}
          onClick={toggleUseful}
          icon="M7 11v9H4v-9zm2 9h8.5a2 2 0 002-1.6l1.4-6A2 2 0 0019 10h-5V6a2 2 0 00-2-2l-3 7z"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={t('comments', { count: item.commentCount })}
          onClick={() => onComments(item)}
          icon="M4 5h16v11H8l-4 4z"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={t('share')}
          onClick={share}
          icon="M14 5l6 6-6 6M20 11H9a5 5 0 00-5 5v3"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={t('report')}
          onClick={() => (signedIn ? onReport(item) : onAuthRequired())}
          icon="M5 21V4h11l-1.5 4L16 12H5"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={muted ? t('unmute') : t('mute')}
          onClick={onToggleMute}
          icon={
            muted
              ? 'M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4zM17 9l4 6m0-6l-4 6'
              : 'M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4zM16 8a5 5 0 010 8m2.5-10.5a8.5 8.5 0 010 13'
          }
        />
      </div>
      {toast && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="absolute left-1/2 top-20 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-black/70 px-3 py-1 text-sm"
        >
          {toast}
        </p>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

function ActionButton({
  label,
  icon,
  onClick,
  pressed,
}: {
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  pressed?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={pressed}
      className="flex w-16 flex-col items-center gap-1 text-center"
    >
      <span
        className={`flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${pressed ? 'bg-accent text-ink' : 'bg-black/50 text-white'}`}
      >
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          className="h-6 w-6"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeLinecap="round"
        >
          <path d={icon} />
        </svg>
      </span>
      <span className="leading-tight drop-shadow">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}
```

```ts
/** "300 m" / "1,2 km" from a 100 m bucketed distance. */
export function formatDistance(
  meters: number,
  locale: string,
): { unit: 'm' | 'km'; value: string } {
  if (meters < 1000) return { unit: 'm', value: String(meters) };
  return {
    unit: 'km',
    value: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(meters / 1000),
  };
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css';
import { CATEGORIES, CATEGORY_COLORS, RADII_M, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import type { ExpressionSpecification, GeoJSONSource, Map as MlMap, Marker } from 'maplibre-gl';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { useLocation } from '@/lib/useLocation';
import { circlePolygon, zoomForRadius } from './geometry';

interface Selected {
  id: string;
  category: Category;
  caption: string;
}

type FC = { type: 'FeatureCollection'; features: unknown[] };

const colorExpression = [
  'match',
  ['get', 'category'],
  ...CATEGORIES.flatMap((c) => [c, CATEGORY_COLORS[c]]),
  '#9ca3af',
] as unknown as ExpressionSpecification;

export function MapView({ initialRadius }: { initialRadius: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations('map');
  const tf = useTranslations('feed');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const { state: location, locate, dismiss } = useLocation();
  const container = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mapRef = useRef<MlMap | null>(null);
  const markerRef = useRef<Marker | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(initialRadius);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category | null>(null);
  const [count, setCount] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Selected | null>(null);

  const lat = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lat : null;
  const lng = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lng : null;

  // Create the map once a position is known.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lat === null || lng === null || !container.current || mapRef.current) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    void import('maplibre-gl').then((maplibregl) => {
      if (cancelled || !container.current) return;
      maplibregl.setWorkerUrl('/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs');
      const map = new maplibregl.Map({
        container: container.current,
        style: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL,
        center: [lng, lat],
        zoom: zoomForRadius(initialRadius),
        attributionControl: { compact: true },
      });
      mapRef.current = map;
      map.on('load', () => {
        map.addSource('radius', { type: 'geojson', data: circlePolygon(lat, lng, initialRadius) });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'radius-fill',
          type: 'fill',
          source: 'radius',
          paint: { 'fill-color': '#ffd34d', 'fill-opacity': 0.08 },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'radius-line',
          type: 'line',
          source: 'radius',
          paint: { 'line-color': '#ffd34d', 'line-width': 2 },
        });
        map.addSource('videos', {
          type: 'geojson',
          data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] },
          cluster: true,
          clusterRadius: 42,
          clusterMaxZoom: 17,
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'clusters',
          type: 'circle',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['has', 'point_count'],
          paint: {
            'circle-color': '#15181d',
            'circle-stroke-color': '#ffd34d',
            'circle-stroke-width': 2,
            'circle-radius': ['step', ['get', 'point_count'], 16, 10, 22, 30, 28],
          },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'cluster-count',
          type: 'symbol',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['has', 'point_count'],
          layout: { 'text-field': ['get', 'point_count_abbreviated'], 'text-size': 13 },
          paint: { 'text-color': '#ffffff' },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'points',
          type: 'circle',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['!', ['has', 'point_count']],
          paint: {
            'circle-color': colorExpression,
            'circle-radius': 9,
            'circle-stroke-color': '#ffffff',
            'circle-stroke-width': 2,
          },
        });
        map.on('click', 'points', (e) => {
          const p = e.features?.[0]?.properties as Selected | undefined;
          if (p) setSelected({ id: p.id, category: p.category, caption: p.caption });
        });
        map.on('click', 'clusters', async (e) => {
          const feature = e.features?.[0];
          const source = map.getSource('videos') as GeoJSONSource;
          if (!feature) return;
          const zoom = await source.getClusterExpansionZoom(
            feature.properties.cluster_id as number,
          );
          map.easeTo({
            center: (feature.geometry as unknown as { coordinates: [number, number] }).coordinates,
            zoom,
          });
        });
        for (const layer of ['points', 'clusters']) {
          map.on('mouseenter', layer, () => (map.getCanvas().style.cursor = 'pointer'));
          map.on('mouseleave', layer, () => (map.getCanvas().style.cursor = ''));
        }
        markerRef.current = new maplibregl.Marker({ color: '#ffd34d' })
          .setLngLat([lng, lat])
          .addTo(map);
        setLoaded(true);
      });
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [lat, lng, initialRadius]);

  useEffect(() => () => mapRef.current?.remove(), []);

  // Data + radius overlay follow the position, radius and category filter.
  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapRef.current;
    if (!loaded || !map || lat === null || lng === null) return;
    (map.getSource('radius') as GeoJSONSource).setData(circlePolygon(lat, lng, radius));
    markerRef.current?.setLngLat([lng, lat]);
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ lat: String(lat), lng: String(lng), radius: String(radius) });
    if (category) qs.set('category', category);
    let alive = true;
    void api<FC>(`/api/map?${qs}`).then((res) => {
      if (!alive || !res.ok) return;
      (map.getSource('videos') as GeoJSONSource).setData(
        res.data as Parameters<GeoJSONSource['setData']>[0],
      );
      setCount(res.data.features.length);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [loaded, lat, lng, radius, category]);

  function relocate() {
    void locate().then(() => {
      const map = mapRef.current;
      if (map && lat !== null && lng !== null)
        map.flyTo({ center: [lng, lat], zoom: zoomForRadius(radius) });
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative h-[calc(100dvh-4.5rem)] w-full">
      <h1 className="sr-only">{t('title')}</h1>
      <PermissionPrimer
        open={location.status === 'primer'}
        title={tf('location.primerTitle')}
        confirmLabel={tf('location.allow')}
        cancelLabel={tf('location.later')}
        onConfirm={() => void locate()}
        onCancel={dismiss}
      >
        <p>{tf('location.primerBody')}</p>
      </PermissionPrimer>

      <div ref={container} className="h-full w-full" role="region" aria-label={t('title')} />

      {(location.status === 'denied' || location.status === 'error') && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <Notice kind="error">
            {location.status === 'denied' ? tf('location.denied') : tf('location.needed')}
          </Notice>
          <Button onClick={() => void locate()}>{tf('location.allow')}</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex flex-col gap-2 p-3">
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
          <Chip active={category === null} onClick={() => setCategory(null)}>
            {tf('filters.all')}
          </Chip>
          {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
            <Chip
              key={c}
              active={category === c}
              onClick={() => setCategory(c)}
              color={CATEGORY_COLORS[c]}
            >
              {tc(`categories.${c}`)}
            </Chip>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="map-radius" className="sr-only">
            {tf('filters.radius')}
          </label>
          <select
            id="map-radius"
            value={radius}
            onChange={(e) => setRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="min-h-11 rounded-full border border-line bg-black/80 px-3 text-sm"
          >
            {RADII_M.map((r) => (
              <option key={r} value={r}>
                {tc(`radius.${r}`)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          {count !== null && (
            <p className="rounded-full bg-black/80 px-3 py-2 text-xs" role="status">
              {t('count', { count })}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button
        variant="secondary"
        className="absolute bottom-6 right-3 rounded-full"
        onClick={relocate}
        aria-label={t('locate')}
      >
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          className="h-5 w-5"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
        >
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
          <path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3" />
        </svg>
        {t('locate')}
      </Button>
      <p className="absolute bottom-1 left-3 text-[10px] text-fog">{t('attribution')}</p>

      {selected && (
        <div
          className="absolute inset-x-3 bottom-20 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-3 shadow-xl"
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={tc(`categories.${selected.category}`)}
        >
          <span
            className="mt-1 h-3 w-3 shrink-0 rounded-full"
            style={{ backgroundColor: CATEGORY_COLORS[selected.category] }}
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{tc(`categories.${selected.category}`)}</p>
            <p className="line-clamp-2 text-sm text-fog">{selected.caption}</p>
            <Link
              href={`/?video=${selected.id}`}
              className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-xl bg-accent px-3 font-semibold text-ink"
            >
              {t('open')}
            </Link>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="h-11 w-11 text-xl"
            aria-label={tc('actions.close')}
            onClick={() => setSelected(null)}
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Chip({
  active,
  onClick,
  color,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  color?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`flex min-h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 text-sm ${active ? 'border-accent bg-accent font-semibold text-ink' : 'border-line bg-black/80'}`}
    >
      {color && (
        <span
          className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full"
          style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\map\geometry.ts`:

```ts
/** GeoJSON polygon approximating a circle of `radiusM` around a point (for the radius overlay). */
export function circlePolygon(lat: number, lng: number, radiusM: number, steps = 64) {
  const coords: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i += 1) {
    const a = (i / steps) * 2 * Math.PI;
    coords.push([
      lng + (radiusM * Math.cos(a)) / (111_320 * Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180)),
      lat + (radiusM * Math.sin(a)) / 110_540,
    ]);
  }
  return {
    type: 'Feature' as const,
    properties: {},
    geometry: { type: 'Polygon' as const, coordinates: [coords] },
  };
}

/** Zoom level showing the whole radius on a phone screen. */
export const zoomForRadius = (radiusM: number): number =>
  radiusM <= 300 ? 15.5 : radiusM <= 1000 ? 14 : 12.4;
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export function MerchantForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('merchant');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/merchant', { body: { businessName, description } });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <Field label={t('businessName')} htmlFor="m-name">
        <input
          id="m-name"
          className={inputClass}
          maxLength={80}
          required
          value={businessName}
          onChange={(e) => setBusinessName(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('description')} htmlFor="m-desc">
        <textarea
          id="m-desc"
          className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
          maxLength={280}
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={businessName.trim().length < 2}>
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

/** Same window as the appeals RLS policy (30 days). */
const APPEAL_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 24 * 3_600_000;

export interface Decision {
  id: number;
  kind: string;
  note: string;
  createdAt: string;
  appealStatus: string | null;
  appealable: boolean;
}

export function Decisions({ items }: { items: Decision[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation.decisions');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [appealed, setAppealed] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  async function appeal(actionId: number) {
    const res = await api('/api/appeals', { body: { actionId, reason } });
    if (!res.ok) return setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' });
    setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('appealSent') });
    setAppealed(new Set(appealed).add(actionId));
    setOpen(null);
    setReason('');
  }

  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {items.map((d) => (
          <li key={d.id}>
            <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p className="font-semibold">{t(`kinds.${d.kind}`)}</p>
              {d.note && <p className="text-sm text-fog">{d.note}</p>}
              <p className="text-xs text-fog">{format.relativeTime(new Date(d.createdAt), now)}</p>
              {d.appealStatus && (
                <p className="text-sm">
                  {t('appealed', { status: t(`status.${d.appealStatus}`) })}
                </p>
              )}
              {d.appealable &&
                now.getTime() - new Date(d.createdAt).getTime() < APPEAL_WINDOW_MS &&
                !d.appealStatus &&
                !appealed.has(d.id) &&
                (open === d.id ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <Field label={t('appealLabel')} htmlFor={`appeal-${d.id}`}>
                      <textarea
                        id={`appeal-${d.id}`}
                        className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
                        maxLength={1000}
                        value={reason}
                        onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    <Button disabled={reason.trim().length < 10} onClick={() => appeal(d.id)}>
                      {t('appeal')}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(d.id)}>
                    {t('appeal')}
                  </Button>
                ))}
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export interface QueueItem {
  videoId: string;
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  status: string;
  hiddenReason: string | null;
  reportCount: number;
  reasons: string[];
  author: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
}

export interface AppealItem {
  appealId: string;
  reason: string;
  actionKind: string;
  actionNote: string;
  caption: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
}

type Status = { kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null;

export function ModerationQueue({ items }: { items: QueueItem[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const tr = useTranslations('video.reportPanel.reasons');
  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.videoId} data-testid="queue-item" data-video-id={item.videoId}>
          <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <strong>{tc(item.category)}</strong>
              <span className="text-fog">@{item.author}</span>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-line px-2 py-0.5 text-xs">
                {t('reports', { count: item.reportCount })}
              </span>
              {item.status === 'hidden' && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-500 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-ink">
                  {t('hiddenAuto')}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {item.videoUrl && (
              <video
                src={item.videoUrl}
                poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
                controls
                playsInline
                preload="metadata"
                className="max-h-96 w-full rounded-xl bg-black object-contain"
              />
            )}
            {item.caption && <p>{item.caption}</p>}
            {item.reasons.length > 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-fog">
                {t('reasons')} : {item.reasons.map((r) => tr(r)).join(', ')}
              </p>
            )}
            <DecisionForm videoId={item.videoId} />
          </Card>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function DecisionForm({ videoId }: { videoId: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function decide(action: 'validate' | 'hide' | 'remove' | 'warn') {
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', {
      body: { type: 'decision', videoId, action, note },
    });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const noteMissing = res.error === 'invalid_input' || res.error === 'note_required';
      return setStatus({
        kind: 'error',
        text: noteMissing ? t('note') : (errorText(res.error) ?? ''),
      });
    }
    setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('done') });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Field label={t('note')} htmlFor={`note-${videoId}`}>
        <textarea
          id={`note-${videoId}`}
          className={`${inputClass} min-h-16`}
          maxLength={1000}
          value={note}
          onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <Button disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('validate')}>
          {t('actions.validate')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('hide')}>
          {t('actions.hide')}
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="danger"
          disabled={pending || note.trim().length < 3}
          onClick={() => decide('remove')}
        >
          {t('actions.remove')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('warn')}>
          {t('actions.warn')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AppealsQueue({ items }: { items: AppealItem[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const tk = useTranslations('moderation.decisions.kinds');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function resolve(appealId: string, uphold: boolean) {
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', {
      body: { type: 'appeal', appealId, uphold, note: notes[appealId] ?? '' },
    });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('appealsEmpty')}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {items.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.appealId}>
            <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">
                {tk(a.actionKind)}
                {a.actionNote && <span className="font-normal text-fog"> — {a.actionNote}</span>}
              </p>
              {a.videoUrl && (
                <video
                  src={a.videoUrl}
                  poster={a.posterUrl ?? undefined}
                  controls
                  playsInline
                  preload="metadata"
                  className="max-h-80 w-full rounded-xl bg-black object-contain"
                />
              )}
              {a.caption && <p className="text-sm">{a.caption}</p>}
              <p className="text-sm">
                <span className="text-fog">{t('appealReason')} : </span>
                {a.reason}
              </p>
              <label className="sr-only" htmlFor={`an-${a.appealId}`}>
                {t('note')}
              </label>
              <textarea
                id={`an-${a.appealId}`}
                className={`${inputClass} min-h-14`}
                value={notes[a.appealId] ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes({ ...notes, [a.appealId]: e.target.value })}
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <Button onClick={() => resolve(a.appealId, true)}>{t('uphold')}</Button>
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => resolve(a.appealId, false)}>
                  {t('reject')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ApplyForm({ eligible, cells }: { eligible: boolean; cells: string[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation.apply');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [cell, setCell] = useState(cells[0] ?? '');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function apply() {
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', { body: { type: 'apply', cell } });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('rules')}</p>
      <Notice kind={eligible ? 'success' : 'info'}>
        {eligible ? t('eligible') : t('notEligible')}
      </Notice>
      {eligible &&
        (cells.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('noZone')}</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Field label={t('zone')} htmlFor="apply-cell">
              <select
                id="apply-cell"
                className={inputClass}
                value={cell}
                onChange={(e) => setCell(e.target.value)}
              >
                {cells.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c} value={c}>
                    {c.slice(3, 9)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Button onClick={apply}>{t('submit')}</Button>
          </>
        ))}
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { isIos, isStandalone } from '@/lib/platform';

import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';

interface InstallPrompt extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
}

const STEPS = ['value', 'permissions', 'rules'] as const;
const INSTALL_STEP = STEPS.length;

export function Onboarding({
  next,
  signedIn,
  initialStep,
}: {
  next: string;
  signedIn: boolean;
  initialStep: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('onboarding');
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(initialStep);
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState<InstallPrompt | null>(null);
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState<'ios' | 'other' | 'installed'>('other');

  useEffect(() => {
    const onPrompt = (e: Event) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setPrompt(e as InstallPrompt);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
    const timer = setTimeout(
      () => setPlatform(isStandalone() ? 'installed' : isIos() ? 'ios' : 'other'),
      0,
    );
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  async function finish() {
    // Non-sensitive preference cookie read by src/proxy.ts (no tracking, no personal data).
    document.cookie = `${ONBOARDED_COOKIE}=1; path=/; max-age=31536000; samesite=lax`;
    if (signedIn) await api('/api/me/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body: { onboarded: true } });
    router.replace(next);
  }

  const key = step === INSTALL_STEP ? 'install' : (STEPS[step] ?? 'value');
  const list = (k: string) => t.raw(k) as string[];

  return (
    <main
      id="main"
      className="mx-auto flex h-dvh w-full max-w-xl flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden px-5 py-4 sm:gap-6 sm:p-6"
    >
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between pt-1 text-sm text-fog">
        <p aria-live="polite">
          {t('step', {
            current: Math.min(step + 1, STEPS.length),
            total: STEPS.length,
          })}
        </p>
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={finish}>
          {t('skip')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1.5" aria-hidden="true">
        {STEPS.map((s, i) => (
          <span
            key={s}
            className={`h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full ${i <= step ? 'bg-accent' : 'bg-line'}`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <section
        className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain"
        aria-labelledby="onboarding-title"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 pb-4">
          {key === 'value' && (
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-accent">
              {t('value.eyebrow')}
            </p>
          )}
          <h1 id="onboarding-title" className="text-2xl font-bold leading-tight sm:text-3xl">
            {t(`${key}.title`)}
          </h1>
          {key === 'value' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('value.body')}</p>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {list('value.points').map((p) => (
                  <li
                    key={p}
                    className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel px-3 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed"
                  >
                    <span
                      className="mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-accent"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <span>{p}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'permissions' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-fog">{t('permissions.body')}</p>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                {(['camera', 'location', 'notifications'] as const).map((p) => (
                  <li key={p} className="rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3">
                    {t(`permissions.${p}`)}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'install' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-fog">{t('install.body')}</p>
              {platform === 'installed' && <Notice kind="success">{t('install.installed')}</Notice>}
              {platform === 'ios' && <Notice>{t('install.ios')}</Notice>}
              {platform === 'other' && (
                <>
                  <Notice>{t('install.android')}</Notice>
                  {prompt && (
                    <Button
                      onClick={async () => {
                        await prompt.prompt();
                        setPrompt(null);
                      }}
                    >
                      {t('install.button')}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('install.ios')}</p>
                </>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'rules' && (
            <>
              <ul className="flex list-disc flex-col gap-2 pl-5">
                {list('rules.points').map((p) => (
                  <li key={p}>{p}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <Link href="/legal/regles" className="underline">
                {t('rules.link')}
              </Link>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-3 border-t border-line bg-ink pt-3 pb-[max(0.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
        {step > 0 && (
          <Button variant="secondary" className="flex-1" onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)}>
            {t('back')}
          </Button>
        )}
        {step < STEPS.length - 1 ? (
          <Button className="flex-1" onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)}>
            {t('next')}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button className="flex-1" onClick={finish}>
            {t('finish')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useFormatter, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

interface OwnVideo {
  id: string;
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  status: 'processing' | 'active' | 'hidden' | 'removed' | 'expired' | 'rejected';
  created_at: string;
}

const statusColor: Record<OwnVideo['status'], string> = {
  processing: 'bg-sky-500',
  active: 'bg-green-500',
  hidden: 'bg-amber-500',
  removed: 'bg-alert',
  expired: 'bg-line',
  rejected: 'bg-alert',
};

async function fetchOwnVideos(): Promise<OwnVideo[] | null> {
  const res = await api<{ videos: OwnVideo[] }>('/api/me/videos');
  return res.ok ? res.data.videos : null;
}

/** Owner view: status of every publication (processing → active / rejected) and withdrawal. */
export function MyVideos() {
  const t = useTranslations('profile');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<OwnVideo[] | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(() => fetchOwnVideos().then((list) => list && setVideos(list)), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void fetchOwnVideos().then((list) => alive && list && setVideos(list));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Poll while something is processing so the status flips to active/rejected without reload.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!videos?.some((v) => v.status === 'processing')) return;
    const timer = setInterval(load, 4000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [videos, load]);

  async function withdraw(id: string) {
    if (!window.confirm(t('withdrawConfirm'))) return;
    const res = await api(`/api/videos/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE', body: {} });
    setMessage(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('withdrawn') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) void load();
  }

  if (!videos || videos.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="my-videos" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id="my-videos" className="text-lg font-semibold">
        {t('myVideos')}
      </h2>
      {message && <Notice kind={message.kind}>{message.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2" aria-live="polite">
        {videos.map((v) => (
          <li
            key={v.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3"
            data-testid="own-video"
            data-status={v.status}
          >
            <span
              className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${statusColor[v.status]}`}
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="truncate text-sm">
                <strong>{tc(v.category)}</strong> · {v.caption || '—'}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-fog">
                {t(`status.${v.status}`)} · {format.relativeTime(new Date(v.created_at), now)}
              </p>
            </div>
            {v.status !== 'removed' && (
              <Button variant="ghost" className="text-sm" onClick={() => withdraw(v.id)}>
                {t('withdraw')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { RADII_M } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import {
  currentPosition,
  isIos,
  isStandalone,
  pushSupported,
  swRegistration,
  urlBase64ToUint8Array,
} from '@/lib/platform';

type State = 'loading' | 'unsupported' | 'ios-install' | 'off' | 'on';

async function detectState(): Promise<State> {
  if (isIos() && !isStandalone()) return 'ios-install';
  if (!pushSupported()) return 'unsupported';
  const reg = await swRegistration();
  const sub = await reg?.pushManager.getSubscription();
  return sub ? 'on' : 'off';
}

export function PushSettings({
  notifyAlerts,
  defaultRadius,
}: {
  notifyAlerts: boolean;
  defaultRadius: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('push');
  const ts = useTranslations('settings.notifications');
  const tr = useTranslations('common.radius');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>('loading');
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(defaultRadius);
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState(notifyAlerts);
  const [primer, setPrimer] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void detectState().then((s) => alive && setState(s));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function enable() {
    setPrimer(false);
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      if ((await Notification.requestPermission()) !== 'granted') return setError(t('denied'));
      let pos: GeolocationPosition;
      try {
        pos = await currentPosition();
      } catch {
        return setError(t('noPosition'));
      }
      const reg = await swRegistration();
      if (!reg) return setError(errorText('generic'));
      const subscription =
        (await reg.pushManager.getSubscription()) ??
        (await reg.pushManager.subscribe({
          userVisibleOnly: true,
          applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array(clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY),
        }));
      const json = subscription.toJSON();
      const res = await api('/api/push/subscribe', {
        body: {
          subscription: { endpoint: json.endpoint, keys: json.keys },
          zone: { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude },
          radius,
        },
      });
      if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
      setState('on');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function disable() {
    setBusy(true);
    const reg = await swRegistration();
    const sub = await reg?.pushManager.getSubscription();
    if (sub) {
      await api('/api/push/subscribe', { method: 'DELETE', body: { endpoint: sub.endpoint } });
      await sub.unsubscribe();
    }
    setState('off');
    setBusy(false);
  }

  async function toggleAlerts(value: boolean) {
    setAlerts(value);
    const res = await api('/api/me/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body: { notifyAlerts: value } });
    if (!res.ok) setAlerts(!value);
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{ts('title')}</h2>
      <label className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span>
          {ts('alerts')}
          <span className="block text-xs text-fog">{ts('alertsHint')}</span>
        </span>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          className="h-6 w-6 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
          checked={alerts}
          onChange={(e) => toggleAlerts(e.target.checked)}
        />
      </label>

      <h3 className="font-medium">{t('title')}</h3>
      {state === 'unsupported' && <Notice>{t('unsupported')}</Notice>}
      {state === 'ios-install' && (
        <Notice>
          {t('iosInstall')}{' '}
          <Link href="/onboarding?step=install" className="underline">
            {t('iosInstallLink')}
          </Link>
        </Notice>
      )}
      {(state === 'off' || state === 'on') && (
        <>
          <Field label={t('radius')} htmlFor="push-radius">
            <select
              id="push-radius"
              className={inputClass}
              value={radius}
              onChange={(e) => setRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
              disabled={state === 'on'}
            >
              {RADII_M.map((r) => (
                <option key={r} value={r}>
                  {tr(String(r))}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog" aria-live="polite">
            {state === 'on' ? t('enabled', { radius: tr(String(radius)) }) : t('disabled')}
          </p>
          {state === 'off' ? (
            <Button onClick={() => setPrimer(true)} disabled={busy}>
              {t('enable')}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={disable} disabled={busy}>
              {t('disable')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}

      <PermissionPrimer
        open={primer}
        title={t('primer.title')}
        confirmLabel={t('primer.continue')}
        cancelLabel={t('primer.later')}
        onConfirm={enable}
        onCancel={() => setPrimer(false)}
      >
        <p>{t('primer.body')}</p>
        <ul className="list-disc pl-5">
          <li>{t('primer.notifications')}</li>
          <li>{t('primer.location')}</li>
        </ul>
      </PermissionPrimer>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { SerwistProvider, useSerwist } from '@serwist/turbopack/react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Registers the service worker (scope "/") and renders update / offline banners. */
export function PwaShell({ children, disable }: { children: ReactNode; disable: boolean }) {
  return (
    <SerwistProvider
      swUrl="/serwist/sw.js"
      disable={disable}
      options={{ scope: '/' }}
      reloadOnOnline={false}
    >
      {children}
      <UpdateBanner />
      <OfflineBanner />
    </SerwistProvider>
  );
}

function UpdateBanner() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.update');
  const { serwist } = useSerwist();
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(false);
  const accepted = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!serwist) return;
    const onWaiting = () => setWaiting(true);
    // Reload only after the user accepted an update, not on the very first install.
    const onControlling = () => {
      if (accepted.current) window.location.reload();
    };
    serwist.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
    serwist.addEventListener('controlling', onControlling);
    return () => {
      serwist.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
      serwist.removeEventListener('controlling', onControlling);
    };
  }, [serwist]);
  if (!waiting) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 bottom-24 z-50 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3 shadow-xl"
    >
      <p className="flex-1 text-sm">{t('available')}</p>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          accepted.current = true;
          serwist?.messageSkipWaiting();
        }}
        className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-accent px-3 font-semibold text-ink"
      >
        {t('reload')}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function OfflineBanner() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.offline');
  const [offline, setOffline] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOffline(!navigator.onLine);
    const timer = setTimeout(update, 0);
    window.addEventListener('online', update);
    window.addEventListener('offline', update);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('online', update);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', update);
    };
  }, []);
  if (!offline) return null;
  return (
    <p
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 bg-amber-500 px-3 py-1.5 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-ink"
    >
      {t('banner')}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { RADII_M } from '@nl/shared';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

type Status = { kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null;

export function ProfileForm({ username, bio }: { username: string; bio: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.profile');
  const tw = useTranslations('auth.welcome');
  const ta = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [values, setValues] = useState({ username, bio });
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: values });
    if (res.ok) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('saved') });
      router.refresh();
      return;
    }
    const text =
      res.error === 'conflict'
        ? tw('taken')
        : res.error === 'invalid_input'
          ? tw('invalid')
          : (errorText(res.error) ?? '');
    setStatus({ kind: 'error', text });
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
        <Field label={t('username')} htmlFor="s-username">
          <input
            id="s-username"
            className={inputClass}
            value={values.username}
            maxLength={20}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            onChange={(e) => setValues({ ...values, username: e.target.value.toLowerCase() })}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t('bio')} htmlFor="s-bio" hint={t('bioHint', { count: values.bio.length })}>
          <textarea
            id="s-bio"
            className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
            value={values.bio}
            maxLength={160}
            onChange={(e) => setValues({ ...values, bio: e.target.value })}
          />
        </Field>
        {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
        <Button type="submit">{ta('save')}</Button>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function DangerZone({ username }: { username: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.danger');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function remove() {
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/me', { method: 'DELETE', body: { confirm } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    router.replace('/?deleted=1');
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-alert/60">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-alert">{t('title')}</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('body')}</p>
      <Field label={t('confirmLabel', { username })} htmlFor="s-confirm" error={error}>
        <input
          id="s-confirm"
          className={inputClass}
          value={confirm}
          autoCapitalize="none"
          onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button
        variant="danger"
        disabled={pending || confirm.trim().toLowerCase() !== username}
        onClick={remove}
      >
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from 'react';

type Variant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'ghost';

const variants: Record<Variant, string> = {
  primary: 'bg-accent text-ink hover:bg-yellow-300 disabled:bg-yellow-200/60',
  secondary: 'bg-panel text-white border border-line hover:border-fog disabled:opacity-60',
  danger: 'bg-alert text-ink hover:bg-red-400 disabled:opacity-60',
  ghost: 'text-fog hover:text-white disabled:opacity-60',
};

export function Button({
  variant = 'primary',
  className = '',
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: Variant }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      {...props}
      className={`inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-semibold transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${variants[variant]} ${className}`}
    />
  );
}

export function Card({ children, className = '' }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <section className={`rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-4 ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

export function Field({
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  htmlFor,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string | null;
  htmlFor: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <label htmlFor={htmlFor} className="text-sm font-medium">
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
      {hint && !error && <p className="text-xs text-fog">{hint}</p>}
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export const inputClass =
  'min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-ink px-3 py-2 text-white placeholder:text-fog/70 focus:border-accent focus:outline-none';

export function Notice({
  kind = 'info',
  children,
}: {
  kind?: 'info' | 'error' | 'success';
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const color =
    kind === 'error'
      ? 'border-alert text-alert'
      : kind === 'success'
        ? 'border-green-500 text-green-300'
        : 'border-line text-fog';
  return (
    <p
      role={kind === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status'}
      className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-sm ${color}`}
    >
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';

/** Maps an API error code to a translated sentence (falls back to the generic message). */
export function useErrorText() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.errors');
  return (code: string | null | undefined) => {
    if (!code) return null;
    return t.has(code) ? t(code) : t('generic');
  };
}
```
