````
`scripts\db-start.mjs`:

```mjs
// `pnpm db:start`: local Supabase + env files + worker container + demo media.
// Idempotent: existing env files are never overwritten.
import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { generateKeyPairSync, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

const root = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..');
const isWin = process.platform === 'win32';
const run = (cmd, args, opts = {}) => {
  const res = spawnSync(cmd, args, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit', shell: isWin, ...opts });
  if (res.status !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd} ${args.join(' ')} failed (${res.status})`);
};

console.log('▶ Starting local Supabase…');
run('pnpm', ['exec', 'supabase', 'start', '-x', 'imgproxy,edge-runtime,logflare,vector,supavisor']);

const raw = execFileSync('pnpm', ['exec', 'supabase', 'status', '-o', 'json'], {
  cwd: root,
  shell: isWin,
  encoding: 'utf8',
});
const status = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'), raw.lastIndexOf('}') + 1));

/** VAPID keys are P-256 key pairs encoded as base64url (public key in uncompressed form). */
function vapidKeys() {
  const { publicKey, privateKey } = generateKeyPairSync('ec', { namedCurve: 'prime256v1' });
  const pub = publicKey.export({ format: 'jwk' });
  const priv = privateKey.export({ format: 'jwk' });
  const point = Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from([4]),
    Buffer.from(pub.x, 'base64url'),
    Buffer.from(pub.y, 'base64url'),
  ]);
  return { publicKey: point.toString('base64url'), privateKey: priv.d };
}

const webEnv = resolve(root, 'apps/web/.env.local');
const rootEnv = resolve(root, '.env');
if (!existsSync(webEnv) || !existsSync(rootEnv)) {
  const vapid = vapidKeys();
  const lines = [
    '# Generated by `pnpm db:start` for LOCAL development only. Not for production.',
    `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=${status.API_URL}`,
    `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=${status.ANON_KEY}`,
    'NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000',
    'NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL=https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty',
    `NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=${vapid.publicKey}`,
    `SUPABASE_URL=${status.API_URL}`,
    `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=${status.SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
    `DATABASE_URL=${status.DB_URL}`,
    `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=${vapid.privateKey}`,
    'VAPID_SUBJECT=mailto:contact@example.org',
    `IP_HASH_SALT=${randomBytes(24).toString('hex')}`,
    'WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1',
    'FACE_BLUR_ENABLED=true',
    'PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED=false',
    'PLATE_MODEL_PATH=',
  ];
  const content = lines.join('\n') + '\n';
  if (!existsSync(webEnv)) writeFileSync(webEnv, content);
  if (!existsSync(rootEnv)) writeFileSync(rootEnv, content);
  console.log('✔ Wrote apps/web/.env.local and .env');
} else if (!readFileSync(webEnv, 'utf8').includes(status.ANON_KEY)) {
  console.warn(
    '⚠ apps/web/.env.local does not match the running Supabase keys: delete it and rerun.',
  );
}

if (process.env.SKIP_WORKER !== '1') {
  console.log('▶ Building and starting the media worker (first build takes a few minutes)…');
  run('docker', ['compose', 'up', '-d', '--build', 'worker']);
}

console.log('▶ Uploading demo media…');
run('node', ['scripts/seed-media.mjs']);

console.log(`
✔ Ready.
  Web:      pnpm dev  →  http://localhost:3000
  Mailpit:  ${status.MAILPIT_URL ?? status.INBUCKET_URL}  (confirmation and recovery emails)
  Studio:   ${status.STUDIO_URL ?? 'disabled'}
  Demo accounts: lea@neighbors.test, modo.belleville@neighbors.test, admin@neighbors.test,
                 boulangerie@neighbors.test (see README)
`);

````

`scripts\seed-media.mjs`:

```mjs
// Generates the 6 demo clips referenced by supabase/seed.sql (demo/clip-N.mp4 + .jpg) with the
// worker image's ffmpeg, then uploads them to the private `videos` bucket.
// Clips are synthetic (test pattern + label + tone): no third-party footage, no rights issue.
import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';

const root = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..');
const outDir = resolve(root, '.demo-media');

// Demo media only ever go to the LOCAL stack: credentials come from `supabase status`, never
// from .env (which may point to a hosted project).
const raw = execFileSync('pnpm', ['exec', 'supabase', 'status', '-o', 'json'], {
  cwd: root,
  shell: process.platform === 'win32',
  encoding: 'utf8',
});
const status = JSON.parse(raw.slice(raw.indexOf('{'), raw.lastIndexOf('}') + 1));
const env = { SUPABASE_URL: status.API_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: status.SERVICE_ROLE_KEY };
if (!/^http:\/\/(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)(:\d+)?$/.test(env.SUPABASE_URL ?? '')) {
  throw new Error(`seed-media refuses non-local Supabase URL: ${env.SUPABASE_URL}`);
}

const clips = [
  [1, 'Alerte', '0'],
  [2, 'Bon plan', '120'],
  [3, 'Événement', '260'],
  [4, 'Entraide', '200'],
  [5, 'Objet trouvé', '40'],
  [6, 'Commerce', '300'],
];

mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
const missing = clips.filter(([n]) => !existsSync(resolve(outDir, `clip-${n}.mp4`)));
if (missing.length > 0) {
  const script = missing
    .map(
      ([n, label, hue]) =>
        `ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=size=720x1280:rate=30,hue=h=${hue}:s=0.6,drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf:text='Neighbors Live - démo':fontcolor=white:fontsize=44:x=(w-tw)/2:y=h*0.12:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.5,drawtext=fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf:text='${label}':fontcolor=white:fontsize=72:x=(w-tw)/2:y=h*0.8:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.5" ` +
        `-f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=${440 + Number(n) * 40}:sample_rate=48000" -t 8 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v main -c:a aac -b:a 96k -shortest -movflags +faststart /out/clip-${n}.mp4 && ` +
        `ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -ss 1 -i /out/clip-${n}.mp4 -frames:v 1 -q:v 4 /out/clip-${n}.jpg`,
    )
    .join(' && ');
  const res = spawnSync(
    'docker',
    [
      'compose',
      'run',
      '--rm',
      '--no-deps',
      '-v',
      `${outDir}:/out`,
      '--entrypoint',
      'sh',
      'worker',
      '-c',
      script,
    ],
    { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit', shell: false },
  );
  if (res.status !== 0) throw new Error('demo clip generation failed (is the worker image built?)');
}

for (const [n] of clips) {
  for (const [ext, type] of [
    ['mp4', 'video/mp4'],
    ['jpg', 'image/jpeg'],
  ]) {
    const body = readFileSync(resolve(outDir, `clip-${n}.${ext}`));
    const res = await fetch(`${env.SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/object/videos/demo/clip-${n}.${ext}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
        'Content-Type': type,
        'x-upsert': 'true',
      },
      body,
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`upload clip-${n}.${ext}: ${res.status} ${await res.text()}`);
  }
}
console.log(`✔ ${clips.length} demo clips uploaded to storage (bucket "videos", folder demo/)`);
```

```sql
-- Neighbors Live — core schema.
-- Exact positions live in videos.location and are only read by SECURITY DEFINER functions.
-- Everything public uses videos.public_location (snapped ~50 m grid + per-video offset).

create extension if not exists postgis with schema extensions;
create extension if not exists pg_cron;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Types
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create type public.video_category as enum ('alert', 'deal', 'event', 'help', 'shop', 'lost');
create type public.video_status as enum ('processing', 'active', 'hidden', 'removed', 'expired', 'rejected');
create type public.user_role as enum ('user', 'merchant', 'admin');
create type public.report_reason as enum (
  'recognizable_person', 'address_or_plate', 'dangerous', 'harassment', 'spam', 'false_info', 'other'
);
create type public.moderation_kind as enum (
  'validate', 'hide', 'remove', 'warn',       -- moderator decisions
  'auto_hide',                                -- report threshold reached
  'revert', 'ban', 'unban',                   -- admin
  'appeal_upheld', 'appeal_rejected'          -- appeal outcomes
);
create type public.appeal_status as enum ('pending', 'upheld', 'rejected');
create type public.job_kind as enum ('process', 'purge');
create type public.job_status as enum ('queued', 'running', 'done', 'failed');
create type public.merchant_status as enum ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected');

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Configuration (thresholds are data, not code)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.app_config (
  key text primary key,
  value jsonb not null,
  description text not null default ''
);

insert into public.app_config (key, value, description) values
  ('report_hide_threshold', '3', 'Distinct reporters before a video is auto-hidden'),
  ('moderator_min_account_days', '14', 'Minimum account age to become a zone moderator'),
  ('moderator_min_clean_videos', '5', 'Minimum published videos never reported'),
  ('moderator_min_reputation', '10', 'Minimum reputation to become a zone moderator'),
  ('merchant_daily_quota', '3', 'Merchant offers per rolling 24 h'),
  ('push_min_interval_minutes', '30', 'Minimum delay between two push notifications per user'),
  ('rate_publish', '{"limit": 5, "window_seconds": 3600}', 'Video publications per user'),
  ('rate_comment', '{"limit": 10, "window_seconds": 300}', 'Comments per user'),
  ('rate_report', '{"limit": 10, "window_seconds": 3600}', 'Reports per user'),
  ('rate_login', '{"limit": 5, "window_seconds": 900}', 'Magic link requests per IP hash / email');

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Profiles and settings
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.profiles (
  id uuid primary key references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  username text unique check (username ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{3,20}$'),
  bio text not null default '' check (char_length(bio) <= 160),
  avatar_color text not null default '#64748b' check (avatar_color ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$'),
  role public.user_role not null default 'user',
  reputation integer not null default 0,
  banned_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.user_settings (
  user_id uuid primary key references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  default_radius integer not null default 1000 check (default_radius in (300, 1000, 3000)),
  locale text not null default 'fr' check (locale in ('fr', 'en')),
  notify_alerts boolean not null default true,
  onboarded_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table public.merchant_profiles (
  user_id uuid primary key references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  business_name text not null check (char_length(business_name) between 2 and 80),
  description text not null default '' check (char_length(description) <= 280),
  status public.merchant_status not null default 'pending',
  daily_quota integer,
  reviewed_by uuid references public.profiles (id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Videos
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.videos (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  author_id uuid not null references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  category public.video_category not null,
  caption text not null default '' check (char_length(caption) <= 140),
  location extensions.geography (point, 4326) not null,
  public_location extensions.geography (point, 4326) not null,
  accuracy_m real not null check (accuracy_m > 0 and accuracy_m <= 100),
  h3_cell text not null check (h3_cell ~ '^[0-9a-f]{15}$'),
  realtime_cell text not null check (realtime_cell ~ '^[0-9a-f]{15}$'),
  status public.video_status not null default 'processing',
  hidden_reason text,
  is_merchant boolean not null default false,
  mime_type text not null check (mime_type in ('video/mp4', 'video/webm')),
  duration_ms integer not null check (duration_ms > 0 and duration_ms <= 31000),
  raw_path text,
  video_path text,
  poster_path text,
  useful_count integer not null default 0,
  comment_count integer not null default 0,
  report_count integer not null default 0,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  published_at timestamptz,
  expires_at timestamptz not null,
  check (expires_at > created_at and expires_at <= created_at + interval '7 days 1 minute')
);

create index videos_public_location_gix on public.videos using gist (public_location);
create index videos_location_gix on public.videos using gist (location);
create index videos_status_expires_idx on public.videos (status, expires_at);
create index videos_cell_status_idx on public.videos (h3_cell, status);
create index videos_author_idx on public.videos (author_id, created_at desc);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Media pipeline (consumed by apps/worker with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.media_jobs (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  -- No FK: purge jobs must outlive the deleted video row.
  video_id uuid,
  kind public.job_kind not null,
  status public.job_status not null default 'queued',
  payload jsonb not null default '{}',
  attempts integer not null default 0,
  max_attempts integer not null default 3,
  run_after timestamptz not null default now(),
  locked_at timestamptz,
  locked_by text,
  last_error text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index media_jobs_ready_idx on public.media_jobs (run_after) where status = 'queued';

create table public.notification_outbox (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  kind text not null check (kind in ('alert_nearby', 'video_rejected', 'video_removed', 'moderation_warning')),

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.reactions (

create table public.comments (

  video_id uuid not null references public.videos (id) on delete cascade,

-- Append-only journal. Ids are kept as plain uuids (no FK) so that the journal survives the
-- deletion of a video or an account, and so that no cascade ever rewrites history.
create table public.moderation_actions (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  video_id uuid,
  target_user_id uuid,
  h3_cell text,
  actor_id uuid,                 -- null = system (report threshold)
  kind public.moderation_kind not null,
  note text not null default '' check (char_length(note) <= 1000),
  reverts_action_id bigint references public.moderation_actions (id),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index moderation_actions_video_idx on public.moderation_actions (video_id);
create index moderation_actions_target_idx on public.moderation_actions (target_user_id);

create table public.appeals (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

  decision_note text not null default '',
  decided_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Push and rate limiting
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.push_subscriptions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  endpoint text not null unique check (endpoint ~ '^https://'),
  p256dh text not null,
  auth text not null,

  zone_cell text not null check (zone_cell ~ '^[0-9a-f]{15}$'),
  zone_center extensions.geography (point, 4326) not null,
  radius_m integer not null check (radius_m in (300, 1000, 3000)),
  last_notified_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index push_subscriptions_zone_gix on public.push_subscriptions using gist (zone_center);
create index push_subscriptions_user_idx on public.push_subscriptions (user_id);

create table public.rate_limits (
  key text not null,
  window_start timestamptz not null,
  count integer not null default 0,
  primary key (key, window_start)
);
```

```sql
-- Neighbors Live — functions and triggers.
-- Conventions:
--  * SECURITY DEFINER functions always `set search_path = ''` and fully qualify names.
--  * Functions taking an explicit actor (p_actor / p_user) are callable by service_role only:
--    the Next.js route handler resolves the actor from the verified session.
--  * Errors are raised with a stable machine-readable message (e.g. 'rate_limited').

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helpers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create function public.config_int(p_key text) returns integer
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select (value #>> '{}')::integer from public.app_config where key = p_key
$$;

language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$

$$;

-- Snap to a ~50 m grid, then add a deterministic per-video offset inside the cell.
-- The result never reveals more than "somewhere in this 50 m square".
create function public.public_point(p_id uuid, p_loc extensions.geography) returns extensions.geography
language plpgsql immutable set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_lat double precision := extensions.st_y(p_loc::extensions.geometry);
  v_lng double precision := extensions.st_x(p_loc::extensions.geometry);
  v_step_lat constant double precision := 0.00045;
  v_step_lng double precision := 0.00045 / greatest(cos(radians(v_lat)), 0.01);
  v_off_lat double precision := ((hashtext(p_id::text) & 1023)::double precision / 1024 - 0.5) * v_step_lat;
  v_off_lng double precision := ((hashtext(reverse(p_id::text)) & 1023)::double precision / 1024 - 0.5) * v_step_lng;
begin
  return extensions.st_setsrid(
    extensions.st_makepoint(
      round(v_lng / v_step_lng) * v_step_lng + v_off_lng,
      round(v_lat / v_step_lat) * v_step_lat + v_off_lat
    ),
    4326
  )::extensions.geography;
end
$$;

create function public.bucket_distance(p_meters double precision) returns integer
language sql immutable set search_path = '' as $$

-- Fixed-window counter. Raises 'rate_limited' when the configured limit is exceeded.
-- The increment is rolled back with the failing statement, so a blocked key stays at its limit.
create function public.check_rate_limit(p_key text, p_rule text) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_rule jsonb := (select value from public.app_config where key = 'rate_' || p_rule);
  v_window integer := coalesce((v_rule ->> 'window_seconds')::integer, 3600);
  v_limit integer := coalesce((v_rule ->> 'limit')::integer, 10);
  v_start timestamptz := to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from now()) / v_window) * v_window);
  v_count integer;
begin
  insert into public.rate_limits as r (key, window_start, count)
  values (p_rule || ':' || p_key, v_start, 1)
  on conflict (key, window_start) do update set count = r.count + 1
  returning count into v_count;
  if v_count > v_limit then
    raise exception 'rate_limited' using hint = p_rule;
  end if;
end
$$;

create function public.create_video(
  p_author uuid,
  p_category public.video_category,
  p_caption text,
  p_lat double precision,
  p_lng double precision,
  p_accuracy real,
  p_h3_cell text,
  p_realtime_cell text,
  p_mime text,
  p_duration_ms integer,
  p_expires_at timestamptz
) returns uuid
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_profile public.profiles;
  v_point extensions.geography := extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(p_lng, p_lat), 4326)::extensions.geography;
  v_last record;
  v_quota integer;
  v_id uuid;
begin
  select * into v_profile from public.profiles where id = p_author;
  if not found or v_profile.username is null then raise exception 'profile_incomplete'; end if;
  if v_profile.banned_at is not null then raise exception 'banned'; end if;
  if p_accuracy is null or p_accuracy > 100 or p_accuracy <= 0 then raise exception 'accuracy_too_low'; end if;

  -- Position coherence: no physically impossible jump since the author's previous publication.
  select v.created_at, v.location into v_last
  from public.videos v where v.author_id = p_author order by v.created_at desc limit 1;
  if found and v_last.created_at > now() - interval '6 hours'
     and extensions.st_distance(v_last.location, v_point)
         / greatest(extract(epoch from now() - v_last.created_at), 1) > 70 then
    raise exception 'position_incoherent';
  end if;

  if p_category = 'shop' then
    select coalesce(m.daily_quota, public.config_int('merchant_daily_quota')) into v_quota
    from public.merchant_profiles m where m.user_id = p_author and m.status = 'approved';
    if v_quota is null then raise exception 'not_merchant'; end if;
    if (select count(*) from public.videos v
        where v.author_id = p_author and v.is_merchant and v.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') >= v_quota then
      raise exception 'merchant_quota_exceeded';
    end if;
  end if;

  perform public.check_rate_limit(p_author::text, 'publish');

  insert into public.videos (
    author_id, category, caption, location, public_location, accuracy_m, h3_cell, realtime_cell,
    is_merchant, mime_type, duration_ms, expires_at
  ) values (
    p_author, p_category, p_caption, v_point, v_point, p_accuracy, p_h3_cell, p_realtime_cell,
    p_category = 'shop', p_mime, p_duration_ms, p_expires_at
  ) returning id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end
$$;

create function public.on_video_activated() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if new.status = 'active' and old.status = 'processing' and new.category = 'alert' then
    begin
      perform realtime.send(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', new.id, 'category', new.category, 'caption', new.caption,
          'lat', extensions.st_y(new.public_location::extensions.geometry),
          'lng', extensions.st_x(new.public_location::extensions.geometry)

      -- Realtime is best effort: never block a publication because broadcasting failed.
      raise warning 'realtime.send failed: %', sqlerrm;

  end if;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Worker job protocol
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create function public.claim_media_job(p_worker text) returns setof public.media_jobs
language sql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  update public.media_jobs j
  set status = 'running', locked_at = now(), locked_by = p_worker, attempts = j.attempts + 1, updated_at = now()
  where j.id = (
    select id from public.media_jobs
    where (status = 'queued' and run_after <= now())
       or (status = 'running' and locked_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')
    order by run_after, id
    for update skip locked
    limit 1
  )
  returning j.*
$$;

create function public.complete_process_job(p_job bigint, p_video_path text, p_poster_path text) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_video uuid;
begin
  update public.media_jobs set status = 'done', updated_at = now(), last_error = null
  where id = p_job and kind = 'process' returning video_id into v_video;
  if not found then raise exception 'job_not_found'; end if;
  update public.videos
  set video_path = p_video_path, poster_path = p_poster_path, raw_path = null,
      status = 'active', published_at = now()
  where id = v_video and status = 'processing';
end
$$;

create function public.complete_job(p_job bigint) returns void
language sql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  update public.media_jobs set status = 'done', updated_at = now(), last_error = null where id = p_job
$$;

-- Exponential backoff (30 s, 60 s, 120 s…); after max_attempts the video is rejected.
create function public.fail_media_job(p_job bigint, p_error text) returns public.job_status
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_job public.media_jobs;
  v_raw text;
begin
  select * into v_job from public.media_jobs where id = p_job for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'job_not_found'; end if;
  if v_job.attempts < v_job.max_attempts then
    update public.media_jobs
    set status = 'queued', last_error = left(p_error, 2000), locked_at = null, locked_by = null,
        run_after = now() + make_interval(secs => 30 * power(2, v_job.attempts - 1)), updated_at = now()
    where id = p_job;
    return 'queued';
  end if;

  update public.media_jobs set status = 'failed', last_error = left(p_error, 2000), updated_at = now() where id = p_job;
  if v_job.kind = 'process' then
    update public.videos set status = 'rejected', hidden_reason = 'processing_failed'
    where id = v_job.video_id and status = 'processing'
    returning raw_path into v_raw;
    if found then
      insert into public.notification_outbox (kind, user_id, video_id)
      select 'video_rejected', v.author_id, v.id from public.videos v where v.id = v_job.video_id;
    end if;
    if v_raw is not null then
      insert into public.media_jobs (video_id, kind, payload) values (v_job.video_id, 'purge', jsonb_build_object('paths', array[v_raw]));
    end if;
  end if;
  return 'failed';
end
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Expiry (scheduled with pg_cron)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create function public.expire_videos() returns integer
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  -- Clean publications earn reputation once they expire.
  update public.profiles p set reputation = p.reputation + sub.n
  from (
    select author_id, count(*)::integer as n from public.videos
    where status = 'active' and expires_at <= now() and report_count = 0
    group by author_id
  ) sub
  where p.id = sub.author_id;

  with targets as (
    select id, array_remove(array[video_path, poster_path, raw_path], null) as paths
    from public.videos
    where status in ('active', 'hidden') and expires_at <= now()
    for update
  ), expired as (
    update public.videos v
    set status = 'expired', video_path = null, poster_path = null, raw_path = null
    from targets t where v.id = t.id
    returning t.id, t.paths
  ), jobs as (
    insert into public.media_jobs (video_id, kind, payload)
    select id, 'purge', jsonb_build_object('paths', paths) from expired where cardinality(paths) > 0
  )
  select count(*) into v_count from expired;

  -- Uploads that never completed or got stuck.
  update public.videos set status = 'rejected', hidden_reason = 'upload_timeout'
  where status = 'processing' and created_at < now() - interval '2 hours';

  delete from public.rate_limits where window_start < now() - interval '1 day';
  return v_count;
end
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Feed and map (public, position-safe: everything uses public_location)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create function public.nearby_videos(
  p_lat double precision,
  p_lng double precision,
  p_radius_m integer,
  p_category public.video_category default null,
  p_cursor_score double precision default null,
  p_cursor_id uuid default null,
  p_ref_time timestamptz default now(),
  p_limit integer default 10
) returns table (
  id uuid,
  author_id uuid,
  author_username text,
  author_color text,
  author_is_merchant boolean,
  category public.video_category,
  caption text,
  published_at timestamptz,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  useful_count integer,
  comment_count integer,
  is_merchant boolean,
  public_lat double precision,
  public_lng double precision,
  distance_m integer,
  score double precision
)
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_origin extensions.geography;
begin
  if p_radius_m not in (300, 1000, 3000) then raise exception 'radius_invalid'; end if;
  if p_lat not between -90 and 90 or p_lng not between -180 and 180 then raise exception 'position_invalid'; end if;
  v_origin := extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(p_lng, p_lat), 4326)::extensions.geography;

  return query
  with base as (
    select v.*, extensions.st_distance(v.public_location, v_origin) as d
    from public.videos v
    where v.status = 'active'
      and v.expires_at > now()
      and extensions.st_dwithin(v.public_location, v_origin, p_radius_m)
      and (p_category is null or v.category = p_category)
  ), scored as (
    -- Scores are computed against a fixed reference time carried by the cursor, so pages stay
    -- consistent while time passes (freshness half-life ~8 h).
    select b.*,
      (exp(-greatest(extract(epoch from (p_ref_time - coalesce(b.published_at, b.created_at))), 0) / 43200.0)
        * (1 + 0.3 * ln(1 + b.useful_count))
        * (1 - 0.5 * least(b.d / p_radius_m, 1)))::double precision as s
    from base b
  )
  select sc.id, sc.author_id, p.username, p.avatar_color, p.role = 'merchant',
         sc.category, sc.caption, sc.published_at, sc.expires_at, sc.useful_count, sc.comment_count,
         sc.is_merchant,
         extensions.st_y(sc.public_location::extensions.geometry),
         extensions.st_x(sc.public_location::extensions.geometry),
         public.bucket_distance(sc.d), sc.s
  from scored sc
  join public.profiles p on p.id = sc.author_id
  where p_cursor_score is null or (sc.s, sc.id) < (p_cursor_score, p_cursor_id)
  order by sc.s desc, sc.id desc
  limit least(greatest(p_limit, 1), 20);
end
$$;

create function public.map_videos(
  p_lat double precision,
  p_lng double precision,
  p_radius_m integer,
  p_category public.video_category default null
) returns table (id uuid, category public.video_category, caption text, public_lat double precision, public_lng double precision)
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_origin extensions.geography;
begin
  if p_radius_m not in (300, 1000, 3000) then raise exception 'radius_invalid'; end if;
  v_origin := extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(p_lng, p_lat), 4326)::extensions.geography;
  return query
  select v.id, v.category, v.caption,
         extensions.st_y(v.public_location::extensions.geometry),
         extensions.st_x(v.public_location::extensions.geometry)
  from public.videos v
  where v.status = 'active' and v.expires_at > now()
    and extensions.st_dwithin(v.public_location, v_origin, p_radius_m)
    and (p_category is null or v.category = p_category)
  order by v.published_at desc nulls last
  limit 500;
end
$$;

  caption text, published_at timestamptz, expires_at timestamptz, useful_count integer,

language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$

    update public.videos set useful_count = useful_count + 1 where id = new.video_id;
  else
    update public.videos set useful_count = greatest(useful_count - 1, 0) where id = old.video_id;
  end if;
  return null;
end
$$;
create trigger reactions_count after insert or delete on public.reactions
  for each row execute function public.reactions_count();

    raise exception 'video_not_active';
  end if;
  perform public.check_rate_limit(new.author_id::text, 'comment');
  return new;
end
$$;
create trigger comments_before_insert before insert on public.comments
  for each row execute function public.comments_before_insert();

language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reports and auto-hide
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create function public.apply_report_threshold(p_video uuid) returns boolean
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_reporters integer;
  v_video public.videos;
begin
  select count(distinct reporter_id) into v_reporters
  from public.reports where video_id = p_video and resolved_at is null;
  update public.videos set report_count = v_reporters where id = p_video returning * into v_video;
  if v_video.status = 'active' and v_reporters >= public.config_int('report_hide_threshold') then
    update public.videos set status = 'hidden', hidden_reason = 'reports' where id = p_video;
    insert into public.moderation_actions (video_id, target_user_id, h3_cell, actor_id, kind, note)
    values (p_video, v_video.author_id, v_video.h3_cell, null, 'auto_hide',
            v_reporters || ' signalements de comptes distincts');
    return true;
  end if;
  return false;
end
$$;

create function public.reports_before_insert() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  perform public.check_rate_limit(new.reporter_id::text, 'report');
  return new;
end
$$;
create trigger reports_before_insert before insert on public.reports
  for each row execute function public.reports_before_insert();

create function public.reports_after_insert() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  perform public.apply_report_threshold(new.video_id);
  return null;
end
$$;
create trigger reports_after_insert after insert on public.reports
  for each row execute function public.reports_after_insert();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Moderation
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create function public.moderation_actions_immutable() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  raise exception 'moderation_actions is append-only';
end
$$;
create trigger moderation_actions_no_update before update or delete on public.moderation_actions
  for each row execute function public.moderation_actions_immutable();
create trigger moderation_actions_no_truncate before truncate on public.moderation_actions
  for each statement execute function public.moderation_actions_immutable();

create function public.moderator_eligible(p_user uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = p_user
      and p.banned_at is null
      and p.created_at <= now() - make_interval(days => public.config_int('moderator_min_account_days'))
      and p.reputation >= public.config_int('moderator_min_reputation')
      and (select count(*) from public.videos v
           where v.author_id = p.id and v.status in ('active', 'expired')
             and not exists (select 1 from public.reports r where r.video_id = v.id))
          >= public.config_int('moderator_min_clean_videos')
  )
$$;

-- A user becomes moderator of a zone where they have already published.
create function public.become_zone_moderator(p_user uuid, p_cell text) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not public.moderator_eligible(p_user) then raise exception 'not_eligible'; end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from public.videos where author_id = p_user and h3_cell = p_cell and status in ('active', 'expired')) then
    raise exception 'not_local';
  end if;
  insert into public.zone_moderators (user_id, h3_cell) values (p_user, p_cell) on conflict do nothing;
end
$$;

create function public.moderate_video(
  p_actor uuid, p_video uuid, p_kind public.moderation_kind, p_note text default ''
) returns bigint
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_video public.videos;
  v_action bigint;
  v_note text := coalesce(trim(p_note), '');
begin
  if p_kind not in ('validate', 'hide', 'remove', 'warn') then raise exception 'invalid_action'; end if;
  select * into v_video from public.videos where id = p_video for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'not_found'; end if;
  if not (public.is_admin(p_actor) or public.is_zone_moderator(p_actor, v_video.h3_cell)) then
    raise exception 'forbidden';
  end if;
  if v_video.author_id = p_actor then raise exception 'conflict_of_interest'; end if;
  if p_kind = 'remove' and char_length(v_note) < 3 then raise exception 'note_required'; end if;

  if p_kind = 'validate' then
    update public.videos set status = 'active', hidden_reason = null, report_count = 0
    where id = p_video and status = 'hidden' and expires_at > now();
    -- Unfounded reports cost their authors.
    update public.profiles set reputation = reputation - 1
    where id in (select reporter_id from public.reports where video_id = p_video and resolved_at is null);
  elsif p_kind in ('hide', 'remove') then
    update public.videos
    set status = case when p_kind = 'hide' then 'hidden'::public.video_status else 'removed'::public.video_status end,
        hidden_reason = 'moderator'
    where id = p_video;
    update public.profiles set reputation = reputation + 1
    where id in (select reporter_id from public.reports where video_id = p_video and resolved_at is null);
  end if;

  update public.profiles
  set reputation = reputation - public.moderation_penalty(p_kind) + (case when p_kind = 'validate' then 1 else 0 end)
  where id = v_video.author_id;
  update public.reports set resolved_at = now() where video_id = p_video and resolved_at is null;

  insert into public.moderation_actions (video_id, target_user_id, h3_cell, actor_id, kind, note)
  values (p_video, v_video.author_id, v_video.h3_cell, p_actor, p_kind, v_note)
  returning id into v_action;

  if p_kind = 'remove' then
    -- Files are kept (private) during the 7-day appeal window, then purged.
    insert into public.media_jobs (video_id, kind, payload, run_after)
    values (p_video, 'purge',
            jsonb_build_object('paths', array_remove(array[v_video.video_path, v_video.poster_path, v_video.raw_path], null), 'action_id', v_action),
            now() + interval '7 days');
    insert into public.notification_outbox (kind, user_id, video_id) values ('video_removed', v_video.author_id, p_video);
  elsif p_kind = 'warn' then
    insert into public.notification_outbox (kind, user_id, video_id, payload)
    values ('moderation_warning', v_video.author_id, p_video, jsonb_build_object('note', v_note));
  end if;
  return v_action;
end
$$;

create function public.moderation_queue(p_actor uuid, p_cell text) returns table (
  video_id uuid, category public.video_category, caption text, status public.video_status,
  hidden_reason text, report_count integer, reasons public.report_reason[], created_at timestamptz,
  author_username text, video_path text, poster_path text
)
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not (public.is_admin(p_actor) or public.is_zone_moderator(p_actor, p_cell)) then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  return query
  select v.id, v.category, v.caption, v.status, v.hidden_reason, v.report_count,
         array(select distinct r.reason from public.reports r where r.video_id = v.id and r.resolved_at is null),
         v.created_at, p.username, v.video_path, v.poster_path
  from public.videos v join public.profiles p on p.id = v.author_id
  where v.h3_cell = p_cell
    and v.author_id <> p_actor
    and (v.status = 'hidden' or (v.status = 'active' and exists (
      select 1 from public.reports r where r.video_id = v.id and r.resolved_at is null)))
  order by v.status = 'hidden' desc, v.report_count desc, v.created_at;
end
$$;

-- Appeals are reviewed by an admin or a moderator of the zone who did not take the decision.
create function public.resolve_appeal(p_reviewer uuid, p_appeal uuid, p_uphold boolean, p_note text default '')
returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_appeal public.appeals;
  v_action public.moderation_actions;
begin
  select * into v_appeal from public.appeals where id = p_appeal for update;
  if not found or v_appeal.status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'not_found'; end if;
  select * into v_action from public.moderation_actions where id = v_appeal.action_id;
  if v_action.actor_id is not distinct from p_reviewer or v_action.target_user_id = p_reviewer then
    raise exception 'conflict_of_interest';
  end if;
  if not (public.is_admin(p_reviewer) or public.is_zone_moderator(p_reviewer, v_action.h3_cell)) then
    raise exception 'forbidden';
  end if;

  update public.appeals
  set status = case when p_uphold then 'upheld'::public.appeal_status else 'rejected'::public.appeal_status end,
      reviewer_id = p_reviewer, decision_note = coalesce(p_note, ''), decided_at = now()
  where id = p_appeal;

  if p_uphold then
    update public.videos set status = 'active', hidden_reason = null, report_count = 0
    where id = v_action.video_id and status in ('hidden', 'removed') and expires_at > now();
    delete from public.media_jobs
    where kind = 'purge' and status = 'queued' and (payload ->> 'action_id')::bigint = v_action.id;
    update public.profiles set reputation = reputation + public.moderation_penalty(v_action.kind)
    where id = v_action.target_user_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.moderation_actions (video_id, target_user_id, h3_cell, actor_id, kind, note, reverts_action_id)
  values (v_action.video_id, v_action.target_user_id, v_action.h3_cell, p_reviewer,
          case when p_uphold then 'appeal_upheld'::public.moderation_kind else 'appeal_rejected'::public.moderation_kind end,
          coalesce(p_note, ''), case when p_uphold then v_action.id end);
end
$$;

create function public.appeals_queue(p_reviewer uuid) returns table (
  appeal_id uuid, reason text, created_at timestamptz, action_kind public.moderation_kind,
  action_note text, video_id uuid, h3_cell text, caption text, video_path text, poster_path text
)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select a.id, a.reason, a.created_at, m.kind, m.note, m.video_id, m.h3_cell, v.caption, v.video_path, v.poster_path
  from public.appeals a
  join public.moderation_actions m on m.id = a.action_id
  left join public.videos v on v.id = m.video_id
  where a.status = 'pending'
    and m.actor_id is distinct from p_reviewer
    and m.target_user_id <> p_reviewer
    and (public.is_admin(p_reviewer) or public.is_zone_moderator(p_reviewer, m.h3_cell))
  order by a.created_at
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Admin
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create function public.admin_revert_action(p_admin uuid, p_action bigint, p_note text) returns bigint
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_action public.moderation_actions;
  v_new bigint;
begin
  if not public.is_admin(p_admin) then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  if char_length(coalesce(trim(p_note), '')) < 3 then raise exception 'note_required'; end if;
  select * into v_action from public.moderation_actions where id = p_action;
  if not found then raise exception 'not_found'; end if;

  if v_action.kind in ('hide', 'remove', 'auto_hide') then
    update public.videos set status = 'active', hidden_reason = null, report_count = 0
    where id = v_action.video_id and status in ('hidden', 'removed') and expires_at > now();
    delete from public.media_jobs
    where kind = 'purge' and status = 'queued' and (payload ->> 'action_id')::bigint = v_action.id;
    update public.profiles set reputation = reputation + public.moderation_penalty(v_action.kind)
    where id = v_action.target_user_id;
  elsif v_action.kind = 'validate' then
    update public.videos set status = 'hidden', hidden_reason = 'admin' where id = v_action.video_id and status = 'active';
  elsif v_action.kind = 'warn' then
    update public.profiles set reputation = reputation + public.moderation_penalty('warn') where id = v_action.target_user_id;
  elsif v_action.kind = 'ban' then
    update public.profiles set banned_at = null where id = v_action.target_user_id;
  else
    raise exception 'not_revertible';
  end if;

  insert into public.moderation_actions (video_id, target_user_id, h3_cell, actor_id, kind, note, reverts_action_id)
  values (v_action.video_id, v_action.target_user_id, v_action.h3_cell, p_admin, 'revert', trim(p_note), v_action.id)
  returning id into v_new;
  return v_new;
end
$$;

create function public.admin_set_ban(p_admin uuid, p_user uuid, p_banned boolean, p_note text) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not public.is_admin(p_admin) then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  if p_admin = p_user then raise exception 'conflict_of_interest'; end if;
  if char_length(coalesce(trim(p_note), '')) < 3 then raise exception 'note_required'; end if;
  update public.profiles set banned_at = case when p_banned then now() end where id = p_user;
  if not found then raise exception 'not_found'; end if;
  if p_banned then
    update public.videos set status = 'hidden', hidden_reason = 'banned' where author_id = p_user and status = 'active';
    delete from public.push_subscriptions where user_id = p_user;
  end if;
  insert into public.moderation_actions (target_user_id, actor_id, kind, note)
  values (p_user, p_admin, case when p_banned then 'ban'::public.moderation_kind else 'unban'::public.moderation_kind end, trim(p_note));
end
$$;

create function public.admin_review_merchant(p_admin uuid, p_user uuid, p_approve boolean) returns void
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not public.is_admin(p_admin) then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  update public.merchant_profiles
  set status = case when p_approve then 'approved'::public.merchant_status else 'rejected'::public.merchant_status end,
      reviewed_by = p_admin
  where user_id = p_user;
  if not found then raise exception 'not_found'; end if;
  update public.profiles set role = case when p_approve then 'merchant'::public.user_role else 'user'::public.user_role end
  where id = p_user and role <> 'admin';
end
$$;

create function public.admin_stats(p_admin uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not public.is_admin(p_admin) then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'users', (select count(*) from public.profiles),
    'banned', (select count(*) from public.profiles where banned_at is not null),
    'active_videos', (select count(*) from public.videos where status = 'active' and expires_at > now()),
    'hidden_videos', (select count(*) from public.videos where status = 'hidden'),
    'open_reports', (select count(*) from public.reports where resolved_at is null),
    'pending_appeals', (select count(*) from public.appeals where status = 'pending'),
    'pending_merchants', (select count(*) from public.merchant_profiles where status = 'pending'),
    'zones', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(z order by z.open_reports desc) from (
        select v.h3_cell,
               count(*) filter (where v.status = 'active') as active,
               count(*) filter (where v.status = 'hidden') as hidden,
               (select count(*) from public.reports r join public.videos v2 on v2.id = r.video_id
                where v2.h3_cell = v.h3_cell and r.resolved_at is null) as open_reports,
               (select count(*) from public.zone_moderators zm where zm.h3_cell = v.h3_cell) as moderators
        from public.videos v group by v.h3_cell
      ) z), '[]')
  );
end
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Notifications (worker)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Takes a batch of pending outbox rows; SKIP LOCKED lets several workers share the outbox.
create function public.claim_outbox(p_limit integer default 100) returns setof public.notification_outbox
language sql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  update public.notification_outbox o
  set processed_at = now(), attempts = o.attempts + 1
  where o.id in (
    select id from public.notification_outbox
    where processed_at is null
    order by created_at
    for update skip locked
    limit p_limit
  )
  returning o.*
$$;

-- Groups a batch of alerts per user: one notification per user (on each of their devices)
-- listing every alert of the batch inside one of their zones. Users notified less than
-- `push_min_interval_minutes` ago are skipped (they still see the alerts in the feed banner);
-- the chosen users are stamped atomically so concurrent workers cannot double-send.
create function public.claim_alert_recipients(p_videos uuid[]) returns table (
  subscription_id uuid, user_id uuid, endpoint text, p256dh text, auth text,
  video_ids uuid[], captions text[]
)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_interval interval := make_interval(mins => public.config_int('push_min_interval_minutes'));
begin
  return query
  with alerts as (
    select v.id, v.author_id, v.caption, v.public_location from public.videos v
    where v.id = any (p_videos) and v.status = 'active' and v.expires_at > now()
  ), matches as (
    select distinct s.user_id, a.id as video_id, a.caption
    from public.push_subscriptions s
    join public.user_settings us on us.user_id = s.user_id and us.notify_alerts
    join public.profiles p on p.id = s.user_id and p.banned_at is null
    join alerts a on a.author_id <> s.user_id
      and extensions.st_dwithin(s.zone_center, a.public_location, s.radius_m)
  ), per_user as (
    select m.user_id, array_agg(m.video_id order by m.video_id) as video_ids, array_agg(m.caption order by m.video_id) as captions
    from matches m
    where not exists (
      select 1 from public.push_subscriptions s2
      where s2.user_id = m.user_id and s2.last_notified_at > now() - v_interval)
    group by m.user_id
  ), stamped as (
    update public.push_subscriptions s set last_notified_at = now()
    from per_user u where s.user_id = u.user_id
    returning s.id, s.user_id, s.endpoint, s.p256dh, s.auth
  )
  select st.id, st.user_id, st.endpoint, st.p256dh, st.auth, u.video_ids, u.captions
  from stamped st join per_user u on u.user_id = st.user_id;
end
$$;

-- Subscriptions of one user (rejection / moderation notices are not rate limited).
create function public.user_push_targets(p_user uuid) returns table (subscription_id uuid, endpoint text, p256dh text, auth text)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select id, endpoint, p256dh, auth from public.push_subscriptions where user_id = p_user
$$;
```

```sql
-- Neighbors Live — privileges and Row Level Security.
-- Principle: deny by default. Table privileges are revoked from anon/authenticated and granted
-- back column by column; RLS policies then restrict rows. Sensitive mutations go through
-- SECURITY DEFINER functions executable by service_role only.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reset privileges
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
revoke all on all tables in schema public from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on all sequences in schema public from anon, authenticated;
revoke execute on all functions in schema public from public, anon, authenticated;
alter default privileges in schema public revoke all on tables from anon, authenticated;
alter default privileges in schema public revoke execute on functions from public, anon, authenticated;

grant all on all tables in schema public to service_role;
grant all on all sequences in schema public to service_role;
grant execute on all functions in schema public to service_role;

-- Helpers used inside policies run with the caller's privileges.
grant execute on function public.is_admin(uuid), public.is_banned(uuid),
  public.is_zone_moderator(uuid, text), public.can_upload_raw(text) to anon, authenticated;

  public.moderator_eligible(uuid)
to anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enable RLS everywhere
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

alter table public.user_settings enable row level security;
alter table public.merchant_profiles enable row level security;
alter table public.videos enable row level security;

alter table public.notification_outbox enable row level security;
alter table public.reactions enable row level security;

alter table public.moderation_actions enable row level security;
alter table public.appeals enable row level security;
alter table public.push_subscriptions enable row level security;
alter table public.rate_limits enable row level security;

-- media_jobs, notification_outbox, rate_limits: no grant, no policy (service_role only).

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- app_config: public read
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select on public.app_config to anon, authenticated;
create policy app_config_read on public.app_config for select to anon, authenticated using (true);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- profiles: public card, owner edits username/bio
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select (id, username, bio, avatar_color, role, reputation, created_at) on public.profiles to anon, authenticated;
grant update (username, bio) on public.profiles to authenticated;

create policy profiles_read on public.profiles for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
create policy profiles_update_own on public.profiles for update to authenticated
  using (id = (select auth.uid()))
  with check (id = (select auth.uid()) and not public.is_banned());

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- user_settings: owner only
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select on public.user_settings to authenticated;
grant update (default_radius, locale, notify_alerts, onboarded_at, updated_at) on public.user_settings to authenticated;
create policy user_settings_read_own on public.user_settings for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy user_settings_update_own on public.user_settings for update to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid())) with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- merchant_profiles: approved ones are public; owner applies and edits texts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select (user_id, business_name, description, status, created_at) on public.merchant_profiles to anon, authenticated;
grant insert (user_id, business_name, description) on public.merchant_profiles to authenticated;
grant update (business_name, description) on public.merchant_profiles to authenticated;

create policy merchant_read on public.merchant_profiles for select to anon, authenticated
  using (status = 'approved' or user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy merchant_apply_own on public.merchant_profiles for insert to authenticated
  with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()) and not public.is_banned());
create policy merchant_update_own on public.merchant_profiles for update to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid())) with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()) and not public.is_banned());

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- videos: no location columns, no storage paths; active ones public, owner sees all of theirs
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select (id, author_id, category, caption, h3_cell, status, hidden_reason, is_merchant, duration_ms,
              useful_count, comment_count, report_count, created_at, published_at, expires_at)
  on public.videos to anon, authenticated;

create policy videos_read_active on public.videos for select to anon, authenticated
  using ((status = 'active' and expires_at > now()) or author_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- reactions: owner only
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select, delete on public.reactions to authenticated;
grant insert (video_id, user_id) on public.reactions to authenticated;

create policy reactions_read_own on public.reactions for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy reactions_insert_own on public.reactions for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = (select auth.uid()) and not public.is_banned()
    and exists (select 1 from public.videos v where v.id = video_id and v.status = 'active' and v.expires_at > now())
  );
create policy reactions_delete_own on public.reactions for delete to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- comments: readable on visible videos; author writes and deletes their own
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select (id, video_id, author_id, body, created_at) on public.comments to anon, authenticated;
grant insert (video_id, author_id, body) on public.comments to authenticated;
grant delete on public.comments to authenticated;

create policy comments_read on public.comments for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.videos v where v.id = video_id));
create policy comments_insert_own on public.comments for insert to authenticated
  with check (author_id = (select auth.uid()) and not public.is_banned());
create policy comments_delete_own on public.comments for delete to authenticated
  using (author_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- reports: reporter creates and sees their own; cannot report own or invisible videos
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select (id, video_id, reason, created_at) on public.reports to authenticated;
grant insert (video_id, reporter_id, reason, details) on public.reports to authenticated;

create policy reports_read_own on public.reports for select to authenticated
  using (reporter_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy reports_insert_own on public.reports for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    reporter_id = (select auth.uid()) and not public.is_banned()
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.videos v
      where v.id = video_id and v.status = 'active' and v.author_id <> (select auth.uid())
    )
  );

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- zone_moderators: public (moderator badge); writes through become_zone_moderator()
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select on public.zone_moderators to anon, authenticated;
create policy zone_moderators_read on public.zone_moderators for select to anon, authenticated using (true);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- moderation_actions: a user sees the decisions about them; writes via functions only
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select (id, video_id, target_user_id, kind, note, created_at) on public.moderation_actions to authenticated;
create policy moderation_actions_read_target on public.moderation_actions for select to authenticated
  using (target_user_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- appeals: author contests a recent decision about them, once
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select on public.appeals to authenticated;
grant insert (action_id, author_id, reason) on public.appeals to authenticated;

create policy appeals_read_own on public.appeals for select to authenticated
  using (author_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy appeals_insert_own on public.appeals for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    author_id = (select auth.uid())
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.moderation_actions a
      where a.id = action_id
        and a.target_user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and a.kind in ('hide', 'remove', 'warn', 'auto_hide')
        and a.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
    )
  );

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- push_subscriptions: owner only
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select (id, user_id, endpoint, zone_cell, radius_m, created_at) on public.push_subscriptions to authenticated;
grant insert (user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, zone_cell, zone_center, radius_m) on public.push_subscriptions to authenticated;
grant update (zone_cell, zone_center, radius_m) on public.push_subscriptions to authenticated;
grant delete on public.push_subscriptions to authenticated;

create policy push_read_own on public.push_subscriptions for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy push_insert_own on public.push_subscriptions for insert to authenticated
  with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()) and not public.is_banned());
create policy push_update_own on public.push_subscriptions for update to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid())) with check (user_id = (select auth.uid()));
create policy push_delete_own on public.push_subscriptions for delete to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()));

```

```sql
-- Neighbors Live — storage buckets, storage policies and scheduled jobs.

-- Both buckets are private. Reads go through short-lived signed URLs created server-side.
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
values
  ('raw-videos', 'raw-videos', false, 62914560, array['video/mp4', 'video/webm']),
  ('videos', 'videos', false, 62914560, array['video/mp4', 'image/jpeg'])
on conflict (id) do update
  set public = excluded.public,
      file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit,
      allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types;

-- Authors upload their single raw recording; nobody (but service_role) can read raw files.
create policy raw_videos_upload_own on storage.objects for insert to authenticated
  with check (bucket_id = 'raw-videos' and public.can_upload_raw(name));

-- TUS resumable uploads may update the object they are writing.
create policy raw_videos_update_own on storage.objects for update to authenticated
  using (bucket_id = 'raw-videos' and public.can_upload_raw(name))
  with check (bucket_id = 'raw-videos' and public.can_upload_raw(name));

-- Expire videos every 5 minutes.
select cron.schedule('expire-videos', '*/5 * * * *', $$select public.expire_videos()$$);

```

`supabase\migrations\20261025000500_merchant_review_conflict.sql`:

```sql
-- Prevent two administrators from deciding the same merchant application twice.
-- The row lock makes the pending-state check and transition atomic under concurrent requests.
create index if not exists moderation_actions_actor_created_idx
  on public.moderation_actions (actor_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists moderation_actions_kind_created_idx
  on public.moderation_actions (kind, created_at desc);

create or replace function public.admin_review_merchant(p_admin uuid, p_user uuid, p_approve boolean)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_status public.merchant_status;
begin
  if not public.is_admin(p_admin) then raise exception 'forbidden'; end if;

  select status into v_status
  from public.merchant_profiles
  where user_id = p_user
  for update;

  if not found then raise exception 'not_found'; end if;
  if v_status <> 'pending' then raise exception 'review_conflict'; end if;

  update public.merchant_profiles
  set status = case when p_approve then 'approved'::public.merchant_status else 'rejected'::public.merchant_status end,
      reviewed_by = p_admin
  where user_id = p_user;

  update public.profiles
  set role = case when p_approve then 'merchant'::public.user_role else 'user'::public.user_role end
  where id = p_user and role <> 'admin';
end
$$;
```


`supabase\tests\database\000_helpers.test.sql`:

```sql
-- Test helpers, created once per test run (local / CI databases only, never in production).
-- This file commits on purpose so that the following test files can use the helpers.
create extension if not exists pgtap with schema extensions;

create schema if not exists tests;
grant usage on schema tests to anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- Creates an auth user (the profile and settings rows come from the signup trigger).
create or replace function tests.create_user(p_username text, p_days_old integer default 30, p_reputation integer default 0)
returns uuid language plpgsql as $$
declare
  v_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
begin
  insert into auth.users (id, instance_id, aud, role, email, created_at, updated_at)
  values (v_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'authenticated', 'authenticated',
          p_username || '@test.local', now(), now());
  update public.profiles
  set username = p_username, created_at = now() - make_interval(days => p_days_old), reputation = p_reputation
  where id = v_id;
  return v_id;
end
$$;

create or replace function tests.authenticate_as(p_user uuid) returns void language plpgsql as $$
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_user, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
  perform set_config('role', 'authenticated', true);
end
$$;

create or replace function tests.authenticate_anon() returns void language plpgsql as $$
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role":"anon"}', true);
  perform set_config('role', 'anon', true);
end
$$;

create or replace function tests.clear_authentication() returns void language plpgsql as $$
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
  perform set_config('role', 'postgres', true);
end
$$;

-- Inserts a video directly (bypassing create_video), active by default.
create or replace function tests.make_video(
  p_author uuid,
  p_lat double precision default 48.8722,
  p_lng double precision default 2.3767,
  p_category public.video_category default 'deal',
  p_status public.video_status default 'active',
  p_cell text default '881fb46625fffff'
) returns uuid language plpgsql as $$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_point extensions.geography := extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(p_lng, p_lat), 4326)::extensions.geography;
begin
  insert into public.videos (author_id, category, caption, location, public_location, accuracy_m, h3_cell,
    realtime_cell, status, mime_type, duration_ms, video_path, poster_path, published_at, expires_at)
  values (p_author, p_category, 'test', v_point, v_point, 10, p_cell, '871fb4662ffffff', p_status,
    'video/mp4', 10000, 'demo/' || gen_random_uuid() || '.mp4', 'demo/poster.jpg',
    case when p_status = 'active' then now() end, now() + interval '1 day')
  returning id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end
$$;

grant execute on all functions in schema tests to anon, authenticated, service_role;

select plan(1);
select has_function('tests', 'create_user', array['text', 'integer', 'integer'], 'test helpers are installed');
select * from finish();

```

`supabase\tests\database\010_schema.test.sql`:

```sql
begin;
select no_plan();

-- Every table of the public schema has RLS enabled.
select is(
  (select array_agg(c.relname::text order by c.relname) from pg_class c
   join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
   where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and not c.relrowsecurity),
  null,
  'RLS is enabled on every public table'
);

select tables_are('public', array[
  'app_config', 'profiles', 'user_settings', 'merchant_profiles', 'videos', 'media_jobs',
  'notification_outbox', 'reactions', 'comments', 'reports', 'zone_moderators',
  'moderation_actions', 'appeals', 'push_subscriptions', 'rate_limits'
]);

select col_type_is('public', 'videos', 'location', 'extensions', 'geography(Point,4326)', 'location is geography(Point,4326)');
select has_index('public', 'videos', 'videos_location_gix', 'GIST index on location');
select has_index('public', 'videos', 'videos_public_location_gix', 'GIST index on public_location');

-- Exact position and storage paths are never readable by API roles.
select ok(not has_column_privilege('anon', 'public.videos', 'location', 'select'), 'anon cannot read videos.location');
select ok(not has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.videos', 'location', 'select'), 'authenticated cannot read videos.location');
select ok(not has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.videos', 'public_location', 'select'), 'public_location only through functions');
select ok(not has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.videos', 'video_path', 'select'), 'authenticated cannot read storage paths');
select ok(not has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.videos', 'accuracy_m', 'select'), 'authenticated cannot read accuracy');
select ok(not has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.push_subscriptions', 'zone_center', 'select'), 'push zone centre is write-only');
select ok(not has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.profiles', 'banned_at', 'select'), 'ban status is not exposed');

-- Service-only tables.
select ok(not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.media_jobs', 'select'), 'media_jobs hidden from users');
select ok(not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.notification_outbox', 'select'), 'outbox hidden from users');
select ok(not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.rate_limits', 'select'), 'rate_limits hidden from users');

-- Sensitive functions are not callable from the API.
select ok(not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.create_video(uuid, public.video_category, text, double precision, double precision, real, text, text, text, integer, timestamptz)', 'execute'), 'create_video is service-only');
select ok(not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.moderate_video(uuid, uuid, public.moderation_kind, text)', 'execute'), 'moderate_video is service-only');
select ok(not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.expire_videos()', 'execute'), 'expire_videos is service-only');
select ok(not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.export_my_data(uuid)', 'execute'), 'export_my_data is service-only');
select ok(has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.nearby_videos(double precision, double precision, integer, public.video_category, double precision, uuid, timestamptz, integer)', 'execute'), 'nearby_videos is public');

-- Private buckets and scheduled expiry.
select is((select count(*)::integer from storage.buckets where id in ('raw-videos', 'videos') and not public), 2, 'video buckets are private');
select is((select count(*)::integer from cron.job where jobname = 'expire-videos'), 1, 'expire_videos is scheduled with pg_cron');

-- Signup trigger creates profile + settings.
select tests.create_user('schema_user');
select is((select count(*)::integer from public.user_settings s join public.profiles p on p.id = s.user_id where p.username = 'schema_user'), 1, 'signup creates profile and settings');
select matches((select avatar_color from public.profiles where username = 'schema_user'), '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$', 'avatar colour generated');

select * from finish();
rollback;

```

`supabase\tests\database\020_rls.test.sql`:

```sql
-- Row Level Security, policy by policy, with anon / user / other user / banned user.
begin;
select no_plan();

-- Isolate from demo data (rolled back at the end of the file).
delete from public.videos;
delete from public.merchant_profiles;
delete from public.zone_moderators;

create temp table ids as
select tests.create_user('alice') as alice, tests.create_user('bob') as bob, tests.create_user('mallory') as mallory;
grant select on ids to anon, authenticated;
update public.profiles set banned_at = now() where id = (select mallory from ids);

create temp table vids as
select tests.make_video((select alice from ids)) as active_v,
       tests.make_video((select alice from ids), p_status => 'processing') as processing_v,
       tests.make_video((select alice from ids), p_status => 'hidden') as hidden_v,
       tests.make_video((select bob from ids)) as bob_v;
grant select on vids to anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- app_config
select tests.authenticate_anon();
select ok((select count(*) from public.app_config) > 0, 'app_config_read: anon reads config');
select throws_ok($$update public.app_config set value = '1'$$, '42501', null, 'app_config: no write for anon');
select tests.clear_authentication();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- profiles
select tests.authenticate_anon();
select is((select username from public.profiles where id = (select alice from ids)), 'alice', 'profiles_read: anon reads public profile');
select throws_ok($$select banned_at from public.profiles$$, '42501', null, 'profiles: banned_at not readable');
select tests.authenticate_as((select alice from ids));
update public.profiles set bio = 'Voisine du 20e' where id = (select alice from ids);
update public.profiles set bio = 'hacked' where id = (select bob from ids);
select throws_ok($$update public.profiles set reputation = 9999 where id = auth.uid()$$, '42501', null, 'profiles: reputation not writable by owner');
select throws_ok($$update public.profiles set role = 'admin' where id = auth.uid()$$, '42501', null, 'profiles: role not writable by owner');
select tests.clear_authentication();
select is((select bio from public.profiles where id = (select alice from ids)), 'Voisine du 20e', 'profiles_update_own: owner edits bio');
select is((select bio from public.profiles where id = (select bob from ids)), '', 'profiles_update_own: cannot edit someone else');
select tests.authenticate_as((select mallory from ids));
select throws_ok($$update public.profiles set bio = 'x' where id = auth.uid()$$, '42501', null, 'profiles_update_own: banned user cannot edit');
select tests.clear_authentication();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- user_settings
select tests.authenticate_as((select alice from ids));
select is((select count(*)::integer from public.user_settings), 1, 'user_settings_read_own: only own row visible');
update public.user_settings set default_radius = 3000;
select is((select default_radius from public.user_settings), 3000, 'user_settings_update_own: owner updates radius');
select throws_ok($$update public.user_settings set default_radius = 42$$, '23514', null, 'user_settings: radius constrained');
select tests.authenticate_anon();
select throws_ok($$select * from public.user_settings$$, '42501', null, 'user_settings: anon has no access');
select tests.clear_authentication();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- merchant_profiles
```

```sql
-- SQL functions: privacy of positions, feed, publication checks, rate limits, media jobs,

begin;

-- Isolate from demo data and from jobs left by e2e runs (rolled back at the end of the file).

create temp table u as

       tests.create_user('shop_owner') as shop, tests.create_user('nouveau') as fresh, tests.create_user('eve') as eve;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- public_point / bucket_distance
select ok(
  public.public_point('7b0f8f9e-6c2d-4c1a-9a51-3b6c1c3e2f10', 'SRID=4326;POINT(2.3767 48.8722)')
  = public.public_point('7b0f8f9e-6c2d-4c1a-9a51-3b6c1c3e2f10', 'SRID=4326;POINT(2.3767 48.8722)'),
  'public_point is deterministic');
select cmp_ok(
  extensions.st_distance(public.public_point(gen_random_uuid(), 'SRID=4326;POINT(2.3767 48.8722)'), 'SRID=4326;POINT(2.3767 48.8722)'::extensions.geography),
  '<', 60::double precision, 'public_point stays within ~50 m');
select ok(
  (select count(distinct extensions.st_astext(public.public_point(gen_random_uuid(), 'SRID=4326;POINT(2.3767 48.8722)')::extensions.geometry))
   from generate_series(1, 20)) > 10,
  'public_point offsets differ per video');
select is(public.bucket_distance(12), 100, 'bucket_distance floors at 100 m');
select is(public.bucket_distance(1049), 1000, 'bucket_distance rounds to 100 m');

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- nearby_videos
-- Belleville origin; videos at ~200 m, ~2 km, one hidden, one expired, one alert.
create temp table nv as
select tests.make_video((select carla from u), 48.8740, 2.3767) as near_v,
       tests.make_video((select carla from u), 48.8902, 2.3767) as far_v,
       tests.make_video((select carla from u), 48.8725, 2.3770, p_status => 'hidden') as hidden_v,
       tests.make_video((select carla from u), 48.8725, 2.3770, p_category => 'alert') as alert_v,
       tests.make_video((select carla from u), 48.8725, 2.3771) as expired_v;
update public.videos set expires_at = created_at + interval '1 second', status = 'active' where id = (select expired_v from nv);
update public.videos set created_at = now() - interval '1 hour', expires_at = now() - interval '1 minute' where id = (select expired_v from nv);
grant select on u, nv to anon, authenticated;

select tests.authenticate_anon();
select set_eq(
  $$select id from public.nearby_videos(48.8722, 2.3767, 300)$$,
  $$select unnest(array[(select near_v from nv), (select alert_v from nv)])$$,
  'nearby_videos: 300 m radius, active and unexpired only');
select ok(
  (select bool_or(id = (select far_v from nv)) from public.nearby_videos(48.8722, 2.3767, 3000)),
  'nearby_videos: far video inside 3 km');
select ok(
  not exists (select 1 from public.nearby_videos(48.8722, 2.3767, 1000) where id = (select far_v from nv)),
  'nearby_videos: far video outside 1 km');
select set_eq(
  $$select id from public.nearby_videos(48.8722, 2.3767, 3000, 'alert')$$,

  'nearby_videos: category filter');
select ok(

select throws_ok($$select * from public.nearby_videos(48.8722, 2.3767, 5000)$$, 'radius_invalid');

select cmp_ok(
  (select extensions.st_distance(
     extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(n.public_lng, n.public_lat), 4326)::extensions.geography, v.location)
   from public.nearby_videos(48.8722, 2.3767, 300) n join public.videos v on v.id = n.id
   where n.id = (select near_v from nv)),
  '>', 0::double precision, 'nearby_videos: returned point is not the exact position');

-- Cursor pagination over 25 videos: no duplicate, no gap.

  (select score from pages where page = 1 order by score, id limit 1),

select is((select count(distinct id)::integer from pages), (select count(*)::integer from pages), 'cursor pagination has no duplicates');

returns uuid language sql as $$
  select public.create_video(p_user, p_cat, 'Coucou', p_lat, p_lng, 12, '881fb46625fffff', '871fb4662ffffff',

$$;
```
